  • Competitive Base Pay

SUMMARY

An Ophthalmic Technician is a valuable asset to an Ophthalmologist as they assist in providing excellent patient care to the patients during their visit. This employee is able to handle a wide range of duties while using equipment to perform the initial testing needed to prepare a patient for an exam with an Ophthalmologist.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide exceptional customer service during every patient encounter (in person or via phone)
  • Display a professional attitude, greet patients promptly with a smile, and thank them when they leave
  • Anticipate Physician needs to facilitate the flow of the clinic
  • Practice urgency at all times with patient’s time, as well as doctor’s time and schedule
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including HIPAA
  • Verify patient’s information by interviewing patient
  • Record patient’s medical history and current medications and confirm purpose of visit
  • Record all data in the patient's Electronic Medical Record (EMR)
  • Check condition of patient's eyes by observing pupils, muscles, visual acuity, and extraocular movements
  • Required skills include: dilation, refraction, pressures, and performing a variety of diagnostic tests including visual fields, OCT, GDX, IOL master, auto refractor and topography
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of eye anatomy, diseases, symptoms and ocular medications
  • Accurately and thoroughly document medical visits and procedures as they are being performed by the Physician
  • Prepare patients for treatments and minor procedures; measure and record vital signs (blood pressure, pulse, and respiration rate) as required
  • Open and close exam rooms as needed
  • Keep examination, treatment, laser and any other assigned rooms cleaned and stocked with supplies, and keep drug count up to date.
  • General office duties and cleaning to be assigned by manager

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Provides excellent patient care and is energetic and empathetic with patients
  • Must comply with HIPAA confidentiality standards when communicating patient information
  • Communication skills and the ability to coordinate and cooperate with all levels of employees in a courteous, professional manner at all times
  • Organizational skills with focus on tracking patient care and improving patient flow
  • Desire to gain industry knowledge and training
  • Demonstrates initiative in accomplishing practice goals
  • Ability to grow, adapt, and accept change
  • Consistently creates a positive work environment by being team-oriented and patient-focused
  • Commitment to work over 40 hours to meet the needs of the business
  • Ability to work weekends when applicable
  • Reliable transportation that would allow employee to go to multiple work locations with minimal notice

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum Required: High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required
  • Minimum Required: One year of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

LICENSES AND CREDENTIALS

  • Current Certified Ophthalmic Assistant (COA) or Certified Ophthalmic Technician (COT) certification is preferred, but not required

SYSTEMS AND TECHNOLOGY

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
  • Experience using Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems
  • Computer proficiency and ability to quickly learn new applications

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This role requires a variety of physical activities to effectively perform essential job functions. The position involves frequent walking (75%), sitting (50%), and standing (50%), with regular bending, stooping, and reaching (25–50%). Employees must be able to lift, carry, push, and pull items up to 25 lbs. Strong fine motor skills and full use of hands are essential, as the role demands constant grasping, writing/typing, and use of technology. Visual and auditory acuity—including color, depth, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus—is required 100% of the time. Occasional driving or climbing may also be necessary.

title: Carbon Footprint Analyst
description:
About the Company

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

Key Responsibilities

  • Calculate and deliver Scope 3 GHG emissions estimations to support materiality assessments and disclosures.

  • Develop and maintain Scope 3 GHG emissions estimation methodologies and resources

  • Provide technical support on product carbon footprinting models, methodologies, reporting and verification for United States and international locations.

  • Calculate and deliver product carbon footprints to meet business and commercial needs.

  • Develop and maintain product carbon footprinting models and resources

  • Lead reviews of asset product carbon footprint models, data submissions, standard operating procedures, and data quality assessments.

  • Coordinate product carbon footprinting reviews with assets.

  • Provide technical support on company carbon intensity metrics data collection, methodologies, reporting, and verification

  • Calculate and deliver company carbon intensity metrics for disclosures.

  • Develop and maintain carbon intensity metric resources (e.g., standard operating procedures).

  • Support carbon intensity metric reviews, substantiation, methodology updates, and forecasting.

  • Support third-party assurance of GHG emissions, product carbon footprints, and carbon intensity metrics

  • Deliver general training on GHG emissions, product carbon footprints, and carbon intensity metrics

  • Monitor and review emerging GHG accounting and product carbon footprinting regulations, standards, and best practices to assess business impacts, develop internal viewpoints, prepare responses, and support implementation.

  • Collaborate with health, environment and safety specialists, operations/maintenance personnel, engineering, finance, supply chain, and other key stakeholders to gather data and ensure accurate calculation, reporting and verification of GHG emissions, product carbon footprints and carbon intensity metrics.

  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders.

  • Support further improvements in enterprise GHG, PCF and carbon intensity metric data integrity, timely reporting and data transparency.

  • Support development, maintenance and improvements to digital tools needed for GHG and product carbon footprinting accounting/reporting.

  • Support assets in United States and international locations with GHG/air compliance programs as needed (e.g., CARB Large Spark Ignition, Clean Truck Check, and Off-Road (Diesel) Regulation programs)

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, or related field

  • Experience with GHG emissions estimation for the energy / oil and gas industry

  • Experience and familiarity with GHG Protocol Scope 3 Standard and emissions estimation

  • Experience and familiarity with GHG Protocol Scope 1 and 2 Standards and emissions estimation

  • Experience and familiarity with life cycle carbon accounting and reporting standards / methodologies

  • Experience with GHG reporting / disclosures and Environmental Social Governance (ESG)

  • Leadership, communication, strategic thinking, and program/project management skills

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, motivate self, influence without authority, and provide mentoring/training to end users.

  • Strong Microsoft Office application skills especially using Excel , PowerBI

  • Ability to accommodate work schedule to collaborate with colleagues in other time zones

  • Minimal to no travel required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (e.g., masters) in environmental science, engineering, or related field

  • Multiple years (3+) experience with Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions estimation and reporting

  • Multiple years (3+) experience with life cycle assessment and/or product carbon footprinting

  • Multiple years (3+) experience working with or in the oil and gas industry

  • Experience using, developing and improving environmental datasets, processes, and digital tools

  • Experience with SharePoint and PowerBI

  • Knowledge of industry best practices, global standards, and emerging regulations

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

title: Systems Engineer II
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

We are seeking a highly motivated Systems Engineer who will be responsible for supporting and maintaining our global enterprise. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow your skills in a dynamic, remote environment. The successful candidate will be a dedicated, hardworking individual with a drive for success, looking to bring their skillset to help support and drive our organization forward. Successful hire will work hybrid schedule with 2 days/week in our Minneapolis North Loop office.

Your Impact

Identity & Access Management (IAM):

  • Administer and maintain our enterprise Okta tenant, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), SAML 2.0, and OIDC integrations.
  • Implement and manage automated provisioning and de-provisioning workflows using SCIM and Okta Workflows, bridging our core HRIS (e.g., Workday) with downstream systems.
  • Audit and manage role-based access control (RBAC), security groups, and identity governance policies.

Microsoft 365 & Cloud Endpoint Administration:

  • Manage and optimize core Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams.
  • Support modern endpoint management via Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) for Windows, macOS, and mobile devices, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployments.
  • Plan, test, and implement routine platform maintenance, service updates, and security baselines.

Slack Enterprise Grid Administration & Collaboration:

  • Administer our Slack enterprise grid environment, including workspace architecture, user access, retention policies, and security configurations.
  • Review, approve, deploy, and maintain Slack third-party apps, custom bots, and integrations across business workflows.
  • Leverage Slack Workflow Builder and webhook integrations to automate operational alerts and cross-functional team processes.

Cross-System Integrations & Process Automation:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust API- and script-driven integrations connecting M365, Okta, Slack, HRIS, and other enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Develop, maintain, and schedule PowerShell scripts and API automation (Microsoft Graph, Okta APIs, Slack APIs) to eliminate manual administration and streamline joiner/mover/leaver (JML) processes.

Operational Health, Monitoring & Escalations:

  • Monitor infrastructure and SaaS services using IT Operations Management (ITOM) and observability tools to proactively detect outages, latency, or integration failures.
  • Manage and triage incident/request queues, acting as a Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex identity, messaging, and system integration issues.
  • Create, maintain, and standardize comprehensive engineering runbooks, architectural diagrams, and support documentation.

Your Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in a Systems Engineer, Systems Administrator, or IAM Engineer role supporting enterprise-scale SaaS and cloud environments.
  • Okta Administration: Proven hands-on experience configuring Okta SSO, SCIM provisioning, Okta Workflows, and integrating Okta with HR systems (e.g., Workday) and enterprise SaaS targets.
  • Microsoft 365 Administration: Deep technical working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft Intune.
  • Slack Administration: Practical experience administering Slack in a corporate environment, including user lifecycle management, app directory governance, and native/API integrations.
  • Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting proficiency with PowerShell and experience interacting with RESTful APIs (JSON, cURL, Graph API, Webhooks).
  • Protocols & Standards: Solid understanding of modern authentication and directory protocols (SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, DNS).
  • Operations & Ticketing: Demonstrated experience managing ticket queues (e.g., Jira Service Management, ServiceNow), managing incident escalations, and working with ITOM monitoring platforms.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate with global stakeholders and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Haves

  • Okta Certified Administrator or Okta Certified Developer.
  • Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), or Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102).
  • Slack Certified Admin.
  • AI Tooling & MCP Engineering: Experience leveraging Enterprise AI tools and modern command-line utilities to accelerate scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation, combined with hands-on experience building, containerizing, or extending custom MCP servers/tools, integrating LLM APIs into corporate IT workflows, or orchestrating multi-agent systems.
  • Advanced IAM Knowledge: Exposure to Okta Identity Governance (IGA), Inline Hooks, or event-driven automation.
  • Advanced Automation: Experience with Python, Bash, or infrastructure-as-code/automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Power Automate).
  • A bias for action, continuous improvement mindset, and a strong problem-solving orientation.
Base Salary Range:
$106,000—$152,000 USD

Job Summary

The Audio-Visual Production Specialist supports live production in boardroom environments. This individual assists with audiovisual elements during meetings, including PTZ camera operation, live switching, and basic audio support, helping ensure each meeting runs smoothly and professionally. The primary focus of this role is executing day-to-day AV production tasks under the guidance of senior team members. Additional post-production support may be required on an as-needed basis.

Additional Job Duties

  • Supports live audiovisual production for boardroom meetings, executive sessions, and other events as assigned
  • Assists in maintaining and organizing the A/V production environment and equipment
  • Stays current with basic AV tools and best practices relevant to daily responsibilities
  • Assists with video production tasks and workflows under the direction of senior staff
  • Supports corporate communications with other creative productions such as podcasts and videos, as assigned
  • Operates remote PTZ cameras, video switchers, audio consoles, and signal processing equipment under supervision to deliver quality output
  • Monitors audio and video quality throughout live sessions and flags issues to senior staff
  • Assists in troubleshooting technical issues during meetings, escalating as needed
  • Supports live graphics, lower thirds, and presentation content during productions
  • Prepares, tests, and verifies equipment, cabling, and signal flow prior to live events
  • Participates in pre-show walkthroughs and technical rehearsals to confirm system readiness
  • Assists with configuration and upkeep of AV equipment including displays, projectors, microphones, and conferencing systems
  • Coordinates with IT and facilities teams as directed to support network and infrastructure needs
  • Communicates with stakeholders and meeting facilitators to gather basic technical requirements
  • Communicates clearly with on-site and remote team members during live productions
  • Assists with post-production tasks including video editing, file management, and content archiving as needed
  • Performs routine maintenance, inspections, and inventory management of AV equipment
  • Documents technical configurations, equipment settings, and event rundowns as directed
  • Maintains a clean, organized, and professional technical workspace

Experience

  • Requires minimum 2 years job related work experience

  • Requires basic familiarity with PTZ camera systems, live switching, and audio workflows

Education

  • Requires high school diploma or equivalent; associate's degree in Audio/Visual Technology, Broadcasting, Film/Media Production, or related field preferred
  • Or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge

With your extraordinary knowledge and incomparable integrity, we know that clients invest their trust in you.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

  • FINRA Series 7 & 66 licenses required or ability to acquire Series 66 upon hire
  • Hold appropriate state registrations
  • Professional designation (CFP) preferred
  • Minimum 7 years of financial relationship management experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Deep understanding of managed account industry and Fidelity’s managed offerings
  • Broad-based knowledge and understanding of financial planning, investments, global economics, and the determinants of market movements
  • Deep understanding of asset allocation, tax planning, and estate planning to service each client's distinct investment needs
  • Demonstrated success in strong needs-based consultative sales skills and client/book management skills
  • Excellent time management, organizational, and phone communication skills, coupled with strong decision-making abilities and sound judgment
  • Ability to leverage expertise in the managed money industry and Fidelity's product line, including existing and emerging offerings, to deliver solutions aligned with client needs
  • Able to handle a book of 850 clients and approximately $500MM in Portfolio Advisory Services (PAS) AUM
  • Participate in joint phone calls with Financial Consultants and clients during Annual Strategic Reviews, presenting recommendations, supporting retention and at-risk client discussions, and identifying additional sales opportunities
  • Conduct pre- and post-sales conversations with clients, establishing expectations on performance, fees, portfolio construction, rebalancing and reallocation strategies
  • Demonstrated effective practice management capabilities and consultative selling skills to handle a book of business on behalf of Fidelity Wealth and Workplace Advisors, utilizing internal support resources
  • Effective profiling, funding, investing procedures, risk mitigation and compliance oversight
  • Ability to engage clients in response to their needs while leveraging strong practice management skills

The Team

The Investment Management Consultant II is part of Fidelity’s Portfolio Advisory Services group, which operates within our Wealth business unit. We are leading providers of investment management, retirement planning, family conversations, portfolio guidance, brokerage, benefits outsourcing, and many other financial products and services. We believe in building relationships, not just in building sales or building our assets. After all, our clients will place their investments, their savings, and their futures in your hands. You will work with them personally to help achieve their dreams – whether that’s saving for college, for retirement, for a big vacation, or anything else. It is a serious responsibility and it’s why we’ll surround you with amazing, supportive people and all the tools you need. Join a team that also invests in you with key product and service offerings, sophisticated technology, and an elite investment platform. title: Associate Director,  PDS Communications, Product Development & External Manufacturing
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Reporting to the Director, CTDO & Global PDS Operations, the Associate Director, Product Development & External Manufacturing Communications, is responsible for developing and executing strategic communications initiatives that support Bristol Myers Squibb's Product Development (PD) and External Manufacturing (ExM) organizations within Product Development & Supply (PDS). This role serves as a trusted communications advisor to senior leaders, translating complex scientific, technical, operational, and organizational priorities into compelling communications that engage employees, strengthen enterprise reputation, and support business objectives.

The role encompasses both the innovation-focused Product Development organization, which advances therapies from discovery through clinical development and market approval, and the newly integrated External Manufacturing organization, which manages strategic partnerships across Bristol Myers Squibb's global CDMO and CMO network spanning clinical development through commercial manufacturing. The Associate Director will help communicate how these organizations accelerate patient access to medicines through innovation, development excellence, external partnerships, manufacturing readiness, and operational execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute integrated internal and external communications strategies that support Product Development and External Manufacturing priorities, aligned with broader PDS and enterprise objectives.

  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of Product Development, including supply chain, analytical sciences, development analytics, chemical process development, CMC strategy, technology transfer, and product commercialization pathways, translating complex technical concepts into clear and compelling communications.

  • Develop expertise in the evolving External Manufacturing model, and help articulate how ExM enables clinical development, commercialization, launch readiness, supply reliability, operational excellence, and strategic growth.

  • Provide strategic communications counsel to Product Development and External Manufacturing leadership teams, helping leaders communicate organizational priorities, change initiatives, business strategy, and key decisions effectively.

  • Support development and execution of organizational communications programs that foster employee engagement, organizational alignment, and culture-building across globally distributed and matrixed teams through town halls, leadership forums, videos, employee campaigns, and digital channels.

  • Partner with leaders to develop speeches, presentations, remarks, executive communications, and leadership messaging for high-profile internal and external engagements.

  • Identify and execute proactive storytelling opportunities that highlight innovation in product development, patient-centric design, scientific advancement, manufacturing readiness, external partnerships, and operational excellence across the product lifecycle.

  • Manage external communications initiatives that strengthen the reputation of Product Development and External Manufacturing through media relations, digital and social content, industry conferences, thought leadership opportunities, awards programs, and strategic announcements.

  • Support communications associated with major organizational initiatives, including operating model changes, organizational evolution, digital transformation efforts, strategic partnerships, network changes, and business integrations.

  • Provide communications support for change management activities associated with the evolving External Manufacturing organization as it brings together capabilities spanning clinical and commercial manufacturing into a more integrated enterprise model.

  • Monitor industry, manufacturing, development, supply chain, and competitive trends to identify communications risks, opportunities, and emerging issues relevant to Product Development and External Manufacturing.

  • Manage issues and special situations that may affect Product Development, External Manufacturing, or broader PDS operations, helping protect enterprise reputation and stakeholder trust.

  • Lead communications workstreams with agency partners and cross-functional collaborators across Corporate Affairs and other enterprise functions.

  • Actively pursue and participate in professional development opportunities as part of a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

  • Work collaboratively across Corporate Affairs and PDS Communications to support a high-performance culture, drive enterprise objectives, and deliver measurable communications outcomes.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Approximately 7 to 10 years of communications experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, life sciences, manufacturing, healthcare, or related industries, or a combination of professional experience that provides an equivalent foundation.

  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in communications, public relations, journalism, business, life sciences, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated ability to counsel and influence senior leaders in a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Experience supporting scientific, technical, manufacturing, supply chain, operational, or business functions is preferred.

  • Exceptional writing, presentation, storytelling, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Strong ability to translate complex scientific, operational, or technical information into clear and engaging content for diverse audiences.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, operate independently, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.

  • Experience supporting organizational change, transformation, or business integration initiatives preferred.

  • Proficiency with digital communications platforms, content development, and social media channels.

  • Understanding of ethical and effective use of generative AI in communications, content development, and employee engagement.

title: School Based Mental Health Clinician
location: FSW Mount Vernon Clinic - Mount Vernon, NY 10550
description:
Open Door Care Network provides health care and wellness programs to individuals and families in need throughout Westchester, Putnam and Ulster Counties. A pioneer Federally Qualified Health Center, Open Door provides more than 300,000 patient visits annually and serves nearly 60,000 individual patients who might not otherwise have access. Open Door offers integrated services and a holistic approach to building healthier communities. Primary medical care, dental care, integrated behavioral health care, clinical nutrition, wellness programs, and chronic disease management are the foundation of its clinical programs.

Founded as a free clinic in 1972, Open Door’s mission of building healthier communities through accessible, equitable, culturally competent health care has led to site and service expansions. Today, Open Door operates centers in Brewster, Mamaroneck, Mount Kisco, Ossining, Port Chester, and Sleepy Hollow, in addition to eight School-Based Health Centers in the Port Chester and Ossining School Districts, a mobile dental van in Mount Kisco, and a new dental practice in Saugerties, NY. For more information, please visit our website at .

Open Door is seeking a School Based Mental Health Clinician to work in our Mount Vernon, NY Schools. The School Based Mental Health Clinician responsibility is to provide direct clinical mental health services to patients of all ages, with the goal of providing high quality, culturally competent, accessible, and integrated healthcare. They will also provide individual, couple, family treatment for children, adolescents, adults, and families.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide individual, family, and group counseling based on clinical diagnosis and assessment of the clients’ presenting problems within an outpatient mental health setting.
  • Accurately document all clinical interventions, diagnoses, symptoms, and presenting problems in the Electronic Medical Record
  • Provide high-quality evidence-based treatment using a variety of modalities including trauma systems therapy and substance use disorder interventions.
  • Participate in weekly supervision, multi-disciplinary team meetings, service training programs.
  • Provide crisis counseling, linkages to concrete and wraparound service, and coordinate with other providers to better serve the needs of students and families.
  • Require independent knowledge and judgment related to complex situations.
  • Document clinical symptoms, presenting problem, symptoms impact on functioning and interventions that are consistent with diagnosis.
  • Work with patient to develop treatment plan goals and objectives for treatment of mental health, substance use disorders and co-occurring disorders.
  • Provides ongoing communication with other care providers including PCP regarding patients care needs.
  • Incorporate health and wellness education and referrals for preventative care.
  • Respond to and incorporates physical health concerns into ongoing care interventions.
  • Provide crisis intervention and warm hand off assessments as needed.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality at all times as per Open Door policies and procedures.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation in compliance with JCAHO standards and applicable city, state, and federal laws.
  • Demonstrate ability to function in a culturally sensitive manner within the organization’s philosophy and mission.
  • Foster good communication between the center and the community by returning all patient telephone requests.
  • Ensure timely communication: responding timely to emails, teams, calls, and electronic health record communication.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • EDUCATION: Master’s Degree from an accredited graduate school in Social Work, Mental Health Counseling, or Marriage and Family Therapy (MSW, MHC, or MFT)
  • LMSW, LMHC, or LMFT preferred with current New York State registration and license as a Licensed Master of Social Work (LMSW) or corresponding degree or limited permit.
  • CASAC a plus

EXPERIENCE

  • Excellent clinical experience with mentally ill, substance abuse afflicted population.
  • Must have experience with providing clinical services to children and families, preferably in the health care field.
  • Passionate about providing high-quality care to low-income, underserved residents in a mental health setting.
  • Desire to work in underserved communities.
  • Outstanding clinical, assessment, and diagnostic skills
  • Proficient in the use of computers, and specifically with electronic medical records
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a culturally diverse population
  • Team-focused collaborator
  • Excellent interpersonal skills both verbally and in writing
  • Highly organized, self–directed.
  • Engaged in learning and continuous quality improvement.
  • Resilient
  • Desire to provide quality care for our patients; to be compassionate, understanding, energetic, organized, self-motivated, and creative problem-solver.
  • Solid clinical experience with mentally ill, substance misuse impacted population.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based treatment modalities, crisis management
  • Working knowledge of electronic records.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills (writing, oral and active listening).
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and culturally diverse setting.
  • Facilitate referrals to appropriate treatment settings for mental health, psychiatric and substance use disorder needs when care is unable to be provided at ODFMC.
  • Strong computer skills including working knowledge in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint as well as capacity to navigate and enhance proficiency in these and other software systems.
  • Thorough knowledge of current social work and mental health practices.
  • Experience in or desire to work with lower socio-economic and multi-stressed families.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent contact with patients, employees, and outside agencies.
  • Frequent exposure to communicable diseases and other conditions common to a health center environment.
  • Requires adherence to Infection Control Standard Precautions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Combination of sitting, standing, and walking
  • Requires independent knowledge and judgment related to complex situations.

There are many fantastic benefits to a career at Open Door Care Network. In addition to working to effect positive change in the health and lives of thousands of residents in our communities, Open Door offers its employees a stimulating, diverse and team-based work environment with comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, life insurance, flexible spending accounts, 401(k), generous paid time off, and educational assistance. Aside from excellent benefits, we offer a competitive salary and annual bonuses based on organizational and individual objectives.

title: Blending Technician
description:
At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role: Blending Technician

As a Technician, Bio/Pharm Production, you will support vaccine manufacturing operations by setting up, operating, and troubleshooting production equipment. In this role, you’ll be responsible for safely producing vaccines in accordance with product specifications, current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) standards, safety requirements, and site procedures while incorporating continuous improvement initiatives such as LEAN.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Perform aseptic production activities including weighing, measuring, calculations, sampling, and verifications in accordance with batch production records and cGMP requirements.

  • Set up, operate, and troubleshoot production equipment and ensure equipment, instruments, and materials are released and available for use.

  • Oversee production processes, cleaning, environmental monitoring, and perform in-process batch quality checks according to written procedures.

  • Complete required production documentation, update standard operating procedures (SOPs), write deviation reports, and perform transactions within electronic inventory management systems.

  • Support continuous improvement by identifying and contributing ideas to improve workplace processes, quality, safety, and operational effectiveness.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Microbiology or a related field; OR Associate’s Degree plus 2 years of relevant experience; OR High School Diploma/GED plus 4 years of relevant experience.

  • Experience: Basic knowledge and understanding of manufacturing and biological production processes, including biological equipment such as fermentation, centrifuge, and concentration units.

  • Skills: Ability to read, interpret, and follow batch records, quality and safety requirements; basic computer skills including Word, Excel, electronic management systems, and applicable ERP systems.

  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Elanco does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B or TN status) for this position.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):

  • Knowledge of aseptic manufacturing processes and cGMP requirements.

  • Experience with production equipment and biological manufacturing processes.

  • Experience with SOPs, deviation reporting, and electronic documentation systems.

  • Strong quality orientation, analytical thinking, and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and continuous improvement initiatives such as LEAN.

title: Broista – Fayetteville, NC
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

But let’s be real, this job isn’t for everyone. It’s fast, high-energy, and physically demanding.   • Team-oriented and ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.

title: Project Manager, IT and Business Portfolio (12-month contract)
description:

The CIB’s mission is to work with provincial, territorial, municipal, federal, Indigenous and private sector investor partners to transform the way infrastructure is planned, financed and delivered in Canada.

We are seeking a Project Manager to deliver a mixed portfolio of technology and business projects at the CIB. This role requires strong project management discipline combined with the ability to partner with technical teams, business stakeholders and senior leadership to deliver measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in mixed environments—from technology implementations and system upgrades to business process improvement and organizational change initiatives—while maintaining governance, transparency and delivery excellence.

Your responsibilities include:

Project Delivery and Execution

Stakeholder and Leadership Engagement

Governance and Portfolio Management

Risk, Issue and Change Management

  • Proactively identify risks and issues; develop mitigation and contingency plans
  • Manage scope changes through formal change control processes
  • Drive resolution of complex issues involving multiple stakeholders or functions

Financial and Vendor Management

  • Manage project budgets, forecasts and vendor contracts
  • Track actual vs. planned spend and support financial reviews
  • Oversee vendor performance and ensure contractual deliverables are met

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to PMO maturity, process improvements and best practices

Your ideal profile:

  • 5+ years of experience managing mixed portfolios of IT and business projects
  • Proven experience delivering:
    • IT projects (e.g., system implementations, upgrades, integrations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data initiatives)
    • Business projects (e.g., process optimization, operational change, regulatory, transformation initiatives)
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid)
  • Experience working within a PMO or structured governance environment
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP or equivalent project management certification
  • Agile certification (CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP), an asset
  • Experience working in matrixed or cross-functional organizations
  • Familiarity with portfolio management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps)

Key Competencies and Attributes

  • Strong business acumen and strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Structured, organized and detail-oriented with a strategic mindset
  • Confident communicator who can collaborate and influence across functions without authority
  • Calm and effective under pressure and ambiguity
  • Results-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

We thank you for your interest. Only those selected for further screening or an interview will be contacted.

description:

Interns will have the opportunity to work on a variety of applications and projects that directly impact the global trading ecosystem. In the past, our interns have worked on building cloud infrastructure, enhancing market architecture, designing AI agents, and taking ownership of new applications that can change the trading lifecycle. title: Director of Orchestral Activities
description: Why Concordia? At Concordia College, faculty are part of a close-knit academic community committed to excellent teaching, meaningful student relationships, and preparing students to influence the affairs of the world. Faculty have the opportunity to engage students both in and beyond the classroom, collaborate with colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to a campus community where teaching, scholarship, service, and mentorship are valued. Located in Moorhead, Minnesota, Concordia offers the opportunity to build a rewarding academic career in a community centered on learning, purpose, and connection. About the Appointment: Concordia College seeks a Director of Orchestral Activities for a full-time, tenure-track appointment at the rank of Assistant or Associate Professor beginning August 2027. The position offers the opportunity for a talented conductor to lead an orchestra that has garnered a reputation for award-winning musical quality at state, national, and international conferences, festivals, and competitions. The successful candidate will demonstrate the capacity to nurture and maintain a reputation of excellence as a conductor, musician, and educator and will be responsible for the artistic leadership of the Concordia Orchestra, including programming, rehearsing, and performing. The Director of Orchestral Activities will collaborate on yearly projects with the Concordia choral ensembles, including the Christmas Concert and Masterworks; collaborate effectively with instrumental faculty and the conductor of Symphonia Orchestra; coordinate with staff to plan the logistical details of performances, including international touring and the annual domestic tours of the Concordia Orchestra; and organize the annual student concerto competition. The successful candidate will display teaching excellence in both ensemble and classroom settings with major and non-major musicians within a liberal arts environment and serve in a collegial manner within the department and across the college. The position requires a candidate who is a strong recruiter for both the Music Department and the College. The Director of Orchestral Activities will work closely with the Concordia Enrollment Office and the applied music faculty studios on recruitment endeavors, including nurturing strong and vibrant relationships with school orchestra programs throughout the region. The candidate will also be responsible for the artistic leadership of the annual Honor String Orchestra for promising high school students. An additional teaching assignment may include courses in the Orchestral Conducting Certificate Program, Instrumental Conducting, Music Education, Master of Music Education program, courses in the candidate's area of expertise, and/or departmental need. For more information about this position and to apply, please visit https://www.concordiacollege.edu/employment . Concordia College is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. International work visa sponsorship is not available for this position. A criminal background check will be completed before hire. With questions, please contact Dr. Peter Haberman, Search Committee Chair, phaberma@cord.edu. Materials to apply include a cover letter, curriculum vita, easily accessible web links to rehearsal and performance videos, and a video of teaching outside of rehearsal. Also include three letters of recommendation and contact information for an additional three references (including name, phone number, and email address). Supplemental materials may be solicited later in the search process (audio recordings, programs, etc.). About the Department: Concordia College is NASM accredited, and the Music Department enjoys a thriving and growing student population with nearly 200 music majors in music education, performance, and composition, due in part to its excellent reputation throughout the region. The department is the single largest on campus, with more than 30 faculty and over one-quarter of the entire student body participating in vocal and instrumental lessons and ensembles. Many graduates pursue careers in music education, where the post-graduation employment rate is extremely high, while others pursuegraduate degrees at leading national institutions and/or careers in performing or creative activity. The instrumental music program includes three concert bands, two orchestras, three jazz bands and a combo, chamber ensembles, and a number of other opportunities for students to engage with music as part of their undergraduate experience. In addition to Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Music degrees, the department also offers a Master of Music in Music Education. About Concordia and the Fargo-Moorhead Community Concordia College is a private liberal arts college of approximately 2,000 undergraduate students located in Moorhead, Minnesota, part of the vibrant Fargo-Moorhead metropolitan community of approximately 250,000 people. Home to a thriving higher education community, the region offers the welcoming feel of a smaller community with the cultural, recreational, and professional opportunities of a growing metropolitan area. Fargo-Moorhead is a regional hub for education, healthcare, business, and the arts, with an active downtown, a strong entrepreneurial community, and easy access to Minnesota lakes country. Concordia's location offers faculty the opportunity to build meaningful connections both on campus and throughout a dynamic and engaged community. Learn more about Concordia College at https://www.concordiacollege.edu .

title: Director, Web Experience Design (Remote)
description:
We believe in the power and joy of learning

At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping learners around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

As the Director Web Experience Design, you will shape the vision and design strategy for Cengage’s web ecosystem, creating modern, compelling experiences that connect customers with our products, services, and learning experiences.

Lead and mentor a dedicated design team, setting a high bar for experience quality, visual craft, and measurable impact. Grounded in customer understanding, behavioral data, experimentation, and business insights, drive continuous improvement across discovery, engagement, ecommerce, and conversion—reducing friction, testing new ideas, and creating differentiated experiences that deliver value for customers and the business.

Job Responsibilities

As the Director, Web Experience Design, you will:

  • Set the vision for Cengage’s web experience, establishing a clear UX/UI strategy for how our websites help customers discover, understand, evaluate, purchase, and engage with Cengage products and services.

  • Make experimentation central to how we design, partnering with Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Engineering to develop hypotheses, rapidly prototype ideas, run A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Advance ecommerce and conversion experiences, continually improving and other high-value conversion moments.

  • Design across the full customer journey, creating coherent experiences across acquisition, exploration, consideration, purchase, onboarding, and engagement.

  • Use data to identify and prioritize opportunities, combining qualitative research with behavioral analytics, funnel performance, experimentation results, conversion metrics, and other signals.

  • Build a culture of continuous optimization, moving beyond one-time redesigns toward an iterative model in which experiences are continually measured, tested, learned from, and improved.

  • Stay ahead of evolving web and design practices, including AI-enabled experiences, personalization, emerging interaction patterns, ecommerce innovation, experimentation methods, accessibility, and new design and development technologies.

  • Develop outstanding talent by coaching and mentoring designers, strengthening UX and UI craft, building commercial and analytical fluency, developing future design leaders, and creating an environment where teams can do their best work.

Requirements

To be considered for this role, you have:

  • Proven experience in a senior Web Experience Design role, including 3+ years of people management experience leading and developing high-performing design teams.

  • Strong experience with ecommerce, growth, conversion optimization, or other transactional digital experiences, with an understanding of how design influences customer behavior and business performance.

  • Deep expertise in UX and UI design principles, human-centered design methodologies, interaction and visual design, information architecture, accessibility, responsive design, research-informed practices, and modern digital design processes.

  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, articulate a compelling experience vision, and connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • A portfolio is required to be considered for this position.

Cengage is committed to working with broad talent pools to attract and hire strong and most qualified individuals. Our job applicants are considered regardless of any classification protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local laws.

Cengage, a global education technology company serving millions of learners, provides affordable, quality digital products and services that equip students with the skills and competencies needed to be job ready. For more than 100 years, we have enabled the power and joy of learning with trusted, engaging content, and now, integrated digital platforms. We serve the higher education, workforce skills, secondary education, English language teaching and research markets worldwide. Through our scalable technology, including MindTap and Cengage Unlimited, we support all learners who seek to improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

title: Cafe Specialist
description:
Cafe Specialist

The Arizona Humane Society is seeking a dedicated and motivated full-time Cafe Specialist to join our Café team at our Papago Park Campus. This role offers a 4 10 - hour shift schedule. If you're a talented professional eager to make a difference, we'd love for you to keep reading!

Paws Up For Great Benefits!

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous PTO program
  • Up to 8 paid holidays per year
  • 401(k) with employer contribution
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Plans
  • Got student loans? Employment with AHS may qualify you for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program!
  • Discounts on veterinary services and other pet perks!

A Day in the Life:

The Cafe Specialist is responsible for opening and closing duties, operating both the hot and cold service lines, and preparing drinks and menu items according to standardized recipes and procedures. This role also operates the point-of-sale (POS) system to accurately create and close customer transactions, handles cash responsibly, maintains knowledge of all menu items and promotions, and delivers exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate is adaptable, responds quickly to changing priorities, and thrives in a fast-paced environment while meeting the evolving needs of both the organization and its customers.

Job Requirements:

  • High school diploma/GED required.
  • One-year prior work experience in a high-volume kitchen or beverage service environment required.
  • Food Handler Card (or Food Handler Certificate) required.
  • Experience in customer service and/or retail preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills required.
  • Must be able to handle food items safely and properly in a kitchen environment.
  • Understanding of retail and cash handling operations required.
  • Ability to learn/use POS software (for use with food service in a restaurant environment).
  • Complete food preparation procedures according to written instructions.
  • Ensure paperwork and data entry is completed accurately and legibly.
  • Multitask and handle multiple, simultaneous orders.
  • Keep necessary items and supplies adequately stocked and understand their uses and applications.
  • Continue to expand knowledge of staff dietary needs and restrictions.
  • Assist drivers with loading and unloading orders.
  • Perform cashier duties; operating the register, completing customer transactions, and cash handling.
  • Perform routine inventory checks and create vendor orders as necessary.
  • Maintain knowledge of all available menu items, their ingredients, and their preparation methods.
  • Create daily or weekly special menu items and order necessary items to execute them properly.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

While performing the duties and essential functions of this position, the employee is required to stand and walk for extended periods, up to ten (10) hours per workday. The employee will also be required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance on a ladder, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must occasionally bend, lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

There will be exposure to dust, heat, cold, and temperature changes; occasional wet floors, and animal noises, odors, and dander.

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Pre-employment background check is required.

Intel Ireland, in partnership with Dundalk Institute of Technology (DkIT), is offering a unique paid traineeship for individuals looking to launch a career in high-tech manufacturing. This 23-month programme combines full-time paid employment with academic study, leading to a nationally recognised Higher Certificate in Manufacturing Engineering (Level 6, NFQ).

No prior semiconductor or manufacturing experience is required. We welcome applications from school leavers and those seeking a career change.

  • Support equipment troubleshooting, maintenance and optimisation activities

title: Senior CPU RTL Design Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact
As a CPU Logic Design Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and optimizing the logic for Intel's cutting-edge processors. You will drive the development of register transfer level (RTL) code and simulation for the CPU, enabling creation of cell libraries, functional units, and CPU IP blocks for integration into full-chip designs. Your expertise will be pivotal in defining architecture and microarchitecture features, ensuring Intel continues to deliver innovative solutions that lead the industry in performance, energy efficiency, and design integrity. By contributing to the development and optimization of logic structures, you will help create technology that enriches the lives of every person on Earth, while enabling Intel to achieve its broader mission of engineering a brighter future.

What You’ll Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Develop and optimize logic design, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulation for the CPU.
  • Participate in defining the architecture and microarchitecture features of the CPU design.
  • Write RTL and optimize logic for power, performance, area, and timing goals.
  • Ensure design integrity for physical implementation through effective strategies, tools, and methods.
  • Review verification plans to ensure design features are correctly validated and resolve failing RTL tests.
  • Document microarchitectural specifications (MAS) for the CPU features.
  • Collaborate with SoC customers to ensure seamless integration and high-quality performance of the CPU block.

Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate

  • Strong ownership of complex technical deliverables and a commitment to delivering results.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent collaboration skills across architecture, design, verification, and integration teams.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.

  • See Intel Benefits for more details.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Note:

For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see

Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information

Minimum Qualification and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science with 5+ years of relevant experience. Or a Master's degree in the same filed with 3+ years of experience.
  • 5+ years experience in CPU RTL design using System Verilog, with strong knowledge of logic design, simulation, and debug.
  • 3+ years experience with modern energy-efficient and low-power logic design methods, including techniques applicable to high-frequency optimization.
  • 3+ years experience in Cross-clock domain crossings and power aware design.
  • 3+ years experience in scripting languages such as TCL, Perl, or Python.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

  • Knowledge on CPU power-management namely power/electrical budgeting, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling, thermal, P/C states and reset sequence handling.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Intel Architecture ISA and system architecture, including x86 assembly language.
  • Experience with high-speed circuit design and optimization, specifically for datapath, circuits, and arrays.
  • Familiarity with circuit planning and timing convergence processes.
  • Ability to leverage broad understanding of CPU architecture to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Proficient with static timing analysis, UPF and lint checks.

Why Join Intel

At Intel, you'll help design the CPUs that power some of the world's most advanced computing platforms. As part of our CPU Design team, you'll work alongside industry-leading engineers and architects to solve complex technical challenges, influence next-generation processor innovations, and deliver technologies that impact millions of users worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical RTL and microarchitecture development, collaborate across the full product lifecycle, and see your contributions come to life in industry-leading products.

title: Temporary Laboratory/Research Technician
description:
About the College

The College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (CALS) is a pioneer of purpose-driven science and Cornell University’s second largest college. We work across disciplines to tackle the challenges of our time through world-renowned research, education, and outreach. The questions we probe and the answers we seek focus on three overlapping concerns: We believe that achieving next-generation scientific breakthroughs requires an understanding of the world’s complex, interlocking systems. We believe that access to nutritious food and a healthy environment is a fundamental human right. We believe that ensuring a prosperous global future depends on the ability to support local people and communities everywhere. By working in and across multiple scientific areas, CALS can address challenges and opportunities of the greatest relevance, here in New York, across the nation, and around the world.

Cornell Cooperative Extension (CCE) provides the educational outreach functions for Cornell University’s role as New York State’s Land Grant University. Programmatically, Cornell Cooperative Extension connects the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (CALS) and the College of Human Ecology (CHE) with 55 off-campus Associations, Integrated Pest Management (IPM), New York State Sea Grant, Area Specialists, and CCE New York City.
What We Need

As a member of the team, you will provide technical support for area Extension Associates. Duties include:

• Provide technical support to area Extension Associates in carrying out research activities that will ultimately enhance the profitability and sustainability of the commercial horticulture industry in Eastern New York.
• Flag and sign cooperating field sites for field research.
• Assist with field maintenance.
• Maintain accurate records.
• Assist with crop harvests, measuring, and recording yields.
• Transport samples to storage sites or research facilities for further analysis.
• Assist in other fieldwork and projects in commercial farms as needed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned to support departmental priorities during the appointment period.

If you possess these experiences and skills, this may be the role for you! There are a few other qualifications that we would view as incredibly helpful in this role, including:

Required Qualifications
• Proven ability to work independently in collecting and summarizing data.
• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to prioritize multiple activities and tasks while meeting deadlines.
• Must be able to work outdoors in all types of weather.
• Must be able to meet the travel requirements of the position and have reliable transportation as well as have and maintain a valid and unrestricted New York State driver’s license and be cleared to drive for university business.
• Visual concentration, attention to detail, and manual dexterity are required.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
• Must exercise sound and ethical judgment when acting on behalf of the University.

Preferred Qualifications
• Associate’s Degree with coursework in entomology, plant pathology, plant physiology, weed science, horticulture, and/or agronomy.
• Experience supporting research projects, including data collection and summary.
• Experience working in agriculture, horticulture, field crops, and/or cash crops production.

This is a part-time temporary position at 20 hours/week. This is a temporary two-month appointment. This on-site position is located in northern New York.

Rewards and Benefits

Compensation is $23.40/hour.


No relocation assistance is provided for this position. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Cofondateur - Technologie de refroidissement / Product Co-Founder - Next-Generation Cooling Technology
description:
À propos de nous

TandemLaunch est un studio de création d'entreprises établi à Montréal qui s'associe à des chercheurs, des inventeurs et des experts de l'industrie de calibre mondial pour bâtir des startups autour d'innovations de pointe (deep tech). Nous atténuons les risques liés aux technologies en début de parcours en les jumelant à des entrepreneurs chevronnés, à un accompagnement concret en création d'entreprise et à un accès au capital – propulsant une propriété intellectuelle prometteuse du laboratoire jusqu'à une entreprise financeable et prête pour le marché.

À propos de l'occasion

Nous bâtissons une nouvelle entreprise autour d'une technologie de refroidissement révolutionnaire qui s'affranchit de la réfrigération conventionnelle à compresseur. La plateforme vise des gains marqués en efficacité énergétique et en réduction du bruit, avec des applications allant de la réfrigération et de la climatisation résidentielles et commerciales jusqu'à la gestion thermique des composants électroniques. Nous constituons maintenant l'équipe fondatrice qui cernera les cibles de propriété intellectuelle, définira le produit, validera les marchés visés et fera passer l'entreprise de la technologie à la société.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un entrepreneur en résidence (EeR) pour se joindre à l'équipe à titre de cofondateur, Produit, pour cette entreprise. Vous serez responsable de la stratégie de produit et de la commercialisation, en travaillant côte à côte avec le ou les cofondateurs techniques afin de transformer une plateforme de refroidissement novatrice en produits gagnants dans les marchés de la réfrigération et de la climatisation ainsi que du refroidissement électronique. Il s'agit d'un rôle concret, à bâtir à partir de zéro, pour une personne qui souhaite cofonder et aider à diriger une entreprise, et non simplement la conseiller.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie de produit et la feuille de route de la plateforme de refroidissement, tant pour les applications de réfrigération et de climatisation que pour le refroidissement électronique
  • Diriger la démarche d'écoute de la clientèle auprès des fabricants d'équipement d'origine (FEO), des intégrateurs et des utilisateurs finaux afin de cerner l'application et le cas d'usage initiaux à plus forte valeur
  • Traduire les capacités techniques (gains d'efficacité, réduction du bruit) en exigences de produit, en spécifications et en propositions de valeur pour les clients visés
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le ou les cofondateurs techniques afin d'harmoniser le développement en ingénierie avec les exigences du marché et de la commercialisation
  • Évaluer la fabricabilité, la structure de coûts, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et les voies de mise à l'échelle de la technologie sous les formes de produit visées
  • Établir des relations commerciales, des projets pilotes et des partenariats préliminaires avec des clients, des partenaires de distribution ou des titulaires de licence potentiels
  • Contribuer à façonner la stratégie de l'entreprise, le discours de financement et le plan de mise en marché à titre de membre de l'équipe fondatrice
  • Créer et tenir à jour une documentation rigoureuse, notamment les exigences de produit, les analyses de marché et les registres des compromis techniques et commerciaux

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Diplôme en génie mécanique, en science des matériaux ou dans un domaine technique connexe (un diplôme de cycle supérieur est un atout)
  • Expérience industrielle ou commerciale dans les marchés de la réfrigération, du CVCA/climatisation ou de la gestion électronique et thermique
  • Expérience commerciale démontrée – p. ex. gestion de produit, développement des affaires ou commercialisation – attestée par un parcours dans les industries mentionnées ci-dessus
  • Une connaissance pratique des technologies de refroidissement à compresseur ou de solutions de rechange (p. ex. à l'état solide, thermoélectrique, magnétocalorique, élastocalorique) est un atout
  • Aisance à évoluer à l'intersection de l'ingénierie, de la fabrication et de la stratégie commerciale
  • Solides aptitudes en communication, avec la capacité de vulgariser des compromis techniques complexes pour des publics tant techniques que non techniques
  • Grande motivation à travailler avec une autonomie importante tout en collaborant étroitement avec l'équipe fondatrice et technique
  • Un esprit entrepreneurial : à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, porté vers l'action et stimulé par l'idée de bâtir une entreprise à partir de zéro

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une participation au capital de niveau fondateur dans l'entreprise, reflétant votre rôle de cofondateur, Produit
  • Une allocation ou rémunération concurrentielle durant la phase de création de l'entreprise, soutenue par TandemLaunch
  • Un accès direct à la plateforme du studio de TandemLaunch – incluant le financement, le soutien opérationnel et un vaste réseau d'experts de l'industrie, d'investisseurs et de conseillers
  • L'occasion de façonner une entreprise dès ses tout débuts, de la définition du produit jusqu'au lancement et à la mise à l'échelle
  • Un environnement collaboratif et dynamique basé à Montréal (Québec), en mode hybride

__________________

About Us

TandemLaunch is a Montreal-based venture studio that partners with world-class researchers, inventors, and industry experts to build startups around breakthrough deep-tech innovations. We de-risk early-stage technology by pairing it with experienced entrepreneurial talent, hands-on venture-building support, and access to capital – taking promising IP from the lab to a fundable, market-ready company.

About the Opportunity

We are building a new venture around a breakthrough cooling technology that moves away from conventional compressor-based refrigeration. The platform targets step-change improvements in energy efficiency and acoustic noise, with applications spanning residential and commercial refrigeration/air conditioning as well as thermal management for electronics. We are now assembling the founding team to identify IP targets, define the product, validate target markets, and take the venture from technology to company.

About the Role

We are seeking an Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) to join as Product Co-Founder for this venture. You will own product strategy and commercialization, working side-by-side with the technical co-founder(s) to translate a novel cooling platform into products that win in refrigeration/AC and electronic cooling markets. This is a hands-on, build-from-zero role for someone who wants to co-found and help lead a company, not just advise one.

What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for the cooling platform across refrigeration/AC and electronic cooling applications
  • Lead voice-of-customer discovery with OEMs, integrators, and end users to identify the highest-value initial application and use case
  • Translate technical capabilities (efficiency gains, noise reduction) into product requirements, specifications, and value propositions for target customers
  • Work closely with the technical co-founder(s) to align engineering development with market and commercial requirements
  • Assess manufacturability, cost structure, supply chain, and scale-up pathways for the technology in target product forms
  • Build early commercial relationships, pilots, and partnerships with potential customers, channel partners, or licensees
  • Help shape company strategy, fundraising narrative, and go-to-market plan as a member of the founding team
  • Create and maintain rigorous documentation, including product requirements, market analysis, and technical/commercial trade-off records

What We're Looking For

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field (advanced degree an asset)
  • Industrial/commercial experience in refrigeration, HVAC/AC, or electronic/thermal management markets
  • Demonstrated commercial experience – e.g. product management, business development, or commercialization – evidenced by a track record in the above industries
  • Working knowledge of compressor-based and/or alternative (e.g. solid-state, thermoelectric, magnetocaloric, elastocaloric) cooling technologies is an asset
  • Comfort operating at the interface of engineering, manufacturing, and commercial strategy
  • Strong communication skills, capable of distilling complex technical trade-offs for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Highly motivated to work with significant autonomy while collaborating closely with the founding and technical team
  • An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, biased toward action, and energized by building a company from the ground up

What We Offer

  • A founder-level equity stake in the venture, reflecting your role as Product Co-Founder
  • Competitive stipend/compensation during the venture-building phase, supported by TandemLaunch
  • Direct access to TandemLaunch's venture studio platform – including funding, operational support, and an extensive network of industry experts, investors, and advisors
  • The opportunity to shape a company from its earliest days, from product definition through to launch and scale
  • A collaborative, fast-paced environment based in Montreal, QC (hybrid)

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:
Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com
Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.
We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.
If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

Primary duties will include overall responsibility for the management of all aspects of projects including the coordination of regulatory approvals and interface with regulators and local elected officials and town department managers; managing the development and process for evaluation of bid documents for engineering, design and construction, as well as for the procurement of material and support systems; and insuring that all aspects of the projects are documented and completed in accordance with company policies and all regulations and laws.

This role will support Major Projects and regular travel to Westwood, MA is required.

Essential Functions:

  • Provide written and oral presentation to senior management, local and state governmental agencies and outside organizations.
