  • Takes the lead representing Eversource at municipal meetings, homeowner meetings, or other interested party meetings.

  • Provides guidance and advice to less experienced personnel and continually develops others in the organization to produce a more productive work force.

  • Manages performance of team members by identifying expectations, performance standards, and the use of timely feedback.

Technical Knowledge/Skill/Education/Licenses/Certifications:

Technical Knowledge/Skill:

  • Through knowledge of Project Management principles and practices.

  • Demonstrated, through experience, very high standards of professional and project management competence.

  • Proven leadership, teambuilding, coaching, problem solving, interpersonal and motivational skills required.

  • Demonstrated ability to schedule, plan and manage numerous complex transmission projects concurrently.

  • Ability to professionally represent Eversource at municipal meetings providing project overviews and answering questions.

  • Possesses highly developed communication skills, i.e., the ability to listen, write clearly and concisely, make presentations before senior management and external stakeholders, ability to discuss ideas and be persuasive, and able to work effectively with all levels within Eversource, government agencies and outside organizations.

  • Ability to assess team member’s abilities and motivational levels and adapt to appropriate leadership styles to produce optimal performance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (preferred) or bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business or the equivalent degree will be considered or equivalent experience.

  • All of the above plus the following: Master’s Degree is preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum five (5) years of Project Management or related experience. Time can be supplemented by demonstrating competencies commensurate with a Project Manager II experience.

Licenses & Certifications:

Working Conditions:

title: Assistant Director of Rehabilitation, Brookpark
location: North Park - Therapy - Brook Park, OH 44142
description:
The Director of Rehabilitation is responsible for overseeing and managing the rehabilitation services department in a healthcare or long-term care facility. This includes physical, occupational, and speech therapy services. The Director ensures that patients receive high-quality rehabilitative care to improve their functional abilities, mobility, and overall quality of life. This leadership role involves managing a team of therapists, coordinating with other healthcare professionals, ensuring regulatory compliance, and implementing strategies to achieve optimal patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leadership and Team Management:

    • Lead, manage, and supervise a multidisciplinary team of physical therapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, and therapy assistants.
    • Oversee hiring, training, and evaluating rehabilitation staff to ensure high standards of clinical care.
    • Schedule and manage staffing to meet patient needs and maintain a balanced workload for the rehabilitation team.
    • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment that promotes teamwork, professional development, and patient-centered care.

  • Patient Care and Clinical Oversight:

    • Oversee the development and implementation of individualized treatment plans for patients based on their medical diagnoses, functional needs, and therapy goals.
    • Ensure that therapy services meet the specific needs of patients, including those with physical, cognitive, or speech impairments.
    • Monitor patient progress, adjust treatment plans as needed, and ensure the highest standard of rehabilitative care is provided.
    • Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure cohesive patient care and treatment plans.

  • Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance:

    • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations related to rehabilitation services.
    • Implement and monitor quality assurance initiatives to improve patient outcomes and maintain accreditation standards.
    • Prepare for and participate in audits, inspections, and surveys by regulatory agencies to ensure that rehabilitation services meet all necessary guidelines.
    • Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of patient treatments, progress, and outcomes, ensuring compliance with facility policies and regulations.

  • Program Development and Improvement:

    • Develop and implement rehabilitation programs that meet the needs of patients and align with facility goals.
    • Stay informed of industry best practices, new technologies, and advancements in rehabilitation to continuously improve the quality of services.
    • Identify opportunities to expand or enhance rehabilitation services and implement innovative approaches to patient care.

  • Budget and Resource Management:

    • Manage the rehabilitation department’s budget, controlling costs while maintaining high standards of care.
    • Monitor the department's financial performance, including billing, insurance claims, and reimbursements for therapy services.
    • Ensure appropriate allocation and utilization of equipment, supplies, and other resources to support effective therapy services.
    • Collaborate with vendors and suppliers to maintain necessary therapy equipment and supplies.

  • Resident and Family Communication:

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for residents, patients, and their families regarding rehabilitation services, care plans, and progress.
    • Address any concerns, questions, or feedback from residents and families with professionalism and empathy.
    • Provide education and support to patients and families about therapy goals, exercises, and strategies for continued progress after discharge.

description:
About Us

Join a Team That Sticks Together!

At Shurtape Technologies, we know how to make things stick. As a leading manufacturer and marketer of adhesive tape, we pride ourselves on creating innovative solutions for a variety of industries.

We have facilities all around the world, including in the U.S., U.K., Germany, Mexico, China, and more.

Our tapes may do the sticking, but it’s our people who hold it all together.

The Chemical Applications Operator is responsible for loading, unloading, operating and troubleshooting the entire high-speed chemical applications line. This position will service the machine with chemicals, pack, box, and palletize the finished product.

title: Product Manager - Mobile
description:
Position Summary

Do you want to put powerful, easy-to-use tools directly in the hands of the people who keep trucks on the road? At Karmak, we're looking for a Product Manager - Mobile to help drive the day-to-day direction and delivery of our mobile applications for heavy-duty truck dealerships. In this role you'll turn customer and business needs into clear requirements, partner closely with engineering to ship well-built features, and keep our mobile messaging and connectivity products moving forward. It's a hands-on product role for someone who loves translating real-world problems into practical software and seeing it land in customers' hands.

Why Join Karmak?

• Employee-Owned: As an ESOP, every Karmak employee is an owner with a real stake in our success.
• Impactful Work: Your work reaches dealerships, service teams, and drivers across the commercial transportation industry every day.
• Collaborative Culture: Join a talented, driven team in an environment that values your insights and ideas.
• Growth Opportunities: Build your product career at a company that invests in its people.

Essential Job Functions

• Requirements & User Stories: Write clear, detailed user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering everything they need to build the right thing.
• Backlog Ownership: Own and groom the product backlog for assigned mobile applications, keeping work prioritized, well-defined, and ready for each sprint.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner day-to-day with engineering, QA, Support, and design to deliver mobile features on time and at quality.
• Customer & Support Insight: Gather feedback from customers, Client Success, and Support to identify pain points and validate what to build next.
• Delivery Support: Work within Agile ceremonies and Azure DevOps to track progress, resolve ambiguity, and keep releases on schedule.
• Roadmap Contribution: Contribute to the mobile product roadmap and help translate business goals into a practical, sequenced plan of work.
• Enablement & Documentation: Support release readiness with clear documentation, and help enable Support and training teams on new mobile functionality.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• 3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or a closely related role.
• Strong requirements-gathering skills, with the ability to write clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and tools such as Azure DevOps, Figma and Aha.
• Well-organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple work items and priorities at once.
• Comfort working with mobile applications and a genuine interest in mobile product experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with mobile applications (iOS/Android) or mobile-first software products.
• Familiarity with the commercial transportation, dealership, or heavy-duty trucking industry.
• Basic SQL or comfort working with data to inform product decisions.
• Formal product management or business analysis training or certification.

What Success Looks Like

• Shipping well-defined mobile features that solve real customer problems and require minimal rework.
• A healthy, well-groomed backlog that keeps engineering moving without ambiguity.
• Strong working relationships across engineering, Support, and Client Success.
• Customer and support feedback consistently reflected in what gets built.

Why Join Us

At Karmak, we're not just building software - we're keeping the commercial transportation industry moving forward. If you're ready to make a hands-on impact on the tools dealerships and drivers rely on every day, we want to hear from you. Apply now!

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by Karmak.

title: Senior Environmental Health and Safety Consultant
description:
Senior Environmental Health and Safety Consultant

Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is seeking a Senior Environmental Health and Safety Consultant for our Advisory Services team.

The Senior EHS Consultant will be responsible for helping clients maintain safe, compliant workplaces by conducting safety inspections, advising on OSHA and other regulations, and identifying and mitigating health hazards. They will support the development of safety policies, deliver EHS trainings, investigate incidents, and ensure proper recordkeeping. The role also includes contributing to business development through networking and client engagement.

Triumvirate Environmental provides leading organizations in the higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing sectors with diverse services and expertise to assist them with compliance management. At Triumvirate Environmental, we strive to WOW both our employees and our customers. Our unique culture fosters growth, development, education, and creativity.

This position reports to the EHS Manager. This role is onsite at assigned client facilities and is based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with client personnel regarding workplace safety issues, recommending corrective actions.
  • Advise clients on occupational health and safety standards, including OSHA, fire code, and other regulatory standards.
  • Assist in the development of specific areas of occupational health and safety systems, including drafting or updating policies, procedures, and manuals.
  • Participate in the inspection of machinery and equipment, such as lifting devices, machine guards, or scaffolding, and other engineered safety systems.
  • Measure occupational and environmental hazards, such as noise and ergonomics, using calibrated scientific equipment and/or collecting samples of dust, vapors, or gases according to a defined operating procedure.
  • Conduct workplace safety inspections according to a defined procedure, evaluating the use of personal protective equipment, such as respirators, respirators, protective eyewear, or hardhats, according to applicable regulations. These inspections of the workplace will involve talking with workers and observing their work.
  • Identify potential accident and health hazards, such as toxic vapors, mold, mildew, and explosive gas-air mixtures and help implement appropriate control measures, such as adjustments to ventilation systems.
  • Help investigate accidents and injuries, identifying causes and recommending remedial action.
  • Conduct routine EHS safety trainings such as new employee orientation, hazard communication, powered industrial trucks (forklift training).
  • Write reports, including accident reports, and enter information on required Occupational Safety and Health Administration recordkeeping forms.
  • Support business development opportunities by leveraging your professional network, supporting sales calls, and attending local networking events.

Basic requirements:

  • 3+ years' experience in an EHS capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health, Safety, or a related scientific field.
  • Must be familiar with and have successfully managed EHS requirements of Northern California CUPA such as San Mateo County, Santa Clara County, and Alameda County.
  • Proven track record of excellent communication & customer service skills with strong attention to detail.

Preferred skills:

  • Prior experience as a professional advisor or consultant to third party clients.

Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines. The position requires overnight hours, generally Tuesday through Saturday, to align with U.S. business hours.

Please note: this role is open to candidates based in the Philippines only. Candidates outside the Philippines will not be considered at this time.

The Role

Kasa is searching for a remote Guest Billing Specialist to join our Guest Experience team, reporting to the Senior Manager of Guest Communications. As a Guest Billing Specialist, you will help build Kasa's global brand by ensuring reservation accuracy, resolving guest billing inquiries, and performing recurring audits to maximize guest satisfaction and financial reporting accuracy. You will have an opportunity to see firsthand how we take care of our guests and also have insights into the revenue side of the business.
Individuals with at least one year of administrative, audit, billing, or hospitality experience are encouraged to apply.

This role is in our Guest Experience department, but will work very closely with departments across Kasa. We have team members located all over the US and the world. Our team is full of people with diverse backgrounds and we work hard to maintain a positive environment within the department. Everyone joined Kasa because they are passionate about travel and hospitality and they stay because of our great culture.

As a Guest Billing Specialist, your typical day will include performing billing audits and adjusting reservation data to ensure financial accuracy. You will regularly contact guests by email, phone, text, SMS to resolve billing issues and payment inquiries based on these findings.
You will work closely with the Communications, Reservations, and Portfolio teams to ensure the accuracy of reservation reporting and to deliver expedient resolutions for payment. You will often need to work cross-collaboratively to process payments for unique reservation circumstances and long-term stays.
Some key duties of this role will be to help ensure that all billing-related transitions and activities are completed for new building transitions, support resolutions with our distribution partners, and manage the processing of long term stay payment plans.

description:

title: RPA Mx Avionics Technician I/Battle Creek ANG
description:
***** Candidates must possess current DoD Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI *****

The Ground Control Station (GCS) Technician I position will support the daily operations of an Air Force Remotely Piloted Aircraft (RPA) unit located at Battle Creek ANG Base in Michigan. The ideal candidate will perform organizational level maintenance on GCSs in accordance with Air Force Technical Data under direct supervision. This position will execute preventative maintenance actions, inspections, modifications, troubleshooting, testing, and removal and installations of electronic and IT systems and subsystems utilizing best maintenance practices as identified by Air Force instruction.

USAF equivalent position is Apprentice level Avionics Technician, Cyber Transport, or RF Transmission Systems. Position reports to the Site Manager.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Interfaces with the customer on a regular basis, excellent customer service and communication skills are required.
  • Able to adhere to Air Force Instruction (AFI), AFI 21-101 – Aircraft and Equipment Maintenance Management, and Technical Data in the performance and documentation of maintenance actions.
  • Documents all maintenance actions and discrepancies utilizing aircraft logs and records utilizing AFTO 781s, Maintenance Information Systems (MIS), and maintenance logs.
  • Applies basic technical knowledge to solve problems by referencing Air Force Technical Data including determining the location and density of circuitry, isolating malfunctions, and incorporating engineering changes.
  • Requires a basic understanding of the interrelationships of circuits, planning work schedules, selecting tools and test instruments, and understanding compliance with maintenance instructions and technical directives.
  • Uses common and complex test instruments to isolate malfunctions and develop concrete solutions for remediation.
  • Work may be reviewed by the Supervisor for general compliance with accepted practices.
  • Maintains, repairs, and installs various types of electronic equipment and related devices such as electronic transmitting and receiving equipment (e.g., radar, radio, telecommunication, SATCOM and navigational aids); micro and mainframe computers and terminals; and industrial measuring, controlling equipment, and industrial calibration devices.
  • Applies basic technical knowledge of electronics principles in determining malfunctions and applies skill in restoring equipment operations.
  • This technician works under immediate supervision and achieves technical guidance, as required, from a higher-level technician or the supervisor.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned or requested.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Must have high school diploma or have completed relevant military and/or vocational technical school curriculum.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must be capable of using and reading blueprints, wiring diagrams, and data tables.
  • Basic understanding of Windows.
  • Thorough knowledge of the Microsoft Office Professional suite of software (Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Must be able to gain and maintain one of the following IAT Level II certifications: CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, Security+ CE, SSCP, or GSEC, IAW DOD 8570.01-M commensurate with the assigned duties within 90 days of hire.
  • Additional “on the job” training may be required.
  • Must be able to lift / carry items in excess of 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to work a non-traditional schedule to maintain 24/7/365 operations.
  • Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.
  • Must submit updated SF-86 within 30 days of hire start date.
  • Current DoD TS/SCI Security Clearance is required. Note: US citizenship is required to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in a relevant career field.
  • Minimum of one year actual and recent Aircraft Avionics, Ground Control Station, SATCOM maintenance, Military Aviation/Maintenance, and/or Communications experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of basic electronics maintenance and repair.
  • Possess basic knowledge of technical publications related to aircraft and ground control station electronics maintenance.
  • Know basic theory of flight and electronic flight controls, and a basic knowledge of electronic principles.
  • Basic understanding of SATCOM communications.
  • Capable of using and reading blueprints, wiring diagrams, and data tables.
  • Possess basic skills and knowledge in the operation of networks; both hardware and software, to include network topology, standards, and protocols.
  • Basic understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Application of technical knowledge of electronic principles in determining malfunctions and skill application in restoring equipment systems and operations.
  • RPA Operations Experience.
  • Military C4ISR (Command, Control, Computers, Communication, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) experience.
  • Prior Experience as a Defense Contractor.
  • Prior Experience in RPA Aircraft Avionics/GCS/SATCOM Maintenance and Repair.
  • FCC Radio Telephone License.
  • Knowledge and ability to administer Linux on both servers and workstations.
  • Prior experience installing, upgrading, and administering operating systems and application software in multi-user client/server environments, including Linux.
  • Current IAT Level II Certification.

Compensation Details:

31.97

title: Commercial Counsel, Supply Chain
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

COMMERCIAL COUNSEL, SUPPLY CHAIN

As a Commercial Counsel on the SpaceX Legal Team, you will enable SpaceX’s procurement of critical goods and services by providing legal review and solutions-based counseling to Supply Chain, Purchasing, Facilities and other cross-functional partners on complex legal and business issues in the United States and internationally.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Draft, negotiate, and review a range of commercial contracts, including purchase orders/agreements, service agreements, license agreements, long-term supply agreements, non-disclosure agreements , and other agreements related to the acquisition of goods and services
  • Identify and mitigate legal risk by implementing appropriate processes, trainings, and controls for the supported SpaceX teams
  • Provide legal analyses of applicable laws, regulations, and industry practices, particularly related to the procurement of goods and services
  • Work closely with Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Facilities Teams to provide legal counseling throughout all stages of the procurement lifecycle, including RFPs, RFQs, purchase agreements, license agreements and dispute resolution
  • Manage SpaceX’s form Purchase Order and Standard Terms and Conditions
  • Support continuous improvements of forms, policies, and processes to streamline and simplify procurements, including using AI and other technologies to improve efficiency and efficacy
  • Work cross functionally with business teams across the company to analyze legal risks, devise creative solutions, and develop strong, trusted advisor relationships

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • JD or foreign equivalent from an accredited law school
  • 5+ years of legal experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience at a well-regarded law firm
  • Experience as an in-house lawyer, ideally within the tech and/or manufacturing sectors and with direct contact with Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Facilities Teams
  • Experience providing legal advice related to commercial procurement transactions, including international transactions, and ideally with Fortune 1000 companies
  • Experience managing legal issues for a high-growth multinational company
  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with clients in various geographies and comfortable advising all levels of management
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders
  • Knowledge of applicable regulatory issues
  • Comfortable with and responsive to rapid developments and changes in direction as well as working with technologies and products and in practice areas without significant precedence
  • The ideal candidate is diligent and proactive and has demonstrated excellent legal and business judgment, technical acumen, communication skills, and strategic thinking, along with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be admitted to the bar, in good standing, in at least one U.S. State
  • This position is based in Bastrop, TX—though other SpaceX offices will be considered—and requires being onsite at a SpaceX office; remote work will not be considered
  • Must be able to work extended hours and weekends, as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $190,000.00 - $255,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. title: Laboratory Technician
description:

  • Work for an iconic brand, home of many Australian products

The Role

Our Port Melbourne site is not only the home of Vegemite it is also the home of other Australian iconic products, such as Bega Peanut Butter, Bega Simply Nuts, Zoosh and Cream Cheese. VEGEMITE has been proudly made in Port Melbourne, Australia since 1923.

The chemistry section at the Port Melbourne site functions as a quality and product release laboratory. The laboratory was established in December 2020 and continues to expand its range of offered tests for Bega products across Australia.

We are looking for a driven and fantastic experience Laboratory Technician to join our technician's team and impact our day-to-day dairy products testing, samples, and analysis to meet Bega's high standards.

Some of the perks of working at Port Melbourne include, free onsite parking, onsite café, free gym, free flu vaccination program, subsidised merchandise, kitchens filled with our goodies including vegemite and peanut butter! What more could you ask for?

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine analysis using instrumentation (HPLC and UPLC) and wet chemistry techniques.

  • Performing reagent preparation and equipment maintenance/internal calibration verification check as per laboratory schedule.

  • Preparation and maintenance of SOP’s and validation reports.

  • Participate in problem-solving routines and maintain work area. High Attention to detail is extremely crucial.

  • Assist in the continuing expansion of analytical testing at the Port Melbourne site by carrying out method development and validation

About you

  • Minimum five years of experience in chemistry laboratory on HPLC instrumentation, preferably in food composition analyses and able to perform validation and implementation of test methods such as Water- and Fat-Soluble Vitamins

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Proficient in Excel and Word.

  • Ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the business.

Bega Group Story

Bega Group is home to many trusted and iconic food and beverage brands. Whether it’s VEGEMITE on toast, a Dare on the go or a Zooper Dooper on a hot day - you've probably grown up enjoying the iconic products we proudly manufacture every day.

Our growth story of becoming a successful ASX 200 listed company with an annual turnover in excess of $3 billion and approximately 3,000 employees, is made possible by our dedicated workforce who live and breathe our values every day. We have a strong regional focus and proudly support the communities where we work, live and play. At the Bega Group, we are proud of our heritage and will continue to build great opportunities to encourage our people to develop and thrive. Come and be a part of our success story as we continue to build The Great Australian Food Company through creating Great Food for a Better Future!

Life at Bega Group

Company culture and our values are very important to us. From flexible working arrangements and regular social catch ups, we’re committed to fostering a supportive and agile work environment for our team.

  • Join a dedicated, forward-thinking and innovative culture

  • Grow with us, through opportunities for career development and progression

  • Contribute by giving back to your community through charities we partner with

  • Access to mental and physical health programs through our wellbeing portal and programs

  • Enjoy excellent employee benefits, including flexible working, purchased leave options and salary continuance insurance

At Bega Group, diversity and inclusion is a business priority, we want everyone to be themselves regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, age or gender so we can truly reflect the customers and communities that we serve. title: Group Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
We’re looking for motivated, engaged people to help make everyone’s journeys better.

Job Summary:

The Analyst Group Financial Reporting will support the preparation of consolidated financial statements and the Group’s monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting activities, helping to ensure the accuracy, completeness and timely delivery of financial information. You will collaborate closely with finance teams across the organization to collect, validate and analyze financial data and contribute to intercompany reporting, regulatory submissions and other Group reporting activities.

In addition, you will support internal business reorganizations and ad-hoc finance projects while contributing to the continuous improvement of reporting processes through data analytics, automation and emerging technologies. This role offers a dynamic, international environment with broad exposure across the organization and opportunities to further develop financial reporting, analytical and technology skills.

Main duties and responsibilities:

Apply business and analytical skills to various reporting activities and projects in group financial reporting and consolidation.

Tasks will include:

  • Support the preparation of the audited annual consolidated financial statements, produced in accordance with IFRS and stock exchange requirements

  • Support the group’s monthly financial closing and reporting activities by analyzing financial data, ensuring accuracy and completeness

  • Collaborate with finance teams across entities to collect and validate financial information for consolidation

  • Involvement in activities like intercompany reporting, internal business reorganizations and financial support to the business

  • Develop and implement data validation checks and controls to minimize errors and discrepancies

  • Preparation of governmental and statistical reports/submissions

  • Undertake ad-hoc exercises and analysis as requested by senior finance management

Core Competencies and requirements

Education

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

  • CPA or relevant professional certification (including those in progress) is a plus

Work Experience

  • 3+ years of work experience in accounting, reporting and finance. Having worked in a large international business would be an advantage.

Technical / Language Skills

  • Basic knowledge of accounting and reporting standards, e.g. IFRS and Swiss GAAP (OR)

  • Experience in using financial software, ERP and reporting tools (e.g. SAP, HFM, or similar)

  • Working knowledge in data analytics and interpretation using statistical analysis and data visualization tools, primarily MS Excel, R and Power BI, SQL is a plus

  • Tech savvy, including interest in learning and developing automation, AI and analytical finance tools.

Core Competencies Required

  • Deliver Results: Consistently delivers accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, demonstrating strong ownership and accountability in meeting deadlines.

  • Drive Execution Excellence: Manages multiple priorities with discipline while continuously improving reporting processes, systems, and controls to enhance efficiency and quality.

  • Collaborate & Act as One Team: Builds strong, trust-based partnerships across global finance teams to ensure alignment, data accuracy, and effective collaboration.

  • Embrace Change & Innovation: Adapts to evolving business and regulatory needs while proactively identifying and driving improvements in tools, processes, and ways of working.

If you want to be part of a team that helps make travel and culinary memories, join us!

title: Senior Application Programmer / Java Developer
description:
Revolutional delivers advanced technology solutions and mission support to federal agencies across civilian, health, and national security environments. We apply modern capabilities, including AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT modernization to solve complex challenges, enable faster and more secure operations, and drive measurable mission outcomes.

We are redefining how federal technology gets built and delivered by operating with a product mindset, prioritizing speed, ownership, and execution over bureaucracy.

Description

Title: Senior Application Programmer / Java Developer

Location: Remote

Terms: Full-time

Salary Range: $130-166k DOE

Clearance: Qualified candidates must be US citizens and able to obtain a minimum of a Public Trust clearance

Travel: 0-20%

Project Description

This position supports Revolutional’s customer, Department of Homeland Security (DHS), where critical mission systems are undergoing modernization. The current environment consists of large, complex legacy systems that manage operational workflows (e.g., processing, tracking, and managing encounters). These systems have evolved over time and often include layers of business rules, manual processes, and tightly coupled functionality.

The core challenge is not simply rebuilding these systems; it is:

  • Understanding how they actually work in practice
  • Identifying which functionality is mission-critical
  • Eliminating unnecessary complexity
  • Translating that functionality into a modern platform-based architecture

As part of this effort, DHS is adopting Palantir as a target platform for modernization. Revolutional plays a key role in bridging legacy systems and this new platform, ensuring accurate translation of functionality while improving system design.

No prior Palantir experience is required. Revolutional will provide training and certification to enable engineers to build effectively within the platform.

Position Description

Revolutional is seeking a skilled Senior Application Programmer / Java Developer to support a federal government client in a dynamic, agile development environment. This role is responsible for participating in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise applications.

The Application Programmer will develop, test, and maintain applications using Java and modern web technologies while working in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) environment. The role includes conducting software analysis, programming, debugging, implementing unit tests, remediating SonarQube findings, and developing technical documentation. The selected candidate will also periodically assist with Help Desk troubleshooting and resolution of end-user issues.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in agile methodologies and contribute within a continuous integration environment.
  • Conduct software analysis, programming, testing, and debugging activities.
  • Analyze user requirements to define business objectives and technical solutions.
  • Contribute to all stages of the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain applications using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful services.
  • Implement and remediate SonarQube findings and develop unit tests to ensure code quality.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and user support materials.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues across application environments.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and DevOps processes using tools such as Jenkins/CloudBees and Git.
  • Work with relational and NoSQL databases including Oracle, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
  • Support cloud-based deployments and infrastructure using AWS services (EC2, CloudWatch, Load Balancers, Lambda).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security and performance best practices.
  • Periodically assist with Help Desk support to troubleshoot and resolve end-user issues.

Requirements

  • US citizenship is required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in application development and/or Java development.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (Java 8+), Spring Boot, and RESTful web services.
  • Experience with MVC architecture and JDBC.
  • Proficiency with front-end technologies including React (18+), Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON.
  • Experience with Node.js (22+), Struts 2, Maven, and JQuery.
  • Familiarity with messaging and streaming technologies such as MQ or Kafka.
  • Experience with Oracle 19c, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and SQL optimization.
  • Experience working in Windows and Linux environments.
  • Knowledge of AWS services including EC2, CloudWatch, load balancers, and serverless architectures.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform and RedHat Ansible Automation Platform.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins/CloudBees and version control systems such as Git.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as AppDynamics and DataDog.
  • Knowledge of application frameworks, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cross-platform interoperability.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and organizational skills.

Desired

  • Current DHS Public Trust Suitability.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Purpose and Impact:

Come be a part of an exciting and ever-changing program that provides a comprehensive range of state-of-the-art solutions and hands-on assistance in designing, implementing, managing, and sustaining operations across various network environments in Columbia, MD for our customer.

We provide an environment that fosters and supports innovation and valuing “outside-the-box” thinking to solve complex problems. There are several training opportunities for team members that want to learn new technologies and stay current with their technical skillset. We are a highly technical group and nurture growth, with a technical culture of cross-trained teammates with opportunities to develop additional skillsets.

Work Schedule:

  • 8hrs / day, 5 days per week, all onsite
  • Occasional after hours work for system maintenance

Essential Responsibilities:

The Senior Infrastructure Engineer serves as the technical lead for the organization's enterprise infrastructure, responsible for the architecture, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of compute, storage, network, virtualization, and identity management platforms. This position provides strategic and operational leadership for critical infrastructure services across a variety of classified networks, establishes engineering standards, drives modernization initiatives, and ensures the reliability, security, and scalability of systems supporting customer operations. The role requires extensive hands-on technical expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to lead complex projects and maintenance activities in a secure enterprise environment.

Responsibilities include:

  • Design, implement, administer, and maintain enterprise infrastructure systems including Cisco UCS, Microsoft Active Directory, enterprise storage platforms, Windows Server environments, and core network infrastructure.
  • Architect, deploy, and support network solutions including routing, switching, segmentation, and secure communications across multiple classified environments.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure standards, engineering best practices, system baselines, and technical roadmaps.
  • Lead infrastructure modernization efforts, technology refresh projects, migrations, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Manage enterprise storage solutions, data protection strategies, backups, disaster recovery capabilities, and capacity planning initiatives.
  • Administer enterprise identity and authentication services including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file services.
  • Plan and execute system upgrades, firmware updates, patches, maintenance activities, and change management procedures.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to improve operational stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity personnel to ensure compliance with security requirements, vulnerability remediation efforts, STIG implementation, and system hardening activities.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide technical recommendations for infrastructure improvements and future-state architectures.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including architectures, diagrams, procedures, standards, and operational runbooks.
  • Provide senior-level technical guidance and mentoring to infrastructure personnel and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
  • Support planned after-hours maintenance windows and emergency response efforts to maintain system availability and operational readiness.

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands: Standard working environment

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • 10+ years of progressive experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure environments, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and identity services.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Cisco UCS infrastructure, including architecture, administration, lifecycle management, firmware maintenance, capacity planning, and performance optimization in highly available enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or equivalent technologies supporting mission-critical workloads.
  • Advanced experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, routing, switching, segmentation, and network security best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to architect and establish enterprise infrastructure standards, develop technical roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies, and lead infrastructure modernization initiatives aligned with business objectives.
  • Extensive hands-on experience administering Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, authentication systems, and enterprise identity management solutions.
  • Strong experience managing enterprise storage platforms, including SAN, NAS, backup, disaster recovery, replication, capacity planning, and data protection strategies.
  • Advanced understanding of Windows server operating systems, including system hardening, patch management, performance tuning, automation, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience leading infrastructure maintenance and operational activities within production environments, including change management, patching, upgrades, disaster recovery testing, and after-hours maintenance windows.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects from design through implementation, collaborating across technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery and operational readiness.
  • Expert troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis, resolve critical infrastructure issues, and develop long-term corrective actions for enterprise systems.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles and infrastructure security practices, including vulnerability remediation, system hardening, access controls, compliance requirements, and secure infrastructure design.
  • Experience developing technical documentation, operational procedures, infrastructure standards, and architectural diagrams to support enterprise governance and knowledge management.
  • Proven ability to serve as a senior technical leader and mentor, providing guidance to engineers, establishing best practices, and driving continuous improvement across infrastructure operations.

Security Clearance Required:

  • TS / SCI

Minimum Education:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Minimum Years of Experience:

  • 10+years of progressive experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure environments, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and identity services.

Required Certifications:

  • This is an IAT3 level billet. Applicant must have:
    • Required IAT Certs: one or more of the following: CISM, CISSP, or equivalent senior-level baseline certification
    • Required vendor certification in one or more relevant technologies (e.g., Microsoft, VMware, Cisco, NetApp, Pure Storage, HP, Dell, Linux+, Red Hat, HBSS, ACAS). Candidates without an active certification must obtain at least one within 6 months of hire

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree
  • Experience supporting Federal Government, DoD, or regulated environments.
  • Experience with NIST RMF, NIST 800-53, STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, or equivalent compliance frameworks.
  • Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or other enterprise virtualization platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
  • Prior Military experience

title: AI GTM Archtiect
description:
Why This Role Exists

AI has created a significant opportunity for GTM organizations to gain competitive advantage by radically improving Buyer Experience. Traditional B2B GTM motions align to how providers sell, not how customers buy, which creates friction along the Buyer Journey. In this role, you will design and operationalize the systems, workflows, operating models and talent requirements that support AI-powered execution across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner organizations. You will connect strategy with execution by architecting AI-enabled processes, engaging with the front-line to test and validate them, partnering with enablement to drive adoption, and translating emerging AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes. Your work will improve productivity, accelerate growth, strengthen decision-making, and optimize Buyer Experiences.

What You’ll Own

  • You will design and evolve AI-powered GTM architecture across lead-to-cash, the customer lifecycle, and renew-to-expand motions, using the buyer journey as the organizing principle to improve efficiency, scalability, and customer outcomes.
  • You will build repeatable AI-enabled programs that help sellers, customer success teams, and partners make better decisions and work more effectively.
  • You will partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Product, and executive stakeholders to align AI initiatives with revenue goals and business priorities.
  • You will lead governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of GTM systems, data, workflows, and AI-enabled processes.
  • You will translate emerging AI capabilities into practical field solutions that improve pipeline generation, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational performance.
  • You will establish success measures, evaluate business impact, and use evidence to guide optimization and investment decisions.
  • You will shape change and adoption strategies that embed AI-powered workflows into day-to-day GTM operations.

Challenges You’ll Help Solve

  • Reducing friction created by provider-centric selling motions and redesigning workflows around how customers evaluate, buy, adopt, renew, and expand.
  • Transforming legacy GTM processes into AI-enabled workflows that improve productivity and decision quality.
  • Creating consistency across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner operations while supporting appropriate business and regional flexibility.
  • Improving the quality and accessibility of revenue data for forecasting, planning, and customer engagement.
  • Balancing innovation, governance, and responsible adoption when deploying AI across revenue-generating processes.
  • Converting AI experimentation into scalable programs with measurable customer and business outcomes.

Skills for Success

Required Skills

  • AI-powered GTM transformation: You have demonstrated success designing and implementing AI-enabled workflows that improve commercial performance or operational efficiency.
  • Revenue process architecture: You have built or redesigned lead-to-cash, customer lifecycle, renewal, or expansion processes around customer buying behavior and delivered measurable outcomes.
  • Cross-functional enterprise leadership: You have aligned Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Product, and executive stakeholders around shared transformation priorities.
  • GTM systems strategy: You have evaluated, governed, and optimized a GTM technology ecosystem while improving adoption and business value.
  • Data-informed decision-making: You use operational, customer, and revenue evidence to guide prioritization, investment, and performance improvement.
  • Program and change leadership: You have led complex transformation programs, influenced adoption, and sustained new ways of working.

  • PhD preferred

title: Data Center Design Manager
description:
Data Center Design Manager

Amentum’s Digital Infrastructure Group has been at the forefront of creating a new generation of communication infrastructure for over 40 years. We specialize in everything from network development to complete telecom life cycle solutions, datacenter retrofits and modernization, to full datacenter buildouts. While these critical environments are ever changing, the demand for innovative technology and long-term support remains constant. These services include design, construction, updates, and maintenance of new and existing datacenter facilities.

Amentum is seeking an experienced Data Center Design Manager to lead the planning, design, engineering coordination, construction execution, and commissioning of mission-critical infrastructure projects. This role serves as the primary technical leader bridging design teams, construction management, commissioning teams, contractors, and client stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of high-availability data center facilities.

The Design Manager is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle, including design reviews, MEP coordination, controls integration, power distribution systems, construction oversight, commissioning, quality assurance, risk mitigation, and operational readiness. The successful candidate will provide leadership across electrical, mechanical, controls, and building automation systems while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with all applicable standards and client requirements.

Responsibilities

Design Leadership & Engineering Management

  • Lead multidisciplinary design teams including electrical, mechanical, controls, architectural, structural, civil, and telecommunications disciplines.
  • Manage design development from concept through construction documentation and turnover.
  • Review and approve design packages, calculations, equipment selections, and technical specifications.
  • Develop and review power distribution and control system designs for greenfield and retrofit data center projects.
  • Establish control strategies, sequences of operation, integration requirements, and design standards.
  • Collaborate with clients, end users, MEP engineers, architects, contractors, commissioning providers, and operations teams to ensure alignment with project objectives.
  • Identify technical risks early and drive resolution through design and construction phases.

Construction Management & Project Delivery

  • Experience managing large-scale data center projects from design through commissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of:

description:
American Rheinmetall provides full services for complex mechanical products, fabricated structures and systems that range from complete design services to prototype manufacturing, testing, production launch, full rate production and product service and sustainment. American Rheinmetall provides quality products and services at affordable prices through a lean organizational structure and four facilities, four in Michigan that span 910,000 square feet, and one in Ohio, that span 800,000+ square feet. FLSA Status: Exempt
Job Title: Production Planner
Department: Materials
Summary The Production Planner’s primary responsibility is to create and maintain production schedules that balance customer demand, manufacturing capacity, and inventory objectives based on customer requirements. This position will create releases to ensure materials arrive in accordance with the production schedule; and will be responsible for managing the replenishment process of materials to support manufacturing operations. This role will prioritize production needs, track schedule adherence and attainment performance, and expedite critical orders. The Production Planner will work closely with other stakeholders to support on-time delivery, quality improvement and cost reduction initiatives.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned
  • Develop, maintain, and communicate production schedules to support customer and operational requirements.
  • Review demand, forecasts, and production capacity to create effective production plans.
  • Monitor system requirements to identify capacity constraints, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain and validate planning, inventory, and master data within the ERP system to ensure scheduling accuracy and data integrity.
  • Issue release orders consistent with ERP System requirements to ensure delivery on a timely basis.
  • Coordinate delivery of materials with vendors and expedite shipments from suppliers as needed to meet production schedules.
  • Review existing inventories through cycle counts for accuracy and as a cross-check to ERP System reports.
  • Work with Production Operations to make necessary adjustments to schedules based on availability of supply or labor.
  • Participate in yearly inventory planning and counts.
  • Crosstrain and provide support for planning, scheduling, and inventory management activities as needed.
  • Manage communication on deliveries and supply issues to all stakeholders (i.e. Shipping/Receiving, Sales, Production, QA, Product Development, etc.).
Competencies
To perform the job successfully, an individual will need to perform the following competencies.
Quantity of Work
The quantity of work produced and the promptness with which it is completed.
Quality of Work
The ability displayed and accuracy of work produced, meeting company standards, and requiring little to no rework.
Judgement/Knowledge of Job
Knowledge of job, techniques, skills, equipment, procedures, materials, etc.
Attendance/Dependability
Punctuality and attendance.
Teamwork/ Attitude
Willingness and cooperativeness with co-workers and supervisors; ability to accept constructive criticism.
Initiative/Independence
The degree to which an employee searches out new tasks and expands their ability to perform assigned tasks without direct supervision.
Adherence to Policy
Follow quality environmental policies and have knowledge of AS9100 and IS14001.
Adherence to Safety
Follow safety procedures, security protocol, and wear proper PPE.
Education and/or Experience
  • Previous experience with Plex preferred.
  • General knowledge of ERP systems.
  • Proficient with Excel/Power Point/Word
  • Good presentation skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, procedure manuals and contracts.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively with vendors and internal staff.
  • Ability to analysis data, identify issues and problem solve to correct issues.
  • Bachelor Degree in Supply Chain Management / Purchasing / Business preferred.
  • Minimum of one but prefer more than three years of Supply Chain experience.
  • Must be willing to attend Supply Chain continuous education seminars or class work as needed.
Mathematical Skills
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
Reasoning Ability
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

title: Therapist
description:

As part of STR Behavioral Health’s comprehensive continuum of care, STR Lancaster provides individualized, evidence-based treatment to support recovery and help clients stay connected to their work, home, and community. Treatment plans are built around each person’s unique needs and goals — because recovery looks different for everyone.

STR Lancaster is a program of STR Behavioral Health, nationally recognized by the Human Rights Campaign for LGBTQIA+-affirming care.

Position Summary

Associate Therapists provide individual, family and group therapy sessions for clients in an Intensive Outpatient and Partial Hospitalization mental health facility, under the supervision of fully licensed therapists. Associate Therapists assess the therapeutic needs of clients, develop appropriate treatment plans, and facilitate group, family and individual therapy sessions. Position collaborates with clients, team members, external clinical partners and family members, as appropriate, to coordinate care throughout the treatment process.

Relationships and Contacts

Within the organization: Maintains frequent and close working relationships with clinical, admissions, and leadership team members throughout the organization.

Outside the organization: Initiates and maintains strong professional relationships with clients and families, clinical providers, referral partners and vendors, as needed.

Position Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Facilitates group, individual, and family therapy sessions in accordance with the clinical program schedule.
  2. Completes session notes, contact logs, discharge plans and other reports in compliance with State, accrediting bodies, quality guidelines and payor source guidelines.
    1. Completes all necessary documentation within prescribed format and timelines.
    2. Ensures documentation reflects ongoing assessments of client’s clinical presentation and behaviors.
  3. Facilitates specialized groups as assigned based on education, training, and experience.
  4. Selects appropriate interventions to meet the clinical needs of individual clients.
  5. Maintains therapeutic relationships with clients using praise and other reinforcers to encourage appropriate behaviors and attitudes.
  6. Sets limits and holds boundaries in a kind and firm manner.
  7. Conducts effective verbal crisis intervention and de-escalation involving other team members, as needed.
  8. Collaborates with an interdisciplinary treatment team to coordinate client care from admission through discharge.
  9. Attends clinical, consultation, and operations meetings; serves as a clinical advocate for assigned cases.
  10. Communicates client progress with the referral sources, families, parents and/or guardians, as appropriate.
  11. Addresses clients, visitors, physicians, and co-workers in a welcoming and respectful manner.
  12. Responds to clients and families with empathy and positive professional skills.

Additional Responsibilities

  1. Can be relied upon to be at work as scheduled, proactively notifying supervisor of planned and unplanned time off needs.
  2. Reads, understands, and adheres to all company policy statements on ethics, conduct, and conflict of interests; adheres to facility policies, procedures, rules, and regulations.
  3. Maintains positive attitude and acts as a team player with others on the team.
  4. Attends and completes all trainings within assigned time frames.
  5. Completes other duties as assigned.

  • You contribute to and execute the strategic near and long-term vision and direction for the healthcare ecosystem set by the Executive Director, Healthcare Ecosystem and therapeutic areas to assist Squads in identifying partnerships and, under direction by the Squads executing partnerships which enhance customer experience, improve patient outcomes and deliver on business opportunities for Genentech
  • You lead the development and execution of customer account planning for target account(s) to deliver maximum impact opportunities

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

title: Automation & Controls Instructor
description:

Benefits

title: AWS Cloud Engineer IV
description:
Job Profile Summary

The L4 Cloud DevOps Engineer serves as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for cloud architecture and operational engineering, focusing on AWS, Terraform (IaC), operating systems, Kubernetes (EKS), and modern DevOps practices. The role designs, implements, and supports cloud infrastructure and deployment automation, leads incident response and DR activities, mentors junior engineers, and collaborates with stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that align with business objectives.

Career Level Summary

  • Requires deep technical expertise across AWS, Terraform, OS administration, Kubernetes, and DevOps tooling.
  • Leads others to solve complex technical problems and provides technical leadership on projects.
  • Works independently on sophisticated engineering tasks; escalates or seeks guidance for only the most complex, ambiguous situations.
  • May provide functional leadership and mentorship to L1/L2 engineers.

Critical Competencies

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Influence and coaching: mentor team members, promote best practices, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Analytical problem solving: diagnosing complex production issues and identifying root cause and long-term fixes.
  • Collaboration: work across disciplines to design, implement, and operate cloud solutions.
  • Project and time management: prioritize work, track deliverables, and meet deadlines while balancing multiple initiatives.
  • Technical documentation: create clear runbooks, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the L3 escalation point and technical SME for complex AWS, OS, Kubernetes, infrastructure and deployment issues.
  • Design and implement infrastructure as code using Terraform (and optionally CloudFormation), building reusable modules and enforcing coding standards.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and GitOps practices (ArgoCD), including pipeline design, environment promotion, rollback, and drift remediation.
  • Develop automation for configuration management and operational tasks using Ansible/AWX, scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python), and other automation tools.
  • Design, deploy and maintain Kubernetes workloads (Amazon EKS), Helm charts, and environment-specific templating.
  • Perform Linux and Windows administration: hardening, patching, performance tuning, and automated deployments.
  • Lead incident response and major production incidents; perform RCA and implement permanent automated fixes.
  • Lead and coordinate Disaster Recovery planning and testing, including runbooks, failover/failback, and validation.
  • Define and enforce technical standards for IaC, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and operational processes.
  • Improve observability: monitoring, alerting, logging and operational reliability across platforms.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1 and L2 engineers; review and approve infrastructure and deployment changes.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, architecture documentation, and DR documentation.
  • Collaborate with product and customer engineering teams to deliver cloud-based solutions, migrations, and optimizations.

Experience

10+ years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or a related field is required.

Knowledge

  • Expert-level knowledge of AWS services, architecture patterns, security, networking, and operational best practices.
  • Deep understanding of Infrastructure as Code concepts and Terraform module design, state management and security.
  • Extensive knowledge of Linux and Windows internals, administration, automation, and security hardening.
  • In-depth Kubernetes architecture and operations experience (preferably Amazon EKS), including Helm and GitOps patterns.
  • Familiarity with common security and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST, HIPAA, PCI) and secure operational controls.

Skills

The candidate must demonstrate hands-on, expert-level skills across the following areas:

  • Cloud & IaC: Expert in AWS and Terraform (including Terragrunt patterns), reusable module development, state management, and IaC security.
  • Kubernetes & Containers: Design, operate and troubleshoot EKS clusters, Helm chart development, container best practices, and GitOps (ArgoCD).
  • CI/CD & Automation: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, automated testing, and deployment automation (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Configuration Management: Use Ansible/AWX for system configuration, patching, application deployment and repetitive operational tasks.
  • Operating Systems: Expert-level Linux administration and solid Windows server administration; automation via scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python).
  • Version Control: Strong Git skills (branching strategies, code review, hooks, access controls).
  • Monitoring & Observability: Implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting (CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK/EFK or similar).
  • Security & IAM: Implement secure IAM practices, secret management, network security and encryption in cloud environments.
  • Disaster Recovery & Resilience: DR planning, regular testing, and runbook creation for reliable failover and recovery.

L4 / SME Expectations

  • Lead and own complex engineering changes and transformations across cloud platforms.
  • Drive automation, standardization, and reliability improvements in operations and delivery.
  • Define technical standards, review peer code, and enforce best engineering practices.
  • Act as a technical escalation point for production incidents and lead root cause analysis.
  • Provide mentorship and hands-on guidance to junior engineers, elevating team capability.

Certifications

  • Preferred: AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer Professional).
  • Beneficial: CNCF/Kubernetes Certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS), Azure/GCP certifications as applicable.

title: C3 Presents - Premium Client Services Intern
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

One of the world’s largest music festival producers, C3 is the force behind two of the most iconic multi-day festivals — Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas and Lollapalooza in Chicago and its six international editions — drawing a combined 2 million music lovers annually.

title: Product Manager, Reporting & Analytics
description:
About DriveCentric

DriveCentric is the world's first Augmented Intelligence CRM, purpose-built for automotive retail. We help thousands of dealerships across North America engage more customers, schedule more appointments, and run their businesses with AI woven into every workflow. We are not a CRM bolting AI on top. We are an AI-first platform that has rebuilt the dealership operating system from the ground up.

We are at the inflection point. Our customers are betting their next decade on AI. So are we.

Why this role
Reporting is how a dealership knows whether it is winning. It is the first thing a GM opens in the morning and the last thing a dealer group executive checks at night. It is also the product surface where our customers feel the gap between what they have and what they expect most acutely.

We are rebuilding it, and more. Our new reporting experience is in early access with a first cohort of stores. Behind it, we are reimagining our data architecture. Thousands of legacy ad hoc and bespoke reports need a migration path to that new architecture, and an individual to own the 0 → 1 build, as well as the migration strategy.

We are hiring a Product Manager to wholly own the Reporting product line. Not a slice of it. The whole thing: the rollout happening right now, the migration, and most importantly, the vision for what dealership reporting looks like in 2026 and beyond. You will report to our Staff Product Manager for Data, CDP and Analytics, work daily with engineering and data platform leads, and present your roadmap to the executive team.

What you'll own
  • The new reporting experience, end-to-end. Phased rollout from early access to general availability: cohort selection, the quality gate that says a phase is ready, launch sequencing, and the customer-facing reporting roadmap that our CSM teams use in the field. You decide what ships in which phase and you defend the call.
  • Legacy migration. Roughly ten thousand ad hoc and bespoke reports live in the old system. Getting dealers off them is the long pole of this program and it is yours. That means a real migration strategy, not a spreadsheet: programmatic conversion, dealer self-service migration tooling, and a plan for the bespoke enterprise reports we built one at a time and should never build again.
  • Dashboards, report building, and self-serve. The dealer-facing analytics surface: dashboards, drill-down, scheduled delivery, date range and attribution controls, and the report builder that lets an operator answer their own question without filing a ticket. You own packaging decisions here too, including what belongs in the base product and what is a premium SKU.
  • Data trust and freshness. A beautiful report on yesterday's data is a broken report. You partner with the data platform and engineering teams on the dimensional model, ETL cadence, freshness SLAs, and report permissioning. You will not build the pipelines, but you will set the bar for what "correct and current" means and hold the line on it.
  • The AI-native reporting vision. With Databricks underneath us, natural language exploration, agent-generated insight, and anomaly detection go from roadmap slideware to buildable. You define what DriveCentric reporting looks like in a world where a dealer asks a question instead of building a report, and you sequence the path to get there.
  • The craft of visualization. Most dealership reporting today is a wide table with a date filter bolted on top. That is a low bar and we intend to clear it by a wide margin. You own the visual language of DriveCentric reporting: which chart actually answers the question being asked, when a sparkline beats a bar, how period-over-period and store-to-store comparison get expressed without a spreadsheet, what a funnel or cohort view looks like for a dealership sales process, and how drill-down carries context forward instead of dumping the user into a raw list. You will partner with design on a chart library and a set of defaults that make the right visualization the easy one, and you will care about the unglamorous parts: color that survives a projector in a Monday manager meeting, density that works on a phone in the service drive, empty and loading states, and an export that still reads correctly when a dealer principal forwards it. Strong opinions are welcome and expected here. Bring references, argue for them, and ship them.
  • The customer relationship for reporting. You are the product face of reporting to GMs, BDC managers, controllers, and dealer group executives, and to the internal CSM and support teams who field their questions today. Expect to be in dealerships. Expect to run a customer advisory group. Expect to be the most trusted voice in the company on what dealers actually need from their data.
How we work
  • AI-native by default. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or equivalent are not occasional tools here. They are how we do PM work every day, from research synthesis to spec writing to prototyping. We will ask how you use them and we expect a real answer.
  • Customer-centric culture. PMs at DriveCentric spend time with the people who use our products. For reporting, that means dealership operators who live in these screens every day. If you only want to build from a backlog, this is not the role.
  • Lean and dense. Small team, high talent density, AI augmentation everywhere. We do not hire to fill org charts. We hire to multiply the leverage of the people already here.
  • Direct exposure. You report to the Staff PM for Data, CDP and Analytics, and work directly with the CPBO, VP of Product, the VP of Engineering, and our data platform and reporting leads. You will present to the executive team.
What you'll bring
  • 3 or more years in product management, or a comparable path into product from analytics, data, implementation, or a dealership operations role where you owned outcomes and shipped change. What we care about is judgment and evidence you have shipped, not the title on your last badge.
  • Automotive retail experience. You have worked at a dealership, a dealer group, or a vendor serving them, and you know how a store actually runs. You can hold a conversation with a GM about closing ratio, gross, aged inventory, or BDC appointment set rate without needing it translated, and you understand why the number a sales manager trusts and the number in the CRM are not always the same. You will be in front of dealers early and often in this role, and credibility there is not something you can pick up on the job.
  • Fluency with data products. You have worked on or near reporting, dashboards, BI, or analytics products. You can read SQL, reason about a schema, tell the difference between a data problem and a UI problem, and pressure test an engineer's proposal without getting out-argued.
