title: Data Science Manager -Marketing
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Manager, Marketing Mix Modeling & Marketing Measurement

What You Will Do

  • Serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for advancing Empower’s marketing effectiveness and marketing measurement capabilities, with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) as the primary focus.
  • Own the end-to-end Marketing Mix Modeling measurement process, from business-question definition and data readiness through model review, validation, refreshes, interpretation, and stakeholder adoption.
  • Partner with Marketing, Media, Finance, Data, Technology, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams to define business outcomes, media inputs, control variables, time periods, geographies, and appropriate model granularity.
  • Partner with external MMM vendors and technical modeling teams to review and challenge model specifications, assumptions, transformations, diagnostics, calibration approaches, sensitivity analyses, and results.
  • Translate MMM outputs into actionable marketing investment insights, including channel contribution, incremental impact, return on investment (ROI), return on ad spend (ROAS), marginal ROI, response curves, diminishing returns, and budget-allocation scenarios.
  • Communicate model uncertainty, limitations, assumptions, and decision guardrails to business and executive stakeholders.
  • Partner with data owners to improve the quality, consistency, and repeatability of marketing, media, business, and external data used for marketing measurement.
  • Establish repeatable processes for MMM refreshes, data and model quality checks, documentation, validation, and version history.
  • Manage external MMM and marketing measurement partners, evaluate deliverable quality, resolve issues, and facilitate knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Develop reusable data definitions, model-review standards, documentation, and marketing measurement playbooks.
  • Assess which MMM activities should remain vendor-supported and which data, validation, analytical, and modeling capabilities can progressively transition in-house.
  • Integrate MMM insights with complementary marketing measurement approaches, including experimentation, incrementality testing, campaign measurement, attribution, and brand measurement.
  • Support brand communication measurement by interpreting brand-health, brand-lift, and advertising-effectiveness studies and connecting findings to media strategy and business outcomes.
  • Build repeatable internal MMM standards, knowledge, and processes and contribute to the long-term marketing measurement roadmap.

What You Will Bring

  • 8–12 years of relevant experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, econometrics, advanced analytics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), including model development, validation, model refreshes, interpretation, or operationalization.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Extensive knowledge of Marketing Mix Modeling concepts and methodologies, including adstock/carryover, lagged effects, saturation, diminishing returns, seasonality, trends, control variables, multicollinearity, model calibration, and uncertainty.
  • Experience interpreting MMM outputs, including channel contribution, incremental impact, response curves, ROI, ROAS, marginal ROI, and marketing budget-allocation scenarios.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate model specifications, assumptions, transformations, diagnostics, sensitivity analyses, calibration approaches, and business reasonableness.
  • Experience working with marketing and media data across digital and traditional channels, including media spend, exposure, response, business outcomes, and relevant external factors.
  • Working proficiency in SQL and Python for data investigation, data quality checks, analysis, and model-output validation.
  • Experience independently managing complex marketing measurement initiatives involving external vendors and cross-functional stakeholders without formal people-management responsibility.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing and media concepts across digital and traditional channels.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate statistical and model results into commercially relevant marketing and investment decisions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, vendor management, prioritization, and execution skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready storytelling and the ability to communicate complex marketing measurement concepts clearly.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience building a Marketing Mix Modeling, marketing science, or marketing measurement capability from the ground up, including transitioning selected capabilities from external vendors to internal teams.
  • Experience using experimentation and incrementality methodologies, including geo experiments, geo tests, matched-market studies, lift studies, or similar approaches to validate or calibrate marketing measurement.
  • Experience with brand communication measurement, brand-health tracking, brand-lift studies, or advertising-effectiveness research.
  • Experience in financial services, retirement, or wealth management.

title: Senior Director & Head of Design
description:
The problem we are hiring you to solve
DriveCentric is the AI Engagement Platform built for automotive dealerships. Through DriveCentric AI Labs we ship native AI agents at a cadence of roughly one every 30 days, across Sales, Service, F&I, and Marketing.

That creates a design problem worth taking seriously. How does a dealership employee actually work alongside a growing fleet of agents, on the same customer, in the same platform, without the experience turning into noise?

We are hiring a Senior Director of Product Design to answer it. You will lead product design for the DriveCentric platform, define how we design agentic experiences, own information architecture across our product lines, and modernize how our team designs and builds.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, growing design team and you will still be personally in the work.

What you will own
  • Agentic experience design. How our agents behave in front of a human being. Designing for probabilistic systems where confidence, ambiguity, and failure are first-class states. Trust and transparency, so users can see what an agent did and why. The progressive autonomy ladder from suggest, to draft, to act with approval, to act on its own. And the handoff moment when a conversation moves from an agent to a real person without the customer feeling the seam.
  • Information architecture across product lines. IA coherent navigation, taxonomy, and permissions model spanning desktop and mobile, where one customer stays one record no matter which department is acting on them. This is a live platform with real customers, so it calls for staged, credible sequencing rather than a big-bang redesign.
  • How we design and build. Working prototypes as the default artifact instead of static frames. Designers building with AI tooling and shipping real code where it accelerates the work. Internal tooling that lets partners across the company produce on-brand work from design system components. And a craft bar that holds while everything speeds up.
  • The design system. A versioned, adopted, measurable product with real consumers, with accessibility built into the components rather than audited afterward.
  • The team. Lead, coach, and grow a small product design team, hire deliberately as we scale, and act as a peer to product and engineering leadership. You will spend real time in dealerships. That is a feature of this job.
What we are looking for
This list is short on purpose. If you meet these, apply, even if you do not match everything in the next section.
  • 8+ years designing software, including 3+ years leading designers in B2B SaaS. You have managed individual contributors, not only projects.
  • You have shipped AI-native or agentic features to production in a real product with real users. Not concepts, not a hackathon. We will want to talk about what broke and what you changed.
  • You personally build working prototypes with AI tooling. Cursor, Claude, v0, Figma Make, whatever you have standardized on. You will be asked to do this with us during the process. This one is a hard requirement.
  • You have restructured the information architecture of a mature, complex product that had existing customers and existing habits, and you can explain the migration path, not just the end state.
  • You have owned a design system used by multiple product lines and multiple engineering teams, and can speak to adoption and governance.
  • You have designed dense, operational software for non-technical professionals who use it all day under time pressure. Enterprise workflow, operations, healthcare, logistics, field service, fintech back office. A consumer-only background will be a stretch here.
  • You are still in the craft. You want to lead a team and personally design the hardest thing on the roadmap.

Nice to have
  • Automotive retail, dealership operations, or DMS and CRM adjacency.
  • You have reshaped a product built on an older paradigm around AI, rather than joining something AI-native on day one. That is precisely our situation.
  • A design engineering background, or internal tools you built that changed how a team works.
  • You have written or spoken publicly about agentic UX, trust and control patterns, or AI in the design process.
What this role is not
  • It is not a brand, marketing, or web design role. Those live with Marketing, and you will partner with them.
  • It is not greenfield. You are inheriting a mature platform, thousands of daily users, and real constraints. The satisfaction here is in the untangling.
  • It is not a role where design waits for a spec. You shape what gets built.
  • It is not a VP role, and we will not pretend otherwise. The scope is large and the level is Senior Director. If title is the deciding factor for you, better that we both know early.
How we hire
We will be explicit so you can prepare. A portfolio review built around two deep case studies, one agentic or AI experience you shipped and one information architecture or systems restructure. A live, collaborative prototyping session on a real DriveCentric problem using your own tooling, which is not spec work and not an unpaid deliverable. A leadership conversation about how you develop designers and set a craft bar. Conversations with product, engineering, and R&D. Then a final conversation with our Chief Product and Business Officer.

title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Overnight) - Dallas, TX
description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
  • Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
  • Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs
  • Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
  • Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.
  • Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
  • Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
  • Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships
  • Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
  • Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software
  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
  • A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
  • A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos
  • High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
  • Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
  • Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors
  • Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs
  • Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

  • Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
  • Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments
  • Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results
  • Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling
  • Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success
  • A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.
  • Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt
  • Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families
  • Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work
  • Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people
  • And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

As a School-Based Licensed Clinical Therapist at Heart of Florida Health Center, you will play a vital role in providing assessments, treatments, psychotherapy, and referrals within our school-based service sites. This position focuses on delivering individual, couples, and family therapy to students, staff, community members, and families, addressing a range of behavioral and mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, and substance use disorders. Qualifications and Requirements

  • Master’s Degree in Social Work, Counseling, Mental Health, Psychology or an acceptable related field

  • Clinical experience providing behavioral health assessment, counseling, or psychotherapy, preferably with children, adolescents, and families.

  • Demonstrated experience assessing and treating common behavioral health conditions affecting school-aged children and adolescents, including anxiety, depression, trauma, behavioral concerns, and family-related stressors.

  • Experience providing behavioral health services in a school-based, pediatric, community mental health, or other child-serving setting preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt therapeutic interventions to the developmental, emotional, and social needs of children and adolescents.

  • Experience collaborating with parents, guardians, school personnel, and other professionals to support patient treatment goals, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

Essential Functions

  • Plans and organizes behavioral health service delivery for Heart of Florida Health Center.

  • Provides individual, group, or family therapy to HFHC patients, using evidence-based models such as cognitive behavioral therapy, motivational interviewing, and psychoeducation.

  • Assesses patients utilizing the biopsychosocial model and utilizing evidenced based assessments for new patients to include but not limit GAD7, PHQ9, SBIRT, and MDQ.

  • Appropriately documents information and review assessments to determine best plan of care.

  • Establishes and maintains positive, therapeutic relationships with patients and their families.

  • Conducts interviews with patients and their families to assess and review their situation.

  • Provides assistance to patients by helping them cope with issues in their everyday lives and relationships by helping to address personal and family problems.

  • Uses evidence-based interventions to provide treatment to patients.

  • Maintains accurate records and documentation.

  • Ensures that treatment is delivered in accordance with high ethical and professional standards and achieves positive patient outcomes.

  • Ensures that patients’ rights are protected and reports any abuse/neglect to the proper authorities.

  • Counsels patients and identifies their psychosocial needs.

  • Prepares educational materials as needed or required.

  • Works closely with community partnerships.

  • Performs short term counseling and crisis intervention as necessary.

  • Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of patient privacy rights.

  • Maintains confidentiality of all medical, financial, and other sensitive materials and information in printed, electronic or verbal form, which may jeopardize the privacy of patients and/or employees.

  • Accesses and uses the minimum necessary patient identifiable information to perform job responsibilities and duties and only for authorized purposes.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

description:
Who we are

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. .

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Onboarding Operations Tech Lead

About the job

This position is needed to lead operational execution, architect risk and workflow strategies, and build the foundational systems for global onboarding. You will ensure that users and clients transition onto our platform efficiently, meeting all verification, compliance, and platform readiness requirements without operational drag.

We are looking for a domain expert who excels at turning chaotic, multi-channel processes into streamlined, automated platform controls. The ideal candidate has masterful operational investigative skills, excels at turning complex workflow data into functional product improvements, acts as a critical bridge translating technical engineering concepts into operational execution, and thrives when operating in a highly regulated industry especially when new deadlines are rolled out.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Architect Foundational Frameworks: Build and own the end-to-end Onboarding Ops roadmap, establishing baseline standard operating procedures (SOPs), service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational governance..
  • Translate Data to Strategy: Analyze operational telemetry, activation funnels, and drop-off metrics to uncover macro friction trends, directly designing targeted intervention logic and automated workflows to resolve them.
  • Bridge Operations & Product: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Go-To-Market teams to build long-term, structural platform controls, self-serve onboarding tooling, and automated verification checks.
  • Serve as a Technical Translator: Act as the critical link between Engineering and frontline Operations, demystifying complex technical platform changes, API updates, and engineering rollouts into actionable, easy-to-understand workflows and guidance for the operations team.
  • Optimize Operational Workflows: Drive process improvements, manage operational performance metrics (e.g., Time-to-Value, Activation Rate, CSAT), and continuously streamline manual intervention queues to maximize accuracy and team efficiency.
  • Manage High-Stakes Escalations: Serve as the final point of operational escalation for complex or high-value onboarding cases, navigating cross-functional risk vectors clearly with Legal, Trust & Safety, and Go-To-Market leaders.
  • Document & Institutionalize Knowledge: Author, refine, and maintain comprehensive runbooks, team playbooks, and training documentation for global operations teams.
  • Multiply Team Talent: Actively mentor early-in-career team members, build enablement frameworks, and lay the operational groundwork to scale the team as platform adoption grows.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a business or technology discipline, or equivalent practical job experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in operations, implementations, customer onboarding, or program management in tech, FinTech, SaaS, or complex digital ecosystems.
  • Proven track record of operating as a founding or pioneer team member, building operational frameworks, workflows, and policies in highly ambiguous environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects with Product and Engineering to automate manual operations.
  • Strong data fluency with experience using tools (SQL, Looker, Tableau, Snowflake, or similar) to analyze workflow performance, defend strategy decisions, and present findings to leadership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to explain complex technical workflows and operational requirements to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable managing absolute ambiguity, working independently without constant supervision, and making high-stakes decisions under tight operational SLAs.

Desired:

  • Advanced proficiency using SQL, Python, or workflow automation platforms to manipulate large data sets and automate tasks.
  • Direct experience with user identity verification, KYC, or regulatory compliance workflows during customer onboarding.
  • Expertise in process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile).
  • Proven experience building and scaling training programs for junior operations staff.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 10% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

title: Data & AI Trainee | Start Your Career in AI
description:
Are you curious about how Data and AI are transforming the way companies work?

If you're looking for an opportunity to develop practical skills in data analytics, Machine Learning and Generative AI while working on real business challenges, this traineeship will give you the chance to learn by doing. You’ll contribute to innovative projects, collaborate with experienced professionals and gain hands-on exposure to technologies that are shaping the future of business. You’ll be part of a collaborative and international team that values curiosity, experimentation and continuous improvement, while providing the support and mentoring you need to grow professionally.

What’s in it for you?

Learn from experienced Data & AI professionals You’ll work alongside Data Scientists, AI Engineers and business experts who will guide your development and help you build practical skills from day one.

Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies You’ll be exposed to Machine Learning, Generative AI, Azure, Databricks and Power BI while working on real use cases and business initiatives.

Develop both technical and business understanding You won’t just work with data. You’ll learn how AI solutions solve real business problems and create value for users and customers.

Participate in meaningful projects You’ll contribute to Data & AI initiatives, proofs of concept and the continuous improvement of AI-powered solutions used across the business.

Grow in a flexible and innovative environment You’ll be part of a people-focused culture that encourages continuous learning, collaboration and professional development.

Questions you may be asking yourself

“Do I need professional experience in AI?” No. This traineeship is designed for people at the beginning of their careers. What matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in Data & AI.

“Will I be expected to work independently from day one?” Not at all. You'll receive mentoring, guidance and regular support from experienced team members while gradually increasing your responsibilities.

“Do I need to know every technology listed?” No. Some familiarity is helpful, but we value learning potential and analytical thinking more than extensive technical experience.

What will help you succeed in this role

  • Basic knowledge of Python and SQL, which will help you work with data and support analytics and AI initiatives.

  • Interest in Data Analytics, Machine Learning and Generative AI, allowing you to quickly absorb new concepts and technologies.

  • A technical or quantitative academic background, such as Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Strong curiosity and willingness to learn, as you’ll be continuously exposed to new tools, technologies and business challenges.

  • Ability to organize your work and communicate clearly, helping you collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Advanced English, as you’ll work with international teams and participate in global initiatives.

  • Exposure to Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Git or AI-related projects is a plus, but not essential.

Your mission

Your mission will be to support the development and continuous improvement of Data and AI solutions, helping the team improve business processes, enhance user experiences and unlock value through data-driven innovation.

What will you do?

  • Support the maintenance and evolution of the AI Assistant used by the commercial network, including content updates, testing and configuration activities.

  • Prepare and validate data for AI initiatives, contributing to data quality, ETL activities and reporting through tools such as Databricks and Power BI.

  • Collaborate on Machine Learning and Generative AI initiatives, gaining exposure to model preparation, evaluation and testing activities.

  • Participate in proofs of concept and innovation projects, working alongside business, IT and international stakeholders.

  • Document and communicate findings, ensuring compliance with data quality, governance, privacy and responsible AI standards.

Ready to start your journey in Data & AI?

If you're excited about data, curious about artificial intelligence and eager to learn in a supportive, innovative environment, this traineeship offers a unique opportunity to build the foundations of your career while contributing to meaningful projects at NN Spain. We'd love to get to know you.

If you think that your profile can fit with us and you like who we are, do not hesitate to sign in to our offers. We are waiting for you!

In Nationale-Nederlanden we are committed with diversity. We are proud to be an inclusive organization and we offer equal opportunities, regardless of race, cultural background, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, marital status, and sexual orientation. One of our core values is taking care of our employees so they can give their best within a respectful environment.

description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) is a non-profit, bipartisan public policy organization established in 1962 to provide strategic insights and practical policy solutions to decision makers concerned with global security and prosperity. Over the years, it has grown to be one of the largest organizations of its kind, with a staff of some 275 employees, including more than 120 analysts working to address the changing dynamics of international security across the globe.

JOB SUMMARY

The Project on Nuclear Issues (PONI) identifies and cultivates emerging leaders in the nuclear field and builds the relationships, expertise, and cross-community engagement needed to address pressing policy challenges. Through its programs, PONI provides opportunities for emerging experts to learn about the policy, technical, and operational aspects of the nuclear enterprise; develop and present new ideas; engage in informed debate; and visit sites across the nuclear community. PONI also conducts research across the full range of nuclear policy issues, including deterrence, arms control, and disarmament.

PONI is seeking a full-time paid intern to support the program’s research, programmatic, and administrative work from early October to mid-December 2026. title: Scrum Master Lead Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
bout Cigna

Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.

Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.

We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.

Purpose of the Role

The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence-based improvement.

This role supports high-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.

About the Role

The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.

The role enables teams to self-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.

This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.

Key Responsibilities

Team Coaching and Agile Enablement

  • Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.

  • Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.

  • Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self-management.

  • Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.

  • Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.

Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement

  • Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.

  • Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.

  • Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.

  • Facilitate evidence-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow-through on agreed outcomes.

  • Encourage Built-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day-to-day team working practices.

Facilitation and Cadence Events

  • Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.

  • Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.

  • Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.

  • Support ART-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect & Adapt, as applicable.

ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments

  • Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.

  • Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.

  • Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.

  • Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.

  • Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.

Success in this Role

  • Teams demonstrate stronger self-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.

  • Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.

  • Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome-focused, and continuously improved.

  • Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.

  • Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.

  • Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.

Required Qualifications / Skills / Experience

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.

  • At least 6 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.

  • Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of Lean-Agile principles, Scrum practices, Kanban practices, and team-level Agile delivery.

  • Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.

  • Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.

  • Knowledge of IT concepts, software delivery lifecycle, delivery methodologies, architecture considerations, and technical standards.

Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience

  • Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration tools.

  • Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service-based delivery teams.

  • Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.

  • Experience in software development lifecycle, IT delivery, product delivery, or project management.

About The Cigna Group

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Job Description:

Responsibilities

  • Own verification planning and execution for Vector, ALU, floating-point blocks from testplanning to unit level verification and integration to core level.

  • Drive verification strategy, test planning, Testbench development, tests writing, debug, coverage analysis, and closure for complex Vector, ALU, FPU execution-pipeline and datapath behaviours.

  • Define effective verification approaches for arithmetic, floating-point, operand dependency, bypass/forwarding, replay, flush/recovery, exception, and execution-to-commit interactions.

  • Develop robust verification environments, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, stimulus, and coverage models that expose corner cases and improve bug-finding efficiency.

  • Partner closely with architecture, design, and verification teams to review specifications, identify risk early, and improve verification completeness.

  • Drive efficient root-cause debug across specification, RTL, tests, and verification infrastructure.

  • Contribute reusable methodology, automation, and infrastructure that improve verification quality and productivity across future CPU core programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in ASIC, CPU/core, or SoC design verification.

  • Strong hands-on experience with SystemVerilog, UVM -based verification and modern verification methodologies.

  • Solid understanding of computer architecture and CPU microarchitecture.

  • Experience verifying one or more of the following areas: ALU pipelines, floating-point execution, datapath verification, formal verification, issue/dispatch behavior, dependency handling, forwarding, replay, or exception handling.

  • Strong knowledge of verification flow methodology, including test planning, stimulus generation, debug, coverage analysis, and coverage closure.

  • Good scripting or programming skills in Python, C/C++, or similar languages used for DV infrastructure and automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-performance out-of-order CPU core verification.

  • Experience developing high-value assertions, checkers, and scoreboards for control-heavy or dependency-sensitive CPU behavior.

  • Experience applying formal verification to execution logic, control interactions, or datapath correctness.

  • Experience collaborating effectively across architecture, design, performance, and verification teams.

India

description:

  • As Work Monitor designated representative, perform quality assurance actions to ensure subcontractor is performing all duties and responsibilities IAW prescribed contract.

JOB SUMMARY

This role is responsible for supervising a team of processing agents and ensuring work is performed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with all internal procedures and regulatory standards. Core areas of oversight include deboning, sifting, grading, trimming, product remediation, and sanitation. The Processing Supervisor will support quality control processes, scheduling, training, and productivity tracking across the team, reporting directly to site leadership.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND SKILLS

Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

title: Avionics Technician Lead, MQ-9 (Japan/Deployable)
description:
The MQ-9 Avionics Technician Lead is a highly qualified and skilled aircraft electronics and Ground Control Station (GCS) technician with experience in troubleshooting multiple electronics systems both aircraft and control stations. They will directly support the USMC MQ-9 Site Manager by leading, performing, and inspecting organizational level maintenance while at the same time being available to support hands-on maintenance and leadership/training on an as needed basis. They will be part of a Deployment Pool and will support deployments to various CONUS/OCONUS locations, as required. This position will require the member to be flexible in the support of assigned deployment/work schedules.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Exercise independent judgment and lead a team of avionics technicians to complete daily aircraft maintenance tasks based on priorities set by their assigned supervisor.
  • This position requires an individual that can apply expert technical knowledge to solve complex problems by interpreting technical publications, manufacturers’ manuals/instructions or similar documents through the usage of test equipment/instruments to affect repairs.
  • Performs all daily launch/recovery duties in support of operational requirements.
  • Maintain assigned MQ-9 aircraft electrical generators, load banks, starters, relays, batteries, actuators, circuit breakers, switches, and aircraft instruments.
  • Apply advanced technical knowledge to solve complex problems that typically cannot be solved solely by referencing manufacturers’ manuals or similar documents. Examples of such problems include determining the location and density of circuitry, evaluating electromagnetic radiation, isolating malfunctions, and incorporating engineering changes.
  • Work typically requires an understanding of the interrelationships of circuits, exercising independent judgment in performing such tasks as making circuit analyses, calculating wave forms, and tracing relationships in signal flow, using complex test instruments such as high frequency pulse generators, frequency synthesizers, distortion analyzers, and complex computer control equipment.
  • Make entries in aircraft logs and records, attend shift change maintenance meetings, perform as a QA, and is responsible for providing guidance and technical expertise to lower-level technicians throughout all aircraft modifications and/or maintenance efforts.
  • Apply advanced technical knowledge to solve unusually complex problems that affect operational and maintenance capabilities.
  • Use common and complex test instruments in the performance of assigned duties.
  • Provides training to lower-level avionic technicians.
  • Sign off work in either NALCOMIS/OOMA or IMDS.
  • Maintain, repair, and install various types of electronic equipment and related devices.
  • Apply advanced technical knowledge of electronics principles in determining malfunctions and apply skill in restoring equipment operations.
  • Recommend revisions to maintenance procedures to improve efficiency and ensure quality workmanship.
  • Able to work without direct supervision.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Active Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.
  • High School Diploma or have completed relevant military and/or vocational technical school curriculum.
  • Eight (8) years of actual Aircraft Avionics and/or GCS maintenance experience required.
  • Three (3) years of experience on MQ-9 Aircraft and/or GCS, as an Avionics Technician.
  • Advanced knowledge of basic and complex mechanical maintenance and repair.
  • Advanced knowledge of technical publications related to aircraft mechanical maintenance.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of aircraft mechanical component troubleshooting/repair procedures and replacement of components, a thorough knowledge of aircraft sheet metal/structural modification and repair and the ability to determine functionality of non-complex electrical systems.
  • Know theory and principles of operation of engines, accessories and components, theory of flight and electronic flight controls, and have an advanced understanding of applicable systems.
  • Have been designated a CDI or Red-X inspector for MQ-9 aircraft.
  • Able to inspect and operate ground support and auxiliary equipment.
  • Have knowledge of CNAFINST 4790.2 NAMP and/or DAFI 21-101.
  • Achieve a passing grade in all required courses/certifications for continued employment, as needed.
  • Able to lift, carry and/or wear Military Issued Equipment in excess of 50 pounds for extended periods.
  • Able to speak, read, write, and understand English.
  • Current/active State Issued Driver’s License.
  • Able to acquire and maintain a valid flight-line Government Driver’s License.
  • Able to travel on CONUS/OCONUS deployments.
  • Meet all OCONUS deployment criteria, to include pre-deployment medical screening, as a condition of employment.
  • Have a valid U.S. Passport with a minimum of two years remaining with at least two facing pairs (four total) of blank Visa pages.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supervising small teams in completing daily tasks.
  • MQ-9 Avionics Technician experience within the last two (2) years.
  • At least one (1) year of experience on both MQ-9 Aircraft and GCS, as an Avionics Technician.
  • Associate degree in a relevant career field.
  • Current IAT Level II Certification.
  • Deployment experience.
  • Prior experience as a Defense Contractor.

title: Software Engineer - Automation
description:
As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.


Why Join Q2?

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.


What Makes Q2 Special?

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.


Why this role

Most engineering roles hand you a slice. A product owner sets the “what,” a manager sets the “how,” and you build your piece inside someone else’s sprint. This role starts one step earlier — before the problem even has a name.

We don’t build the product our customers log into. We build the tools that make the whole company faster, and the systems that catch a problem before a customer ever feels it. When what we build works, everyone ships and resolves faster. When it doesn’t, everyone feels it. At the Principal level, you own that leverage for the whole org: you decide what should exist, and you build it.

Here is how the work actually starts. Sometimes a friction point lands overnight and someone has to own it end to end by morning. More often, nobody has named the problem yet — and you are the one who sees it, frames it so the rest of us understand it, and sets the direction we build toward. You dig into an ambiguous system until you understand it better than the people living inside it, then you reach for code, AI, and systems to remove or replace the bottleneck — not to optimize around it. What you ship did not exist before, scales across the company, and becomes something other engineers build on.

This is blue-water work. There is frequently no tool to configure, no vendor to call, and no best practice to copy — the thing does not exist yet, and your job is to invent it, then make it something the org can run without you. If your best year would be spent tuning one system a few percent faster, you will be bored here. If you’d rather build the thing that goes to Mars — and you’ve already been the person whose designs your org couldn’t ship fast enough — keep reading.

What you’ll do

  • Decide what should exist. Find the highest-leverage problem no one has scoped yet, frame it so engineers and executives both get it, and set the technical direction the team aligns to.

  • Build it end to end. Whiteboard, prototype, architecture, production — you take ambiguous problems (sometimes the overnight fire-drill) all the way to something operable, and you can still go deep in code when it matters.

  • Build with AI as a first-class tool. Extend our in-house, cloud-hosted agentic AI platform — including self-hosted models that already resolve a meaningful share of alerts with no human in the loop — and use it to make previously impractical problems tractable.

  • Replace bottlenecks, don’t optimize them. Re-architect the risky, manual pathways people fight today into secure, self-service tools with the right guardrails and audit built in.

  • Multiply the org. Create the platforms, patterns, and standards other engineers build on; decompose big problems and hand off well-scoped pieces; grow a bench of builders and hold the quality bar on work you didn’t write — so you’re free to go work the next hard thing.

  • Make the work legible. Socialize designs with senior leaders, defend an architecture to a room of principals and to the exec team in the same afternoon, and keep plans and outcomes visible as you go — real influence, not death by process.

  • Own what you ship. Including light, event-driven on-call for the things you build — not a rotation for systems you didn’t.

What we’re looking for

  • A builder’s track record at scale. You’ve shipped tools and platforms others now depend on — things that didn’t exist before you built them, used well beyond your own team.

  • Systems you can hold in your head. You reverse-engineer and understand complex, cross-team systems before you change them.

  • AI as a build accelerant. Fluency with LLMs, agents, and self-hosted models, and the judgment to know where they create leverage and where they don’t.

  • Force multiplication. You can name specific engineers you’ve made materially better, and patterns or platforms others now build on.

  • Strong, general engineering ability. Full-stack and production-quality. We work primarily in C# and Go, with Python everywhere — we care that you can build, not that you’ve memorized our stack. Friction as opportunity. You can’t leave a normalized bottleneck alone.

EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE
• Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with 3+ years of experience; or equivalent related work experience
• Strong proficiency in backend and scripting languages (C#, Go, Python)
• Experience building and consuming APIs at scale
• Knowledge of containerized applications and cloud-native environments
• Advanced experience with Grafana, Splunk, and telemetry pipelines
• Familiarity with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
• Experience designing self-service tools for observability data access
• Strong troubleshooting skills across OS, app, and network layers
• Knowledge of Microsoft Internet Information Services and/or NGINX websites
• Knowledge and troubleshooting of Linux operating systems, particularly Red Hat or CentOS

This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.

title: Tour Settlements Officer
description:
Job Summary:

About Live Nation:

Join the team at Live Nation, where innovation meets live entertainment on a global scale! With 40,000 shows and 500 million tickets sold each year, we’re the industry leader, powered by 44,000 talented individuals worldwide. At Live Nation, we’re passionate about transforming live events and creating extraordinary moments for artists, event professionals, and fans.

About the role:

We're looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Tour Settlements Officer (Assistant Accountant) to join Live Nation's Touring Finance team in Melbourne.

In this 9-month fixed term contract, you'll assist with the settlements process for concerts and tours across Australia and New Zealand, working closely with Tour Accountants and Promoters to make sure all financial information relating to a tour is accurately coded in the accounts payable system. You'll also be responsible for ensuring cash deposits are correctly allocated and that all supporting documentation is in order.

If you think you have what it takes, apply now with your resume and a cover letter outlining why you're the perfect fit for this role.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Settlement accuracy: Ensure correct GL coding and cash receipting of venue settlements.
  • Invoice compliance: Check invoice operational approvals are compliant with approval limits before approving in the invoice workflow platform.
  • Documentation management: Ensure all event related invoices are saved in tour folders.
  • Journal processing: Load tour related journals to Oracle.
  • Audit preparation: Prepare end of tour audit checklists to ensure key tour documentation is held on file for audit purposes.
  • Compliance submissions: Prepare APRA/PPCA submissions for sign off.
  • Cash flow coordination: Liaise with the bank to arrange cash floats requested by Tour Accountants.
  • Process improvement: Actively review the settlement process to identify efficiencies and improvements.

What you’ll bring:

  • Accounting foundation: Experience in an Assistant Accountant role, or in an accounting function in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong ability to interpret financial data, identify variances, and present clear reconciliations and commentary.
  • Collaborative approach: A team player with a positive attitude who takes pride in accuracy and manages multiple competing deadlines.
  • Excel proficiency: Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with comfort across the broader Microsoft Office suite.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic, deadline driven environment where priorities can shift quickly.
  • Industry interest: A genuine interest in music, live entertainment, or events, with an appreciation for the fast-paced nature of touring and peak periods.

The Benefits:

  • A vibrant, music-focused workplace fostering creativity and collaboration.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • A flexible approach to when and where you work, designed to support balance in all aspects of life.
  • Access to concerts, events, and other entertainment perks.
  • A diverse, equitable workplace where every voice matters.
  • Comprehensive benefits, from volunteer days to wellness programs and mental health support.

Equal Opportunities:

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

title: Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) 2
description:
Amentum is seeking an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) 2 for a new prime contract that is based out of our Maryland office.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide support for a program, organization, system, or enclave's information assurance program.
  • Provide support for proposing, coordinating, implementing, and enforcing information systems security policies, standards, and methodologies.
  • Maintain operational security posture for an information system or program to ensure information systems security policies, standards, and procedures are established and followed.
  • Assist with the management of security aspects of the information system and perform day-to-day security operations of the system.
  • Evaluate security solutions to ensure they meet security requirements for processing classified information.
  • Perform vulnerability/risk assessment analysis to support security authorization.
  • Provide configuration management (CM) for information systems security software, hardware, and firmware.
  • Manage changes to system and assess the security impact of those changes.
  • Prepare and review documentation to include System Security Plans (SSPs), Risk Assessment Reports, Certification and Accreditation (C&A) packages, and System Requirements Traceability Matrices (SRTMs).
  • Support security authorization activities in compliance with National Institute of Standards and Technology Risk Management Framework (NIST RMF).

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Provide support to senior ISSOs for implementing, and enforcing information systems security policies, standards, and methodologies
  • Assist with preparation and maintenance of documentation
  • Assist in the evaluation of security solutions to ensure they meet security requirements for processing classified information
  • Assist with Configuration Management (CM) for information system security software, hardware, and firmware
  • Maintain records on workstations, servers, routers, firewalls, intelligent hubs, network switches, etc. to include system upgrades
  • Propose, coordinate, and implement information systems security policies, standards, and methodologies
  • Develop and maintain documentation for Security Authorization in accordance with ODNI and DoD policies
  • Provide CM for security-relevant information system software, hardware, and firmware
  • Ensure compliance with system security policy
  • Evaluate security solutions to ensure they meet security requirements for processing classified information
  • Maintain operational security posture for an information system or program
  • Provide support to the information System Security Manager (ISSM) for maintaining the appropriate operational Cybersecurity posture for a system, program, or enclave
  • Develop and update the system security plan and other Cybersecurity documentation
  • Assist with the management of security aspects of the information system and perform day-to­ day security operations of the system
  • Track and ensure appropriate user identification and authentication mechanism of the information System (IS)
  • Obtain system authorization for ISs under their purview
  • Provide support for a program, organization, system, or enclave's information assurance program
  • Plan and coordinate implementation of IT security programs and policies
  • Manage and control changes to the system assessing the security impact of those changes
  • Provide daily oversight and direction to contractor ISSOs
  • Interact with customers, IT staff, and high-level corporate officers to define and achieve required Cybersecurity objectives

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Cyber Security, IT Engineering or related field is required.
  • In lieu of a bachelor's degree, four (4) additional years of work-related experience may be substituted for a total of twelve (12) years.

Minimum Years of Experience:

  • Eight (8) years of combined work-related experience in the fields of IT, cybersecurity or security authorization is required. Experience in at least two of the following areas is required: knowledge of current security tools, hardware/software security implementation; communication protocols; or encryption tools and techniques. Familiarity with commercial security products, security authorization techniques, security incident management, and PKI and authorization services.

Required Certifications:

  • Compliance with DoD 8570.01-M with a minimum certification of IAM Level I is required.

title: C3 Presents - Festival Operations & Sustainability Intern
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

C3 Presents (which is owned by Live Nation Entertainment) creates live experiences for millions of fans across the globe, setting the new standard each year for events that are as memorable as they are spectacular. One of the world’s largest music festival producers, C3 is the force behind two of the most iconic multi-day festivals — Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas and Lollapalooza in Chicago and its six international editions — drawing a combined 2 million music lovers annually.

Headquartered in Austin, TX, with offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, New Orleans, and Nashville, the company also promotes thousands of concerts annually in arenas, casinos and clubs throughout North America.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At C3 Presents, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you, then please read on!

THE POSITION

Are you looking for an exciting internship experience? Our paid Internship Program offers real-world exposure for students interested in the live entertainment industry. Throughout the program, you’ll gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of the live event business while applying your academic knowledge to real-world situations. You’ll also strengthen your leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills along the way.

This part-time position requires 15–25 hours per week. Interns are expected to work in our Austin office Tuesday through Thursday, so please ensure your availability aligns with these days. The internship runs through the 2027 Spring semester, beginning January 19, 2027, and concluding May 6, 2027.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Manage calendars, including scheduling and coordinating meetings, appointments, and other obligations

  • Take meeting minutes or notes, create agendas, and assist with meeting preparation

  • Coordinate with vendors and submit required paperwork as needed

  • Research, develop, and assist with implementing sustainability initiatives

  • Support department staffing activities, including organizing and maintaining offer letters, timecards, and reimbursements

  • Assist with miscellaneous tasks in the office and on-site, as requested

LEARNING OBJECTIVES

  • Gain knowledge and perspective within the Site Operations department

  • Learn the essential roles and responsibilities involved in laying the groundwork for successful C3 festivals and live events

  • Apply academic learning and internship experience to real-world situations

  • Strengthen leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • This role requires you to be in our Austin, TX office

  • Previous experience preferred (school, internship, or professional)

  • Creative thinker and problem solver

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and initiative

  • Competency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Exercises sound judgment with professionalism and discretion

  • Able to commit to 15-25 hours per week, with in-office availability Tuesday through Thursday

  • Ability to bring a personal laptop to the office

C3 COMPETENCIES

  • Demonstrate integrity in the way you operate in day-to-day business and the way you deal with people.

  • Communicate effectively with various audiences by organizing and delivering information appropriately and listening actively to others.

  • Proactively seek solutions to problems. Be enthusiastic and energetic in your approach to your job. Commit to putting in extra effort with a positive attitude.

  • Be flexible in handling change, able to juggle multiple demands, and adaptable to new situations with fresh ideas or innovative approaches.

  • Stay composed, confident, optimistic, and in problem-solving mode when the going gets tough.

  • Possess the skills needed to perform your job well, paying close attention to detail, accuracy, and completeness.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. title: HR Shared Services Consultant
description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

The HR Shared Services team is looking for a creative, resourceful, and organized HR Consultant to support a thoughtful and effective employee experience. You will provide analytical support and operational oversight within a shared services environment, handling a variety of complex functions related to HR and the full employee lifecycle.You will analyze data, develop insights, troubleshoot issues, participate in special projects and drive process improvement initiatives within the Shared Services function, including emerging AI technologies.

The HR Consultant will have a strong ability to work independently and proactively, leveraging critical thinking, anecdotes from relevant internal stakeholders, and data to anticipate potential issues and support solutions before they arise. In addition, the Consultant will consistently drive work forward autonomously, demonstrating strong initiative and ownership. Innovation is also a key component of success in this role, as we will look to you to proactively suggest improvements and drive process enhancements, whether based on your day-to-day work or identified through cross-functional collaboration.

Our People & Culture team works collaboratively and is known for solving problems and finding solutions at high speed —allowing others to do what they do best! You will join a team of creative, motivated, and goal-oriented problem solvers who are deeply connected to, and have a big impact on the people of Stitch Fix.

Responsibilities:

Employee Experience

  • Identify gaps and inefficiencies, provide standardization and improvement recommendations which impact the full employee lifecycle from hire to retire.
  • Interact with employees, managers, and other internal teams including HR Business Partners, Recruiting, Compensation, L&D, Legal, and IT to provide direction and clarity on processes related to the employee life cycle and systems.
  • Own Tier II specialized support for important Shared Services programs such as immigration and unemployment, as well as complex employee issues, and maintain data integrity within Workday and other enterprise systems.
  • Identify gaps and opportunities and own process improvements for shared services tools and systems utilizing cutting edge technologies.
  • Consistently look for opportunities to enhance employee self service, drive adoption and support ongoing enhancements to automate workflows and increase self service utilization.

Metrics & Reporting:

  • Serve as administrator for the FreshService ticketing systems and other tools that support metrics & reporting.
  • Use captured data to inform monthly and quarterly data insights for internal customers and People team to help drive business decisions and to inform process and vendor enhancements.

Compliance:

  • Maintain working knowledge and ability to research current, local employment laws, best practices and ensure Stitch Fix policies are legally compliant.
  • Utilize new tools and technology to proactively support the design and implement of new compliance processes and improvements and maintain and revise current compliance and audit standards.

Vendor Management:

  • Provide recommendations to Shared Services leadership for enhancements to increase efficiency and add value to the user experience.
  • Maintain vendor relationships - support vendor relationships for effective operations and to ensure consistent service delivery and scalable solutions.

People Programs:

  • Own and participate in ad hoc projects that support the broader People team and partner groups including HR Business Partners, Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation and IT teams.

How AI and tools show up in your day-to-day work.

  • Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) to improve efficiency and outcomes
  • Work with core tools and systems relevant to the role
  • Comfort learning and applying new technologies

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

Requirements:

  • You have 2-4 years of experience in HR in a people-focused or HR operations role; Have a Bachelor or Associate degree, or equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • You use creativity and your analytical skills to remove obstacles while working collaboratively with others.
  • You are an expert multi-tasker who is able to ruthlessly prioritize tasks.
  • You possess top-notch organization skills, strong attention to detail to develop and execute plans .
  • You seamlessly adapt and adjust plans, as needed, using internal and external inputs; might be a mind reader - you are consistently able to anticipate needs.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to interact with all levels of the company.
  • You are proficient with Excel, Google Suite, HRIS; have the ability to quickly and efficiently learn how to use new systems and tools.
  • You are skilled at analyzing and synthesizing metrics and data to identify trends, patterns, and areas of opportunity.

You’ll love working at Stitch Fix because you will…

  • Fuse human creativity and styling expertise to redefine personalized retail.
  • Set a high bar for our craft and drive measurable impact across fashion, tech, and data science.
  • Actively leverage AI and modern tech to evolve how work gets done.
  • Lead with innovation, think boldly, and aren't afraid to challenge conventional retail norms.
  • Win together in a collaborative, low-ego environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated.
  • Be client obsessed by putting our customers at the heart of every decision to deliver unmatched personalization and trust.
  • Support our team with competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful career growth.

Compensation and Benefits

This role will receive a competitive salary and benefits. The salary for US-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below, which includes our three geographic areas. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, location, and performance. In addition, the position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and other benefits. Applicants should apply via our internal or external careers site.

Salary Range
$58,900—$98,000 USD
