title: Data Migration Intern
description:
As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.


Why Join Q2?

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.


What Makes Q2 Special?

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.


SUMMARY Q2 is seeking a Data Migration Engineer Intern that will join an existing data migration team that’s responsible for converting the client’s online banking data from their legacy system onto the Q2 platform. This is a technical implementation role that requires mid-sized application experience. The Data Migration Intern will work closely with the Platform and Project Services Implementation teams to migrate client’s data from their legacy online banking provider to Q2’s required data format. The preferred candidate will be an exceptionally detail-oriented, energetic, self-starter who can work independently and, in a team-setting. We are seeking an analytically minded individual passionate about data and one with a keen eye for detail! This role is working in one of the most visible departments at Q2 and you will have the opportunity for a lot of career growth and development.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Construct and schedule automated processes and create custom processing scripts
  • Regularly troubleshoot complex client application, integration and environment issues • Troubleshoot and resolve customer data migration problems of a complex nature
  • Thoroughly document and track production environment modifications
  • Manage multiple projects while regularly receiving escalated cases from management and prioritize accordingly
  • Escalate unresolved problems to the appropriate resources
  • Establish relationships with other partner teams that impact technical support including Implementation Teams, Data Center Operations, QA, and Development
  • Follow internal change control processes to implement any required production modifications
  • Contribute to a knowledge/FAQ database for supported software
  • Responsible for ensuring that all security, availability, confidentiality and privacy policies and controls are adhered to


EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE: • Typically requires a bachelor’s Degree in related field and 0-2 years of experience • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills required • Keen attention to detail while keeping an eye toward the big picture • Database knowledge with MS SQL 2005 or 2008 experience required • Experience with Python, advanced SQL Scripting (TSQL), and .net programming • Availability to work weekends and the occasional late night or early morning is required • Enterprise/mid-sized software delivery experience preferred • Understanding of remote tools and networking required • Ability to deal with ambiguity, tight timelines and demanding constraints • Ability to work on multiple assignments, prioritize, and resolve issues in a timely manner within a high-pressure environment. • Innate desire to find the root cause of technical issues, while balancing business needs to identify, support, and solve customer needs. • Knowledge of banking practices is helpful.

This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.

Our Culture & Commitment:

We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.

title: Analyst, Technology and Operations
description:
The Compliance Technology and Operations Analyst serves as a bridge between Compliance, Operations, and Technology, partnering across the organization to modernize, streamline, and automate regulatory and compliance processes. This role is responsible for identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, strengthen controls, and leverage technology solutions to support the firm's compliance framework.

The ideal candidate combines regulatory awareness, operational excellence, process improvement expertise, and technical aptitude. They are comfortable translating business requirements into practical technology solutions and driving initiatives that enhance the effectiveness, scalability, and consistency of the Compliance function.

THE SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE IS EXPECTED TO:

Compliance Process Automation

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize opportunities to automate manual compliance activities.
  • Partner with Compliance, Technology, and Operations teams to design and implement workflow automation solutions.
  • Support implementation and enhancement of compliance technology platforms, including surveillance, employee compliance, licensing, AML, regulatory change management, and monitoring systems.
  • Reduce reliance on manual processes and spreadsheets through automation, workflow optimization, and system integration.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and regulatory technology (RegTech) solutions to strengthen compliance operations.

Compliance Operations & Technology Enablement

  • Gather and document business requirements from Compliance stakeholders.
  • Translate compliance requirements into technology specifications and implementation plans.
  • Serve as a liaison between Compliance and Technology teams during system implementations, upgrades, and enhancements.
  • Support platform administration, user acceptance testing, issue resolution, and ongoing system governance.
  • Assist with vendor management activities and the evaluation of third-party compliance technology solutions.

Process Improvement & Control Enhancement

  • Document and map current-state and future-state compliance processes.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies, control gaps, and opportunities for standardization.
  • Recommend and implement solutions that improve effectiveness while maintaining regulatory compliance.
  • Develop procedures, workflows, and operating documentation that support sustainable operations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across the Compliance organization.

Governance, Risk & Regulatory Support

  • Assist with regulatory examinations, audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Support compliance testing and monitoring activities through process improvements and technology-enabled controls.
  • Help establish governance frameworks for compliance technology platforms and operational processes.
  • Partner with Compliance leadership to ensure key controls remain effective and scalable as the organization grows.

Project Management & Change Enablement

  • Participate in strategic compliance transformation initiatives.
  • Track project milestones, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate across Compliance, Legal, Operations, Technology, and business stakeholders.
  • Support change management, training, and user adoption efforts associated with new technologies and processes.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, or related field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit, Operations, Business Analysis, or Financial Services Technology.
  • Experience documenting business requirements, workflows, and operating procedures.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience within asset management, private equity, private credit, wealth management, or banking.
  • Familiarity with SEC, FINRA, AML, and other financial regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with workflow automation or process improvement tools such as Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting compliance technology or regulatory technology (RegTech) implementations.
  • Lean Six Sigma, Agile, Scrum, or project management certifications.

Critical Competencies

  • Compliance Operations
  • Process Automation
  • Technology Enablement
  • Business Analysis
  • Process Mapping & Documentation
  • Regulatory Risk Awareness
  • Project Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Change Management

Success Measures

Success in this role is demonstrated through:

  • Reduction in manual compliance activities and operational inefficiencies.
  • Successful implementation and adoption of compliance technology solutions.
  • Improved effectiveness, scalability, and consistency of compliance processes.
  • Enhanced control environment and reduced operational risk.
  • Timely delivery of compliance transformation initiatives.
  • Strong partnership across Compliance, Technology, Operations, and business teams.

title: Staff Fullstack Developer- Simulation
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Vacancy Status:

This posting is not for an existing vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications. (New Head Count)

AI Disclosure:

As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

Remote - This role is categorized as remote. This means the successful candidate may be based anywhere in Canada and is not expected to report to a GM worksite unless directed by their manager.

About the role:

GM’s simulation team is looking for an experienced staff fullstack developer to be a key technical leader in our mission to deliver autonomous driving technologies safely. This is a high-impact role where your work directly enables the validation of our most complex AI-driven systems.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Vision: Define the architectural roadmap for our Simulation Scenario Definition platform and/or its programmatic Typescript/Python SDK.

  • Scalable Tooling: Lead the design and implementation of our next-generation graphical editing tools used by hundreds of engineers to precisely define complex traffic, environment, and sensor scenarios.

  • Performance & Infrastructure: Drive the evolution of our Python infrastructure, focusing on core algorithms for scenario serialization, validation, and integration with our large-scale cloud compute cluster.

  • Mentorship: Act as a hands-on mentor, setting the engineering excellence standard for API design, code quality, and testing practices across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience minimum in software development, with a significant portion focused on large-scale platforms, tooling, or SDK development.

  • Proven ability to lead technical architecture and drive complex, multi-quarter projects from concept to production.

  • Strong experience with front-end engineering for sophisticated graphical applications using TypeScript (e.g., using modern frameworks like React or Vue, and graphical/mapping libraries like WebGL/Three.js, or MapboxGL).

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python, including deep knowledge of best practices, performance optimization, and building robust APIs/SDKs for external consumers.

  • A track record of mentoring and coaching mid-level and senior engineers, raising the technical bar, and driving code quality standards within a team.

Desired Skills (Bonus Points)

  • Solid foundation in 3D graphics, computational geometry, and/or real-time simulation concepts.

  • Direct experience developing or extending a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) or high-level scripting language.

  • Background in game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal) or other professional simulation software.

  • Experience in data visualization techniques for large, complex datasets.

  • Familiarity with the architecture of Autonomous Vehicle (AV) technology (e.g., perception, planning, controls) or other complex robotics/safety-critical systems.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $167,000 to $216,200. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP NOW OR IN THE FUTURE

Benefits:

The goal of the General Motors of Canada total rewards program is to support the health and well-being of you and your family. Our comprehensive compensation plan currently includes the following benefits, in addition to many others:

  • Paid time off including vacation days, holidays, and supplemental benefits for pregnancy, parental and adoption leave.
  • Healthcare, dental and vision benefits including health care spending account and wellness incentive.
  • Life insurance plans to cover you and your family.
  • Company and matching contributions to a Defined Contribution Pension plan to help you save for retirement.
  • GM Vehicle Purchase Plan for you and your family.

Description du poste

Statut du poste

Cette offre ne correspond pas à un poste vacant existant au sein de l’organisation et est ouverte aux nouvelles candidatures. (Nouveau poste autorisé)

Divulgation concernant l’IA

Dans le cadre du processus de candidature, l’intelligence artificielle sera utilisée dans le processus d’embauche pour ce poste.

Télétravail

Ce poste est classé comme un poste à distance. Cela signifie que la personne retenue peut être établie n’importe où au Canada et ne devrait pas avoir à se présenter dans un établissement de GM, sauf indication contraire de la part de sa gestionnaire ou de son gestionnaire.

À propos du poste

L’équipe de simulation de GM est à la recherche d’une ingénieure principale ou d’un ingénieur principal expérimenté en développement full stack pour jouer un rôle de leadership technique clé dans le cadre de notre mission visant à déployer de façon sécuritaire des technologies de conduite autonome. Il s’agit d’un rôle à fort impact, dans lequel votre travail contribuera directement à la validation de nos systèmes d’IA les plus complexes.

Responsabilités

  • Vision technique : définir la feuille de route architecturale de notre plateforme de définition de scénarios de simulation et/ou de son SDK programmatique en TypeScript/Python.

  • Outils évolutifs : diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de nos outils graphiques d’édition de nouvelle génération, utilisés par des centaines d’ingénieures et d’ingénieurs pour définir avec précision des scénarios complexes liés à la circulation, à l’environnement et aux capteurs.

  • Performance et infrastructure : piloter l’évolution de notre infrastructure Python, en mettant l’accent sur les algorithmes de base pour la sérialisation et la validation des scénarios, ainsi que sur leur intégration à notre cluster infonuagique de calcul à grande échelle.

  • Mentorat : agir comme mentore ou mentor pratique, établir la norme d’excellence en ingénierie en matière de conception d’API, de qualité du code et de pratiques de test au sein de l’équipe.

Qualifications requises

  • Au moins 7 années d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, dont une part importante consacrée à des plateformes, des outils ou des SDK à grande échelle.

  • Capacité démontrée à diriger l’architecture technique et à mener des projets complexes s’échelonnant sur plusieurs trimestres, de la conception à la mise en production.

  • Solide expérience en ingénierie front-end pour des applications graphiques sophistiquées utilisant TypeScript, par exemple des frameworks modernes comme React ou Vue, ainsi que des bibliothèques graphiques ou cartographiques comme WebGL/Three.js ou MapboxGL.

  • Maîtrise experte de Python, y compris une connaissance approfondie des pratiques exemplaires, de l’optimisation des performances et de la création d’API/SDK robustes destinés à des utilisateurs externes.

  • Expérience avérée en mentorat et en accompagnement d’ingénieures et d’ingénieurs de niveau intermédiaire et principal, en rehaussant le niveau technique et en faisant progresser les normes de qualité du code au sein d’une équipe.

Compétences souhaitées (atouts)

  • Solides connaissances en graphisme 3D, en géométrie computationnelle et/ou en concepts de simulation en temps réel.

  • Expérience directe dans le développement ou l’extension d’un langage spécifique à un domaine (DSL) ou d’un langage de script de haut niveau.

  • Expérience des moteurs de jeu, comme Unity ou Unreal, ou d’autres logiciels professionnels de simulation.

  • Expérience des techniques de visualisation de données pour de grands ensembles de données complexes.

  • Connaissance de l’architecture des technologies de véhicules autonomes (VA), notamment la perception, la planification et les systèmes de commande, ou d’autres systèmes complexes de robotique essentiels à la sécurité.

Rémunération

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 167 000 $ à 216 200 $. Le salaire de base réel qui sera offert à la personne retenue dans cette fourchette variera en fonction de facteurs pertinents pour le poste.

Avantages sociaux

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

title: Certified Medical Coder [Baptist Jax]
description:
Certified Medical Coder

North Florida Surgeons- Baptist Jacksonville division is looking for an energetic, patient focused certified medical coder.
This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy surgical practice! We are located in the Pavilion Building on the Baptist Main Campus Downtown. North Florida Surgeons Baptist Jacksonville Division offers great benefits, competitive wages and opportunities for growth.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Review medical records and documentation to assign accurate diagnosis and procedure codes
  • Responsible for coding office visits and surgeries
  • Collaborate between clinical, billing and patient services departments to ensure correct information is obtained for accurate coding and billing

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Coder Apprentice (CPC-A) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) certification required.

title: Document Control Analyst
description:
TerraPower is a nuclear technology company based in Bellevue, Washington. At its core, the company is working to raise living standards globally through a more affordable, secure, and environmentally friendly form of nuclear energy along with innovations in medical isotopes to improve human health. In 2006, TerraPower originated with Bill Gates and a group of like-minded visionaries who evaluated the fundamental challenges to raising living standards around the world. They recognized energy access was crucial to the health and economic well-being of communities and decided that the private sector needed to take action and create energy sources that would advance global energy deployment. TerraPower’s mission is to be a world leader in new nuclear technologies, while developing innovators and future leaders in the nuclear field. As a result, the company’s activities in the fields of nuclear energy and related sciences are yielding significant innovations in the safety and economics of nuclear power, hybrid energy and medical applications – all for significant human health benefits.”

TerraPower is seeking to hire highly motivated and forward-thinking professionals who are interested in focusing on advanced nuclear reactor research and development and influencing change within the nuclear power landscape and bringing forward the critical production of medical isotopes. Document Control Analyst

The Document Control Analyst is an intermediate-level position within TerraPower’s Records Management and Document Control (RMDC) program, reporting directly to the RMDC Manager. This role is well-suited for individuals with prior experience in document control or records management in a regulated industry, particularly nuclear. The Analyst supports the full document lifecycle using electronic systems and standard processes, including EPC and construction document control activities, while also contributing to the improvement of RMDC practices, user training, and regulatory readiness. This position requires a high level of attention to detail, the ability to work independently, and a working knowledge of quality and regulatory requirements in the nuclear industry. This is an on-site role based in Kemmerer, WY.

Responsibilities:

  • Support EPC and construction document control processes, including intake, validation, and release of drawings, specifications, RFIs, field changes, and other construction records.
  • Coordinate with site construction, engineering, and EPC teams to ensure timely distribution and access to current‑revision documents in the field.
  • Monitor and help maintain construction document registers, turnover packages, and related metadata to ensure configuration control and traceability across design and construction phases.
  • Administer and maintain TerraPower’s Electronic Document Management System (EDMS), ensuring compliance with document lifecycle requirements including version control, approvals, metadata standards, and archival.
  • Review, edit, and process-controlled documents and Change Orders, verifying alignment with TerraPower procedures and nuclear regulatory expectations.
  • Act as a point of contact for document control support across engineering, quality, licensing, project management, and supply chain functions.
  • Guide internal teams through EDMS workflows, ensuring timely routing, review, and release of documentation.
  • Train TerraPower staff and contractors on RMDC policies, procedures, and EDMS use; assist in onboarding new users.
  • Support records retention, retrieval, and disposition processes consistent with internal schedules and external compliance obligations (e.g., ASME NQA-1, NRC guidance, NIRMA).
  • Perform document audits and quality checks to ensure completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Help develop and maintain RMDC tools, templates, training materials, and standard work instructions.
  • Maintain and triage RMDC mailboxes and ticketing systems, escalating issues as needed.
  • Contribute to readiness activities for audits, licensing submittals, vendor reviews, and regulatory inspections.
  • Support the migration of legacy documents and data cleanup efforts within EDMS and SharePoint.
  • Coordinate with configuration management or quality teams on change control, revisions, and baselining activities.

Key Qualifications and Skills

  • Associate degree preferred. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
  • 3+ years of experience in document control or records management, ideally within a regulated industry such as nuclear, aerospace, energy, or life sciences.
  • Strong working knowledge of electronic document management systems (e.g., SharePoint, Agile, or similar).
  • Demonstrated understanding of document lifecycle processes, change control, and records retention principles.
  • Familiarity with nuclear regulatory and quality frameworks, including ASME NQA-1, NRC Regulatory Guides, and NIRMA Technical Guidelines.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to train and support users across departments.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines, and work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Proven track record of reliability, integrity, and maintaining confidentiality in a technical or regulated environment.

title: Analista Financiero
location: Mexico, Nuevo Leon, Cienega de Flores
description:
The Role

The Finance Analyst is responsible for supporting the financial and accounting operations of the plant, with a strong focus on budget control, expense monitoring, inventory and fixed asset management, accounting reconciliations, and internal controls. This role provides timely and accurate financial information to support plant operations and business decision-making while ensuring compliance with established financial, safety, quality, and environmental procedures.

What You’ll Do (Impact Areas)

Financial Analysis & Budget Control

  • Monitor daily actual expenses versus budget and identify relevant variances.
  • Support budget control and allocation activities across the plant.
  • Prepare monthly accrual entries, expense provisions, and accounting reclassifications.
  • Prepare monthly energy expense reports.
  • Analyze plant operations to explain key expense and material consumption variances.

Accounting & Internal Controls

  • Perform account reconciliations and maintain internal control documentation.
  • Update and maintain internal control information in SharePoint.
  • Monitor supplier invoices pending interface and payment, particularly aged items.
  • Process employee expense reimbursements and miscellaneous debtor transactions.
  • Support compliance with applicable accounting and internal control procedures.

Inventory & Cost Management

  • Monitor daily material usage and MUV (Material Usage Variance).
  • Coordinate physical inventories for raw materials, work in process, finished goods, spare parts, and fixed assets.
  • Record inventory adjustments and prepare corresponding reports.
  • Monitor inventory in transit and help ensure accurate production and material consumption records.

Fixed Assets & Capital Investments

  • Track invoices related to capital investments in process and maintain updated reports.
  • Capitalize investments according to established procedures.
  • Coordinate and maintain fixed asset inventories, including additions, disposals, and transfers.

Procurement & Payment Support

  • Review and authorize purchase requisitions for indirect materials and services within the scope of the role.
  • Follow up on Blanket POs and purchase order routing, including orders above USD $50K.
  • Coordinate energy-related invoices and hot-payment requests when required.

Cross-Functional & Plant Support

  • Collaborate with area leaders, management, Finance, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Fixed Assets teams.
  • Manage invoicing and collection related to scrap sales to external customers.
  • Support plant performance processes and EAD/HPT scorecard evaluations.
  • Comply with applicable IATF 16949, ISO 14001, Safety, Health, and Environmental requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and timely monitoring of actual expenses against budget.
  • Reliable accounting records, accruals, reclassifications, and reconciliations.
  • Accurate inventory records across raw materials, work in process, finished goods, spare parts, and fixed assets.
  • Effective control and capitalization of investments in process.
  • Timely follow-up of supplier invoices, purchase orders, and energy payments.
  • Clear understanding of plant operations and the ability to explain key financial and material consumption variances.
  • Strong compliance with internal controls and applicable quality, safety, and environmental requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Financial and analytical thinking
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Customer and service orientation
  • Proactivity and sense of ownership
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Effective communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Internal control mindset
  • Understanding of manufacturing operations

What You Bring (Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of financial accounting, accounts payable, internal controls, fixed assets, budgeting, inventories, and manufacturing costs.
  • Knowledge of accounting, finance, and tax fundamentals.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience working with financial reporting, reconciliations, expense control, inventories, or similar finance activities.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is highly desirable due to the role's involvement with production, materials, inventories, and plant expenses.
  • English proficiency: approximately 90%.

Work Model & Travel

  • Plant-based role with frequent interaction across operational and corporate functions.
  • Travel: Yes, as business needs require.
  • Shift rotation: Not required.
  • Relocation: Not required.

Our Commitment to You

You’ll have the opportunity to develop a broad understanding of plant finance and manufacturing operations while partnering with multiple functions across the organization. The role provides exposure to accounting, budgeting, cost management, inventories, capital investments, and internal controls, creating a strong foundation for continued growth within the Finance organization.

title: Transactions Analyst
description:
Job Description

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth & Investments group.

Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.

Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.

We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.

Aberdeen comprises three businesses, interactive investor (ii), Investments, and Adviser, each of which focuses on meeting and adapting to our clients’ evolving needs.

  • interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct-to-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.

  • Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.

  • Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.

About the Department

Our Real Estate Investments team is responsible for the acquisition, management and disposal of assets across multiple European markets. Working closely with fund management, portfolio management, development, research and strategy teams, the department supports investment performance and enables our clients to be better investors. The team combines market insight, disciplined execution and collaborative working to deliver outcomes across a diverse portfolio.

About the Role

This opportunity sits within the European Transactions team and would operate as a pan-European role. You will support the coordination and execution of acquisitions and disposals across Aberdeen’s European real estate portfolio, working alongside the Head of Investments Execution and colleagues across the region. The role offers exposure to multiple jurisdictions, asset classes and investment strategies, providing an excellent platform to build deep real estate transaction expertise. You will also help improve processes, data management and reporting through AI and workflow automation. Based in London, this is an opportunity to make a visible impact while developing your career.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help co-ordinate and support acquisitions and disposals across Aberdeen’s European real estate portfolio.

  • Appraise investment and divestment opportunities and contribute insight to transaction decision-making.

  • Prepare investment committee papers, transaction reports and client presentation materials.

  • Maintain transaction data, records and reporting to support existing funds and new fund launches.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across fund management, portfolio management, research and development teams.

  • Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through AI solutions and workflow automation.

About the Candidate

  • Knowledge of, or genuine interest in, the European real estate investment market.

  • Experience supporting transaction processes, investment analysis or related real estate activities.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills

  • Experience using data to support decision making.

  • Analytical mindset with experience preparing reports, proposals or supporting papers.

  • Ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Curiosity, initiative and a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Experience using AI, automation tools or process improvement techniques.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

Our benefits

There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.

title: Operations Fulfillment Analyst - Cigna Healthcare - Remote

  • 2+ years of account management, sales, and/or client service experience

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to drive results

  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while working independently and taking initiative

title: Senior Engineer (Micro-Sensor & Material Science)
description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Engineer will be responsible for project development/execution and designing novel measurement applications for GE’s future of flight tests. You will be working hands-on in a collaborative team to learn and apply materials and microfabrication design expertise and integrate sensor systems into next-generation engines. You will be working closely with scientists, engineers, interns and laboratory personnel to ensure on-time customer delivery of projects.

Job Description

Role and Responsibilities

  • Design and execute microfabricated sensor applications for Aerospace engines and aircrafts testing.

  • Support microfabricated sensor system integration to engine/rig and support testing and data post-processing.

  • Support microfabricated sensor process improvement and update the process documents.

  • Maintain lab facilities and equipment and update their operational procedures.

  • Adhere to business standards, practices, procedures, & product requirements.

  • Review designs and consult with senior technical leaders for evaluation of work.

  • Develop project design, implementation and cost proposals.

  • Develop strong internal and external customer relationships by serving as an interface point within GE Aerospace.

  • Will be required to lead the Thin Film Lab technology development and gain hands-on experience with thin film processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Advanced degree in engineering, materials science and/or physical sciences from an accredited university or college.

  • Proven ability to utilize expertise in materials science/engineering or analytical chemistry principles to achieve design, quality and instrumentation goals.

  • Minimum of 5 years of physical vapor deposition (PVD) experience

  • This role requires the candidate to have the ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance; prerequisite for a security clearance is U.S. Citizenship.

Desired Characteristics

  • Hands-on experience with photolithography or similar precision patterning processing.

  • Hands-on experience with PVD systems and processing.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

  • Good understanding of the physics and chemistry related to physical vapor deposition processing, most notably sputter deposition.

  • Understanding of physics and chemistry related to photolithographic processing.

  • Experience in a wet chemical lab and/or cleanroom environment (i.e.. semiconductor, thin film deposition, etc).

  • Experience developing thin and thick film processes on complex contour substrates.

  • Experience with high temperature handling materials

  • Experience analyzing and characterizing single and stacked thin and thick film layers.

  • Experience with thin-film based transducers and developing/executing technology roadmaps.

title: Technical Director
description:
Title: Technical Director
Department: Production
Reports To: Senior Director of Production Operations
Supervises: KPA and IATSE crews
Starting Pay: Up to $36/hour, Non-Exempt

Job Summary:
The Technical Director is responsible for overseeing the technical operations, infrastructure, systems, and technical execution support for Kentucky Performing Arts’ (KPA) venues, productions, events, and theatrical spaces. This position provides leadership and oversight for technical theatre systems including carpentry, rigging, lift systems, staging systems, and related production technologies.

The Technical Director is responsible for maintaining technical readiness across KPA venues through preventative maintenance planning, equipment oversight, technical safety practices, troubleshooting, system coordination, and technical staff leadership. This position supervises IATSE and KPA crews, and works closely with Production Managers and production leadership to support successful event execution.

While this role collaborates closely with production operations and event planning, the primary focus of the position is technical systems leadership, technical infrastructure oversight, equipment management, technical safety, and operational support for KPA productions and venues.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Lead and oversee technical operations for KPA venues and theatrical spaces.
  • Serve as a senior production management resource for complex, high-profile, multi-venue, or high-impact events, including Broadway productions, major rentals, resident company events, and special projects.
  • Oversee production planning processes, including advance work, show/event estimates, staffing coordination, stage reports, schedules, service orders, and post-event follow-up.
  • Oversee technical theatre systems including rigging, staging systems, lift systems, and related infrastructure.
  • Maintain operational readiness of production systems and equipment across KPA venues.
  • Develop, coordinate, and maintain preventative maintenance programs for technical theatre systems and equipment.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and coordinate resolution of technical equipment issues and infrastructure concerns.
  • Assist with evaluating, recommending, and implementing technical upgrades, repairs, replacements, and capital improvements.
  • Develop, implement, and reinforce technical safety standards and backstage safety practices.
  • Support compliance with OSHA requirements, electrical safety standards, fire/life safety requirements, and applicable theatrical safety standards.
  • Promote safe operation and use of production systems, equipment, lifts, rigging systems, and backstage spaces.
  • Coordinate technical staffing priorities, training needs, operational support, and technical readiness.
  • Assist in training full-time, hourly, call-in, and event technical personnel as needed.
  • Partner with the Senior Production Manager, Production Managers, and production leadership to support event planning and execution.
  • Provide technical guidance and operational support for productions, rentals, Broadway engagements, resident companies, and special events.
  • Support technical coordination for incoming attractions, touring productions, vendors, and clients.
  • Provide hands-on production or technical support when business needs require, which may include assisting with stage operations, crew coordination, client support, or technical event support.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, records, and operational information.
  • Assist with technical budgeting, capital planning, and equipment purchasing recommendations.
  • Communicate effectively with internal departments, vendors, contractors, touring personnel, and clients.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  • Strong knowledge of technical theatre operations, theatrical systems, and live event technical execution.
  • Advanced knowledge of theatrical rigging systems, staging systems, and related technical infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of preventative maintenance practices, equipment lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, and operational readiness for production systems and theatrical equipment.
  • Working knowledge of theatrical safety standards, OSHA requirements, electrical safety practices, fire/life safety standards, and backstage safety procedures.
  • Ability to identify, troubleshoot, coordinate, and resolve technical equipment issues and infrastructure concerns in a fast-paced live event environment.
  • Strong understanding of technical coordination requirements for productions, touring shows, rentals, resident companies, and special events.
  • Ability to supervise, coach, support, and develop technical staff while maintaining operational consistency, accountability, and professionalism.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities, production needs, deadlines, and operational challenges simultaneously.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with technical staff, production leadership, touring personnel, clients, vendors, contractors, resident companies, and internal departments.
  • Strong organizational, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism, flexibility, and sound judgment under pressure and during time-sensitive event operations.
Essential Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, climb, and move throughout KPA venues for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift and move up to approximately 50 pounds unassisted using proper lifting techniques and/or equipment.
  • Ability to climb ladders and work in elevated areas, including lifts, catwalks, grids, or other production-related spaces as needed.
  • Ability to work at heights up to approximately 100 feet when required.
  • Ability to push, pull, or move large production-related items using proper equipment and procedures.
  • Ability to use hand tools, power tools, production equipment, radios, computers, and other equipment necessary to perform assigned duties.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Ability to communicate in environments that may be loud, quiet, active, or require discreet communication.
Schedule & Work Environment:
  • This position requires a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends, holidays, extended hours, and on-call availability based on event and business needs.
  • Work is performed in office, backstage, stage, front-of-house, loading dock, rehearsal, and venue environments across KPA’s campus and related sites.
  • The work environment may include loud noise, low light, heights, moving equipment, active stage operations, time-sensitive event needs, and interaction with employees, clients, patrons, vendors, contractors, and touring personnel.
Education, Experience, and Qualifications:
Required:
  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible technical theatre or live event technical operations experience.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of supervisory or leadership experience within a theatrical, technical production, or live event environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of theatrical rigging including counterweight and automated systems, electrics, staging systems, and technical infrastructure.
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting technical theatre systems and production equipment.
  • Experience supporting productions, events, or theatrical operations in performing arts, touring, arena, theatre, or live event environment.
  • Experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, or overseeing professional theatrical systems and production equipment.
  • Experience coordinating or overseeing technical operations for productions, theatrical events, live entertainment venues, or touring environments.
  • ETCP Certified Rigger – Theatre certification.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and standard production-related software systems.
  • Valid driver’s license.
Preferred:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Theatre, Production Management, Performing Arts Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in a multi-venue performing arts center, Broadway environment, touring production environment, or similarly complex live event operation.
  • Experience supervising union labor and large production crews.
  • Experience managing Broadway, touring, or large-scale theatrical productions.
  • Experience with Yamaha CL/QL series consoles or similar professional audio systems.
  • Working knowledge of Vectorworks, AutoCAD, Momentus, or similar production and venue management systems.
  • *OSHA 30 certification.
  • *DOT medical card.
* Denotes certifications or training that may be required based on operational needs, assigned responsibilities, or departmental expectations. If they are not currently held at the time of hire or promotion, they may be obtained during employment within agreed-upon timelines established by KPA leadership.
Kentucky Performing Arts is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer.

title: C3 Presents - Culture & Office Operations Intern
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

C3 Presents (which is owned by Live Nation Entertainment) creates live experiences for millions of fans across the globe, setting the new standard each year for events that are as memorable as they are spectacular. One of the world’s largest music festival producers, C3 is the force behind two of the most iconic multi-day festivals — Austin City Limits Music Festival in Texas and Lollapalooza in Chicago and its six international editions — drawing a combined 2 million music lovers annually.

Headquartered in Austin, TX, with offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, New Orleans, and Nashville, the company also promotes thousands of concerts annually in arenas, casinos and clubs throughout North America.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At C3 Presents, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you, then please read on!

THE POSITION

Are you looking for an exciting internship experience? Our paid Internship Program offers real-world exposure for students interested in the live entertainment industry. Throughout the program, you’ll gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of the live event business while applying your academic knowledge to real-world situations. You’ll also strengthen your leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills along the way.

This part-time position requires 15–25 hours per week. Interns are expected to work in our Austin office Tuesday through Thursday, so please ensure your availability aligns with these days. The internship runs through the 2027 Spring semester, beginning January 19, 2027, and concluding May 6, 2027.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Complete administrative and online tasks, as well as a variety of office-related responsibilities

  • Update and maintain spreadsheets

  • Take inventory and order office supplies

  • Assist with monthly birthday gift ordering and distribution

  • Engage with employees across the organization, as this department focuses on serving the company

  • Support company events led by the Director of Culture & Operations and C3’s four essential committees, both on- and off-site

  • Gain production knowledge through exposure to the Director’s work as Talent Buyer and lead for children’s areas at C3’s large festival

  • Provide general administrative support as needed

LEARNING OBJECTIVES

  • Develop an understanding of administrative and office operations through hands-on experience with spreadsheet maintenance, inventory management, supply ordering, and employee recognition initiatives

  • Strengthen communication, organization, and collaboration skills through engagement with employees across the organization and support of company events

  • Gain exposure to C3’s culture and festival production through the work of the Director of Culture & Operations, including talent buying and children’s programming

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Initiator with a positive attitude

  • Acute sense of judgement, tact, and diplomacy

  • Outgoing and personable

  • Efficient with completing tasks

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and initiative

  • Competency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Exercises sound judgment with professionalism and discretion

  • Able to commit to 15-20 hours per week, with in-office availability Tuesday through Thursday

  • Ability to bring a personal laptop to the office

C3 COMPETENCIES

  • Demonstrate integrity in the way you operate in day-to-day business and the way you deal with people.

  • Communicate effectively with various audiences by organizing and delivering information appropriately and listening actively to others.

  • Proactively seek solutions to problems. Be enthusiastic and energetic in your approach to your job. Commit to putting in extra effort with a positive attitude.

  • Be flexible in handling change, able to juggle multiple demands, and adaptable to new situations with fresh ideas or innovative approaches.

  • Stay composed, confident, optimistic, and in problem-solving mode when the going gets tough.

  • Possess the skills needed to perform your job well, paying close attention to detail, accuracy, and completeness.

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

title: Commercial Account Handler
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

With a no limits approach, we can rise to any challenge. Whatever the question, the concern, or the risk, we can get the right people in a room and find the right answer. Our collective power is also helping us to change the insurance narrative – doing right by our clients while using insurance as a tool to build resilience for individuals, businesses and communities. From pro bono work to insuring COVID-19 vaccine development to de-risking the carbon market, we’re using our skills, knowledge, and networks to make a difference and speed positive change in the world around us.

We are actively looking for a Commercial Account Handler to join our Howden Consumer & Local Commercial team. Our local Commercial team have grown rapidly over the last 14 years’, and we now have over 200 people within the team across the UK. In this role you will be responsible for building rapport with new and existing clients, who could range from sole traders, through to the MD/CEO of a large organisation, and working closely with the Branch Manager to achieve

objectives.

About you:

  • You will have strong attention to detail as you will be reviewing client documentation, ensuring the information is

comprehensive and accurate to support the quoting process

  • You must have the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clients and

external contacts to ensure we meet expectations and compliance standards

  • You will be assisting the Commercial Account Executives in achieving high levels of renewal retention, whilst

exceeding customer expectations and meeting FCA requirements.

  • You are willing to learn, as every day will be different. This is a great opportunity to progress your career as a
  • Commercial Account Handler and become further your professional qualifications.
  • You have the ability to process data promptly and accurately on relevant systems in order to support and improve

high levels of client service, internal process execution and to facilitate informed analysis


Rewards:
We believe that great work and dedication should be rewarded, that’s why we offer:

  • 22 days holiday (plus bank holidays), increasing through length of service
  • A set of core benefits, designed with your health and financial protection in mind:
    • Life Assurance up to 4x salary, protecting your loved ones in case the worst should happen
    • Income protection, guaranteeing an income for up to 5 years in the event of an illness or injury
    • Contributory pension scheme – 5% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution
    • Access to a Healthcare Cashplan, which gives you access to a variety of health related benefits
  • Access to a host of lifestyle and financial benefits that you can choose from:
    • Discounts on gym membership across the UK
    • Salary sacrifice schemes – Travel Insurance, Cycle to Work, Car leasing, Technology purchase
    • Access to a range of insurance polices through Howden at discounted rates
    • Access to hundreds of high-street retailer discounts

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

description:

Have a passion for helping people? Join our team of Financial Services Representative where you’ll have dedicated time to focus on growth and career development, while you support our customers taking inbound calls while preparing for a future as the official face of Fidelity in our Investor Centers. Supercharge your early planning and advice career at Fidelity with paid training to help you get your Series 7 & 66 licenses, personalized support, knowledgeable career guides, and celebration of your achievements, while building skills and experiences. During your onboarding experience in this role, you’ll support Fidelity’s customers over the phone by answering questions about account balances, making withdrawals, transferring funds, identifying resources, and placing trades, while working from home and spending one day per week in the Investor Center. Upon completion of this onboarding experience, you will work in the Investor Center on a daily basis.

What to expect…

In your first year as a new Financial Services Representatives, your onboarding leader will support you as you navigate our Industry leading training program, working at home and in an Investor Center.

  • Obtain Licenses: Become a FINRA (Financial Industry Regulatory Authority) Registered Representative by studying for and obtaining your SIE, Series 7 Top Off and Series 66 licenses, fully paid for and sponsored by Fidelity. This includes paid, on-the-job study time 4 days a week, support from licensing coaches, group and individualized study plans, and review classes. This role requires successful completion of all exams.

  • Build and Solidify Skills: You’ll continue to spend four days a week working from home and one day a week in an Investor Center, where you’ll support customers with increasing complexity to develop and hone your skills. You’ll have dedicated time each week to develop new skills and to connect and refuel by networking with colleagues, taking online classes, and more! Once you complete this training journey, you’ll transition to working fully on-site in an Investor Center. Depending on business need, you might spend more time working remotely supporting inbound phone customers before you transition to an Investor Center.

  • Discover Success: You’ll gain confidence and develop proficiency serving customers as you join the wealth management development track and will spend time building advanced skills that will further develop your career in planning.

Advantages of our career development experience…

  • You are supported. We provide all the training you need to develop the skills needed to service customers and study for your FINRA licensing exams! You don’t need a finance background or college degree to succeed in this role.

  • You are celebrated. Your achievements will be recognized and celebrated as you progress through this career development experience on your way to your first promotion.

  • You are growing. From day one you’ll have the support and structure to plan for your future at Fidelity. The career coaching you will receive will help you understand the array of career opportunities at Fidelity and chart a course to help you grow in a personalized career path.

  • You get variety. You’ll have dedicated time to focus on development activities and doing work that goes beyond supporting customer needs, while building the unique skills you’ll need as you prepare to be in the Investor Center each day.

The expertise we’re looking for…

  • High energy and enthusiasm with a natural passion for helping people

  • Flexibility and self-motivation

  • Experience in customer service (phone or in-person) and an ability to thrive face to face with clients in a fast-paced environment

The Skills You Bring

  • Eagerness to learn and build a career in financial services

  • Ability to deliver an outstanding customer experience

  • Superb interpersonal skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks at once

  • Coachability, collaboration and curiosity will fuel your success

Our Investments in You

Our benefit programs are crafted to help you and your loved ones strike the perfect balance. Here are a few featured benefits (not all benefits are listed): Maternal and Parental Leave, Tuition Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance, 401(K) 7% match, Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Disability Insurance, Paid Time off, Commuter Benefit Program, Backup Dependent Care, Charitable match, Concierge Services, Wellness Program, and Fitness Reimbursement.

title: Regulatory Specialist
description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

As a Regulatory Specialist within our Professional Hygiene Regulatory Team, you will play a critical role in ensuring regulatory compliance while supporting the successful registration and commercialization of Arxada products. You will collaborate across regulatory, R&D, marketing, sales, and external regulatory agencies to deliver timely regulatory solutions that drive business success. This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, enjoys solving complex regulatory challenges, and is passionate about delivering exceptional service to both internal and external stakeholders. Drawing on Arxada’s values of Collaborate Always, Decide and Drive, Foster Grit, and Go Beyond, you will help safeguard our reputation for regulatory excellence while supporting innovation and growth.

Essential Job Functions

  • Prepare, submit, and monitor regulatory applications, supplemental registrations, label updates, and supporting documentation to maintain product compliance.
  • Liaise with regulatory agencies, customers, and internal stakeholders to resolve registration and compliance matters.
  • Ensure regulatory documentation and customer or third-party agreements comply with applicable requirements and internal standards.
  • Support audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews by providing accurate and timely documentation.
  • Partner with R&D and cross-functional teams to develop proactive solutions to registration and compliance challenges.
  • Maintain current knowledge of regulatory requirements, policies, and industry developments impacting the business.
  • Identify opportunities to improve regulatory processes and enhance the stakeholder experience.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience in regulatory affairs, compliance, or registrations.
  • Knowledge of FIFRA regulations, EPA pesticide registrations, and North American regulatory requirements.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory processes, documentation standards, and compliance frameworks.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience working with regulatory agencies, industry bodies, or compliance organizations is preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and registration management systems.
  • Experience with AI-enabled tools or willingness to adopt new technology solutions is an advantage.

The expected salary range for this role is 84,000 $- 102,000 $, but specific employee compensation may vary depending on factors including experience, education, training, licensure, certification, location and other job-related, non-discriminatory factors permitted by law.

This role is also eligible to earn a short-term incentive bonus and the following benefits: 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off, paid holidays and paid sick leave.

Arxada has world class offering in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Senior Sterile Manufacturing Operator executes advanced aseptic manufacturing activities that ensure safe, accurate, and reliable production of sterile medications in Empower’s hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment. This role owns disciplined execution of cleanroom workflows, equipment operation, component preparation, documentation, and environmental controls while consistently following approved procedures and regulatory requirements.

The operator applies strong judgment to identify issues, protect product quality, and maintain production readiness without compromising compliance or patient safety. As an experienced individual contributor, this position also reinforces proper technique, supports developing operators, and contributes to continuous improvement efforts that strengthen throughput, consistency, and operational control. Success requires learning agility, precision, accountability, and the ability to perform effectively in an AI-enabled organization where technology supports faster, higher-quality decisions and more efficient execution across sterile manufacturing operations daily.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Sterile Production

  • Aseptic Operations: Execute advanced sterile manufacturing activities using qualified aseptic techniques, approved batch records, procedures, and established production controls within cleanroom environments.
  • Equipment Operation: Operate sterile processing equipment accurately and consistently, completing required calculations, checks, and production steps to support safe, compliant batch execution.
  • Component Preparation: Prepare components and materials, operate autoclaves, and perform bubble point testing to maintain production readiness and support reliable sterile processing.

Quality And Compliance

  • Procedure Adherence: Follow applicable requirements, including 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 and USP Chapters 797 and 800, during assigned manufacturing activities.
  • Cleanroom Control: Perform required cleaning, disinfection, and sterilization of components, equipment, and work areas in accordance with established cleanroom and ISO controls.
  • Documentation Accuracy: Complete production records accurately and contemporaneously, verifying calculations and required entries to support traceability, quality review, and compliant batch documentation.

Operational Excellence

  • Issue Resolution: Identify production issues, apply sound judgment, and escalate concerns appropriately to protect quality, safety, workflow continuity, and established manufacturing requirements.
  • Process Improvement: Contribute practical improvement ideas that strengthen safety, throughput, consistency, inventory coordination, and workflow efficiency without compromising established quality or regulatory controls.
  • Operator Support: Reinforce proper sterile processing techniques with developing operators by demonstrating approved practices, answering procedural questions, and promoting consistent execution across the team.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Advanced knowledge of aseptic technique, sterile manufacturing workflows, cleanroom practices, environmental controls, and disciplined execution within controlled pharmaceutical production environments.
  • Working knowledge of 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, USP Chapters 797 and 800, and applicable ISO cleanroom requirements.
  • Strong capability in sterile equipment operation, component preparation, autoclave use, bubble point testing, calculations, and accurate production documentation.

title: Head of Flight Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Fortastra designs and delivers resilient, high-performance spacecraft that safeguard critical orbital assets and ensure freedom of action in space. We integrate advanced autonomy, sensing, and control into systems engineered for reliability, speed, and scale. Our culture values simplicity, accountability, and disciplined execution — empowering every engineer to think systemically, act decisively, and build with purpose. Aggressive innovation. Disciplined execution. Strength among the stars.

We recently raised $8M in seed capital and are led by visionary founder and former Hermeus co-founder, Mike Smayda.

Our Engineering Team

You will join Fortastra’s Engineering Division, responsible for the design, development, and test of flight systems across our autonomous spacecraft portfolio.

The Role

Fortastra is seeking a Head of Flight Software Engineer. As part of our early engineering team, your scope of work will focus on developing and integrating the flight software stack end-to-end — spanning ground-side mission operations tools, and vehicle-side embedded software. You’ll work closely with avionics, GNC, and systems engineers to help bring our vehicle from concept to flight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build mission operations software — the ground tools that plan, execute, and monitor missions in real time.
  • Develop and integrate flight software for the vehicle — from architecture and implementation to test and flight readiness.
  • Develop ground software services for telemetry, commanding, and visualization.
  • Write embedded software for flight computers, sensors, and actuators.
  • Collaborate with avionics, propulsion, and GNC teams to define software interfaces and data models.
  • Contribute to flight software CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and simulation environments.
  • Support software-in-the-loop testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, environmental testing, and flight campaigns.

Qualifications & Skills

  • B.S. Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical, or other sciences and/or physics based degree
  • Prior experience in systems and mission operations software
  • Experience with ground software, mission ops, or telemetry/command systems.
  • Experience with space systems - rovers, satellites, launch vehicles, etc.
  • Familiarity developing embedded software for real-time or safety-critical systems (aerospace, robotics, automotive, or similar).
  • Exposure to DevOps for embedded systems and automated testing pipelines.
  • Familiarity with hardware-in-the-loop, fault tolerance, and safety-critical standards.
  • Experience with cloud-based ground systems or mission control software
  • Ability to work independently and in small, fast-moving teams.
  • Work is on-site, remote or hybrid arrangements will not be considered
  • U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain or have an active TS/SCI clearance (US Person considered)

Why Fortastra

We are a small, high-impact team building the next generation of autonomous orbital control systems for national security space. At Fortastra, leaders own outcomes from first principles through flight and directly shape the future of resilient, mission-critical spacecraft autonomy.

FORTASTRA TALENT & CULTURE PRINCIPLES

Values Driven by First Principles

We value engineers and operators who prioritize sound judgment, candor, technical rigor, bias for action, and intellectual honesty over corporate consensus. We care about the caliber of the system you build and the speed at which you solve problems.

Talent Density Over Headcount

A high-performing startup is built on dense talent, not organizational bloat. A single exceptional engineer designs, tests, and delivers faster than a bloated committee. We intentionally maintain a lean, elite engineering crew where every contributor directly moves the needle on the mission.

High Autonomy, High Ownership

We hire domain experts to execute, not to micromanage them. You own your systems end-to-end, from initial architecture and hardware design to testing and deployment. With absolute ownership comes the responsibility to deliver mission critical reliability.

Mission Context Over Bureaucracy

The best execution happens when teams are provided clear technical objectives, constraints, and operational context, rather than rigid top-down policies. We strip away red tape so builders can iterate, make decisions, and push hardware and flight software forward rapidly.

Disciplined Speed & Flight Rigor

We move fast because we test often and kill artificial bottlenecks, not because we cut corners. Rapid iteration on the test stand and in simulation is how we learn; an uncompromising flight-readiness bar is how we earn trust. Precision without friction, speed without recklessness.

Direct Impact, Not Career Bureaucracy

You don’t come to Fortastra to climb a corporate ladder or manage slide decks; you come to build complex, flight-ready systems from day one. Growth here is organic, driven by the magnitude of technical challenges you solve and the trust you build across the team.

Benefits

We take care of our employees so they can focus on what matters most: family, well-being, and life outside of work.

Unlimited Paid Time Off so that you have the time you need to rest and recharge.

Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, because peace of mind starts with feeling cared for.

Equity: Share in Fortastra's success with equity in the company you're helping build.

401(k): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in your future and plan for what's ahead.

Social Events: Regular social events, team outings, and company-sponsored activities that make this a place people are glad to be part of.

The pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $250,000.00. Where an offer falls within that range depends on factors like your qualifications, experience, location, and interview performance, which we weigh against the market rate for the position.

Recruiters & Agencies: Fortastra does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from recruiters, agencies, or third parties. Any candidate submitted without a signed agreement and prior written authorization from Fortastra will not be subject to any fee, and no relationship is implied. Please do not contact Fortastra employees, hiring managers, or recruiting team directly.

title: Senior Database Engineer (Renewable Fixed Term Contract)
description:
At Johnson Matthey, your work will matter. As a Senior Database Engineer, you’ll join a world leader in platinum group metals with over 200 years of history. Using advanced metals chemistry, you’ll help tackle the world’s biggest challenges - cutting emissions, powering modern life and supporting life‑saving technologies - by applying, refining and recycling metals that matter for a healthier, more sustainable, circular future.

The role:

As a Senior Database Engineer, you will help drive our goals by:

  • Design, implement, administer, and support Microsoft SQL Server environments across on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure platforms.

  • Manage SQL Server lifecycle activities including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity planning, and decommissioning.

  • Experience administering Azure SQL services including:

    • Azure SQL Database

    • SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

  • Proven experience performing SQL Server upgrades, migrations, and database consolidation activities.

  • Advanced T-SQL scripting and troubleshooting skills.

  • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation capabilities.

  • Experience supporting Power BI reporting environments and SQL backend databases.

  • Experience with SQL monitoring and performance tools such as:

    • SolarWinds DPA

    • Azure Monitor

  • Strong understanding of database security, auditing, access control, encryption, and vulnerability management.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Power BI Service and enterprise analytics platforms.

title: Vice President, Field Operations
description:
Job Description

VP, Field Operations

At Advance Auto Parts, a Vice President of Operations (VPO) is a senior leader in the Region. The VPO must be knowledgeable of all facets of operating multiple (150-200) Advance Auto Parts stores. Each Vice President must be committed to inspiring our team, helping our customers succeed, and growing the business and profitability with integrity.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner with Area HR Director and Managers, Retail Store Management Recruiter(s) and Trainer(s), Asset Protection Manager, etc., to set and execute the company’s key strategies in the Region
