title: Product Owner
location: Mounds View, Minnesota, United States of America
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

This role is onsite in Mounds View, Minnesota.

Medtronic's Acute Care & Monitoring (ACM) business works together with the global healthcare community to solve clinically meaningful problems, with technologies and solutions for remote patient monitoring, blood oxygen management, respiratory compromise, and perioperative complications. Our vision is to empower patient safety - anytime, anywhere.

In the role as Product Owner, you'll be supporting our Digital Health portfolio, servicing US Veterans Affairs and hospitals. This role owns software solutions that enable clinicians to remotely monitor veterans with chronic conditions in their homes or commercially in the hospital.

You will work with the Product Design team to advance existing technology or introduce new technology and therapies, specifically in the area of Digital Health. You will work with key stakeholders to understand needs, prioritize features, define and deliver features in the feature backlog. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for building tight collaboration and a culture of trust within the Digital Health organization.

As a Product Owner, you will be accountable for understanding and prioritizing features for the product in the feature backlog with the understanding to then allot the appropriate features to the feature roadmap based on the defined Digital Health vision. The Product Owner will also collaborate closely with Marketing for management and synthesis of needs to features for delivery in a release.

Key responsibilities Include:

  • Accountable for intake of needs from the Marketing and closely connecting with the customer to understand the value and problem to solve.

  • Responsible for deep engagement with the customer to understand the needs being presented and subsequently, build the desired behavior of the features based on the customer feedback

  • Connect with the customer to ensure the Agile Release are continually building the right things and building them right.

  • In close partnership with Marketing, apply a customer-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to guide the product releases toward delivering solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible and sustainable.

  • Understand from the Marketing the themes prioritized, vision, product roadmap and definition of quantified value

  • Identify the problem to be solved. Identifying problems that customers want to be solved is the first element of design thinking.

  • Responsible for managing and prioritizing the team backlog and ensuring that it aligns to customer and stakeholder needs

  • Collaborate with the architects to define technical and design discovery required for a feature

  • Intake input/feedback/insights from customers, stakeholders, and the scrum team and understand the needs around the voices to evaluate value accordingly and make an informed decision

  • Collaborates with Business Analyst to ensure solutions are understood and aligned to features that need to be developed

  • Collaborates with UI/UX Designer to ensure design meets customer needs

  • Help Digital Health portfolio innovate digital solutions in the medical and home care space by engaging Systems thinking.

  • Organizational collaborator on Digital Health enabled initiatives to leverage cross disciplinary and globally distributed teams to craft high-quality products and services that customers love and drive preference

  • Collaborate with other leaders to ensure successful development, release, and launch of world-class product (portfolio/program)

Minimum Qualifications (Must Have):

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 2+ years experience in systems, digital, or software development.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience in systems, digital or software development with proven track record.

  • Experience in the medical device industry or other regulated product industry

  • Knowledge of the Agile methodology

  • Experience in 5+ major product or portfolio releases.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex system behaviors, engineering problems, technical and architectural constraints.

  • Excellent verbal and written and communication skills with an aptitude for convincing others, both internally and externally, of the value of their ideas.

title: Director of Donor Engagement & Stewardship
description:
Careers at Our Amazing Place.
At The Children’s Institute of Pittsburgh, we’ve built our legacy on being amazing. After more than a century of the highest quality care and service to children and their families, we’re forever proud of our team members who don’t just make a career here – they make a difference.
Job Title: Director of Donor Engagement & Stewardship
Location: 1405 Shady Ave., Pittsburgh, PA 15217
Schedule: Monday through Friday, Full Time, Onsite
Responsibilities
The Director of Donor Engagement & Stewardship is a senior leader within the Development team responsible for cultivating meaningful relationships with donors, designing and executing high‑impact stewardship strategies, and overseeing a portfolio of major donors and prospects. This role blends strategic oversight with direct donor engagement, ensuring that supporters feel valued, informed, and connected to the organization’s mission. The director also leads the planning and execution of signature events that strengthen donor relationships and drive philanthropic investment.
Donor Portfolio Leadership
  • Manage a portfolio of mid‑level and major donors, with clear goals for cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Develop individualized engagement strategies that deepen donor commitment and increase giving.
  • Conduct regular donor meetings, site visits, and personalized outreach to maintain strong relationships.
  • Collaborate with Senior Director of Development and senior leadership on strategy for high‑capacity prospects.

Position:

Strategic Provider Partnerships Director

Position Summary:

The Strategic Provider Partnership Director is a senior, strategic individual contributor role within the strategic growth initiative, reporting directly to the SVP, Growth. This highly autonomous leader is accountable for the end-to-end identification, prospecting, cultivation, and qualification of high-value provider and health system partnerships. The role will support selective market growth only where Essence Healthcare can establish the right strategic anchor partnerships and a compelling foundation for long-term success.

The role requires a seasoned healthcare strategist and relationship architect who can develop, refine, and compellingly communicate Essence Healthcare’s differentiated value proposition to health systems and large physician groups. This leader must possess the C-suite presence and healthcare expertise to connect Essence’s capabilities, clinical model, and partnership approach to the strategic priorities of prospective partners, while collaborating with internal subject-matter experts on value-based care arrangements, risk-sharing agreements, and other partnership structures. Working closely with the Network and Product organizations, this leader will translate market data, provider insights, and organizational capabilities into a strategic partnership plan. Success in this role establishes the structural and relational foundation for selective market entry and membership growth in alignment with Essence Healthcare’s strategic growth plan.

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Prospecting & Relationship Cultivation
    • Identify, research, and prioritize high-value provider organizations and health systems in target markets, focusing on opportunities where the right strategic anchor partnerships can support a differentiated and sustainable growth strategy.
    • Design and execute sophisticated outreach strategies to secure access and build trust with C-suite and executive leaders at prospective partner organizations, including Health System CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, VPs of Managed Care, and Large Physician Group Executives.
    • Serve as the primary brand ambassador and external representative of Essence Healthcare in new markets, articulating the plan's unique value proposition and clinical models.
    • Cultivate deep, trust-based relationships within the regional healthcare ecosystem to position Essence Healthcare as the preferred Medicare Advantage partner.
  • Deal Structuring & Business Case Development
    • Conduct comprehensive market analyses to evaluate competitive dynamics, provider readiness for value-based care, strategic fit, and financial viability, with particular emphasis on identifying potential anchor partners.
    • Partner closely with the Network and Product organizations to translate market data, provider insights, and product capabilities into a strategic plan for targeting health systems and other key provider organizations; collaborate with Finance, Actuarial, Legal, and Marketing to assess and support risk-sharing, value-based care, and joint-venture opportunities.
    • Develop and present comprehensive business cases and differentiated strategic value propositions to external provider C-suite leadership teams, while facilitating substantive strategic discussions between the respective C-suite leaders of Essence Healthcare and prospective partner organizations.
    • Own end-to-end relationship management for prospective strategic partners—from initial engagement and executive alignment through opportunity development, internal coordination, and transition—ensuring continuity, trust, and clear communication throughout the partnership lifecycle.
  • Pipeline Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Maintain and manage a highly organized pipeline of prospective strategic partnerships, providing regular updates and milestone reports to the SVP, Growth, and other executive stakeholders.
    • Act as the lead coordinator across Growth, Network, Product, Finance, and Operations to align data, insights, capabilities, and resources around strategic partnership priorities and selective market-entry decisions.
    • Identify opportunities that require executive sponsorship and facilitate strategic conversations with Essence Healthcare’s senior leadership team to align priorities, resolve key issues, and advance high-value partnerships.
    • Continuously gather market intelligence and competitor trends to refine Essence Healthcare’s strategic partnership approach, selective market-entry criteria, and product positioning.
  • Cross-Functional Deal Execution
    • Stay actively engaged across Growth, Network, Product, Finance, Legal, Contracting, and Operations from opportunity development through deal execution to ensure seamless relationship management for the network partner, clear communication, timely issue resolution, and a consistent partner experience.
    • Maintain strategic oversight and relationship continuity throughout diligence, contracting, and final execution, facilitating collaboration among internal teams, partner stakeholders, and executive sponsors to advance the agreement successfully.

Qualifications

  • Master’s in Public Health (MPH), Business Administration (MBA), or Healthcare Administration (MHA) preferred; Bachelor’s degree in a related field required.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in healthcare business development, network development, strategic sales, or managed care contracting.
  • 5+ years of experience in high-level strategic business development, complex enterprise sales, or negotiating value-based care partnerships.
  • A robust, pre-existing professional network of provider and health system contacts within Essence Healthcare's key markets (IL, KY, AR, or MO).
  • Solid understanding of Medicare Advantage and health system economics, including managed care dynamics, value-based care structures, CMS risk adjustment, provider reimbursement methodologies, health system financial drivers, and the economic considerations that shape strategic partnerships.
  • Proven track record of successfully engaging, presenting to, and influencing senior healthcare executives (CEOs, CFOs, CMOs).
  • Demonstrated ability to independently navigate and close complex joint-venture agreements, Letters of Intent (LOIs), and strategic partner alignments.
  • Highly motivated self-starter who uses data and strategic judgment to identify and prioritize target markets, then identify and pursue strategic provider and health system partnerships within those markets based on competitive dynamics, existing payer networks, market economics, and alignment with Essence Healthcare’s differentiated value proposition.
  • Expert ability to synthesize market research, provider performance metrics, competitive intelligence, payer network composition, and other relevant data to evaluate market attractiveness, assess partnership fit, and develop compelling financial and clinical business cases.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% for consistent, high-impact in-market C-suite presence and strategic meetings.

title: Senior Scientist - Performance/Analytical Testing
description:
Founded over 35 years ago, First Quality is a family-owned company that has grown from a small business in McElhattan, Pennsylvania into a group of companies, employing over 5,000 team members, while maintaining our family values and entrepreneurial spirit. With corporate offices in New York and Pennsylvania and 8 manufacturing campuses across the U.S. and Canada, the companies within the First Quality group produce high-quality personal care and household products for large retailers and healthcare organizations. Our personal care and household product portfolio includes baby diapers, wipes, feminine pads, paper towels, bath tissue, adult incontinence products, laundry detergents, fabric finishers, and dishwash solutions. In addition, we manufacture certain raw materials and components used in the manufacturing of these products, including flexible print and packaging solutions.

Guided by our values of humility, unity, and integrity, we leverage advanced technology and innovation to drive growth and create new opportunities. At First Quality, you’ll find a collaborative environment focused on continuous learning, professional development, and our mission to Make Things Better®.

We are seeking a Sr. Scientist – Performance/Analytical Testing for our First Quality Home Care Products LLC facility located in Trumbull, CT. The Sr. Scientist – Performance/Analytical Testing provides technical support to the R&D team by generating scientific data that informs formulation development and performance evaluation. This role ensures results meet customer brief requirements for cleaning performance while complying with physical and analytically measured specifications.

As part of a team of scientists and technicians, this role shares responsibility for scheduling and executing internal cleaning performance testing, as well as laboratory and analytical testing across all First Quality product and formulation formats. The Sr. Scientist manages existing test methods and develops new internal cleaning performance and analytical methods that deliver accurate, consistent results aligned with customer specifications. The role also oversees demonstrations for internal and external customer visits.

This position partners with third-party laboratories selected by First Quality customers to align internal methodologies with external evaluation techniques for cleaning performance. This collaboration supports the R&D formulation screening process, helping identify the best-performing formulation at the target cost structure before submission for final third-party testing.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Understand the principles and challenges of formulating Home Care products, including SDL (single-dose laundry detergents), HDL (liquid laundry detergents), FSL (liquid fabric softeners), FSS (fabric softener sheets), ADW (auto dishwasher detergent), HDW (hand dishwashing detergents), SB (scent boosters), and others.

  • Lead development of laboratory methods that predict consumer purchase intent and liking for key attributes across Home Care products.

  • Lead development of demonstrations for internal and external customer visits.

  • Schedule cleaning performance testing for samples and formulations submitted by R&D team members.

  • Organize sample preparation for consumer insights testing, including in-home-use testing (IHUT) and consumer liking testing (CLT).

  • Approve and/or generate internal cleaning performance reports for all tested samples across categories and formats.

  • Understand the principles and requirements of Home Care product stability testing protocols.

  • Maintain and schedule preventive maintenance for all analytical instruments and laboratory equipment.

  • Design and manage an electronic tracker for tested samples, linked to internal testing reports and R&D samples sent for external testing, including benchmark samples.

  • Stay current with home care industry test methods, ASTM methods, and standard laboratory methods used in the R&D lab.

  • Provide the Product Development Technical Communication Manager with technical information, documents, and reports as requested.

  • Understand analytical/instrumental testing principles to support starting-formulation reverse-engineering.

  • Stay current on market trends, innovation, new ingredients, and consumer testing methods to support business needs.

  • Perform other duties and assignments as necessary.

The ideal candidate should possess the following:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of experience in methods development and technical writing.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Regulatory, Sales & Marketing, and Legal teams.

  • Ability to motivate and lead by example.

  • Strong knowledge of business unit products.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results efficiently and proficiently.

  • Proven track record in team and cross-functional project management.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple documents/reports and extract technical information from publications.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in SAP.

  • Strong statistical analysis skills.

  • Travel as needed to support 3rd party lab audits, manufacturing site meetings; Approximately 15%

What We Offer You

We believe that by continuously improving the quality of our benefits, we can help to raise the quality of life for our team members and their families. At First Quality you will receive:

  • Competitive base salary and bonus opportunities

  • Paid time off (three-week minimum)

  • Child and family care assistance (dependent care FSA with employer match up to $2500)

  • Bundle of joy benefit (years’ worth of free diapers to all team members with a new baby)

  • ...and more!

First Quality is committed to protecting information under the care of First Quality Enterprises commensurate with leading industry standards and applicable regulations. As such, First Quality provides at least annual training regarding data privacy and security to employees who, as a result of their role specifications, may come in to contact with sensitive data.

First Quality is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or protected Veteran status.

Who is ACT1 Federal? ACT1 Federal LLC is a 100% employee-owned company. We’ve served the Department of War (DoW) for nearly thirty years. Our core missions include weapon systems engineering, logistics, space domain expertise, global defense and security, business and financial management for security assistance and major defense articles, as well as military training and arctic security. Join us!

Description: ACT1 Federal is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to provide requirements analysis, architecture, interface, systems integration, verification, advanced-manufacturing, and systems planning in support of industrial base and fifth shipyard decisions.

Responsibilities:

Systems Engineering and Requirements Analysis:

  • Apply systems engineering principles to defense industrial base programs, initiatives, and emerging requirements involving production capacity, suppliers, shipyards, infrastructure, workforce, data, technology, and investment.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and maintain mission, operational, functional, performance, interface, data, and implementation requirements.
  • Decompose complex problems into manageable elements; identify dependencies, interfaces, constraints, assumptions, decision points, and measures of effectiveness.
  • Develop requirements matrices, system and process models, interface descriptions, functional architectures, workflows, use cases, roadmaps, and traceability products.
  • Evaluate whether proposed solutions, analytical methods, data sources, and implementation plans satisfy requirements and support intended mission outcomes.

Industrial Base Integration and Analysis:

  • Integrate production, supplier, infrastructure, economic, financial, acquisition, workforce, and technology information into coherent baselines and analytical products.
  • Support assessments of production constraints, supplier capacity, industrial resilience, shipyard alternatives, infrastructure needs, technology adoption, investment priorities, and recovery initiatives.
  • Conduct alternatives analyses and trade studies addressing technical feasibility, operational utility, cost, schedule, risk, scalability, interoperability, and lifecycle considerations.
  • Identify gaps, redundancies, conflicting assumptions, data limitations, and cross-directorate impacts that could affect implementation or senior-leader decisions.
  • Develop performance measures and monitoring approaches that connect recommended actions to observable improvements in capacity, delivery, resilience, and execution.

Management Analysis and Decision Support:

  • Analyze organizational structures, governance, processes, roles, responsibilities, and decision authorities affecting DASN DIB initiatives.
  • Facilitate working sessions with Government, program, engineering, acquisition, financial, data, and industry stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve integration issues.
  • Prepare executive briefings, issue papers, decision memoranda, requirements packages, risk assessments, implementation plans, and responses to senior-leader questions.
  • Maintain action, risk, issue, dependency, and decision tracking; monitor implementation progress and elevate matters requiring Government direction.
  • Provide independent analysis while preserving Government responsibility for policy, requirements approval, funding, acquisition, source selection, and other inherently governmental decisions.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in systems engineering, engineering, industrial engineering, operations research, computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years’ experience in systems engineering, management analysis, engineering analysis, program analysis, defense acquisition, industrial base analysis, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing requirements, performing functional or process analysis, evaluating alternatives, identifying interfaces and dependencies, and communicating technical findings.
  • Experience integrating information from multiple technical and organizational disciplines into defensible recommendations for complex programs or initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of systems engineering methods, requirements traceability, risk management, lifecycle analysis, process modeling, performance measurement, and implementation planning.
  • Experience preparing and presenting analytical products to senior Government or industry leaders and facilitating multidisciplinary stakeholder discussions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and collaboration tools; ability to develop clear models, diagrams, matrices, dashboards, and executive-level products.

Strategic counsel:

Operations:

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At C3 Presents, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you, then please read on!

THE POSITION

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

LEARNING OBJECTIVES

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail

title: Lead Certified Welding Inspector (CWI)
description:
Hohl Industrial Services, Inc. is seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) to lead the technical Quality Control function across our shop and field operations. This is a critical leadership position for an individual who takes pride in precision, technical excellence, and ensuring that every project meets the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance.

As our Lead CWI, you will serve as the Company's senior technical quality resource, providing direction to QC Inspectors and working closely with Operations, project teams, customers, and quality representatives. You will play a key role in overseeing welding, fabrication, inspection, testing, and code compliance across a variety of industrial projects.

If you are a knowledgeable welding and quality professional who enjoys solving technical challenges, mentoring others, and making a direct impact on project success, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do

As the Lead CWI, you will provide technical leadership and oversight of quality activities throughout Hohl Industrial Services' shop and field operations.

Quality Control Leadership

  • Lead and provide technical direction to QC Inspectors.
  • Develop and implement inspection plans, inspection methods, hold points, and acceptance criteria for shop and field activities.
  • Review inspection results, NDE reports, non-conformance documentation, work releases, and final release documentation for technical completeness and acceptability.
  • Ensure inspection activities are performed by properly qualified personnel and maintain inspection independence.
  • Serve as the primary technical Quality Control contact for customers, customer QA/QC representatives, certifying agencies, Authorized Inspectors, and third-party inspectors.
  • Provide technical input for Project Specific Quality Plans and Inspection and Test Plans.
  • Coordinate outside NDE and third-party inspection services.
  • Lead technical investigations and disposition of non-conformances, including root-cause determinations and corrective actions.
  • Identify recurring quality issues and trends and communicate findings to Operations and Senior Management.
  • Participate in internal audits, management reviews, supplier evaluations, and customer quality investigations.

Welding & Inspection Program

  • Provide technical oversight of the Company's welding quality program.
  • Review and maintain technical compliance of Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and Welder Performance Qualifications (WPQ).
  • Oversee or witness PQR testing and welder qualification testing as appropriate.
  • Ensure welder qualification and continuity requirements are met.
  • Oversee visual welding inspection and applicable NDE activities, including MT, PT, UT, and other methods.
  • Ensure material identification, traceability, and Material Test Report (MTR) review requirements are satisfied.
  • Oversee inspection activities involving dimensional verification, bolting, coatings, hydrostatic testing, heat forming, hardness testing, and other applicable fabrication processes.

ASME & Code Compliance

  • Serve in the technical Quality Control role designated by the Company's ASME Quality Control Manual.
  • Administer the technical implementation of the ASME Quality Control system for applicable shop and field activities.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable ASME Code, NBIC, jurisdictional, and Authorized Inspector requirements.
  • Develop, review, and approve the technical content of the ASME Quality Control Manual and revisions.
  • Review applicable code changes and determine required updates to Company procedures and inspection practices.
  • Coordinate technical access, reviews, inspections, and audits with Authorized Inspectors.
  • Review and approve applicable MTRs, receiving inspections, inspection travelers, hold points, examinations, and testing.
  • Ensure WPS, PQR, and WPQ documentation complies with applicable ASME Section IX requirements.
  • Oversee technical requirements associated with R-Stamp, U-Stamp, S-Stamp, and PP-Stamp activities, as applicable.
  • Prepare, review, and/or certify Manufacturer's Data Reports when authorized and required.
  • Ensure ASME job files and code-required documentation are complete and ready for final records retention.

Quality Systems & Documentation

  • Partner with the Compliance & Quality Systems Administrator to ensure the technical requirements of the Company's Quality Management System are properly implemented and maintained.
  • Ensure technical quality records are complete, accurate, legible, and traceable.
  • Support document control and records control requirements within QA/QC processes.
  • Establish technical calibration and measuring-equipment requirements.
  • Review out-of-tolerance conditions that may affect product acceptance.
  • Determine technical qualification and competency requirements for QC personnel.
  • Provide, coordinate, or approve technical training for QC Inspectors and other personnel as appropriate.
  • Ensure annual visual acuity testing is completed for applicable inspection personnel.
  • Oversee the collection, technical review, and completion of Work Release documentation.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent required; technical or engineering degree preferred.
  • 5 or more years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, welding inspection, steel fabrication, or related industrial work.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical direction, leadership, or supervision to inspectors or other quality personnel.
  • Significant welding and steel fabrication experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of Quality Control systems applicable to structural steel, welding, fabrication, and code work.
  • Experience reading layouts, prints, schematics, and engineering drawings.
  • Current AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification required.
  • Current or previous NDE Level II qualifications in applicable methods such as MT, PT, VT, and UT.
  • Ability to read and interpret applicable codes, standards, and specifications, including ASME, AISC, and AWS.
  • Strong communication, leadership, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to make independent technical quality decisions within established authority.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and applicable quality, fabrication, and electronic reporting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical or engineering degree.
  • Experience with boilers, pressure vessels, piping, or ASME-code fabrication and repair.
  • Structural bolting inspection training or certification.

Why Join Hohl Industrial Services?

At Hohl Industrial Services, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the quality and success of industrial construction and fabrication projects. As our Lead CWI, your technical expertise will help ensure that our work meets customer expectations, applicable codes, and the high standards we strive for as a company.

You'll work alongside experienced professionals in a hands-on environment where your knowledge, leadership, and commitment to quality will be valued. This is an opportunity to take ownership of technical quality, mentor inspection personnel, and contribute to continuous improvement across our operations.

Physical & Work Environment

This position involves a combination of office, fabrication shop, and field responsibilities. The role requires the ability to perform physical maneuvers, including lifting up to 50 lbs., stretching, climbing, crawling, and other physical activities.

Work may take place in fabrication and construction areas that are dirty, non-climate controlled, and involve inherent hazards. The position may include walking, standing, climbing, crouching, lifting, and exposure to noise and dust. All applicable safety and PPE requirements must be followed.

Ready to Lead Quality at Hohl Industrial Services?

If you're a certified welding inspector with strong technical knowledge, leadership skills, and a passion for quality, we encourage you to apply!

Apply today and join the Hohl Industrial Services team!

Hohl Industrial Services, Inc. established in 1950, with headquarters in Tonawanda, NY, is a full-service specialized organization that provides for a diverse industrial clientele. Hohl offers a unique range of field, shop, technical, equipment sales and services.

With our professional staff of engineers, project managers, skilled tradespeople, fabricators and machinists, we are able to thoroughly study and develop a customized plan to meet all of our client's needs. Combining this with our innovative strategies and techniques, added with our experienced field personnel, we administer these plans in a safe, expedient and economical measure.

Hohl Industrial Services is a certified AISC fabricator and erector. Additionally, we maintain CWB, NYDOT, ODOT, AWS, ASME and ISO certifications

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Network Model Engineer 2
description:
At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career.

ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future.

As a Power Systems Modeling Engineer, you will develop transmission system models used in both real-time operations and in transmission planning. These models support the delivery of power to everyone in the ERCOT grid and the planning of billions of dollars of transmission system projects. You will be joining a team that performs industry leading power systems modeling and model management. In power systems modeling you will develop real-time operational models in conjunction with ERCOT transmission service providers. You will also help improve system modeling processes and develop software tools to manage and validate model data. Good communication skills will be needed as this role will involve working with numerous internal and external stakeholders to build transmission system models.

ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES

Network Model Development

  • Develops operations models from the Network Model Management System (NMMS)
  • Works with the Network Data Support Working Group (NDSWG) members on operational model data exchange and transmission network model maintenance in NMMS.
  • Reviews generator and transmission equipment data submitted by resource entities and works with resource entities to correct invalid model data.

Modeling Application Support

  • Manages transmission system model software infrastructure and develops tools to assist in managing transmission models which includes database infrastructure, model data exchange interfaces, and data export formats
  • Develops and maintains modeling software tools in Java, C# .NET, Python to validate transmission network and generator data submissions using electrical engineering principles by doing data comparison and validity checks, and to automate and perform system modeling
  • Develops rules to validate data submissions in operations and planning models using SQL
  • Manages projects to upgrade the NMMS applications to implement desired new functionality, reviews system patches, and help administer servers

Other Responsibilities

  • Provides training and mentoring of members of the Engineering Development Program (EDP)
  • Works closely with ERCOT Network Model Maintenance, Network Model Coordination, Resource Integration, System Operations, System Planning, Forward Markets, Client Services, and Grid Applications Development
  • Reviews, drafts, and presents changes to the Protocols, Guides, procedures, training material for EDP and for Market Participants (MPs), and other supporting ERCOT documents related to system modeling
  • Reviews changes to NERC standards to assess if changes to modeling methodologies are needed

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, or a combination of education and experience that provides the applicant with knowledge equivalent to a major in such fields.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Has experience with developing and maintaining software at least one of the following programming languages or equivalent: C#, Java, Python

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Has experience with at least one of the following power system simulators or equivalent: PowerWorld, PSS/E, ASPEN One-liner
  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience with software tools like Git/BitBucket and Jira
  • Strong communication skills
  • Able and comfortable with working independently, managing projects, and stakeholder groups

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Level 2: Requires minimum 1 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements.
  • Level 3: Requires minimum 3 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements
  • Sr level: Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements.

WORK LOCATION:

  • This position is Hybrid. Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at least 2-3 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management. Employees are required on-site during tight grid conditions or emergency grid operations
  • On-site schedules are flexible or may be rotated based on business needs as determined by the Manager
  • Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence.
  • Employees may opt to work on-site more than required or 100% of the time

Salary and level will be based on overall experience as determined by ERCOT.

The foregoing description reflects the minimum qualifications and the essential functions of the position that must be performed proficiently with or without reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. It is not an exhaustive list of the duties expected to be performed, and management may, at its discretion, revise or require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned. This job description is not intended to create a contract of employment with ERCOT. Both ERCOT and the employee may exercise their employment-at-will rights at any time.

title: APAC Delivery Manager
description:
Job Description

APAC Delivery Manager

JR6157030

Bengaluru, India with regional travel required

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Summary

We are looking for an emerging talent operational manager who wants to drive forward our award-winning emerging talent programmes at Rolls-Royce. This role will be responsible for the operational delivery of emerging talent in APAC partnering our businesses and outsourced providers to deliver a ‘One Rolls-Royce’ end to end service. You will be responsible for the recruitment of circa 80+ hires (interns and graduates) and coordination of their programme delivery across APAC (primary focus Singapore, India, China). This role leads the delivery of emerging talent programmes across APAC ensuring alignment to global strategy while adapting to regional market needs

This role reports into Head of People Services Operations, India with dotted reporting line into Global Head of Emerging Talent.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own regional delivery strategy and execution

  • Lead delivery teams and suppliers across multiple countries

  • Partner with business leaders on workforce planning

  • Ensure compliance with regional regulations

  • Drive attraction and pipeline activity

  • Monitor performance, reporting and continuous improvement

  • Ensure consistent learner experience across region

What you will be doing:

  • Accountable for executing our emerging talent recruitment process, onboarding, programme delivery & offboarding for your region.

  • Regional responsibility for the relationship with the emerging talent suppliers including demand planning, delivery against regional contract of services, risk & compliance, governance, commerciality & ROI, improvements and key performance to ensure business need are met and user experience optimised

  • Regional management of any emerging talent training providers including local universities or apprenticeship trainers.

  • Responsible for partnering with business stakeholders on the execution of our emerging talent programmes including managing operational governance framework, local country management of processes & legislation, compliant hiring process, effective people data

  • Own the relationship between Rolls-Royce and regional schools (age 14+), colleges and universities including collaboration with our internal and external partners to support STEM activities that contribute to future emerging talents talent growth.

  • Understand and contribute to the effective delivery of emerging talent attraction strategy within region including award partnerships, pipeline programmes and diversity partnerships

  • Partner with our global design team to take from strategy to implementation critical processes including recruitment, onboarding, induction and keep warm

  • Oversight of the delivery of centralise emerging talent learning and mandatory training programmes

  • Own the process guiding our people partners in the offboarding approach for graduates and interns within region

  • Identify areas for improvement and in partnership with the wider emerging talent team implement changes to optimize the overall experience

  • Quality assurance of graduate, apprentice and intern gigs, escalations, and day to day programme management

  • Ensure the effective delivery of the graduate and intern placements, escalations, and day to day programme management in partnership with local people teams

  • Establish and be responsible for the APAC operational emerging talent governance board including data management and reporting

  • Ensure compliance with local labour laws, regulations, and internal policies.

  • Actively promote diversity and inclusion initiatives with our emerging talent processes - ensuring all activity is aligned to the Diversity and Inclusion strategy and is woven into delivery plans.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Experience and a strong understanding of emerging talent delivery, frameworks, processes & policies

  • Vendor management skills, with the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with recruitment suppliers/vendors.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data and metrics to drive decision-making and process improvements.

  • Shown success in delivering successful projects within HR, Talent or Learning

  • Commitment to delivering the best customer experience

  • Proven capability in Stakeholder Management at all levels of the organisation.

  • Good interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and engage with a range of different stakeholders

  • Extensive matrix-working experience; ability to partner internally & with 3rd parties to enable operational delivery against strategy

  • Understanding of employment laws, regulations, and local HR practises

  • A passion for emerging talent, talent and learning

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too. Rolls-Royce are committed to a being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

Human Resources

title: Assembler II (50798)
description:

title: Associate Director, Business Strategy and Operations
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Operations & Process Improvement

  • Lead business process mapping, analysis, design, and optimization initiatives across CMC Regulatory Affairs, including development, registration, post-approval, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Identify operational pain points, process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for simplification or digital enablement in partnership with process owners and subject matter experts.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and data-driven approaches to evaluate root causes, assess options, and develop practical and sustainable solutions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops and working sessions to define current and future-state processes, clarify roles and decision points, and establish implementation plans.
  • Support the development and maintenance of process standards, procedures, governance mechanisms, and operational controls that enable consistent execution across CMC Regulatory Affairs.
  • Develop and monitor operational measures and KPIs to evaluate process performance, adoption, and opportunities for continued improvement
  • Support portfolio, resource, and operational planning activities as needed, including use of enterprise planning and resource forecasting tools.

Digital Enablement, Data & Systems

  • Partner with the CMC Digital Enablement Head, business process owners, IT, and other stakeholders to identify and advance digital opportunities that address meaningful regulatory business needs.
  • Translate regulatory operational needs and process requirements into clear business requirements and use cases for digital, automation, data, and technology solutions.
  • Lead or support the implementation of digital solutions from business problem definition and requirements development through testing, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and monitor success metrics for digital and AI-enabled capabilities including adoption, operational efficiency, quality, user experience, and business value realization.
  • Evaluate opportunities to apply workflow automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies to improve regulatory processes and decision-making.
  • Support integration of regulatory processes, data, content, and systems to enable more connected and efficient ways of working.
  • Partner with data and system owners to improve data quality, usability, and availability for regulatory operations, analytics, and decision-making.
  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and operational insights that increase visibility into performance and enable data-driven decisions.
  • Support user acceptance testing, implementation readiness, change management, and adoption of new or enhanced digital capabilities.

Cross-Functional Delivery & Change Leadership

Who is ACT1 Federal? ACT1 Federal LLC is a 100% employee-owned company. We’ve served the Department of War (DoW) for nearly thirty years. Our core missions include weapon systems engineering, logistics, space domain expertise, global defense and security, business and financial management for security assistance and major defense articles, as well as military training and arctic security. Join us!

Description: ACT1 Federal is seeking an experienced Data and Performance Analyst to provide the integration of production and supplier data, and deliver traceable dashboards and exception analysis.

Responsibilities:

Production and Supplier Data Collection:

  • Work with the BOND team, assigned PAE, program offices, prime contractors, and suppliers to define data requirements for the weapon or weapon system under review.
  • Collect and validate production schedules, output, cycle and takt time, work in process, yield, scrap and rework, downtime, labor, tooling, material, quality, test, and supplier-delivery data.
  • Map data across the prime contractor and critical lower-tier suppliers; reconcile definitions, reporting periods, part identifiers, and conflicting source information.
  • Identify material data gaps, establish repeatable collection processes, and document source, lineage, assumptions, limitations, and confidence levels.
  • Maintain secure, traceable, and reproducible data sets and analytical products in accordance with Government requirements.

Production Performance and Root-Cause Analysis:

  • Establish current-state production, capacity, throughput, schedule, quality, and supplier-performance baselines for the assigned program or system.
  • Compare planned and actual performance; analyze trends, variance, queue time, flow, yield, utilization, and leading indicators of delivery risk.
  • Identify bottlenecks and root causes associated with material, workforce, equipment, tooling, facilities, test, quality, engineering, or lower-tier suppliers.
  • Assess the feasibility and likely production impact of recovery plans, capacity expansions, process changes, investments, and supplier interventions.
  • Develop forecasts, scenarios, and early-warning indicators that clarify risks to production rates, milestones, and weapon-system deliveries.

Improvement Recommendations and Decision Support:

  • Build production dashboards, scorecards, constraint views, and recurring reports tailored to the BOND team, PAE, program managers, and senior DASN DIB leaders.
  • Recommend prioritized actions to improve production flow, throughput, quality, schedule performance, supplier reliability, and constraint visibility.
  • Track approved corrective actions, owners, milestones, measures, and results; identify when interventions are not producing the intended effect.
  • Support site visits, working sessions, and data calls and present methods, findings, limitations, and recommendations to technical and executive audiences.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in data science, statistics, mathematics, operations research, industrial or systems engineering, supply chain, business analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 8+ years’ experience in data analysis, manufacturing or production analysis, supply-chain analytics, performance management, operations research, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience collecting and validating manufacturing or supplier data, establishing production baselines, analyzing constraints, and identifying root causes of schedule, quality, or throughput shortfalls.
  • Experience developing production dashboards, forecasts, scorecards, executive visualizations, and decision-support products.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and at least one analytical or visualization environment such as Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent tool.
  • Knowledge of production measures such as capacity, throughput, cycle time, work in process, yield, utilization, downtime, quality, and supplier delivery performance.
  • Ability to communicate technical methods, findings, uncertainty, and improvement recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance required.

title: Avionics Technician III, MQ-9 (Japan/Deployable)
description:
The USMC MQ-9 CLS Technician is a highly qualified and skilled aircraft electronics and Ground Control Station technician with experience in troubleshooting multiple electronics systems both aircraft and control stations. Work may be reviewed by supervisor for general compliance with accepted practices. This position may provide technical guidance to lower-level technicians.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Must maintain assigned UAS aircraft electrical generators, load banks, starters, relays, batteries, actuators, circuit breakers, switches, and aircraft instruments.
  • Must apply advanced technical knowledge to solve complex problems that typically cannot be solved solely by referencing manufacturers’ manuals or similar documents. Examples of such problems include determining the location and density of circuitry, evaluating electromagnetic radiation, isolating malfunctions, and incorporating engineering changes.
  • Work typically requires an understanding of the interrelationships of circuits, exercising independent judgment in performing such tasks as making circuit analyses, calculating wave forms, and tracing relationships in signal flow, using complex test instruments such as high frequency pulse generators, frequency synthesizers, distortion analyzers, and complex computer control equipment.
  • The CLS technician shall utilize excellent organizational skills in prioritizing workload to meet Daily Flight Schedule.
  • Required to make entries in aircraft logs and records, attend shift change maintenance meetings, perform as a QA, and is responsible for providing guidance and technical expertise to lower-level technicians throughout all aircraft modifications and/or maintenance efforts.
  • Applies advanced technical knowledge to solve unusually complex problems that affect operational and maintenance capabilities.
  • Requires an advanced understanding of the interrelationships of circuits and associated systems.
  • Exercises independent judgment and leadership in performing assigned tasks in conjunction with designated direction from Production Staff and/or Avionic Leads.
  • Uses common and complex test instruments in the performance of assigned duties.
  • Provides technical and directional leadership guidance to lower-level avionic technicians.
  • Provides training to lower-level avionic technicians.
  • Must be able to sign off work in either NALCOMIS/OOMA or IMDS.
  • Must have knowledge and understanding of CNAFINST 4790.2 and DAFI 21-101.
  • Maintains, repairs, and installs various types of electronic equipment and related devices.
  • Applies advanced technical knowledge of electronics principles in determining malfunctions and applies skill in restoring equipment operations.
  • Must be able to work without direct supervision.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned as requested.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must have an active Secret US Government clearance with ability to obtain Top-Secret. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.
  • Must have High School Diploma or have completed relevant military and/or vocational technical school curriculum.
  • Minimum of five years of actual Aircraft Avionics and Ground Control Station (GCS) maintenance experience required.
  • Minimum of two years’ actual experience on MQ-9 aircraft and GCS, as an Avionics Technician.
  • Must have advanced knowledge of basic and complex electronics maintenance and repair.
  • Must have advanced knowledge of RFF systems, components, and accessories.
  • Must possess advanced knowledge of technical publications related to aircraft electronics maintenance.
  • Must know theory and principles of operation of engines, accessories and components, theory of flight and electronic flight controls, and have a thorough understanding of electrical and electronic principles.
  • Must be capable of using and reading blueprints, wiring diagrams, and data tables.
  • Must be eligible to gain and maintain one of the following IAT Level II certifications: CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, Security+ CE, SSCP, or GSEC, IAW DOD 8570.01-M commensurate with the assigned duties within 90 days of hire or before second deployment.
  • Must be able to inspect and operate ground support and auxiliary equipment.
  • Must achieve a passing grade in all required courses/certifications for continued employment, as needed.
  • Must be able to lift, carry and/or wear Military Issued Equipment in excess of 50 pounds for extended periods.
  • Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.
  • Must submit updated SF-86 within 30 days of hire start date.
  • Must have current/active State Issued Driver’s License.
  • Must be able to travel on CONUS/OCONUS deployments.
  • Must meet all OCONUS deployment criteria, to include pre-deployment medical screening, as a condition of employment.
  • For OCONUS deployments, must have valid U.S. Passport with a minimum of two years remaining with at least two facing pairs (four total) of blank Visa pages.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Top Secret Clearance with SCI
  • Associate degree in a relevant career field.
  • Current IAT Level II Certification.
  • Deployment Experience.
  • Prior experience as a Defense Contractor.
  • Avionics Technician experience within the last 10 years.

title: Senior Data Engineer I
description:
Who we are:

At SpotHero, we work as a team to empower people to get everywhere, easier! We’re rapidly growing with the mission of bringing the parking industry into the future through technology. Drivers across the nation use the SpotHero mobile app and website to reserve convenient, affordable parking in advance, on-the-go or through their connected cars, and parking companies rely on us to help them reach new customers while optimizing their business. We connect the dots with cutting-edge technology, delivering value to both sides of this exciting, evolving marketplace. We’ve been quite busy, take a peek at some of our recent announcements.

Senior Data Engineer at SpotHero:

SpotHero is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join the Data Engineering squad. This squad interacts with data consumers such as Data Science, Marketing, Engineering, and Business Analysts to provide data platform solutions that meet their day-to-day needs and long term vision.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll focus heavily on backend application development with a focus on building reusable infrastructure services for our stakeholders to enable them to model, store, access, process, and analyze SpotHero’s data. You’ll also design, instantiate, observe and maintain infrastructure services, both AWS-managed and open source solutions. As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll influence the technology choices and patterns established for data-heavy workloads at SpotHero.

What will you do:

  • Work with our Analytics, Data Science, Marketing and other squads to understand their data storage and processing needs.
  • Be a key hands-on contributor to the design and implementation of our data platform solutions from the infrastructure layer up to the API.
  • Model and architect our data in a way that will scale with the increasingly complex ways we’re analyzing it.
  • Build robust pipelines that make sure data is where it needs to be, when it needs to be there.
  • Build frameworks and tools to help our software engineers, data analysts, and data scientists design and build their own data pipelines in a self-service manner.
  • Performance testing and engineering to ensure that our systems always scale to meet our needs.
  • Be a key member of the team focused on hands-on contribution to the implementation and operation of our data platform.
  • Contribute to more junior team members' development, via thoughtful reviews and your own exemplary work.
  • Data Modeling/Architecting
    • Design data models with a broad understanding of underlying systems.
    • Create approachable, thorough documentation of data models describing how to access their data in a performant way.
    • Build performant models that are consistent with accompanying documentation that are built with quality in mind.
    • Consult with stakeholders on the best practices for creation and deployment of data models and data flows.
  • Data Processing
    • Define and enforce service level agreements between products owned and stakeholders, including configuration of monitoring and alerting
    • Understand data lineage and dependencies between data pipelines.
    • Design, implement, and maintain complex data processing pipelines which involve multiple integration points, including those which rely on distributed systems like Kafka and Spark.
    • Influence data processing and infrastructure practices across all of SpotHero.
    • Determine the best architecture, batch or streaming, for applications being built.
  • Working with Infrastructure
    • Evaluate different architectures for new systems or changes to the company’s existing systems, and propose thorough, specific designs for implementing those architectures.
    • Provision new infrastructure in cloud environments.
    • Deploy and manage containerized applications running in Kubernetes.
    • Identify and remedy security, cost, and maintainability issues in the team’s infrastructure.
    • Manage and integrate autoscaling, logging, monitoring and alerting for the team’s systems.

What you bring:

  • We care about your abilities, not how you gained them. You might demonstrate the capabilities below through any combination of relevant professional experience, experience in a research setting, formal education, self-guided learning, open source contributions, or public speaking / writing / teaching experience.
  • You are able to design and implement high-quality software in Python.
  • Experience using SQL to read and manage data.
  • Experience with Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or other ETL scheduling tools.
  • You have experience provisioning and managing infrastructure with infrastructure-as-code tools (we use Terraform, but experience with similar tools like CloudFormation, Pulumi, or SaltStack is totally fine!)
  • Hands-on experience using multiple data platforms and tools (e.g. Airflow, Hive, Kafka, Postgres, Redshift, S3, Spark, Trino, Airbyte), and experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining at least one of them
  • Experience designing and implementing software (pipelines, services and client libraries) that is run in Docker containers, automatically tested on a continuous integration (CI) system, and versioned in git. You have experience writing shell scripts, Makefiles, or other configuration to glue together these components.
  • Ability to deploy containerized software in Kubernetes, or sufficient experience in similar technologies like Apache Mesos or Amazon ECS.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and supporting technology intended to be used by other stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to communicate on both business and technology subjects.

Nice to Haves:

  • Message driven or streaming architectures, such as those with Kafka, Spark, Flink.
  • Postgres, MySQL, or other RDBMS experience.
  • Redshift, Presto, or other MPP database experience.
  • Experience with at least one JVM language (we use Kotlin, but Java or Scala experience works).
  • Experience with cloud data pipeline services like dbt Cloud, Airbyte, or Hightouch.
  • Experience using the latest AI tooling (Claude, Codex, etc.)

Technology we use:

  • Our Data Stack is: Our Monolith Database is Postgres and Redis for caching. We also use Redshift as our data warehouse and S3 as our data lake. The data lake is queried using Trino. We use Apache Airflow, Python, dbt, and Apache Spark for ETL. For streaming data, we use Apache Kafka managed by a vendor and use Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and Spark Streaming for stream processing. All machine learning work is done in Python, using the PyData ecosystem. Our analysts use Looker for internal-facing business intelligence reports, and Amazon Quicksight for external-facing data visualizations.

Seeking Candidates in:

  • Chicago, Illinois

What we are offering:

  • Career game changer – A truly unique experience to work for a fast-growing company in a role with unlimited growth potential.
  • Excellent benefits
    • We cover a generous portion of Medical Premiums, 50% of Dental and Vision Premiums, company-sponsored Life Insurance, STD, and AD&D coverage, a 401(k) with match and immediate vesting, and comprehensive leave policies to meet your needs in creating space for life.
  • Flexible PTO policy and outstanding work/life balance – We value and support each individual team member.
  • UberEats weekly lunch stipend for in-office days
  • Udemy License and Personal Learning Budget – We support the professional and personal growth of our people by providing everyone with learning resources and development opportunities.
  • Annual parking stipend – Duh. We help people park!
  • The opportunity to collaborate with fun, innovative, and passionate people in a casual yet highly productive atmosphere.
  • Our commitment to allyship has been a central driver of how we Respect Fellow Drivers. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of Employee Resource Groups, access allyship learning resources, and actively contribute to our ongoing effort of making SpotHero inclusive for all.
  • Employee programs to grow and support our people such as Discovery Days for Product and Engineering, Gearing up for Aspiring Leaders, and Mentorship Program.
  • Wellness program – a workplace that actively supports your physical and mental wellbeing through ongoing events, initiatives, resources, and thoughtful perks and benefits.
  • A workplace recognized as CityLights award winner by 1871, 2026 Best Places To Work by BuiltIn, Most Loved Workplace Certified by the Best Practice Institute, and recipient of multiple Comparably awards, including Best Company Culture, Best Company for Women, and Best Company for Diversity.

Compensation in Illinois:

  • Depending on your skillset and experience, you can expect your base salary to be between $136,000 - $153,000 as well as a discretionary bonus, and leading total rewards package.

title: AutoTEM technician
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact In this role, you will work as part of our advanced electron microscopy lab, supporting Intel's technology development efforts. You will be responsible for preparing ultra-thin specimens and/or performing Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) analysis to assist with process development, product qualification, and failure analysis. Your expertise in utilizing advanced tools like dual-beam Focused Ion Beam (FIB) systems and TEM imaging will directly contribute to Intel's research and development activities, ensuring the quality and reliability of our cutting-edge innovations. Business Group Intel Foundry is dedicated to driving innovation and enabling manufacturing excellence. Within this organization, the OR TEM Auto Prep team focuses on delivering high-quality materials analysis to support Intel's broader technology development efforts. This group plays a pivotal role in ensuring the success of Intel's advanced product designs and manufacturing processes by leveraging expertise in lab operations to support critical research and development objectives. Key Responsibilities - Perform technical functions to support engineering activities like fabrication, process integration, and failure analysis. - Conduct detailed engineering tasks and technical procedures to prepare samples or capture imaging using advanced FIB and TEM tools. - Complete work in alignment with general instructions and priorities while exercising judgment in resolving non-standard problems. - Maintain necessary records and reports for lab activities and ensure adherence to established protocols. - Continuously upgrade skills through hands-on training and collaboration with peers to stay current with evolving technologies and methodologies. - Participate in lab sustaining efforts, ensuring the availability and maintenance of analytical tools and processes. - Execute other related duties as required or directed.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics Technology, Materials Science, or a comparable field, with 0-3 years of hands-on lab or manufacturing experience. - OR an Associate's degree in a relevant technical field with 6-8 years of lab or manufacturing experience. - Proficiency in using advanced lab tools, such as dual-beam Focused Ion Beam (FIB) systems and TEM imaging equipment. - Strong understanding of sample preparation techniques and lab protocols. Preferred Qualifications - Previous experience working in a semiconductor manufacturing or analytical lab environment. - Familiarity with laboratory-scale tools and pipetting techniques. - Demonstrated ability to adapt to dynamic environments and work effectively in team settings. - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Join us to explore the forefront of microscopy and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in Intel's technology development. Your expertise will make a direct impact on our innovation journey.

title: Executive Director, Specialty Commercial Strategy
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

The Executive Director, Specialty Commercial Strategy will lead the commercial strategy and business performance of athenahealth’s specialty growth initiative. This leader will shape market strategy, go-to-market execution, product direction, partnerships, and growth plans while working across clinical, product, sales, marketing, customer success, onboarding, finance, and operations teams. This position is based in Boston, MA and operates in a Hybrid work model. This role reports to the Chief Medical Officer.

About the Team

The Specialty team sits within the CMO Organization – athenahealth’s cross-functional hub connecting sales, marketing, customer success, onboarding, operations, and product. The Executive Director, specialty Commercial Strategy will partner directly with the Chief Medical Officer to develop and execute strategies to expand athenahealth’s solutions across priority medical specialties and care delivery models. The team brings together clinical, commercial, product, and operational perspectives to identify market opportunities, develop specialty solutions, and support sustainable customer and revenue growth. Team members partner closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding, Finance, Analytics, Operations, and Corporate Development and use customer, market, competitive, and financial data to identify market opportunities, develop specialty solutions, and support sustainable customer and revenue growth.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead the commercial strategy for the specialty initiative, including go-to-market plans, market-entry sequencing, partnerships, and bookings growth objectives.

  • Shape the product vision for specialty solutions by translating market intelligence and customer feedback into product requirements and partnering with Product leaders on roadmap priorities and investment decisions.

  • Lead and develop specialty business segment leaders responsible for expanding provider participation and business performance across priority specialty markets.

  • Align Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding, Finance, Analytics, and Operations teams around specialty growth priorities, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.

  • Drive new customer acquisition and recurring revenue growth by developing scalable, data-informed sales, demand generation, pricing, and market development strategies.

  • Define specialty business performance measures and partner with Finance and Analytics to strengthen reporting, evaluate profitability, monitor results, and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Lead market expansion planning, including market sizing, competitive analysis, financial modeling, due diligence, and recommendations on whether to build, buy, or partner to address new opportunities.

  • Direct go-to-market and launch strategies for new specialty solutions while partnering with Customer Success and Onboarding leaders to strengthen the customer experience throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • Apply AI-enabled tools and approaches to strengthen market analysis, scenario planning, customer and competitive insights, and commercial decision-making; evaluate the business implications of emerging AI capabilities and promote responsible AI adoption across specialty strategy workflows.

  • Travel 10–25% annually within the United States to support customer, market, and business needs.

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Represent the specialty initiative with prospects, customers, and executive stakeholders through presentations, workshops, and industry forums.

  • Analyze win/loss findings, competitive positioning, customer feedback, and internal performance data to refine specialty strategy and execution.

  • Partner with Corporate Development to identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential specialty markets, partnerships, and inorganic growth opportunities.

  • Develop the Specialty Long-Range Plan in partnership with clinical and Corporate Development leadership, incorporating market, competitive, and financial analysis.

  • Prepare and deliver monthly steering committee discussions and quarterly specialty performance updates for executive leadership.

  • Coach specialty business segment leaders in business planning, performance management, executive communication, and cross-functional execution.

Expected Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; MBA, MS, or other relevant advanced degree preferred.

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in business development, general management, growth strategy, commercial strategy, or related leadership roles.

  • Demonstrated experience driving new customer acquisition and scaling go-to-market operations in B2B software-as-a-service environments; healthcare technology experience preferred.

  • Experience building and leading commercial teams and coordinating work across multiple functions and organizational levels.

  • Experience with inorganic growth activities, including mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, or channel strategies, and the ability to conduct and interpret market and financial due diligence.

  • Strong financial and business analysis skills, including experience developing business cases and connecting bookings, revenue, win rates, customer acquisition measures, and profitability to broader business performance.

  • Ability to communicate complex business strategies clearly, influence senior stakeholders, align teams with differing priorities, and represent an organization effectively with external audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver business outcomes through cross-functional collaboration in a matrixed organization.

  • Ability to establish structure, priorities, processes, and measurable objectives when working with evolving business opportunities or incomplete information.

  • Experience with healthcare technology, physician practice markets, ambulatory care, or related healthcare settings preferred

Expected Compensation

$185,000 - $315,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates.
