title: Senior Software Engineer, Specialties
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Join athenahealth as a Senior Software Engineer in the Specialties Zone, where you’ll design and build scalable, secure, and maintainable software that powers clinical workflows for specialty practices. In this Boston-based hybrid role, you’ll work as a full-stack engineer and own solutions across the entire software development lifecycle—from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support. You’ll partner closely with product, design, and adjacent engineering teams to deliver high-impact capabilities that help healthcare providers work more efficiently and deliver better patient care.

Team Summary

The Specialties Zone builds mission-critical clinical solutions used by healthcare providers every day. Our products support the distinct needs of specialty practices and care settings—including Women’s Health, Behavioral Health, Ambulatory Surgery Centers, Physical Therapy, Orthopedics, and more—helping providers simplify complex workflows, make informed clinical decisions, and deliver efficient, personalized care.

Our collaborative, mission-driven team is passionate about improving healthcare outcomes through technology. We foster an environment of continuous learning and innovation in which engineers take ownership of quality across the full software development lifecycle. We are also evolving how we build software—shifting from manual, ticket-by-ticket implementation toward a spec-first, AI-accelerated workflow in which engineers focus on domain correctness, architecture, system constraints, and edge cases.

You’ll work closely with product, design, and adjacent engineering teams to deliver practical, scalable solutions aligned with customer and clinical needs.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support high-quality software as part of an agile, cross-functional product team.

  • Work as a full-stack engineer across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Own features across the entire software development lifecycle, including requirements refinement, technical design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing production support.

  • Develop strong knowledge of specialty clinical workflows to improve technical decision-making, ticket triage, dependency mapping, and cross-team coordination.

  • Contribute to and help evolve team practices, including design reviews, feature readouts, agile ceremonies, code review standards, and testing strategy.

  • Use Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and similar AI-assisted or agentic development tools throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements refinement, codebase exploration, implementation planning, code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation, and first-pass code review.

  • Critically evaluate, debug, and refine AI-generated code, tests, designs, and recommendations rather than accepting outputs at face value.

  • Mentor other engineers on effective engineering practices and the responsible use of AI tools, including prompt design, context management, output verification, and recognizing when an LLM-based tool should not be used.

Additional Job Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests as part of feature development.

  • Use AI-assisted approaches to strengthen testing, including test generation, coverage analysis, identification of edge cases, and validation of expected behavior.

  • Explore and apply technologies such as GraphQL to extend product and platform capabilities.

  • Monitor application health and performance and use AI-assisted tools to accelerate troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

  • Identify opportunities to use Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other LLM-powered tools to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate codebase understanding, improve test coverage, and shorten development feedback cycles.

Expected Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience in a product development organization.

  • Strong full-stack development experience, including backend services, frontend applications, APIs, data persistence, and production support.

  • Solid backend development experience using Java or modern OOP languages.

  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend architecture.

  • Experience working with Perl and/or Python in production environments, including the ability to understand, maintain, extend, and modernize existing applications.

  • Experience designing, building, and supporting APIs using technologies such as REST and GraphQL.

  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, Oracle and PostgreSQL.

  • Experience working with distributed systems and evolving application architectures, including monolithic, microservices, modern, and legacy production environments

Expected Compensation

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

title: Intermediate Software Engineer
description:
About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About the team - Tackle

Tackle, a business unit of AppDirect, is the leading solution built to help software companies generate revenue through data-driven Cloud go-to-market (Cloud GTM). Our platform and team help customers identify the right buyers, grow cloud co-sell relationships, and transact efficiently at scale through AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft.

Tackle serves more than 500 software companies—including CrowdStrike, HashiCorp, New Relic, and Snyk—from high-growth startups to the largest software companies in the world.

About You

You'll join a small, high-ownership team building Tackle's marketplace post-transaction experience — the systems that keep contracts, invoices, payments, and metered usage in sync after a deal is sold, and the product surfaces vendors use to act on that data. Your day-to-day work spans the full stack on both the backend (, Go) and frontend (React), running on AWS across Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions, ECS, and Postgres. Because the team is small, you'll own meaningful portions of the product end to end: from a cloud marketplace API, through the pipelines that build a contract or deliver a usage record, to the React UI and public APIs customers rely on. You bring a growth mindset to your work — you're comfortable asking questions, learning unfamiliar cloud APIs quickly, and closing gaps through curiosity rather than waiting for perfect prior experience. You communicate clearly in a distributed team setting and take pride in writing code that is testable, maintainable, and ready for production.

What you'll do and how you'll have an impact

  • Build and maintain full-stack features across Tackle's post-transaction product, exposing that data to customers through a React frontend and TypeScript/Node.js and Go backends.
  • Design and implement backend services on AWS, including serverless, event-driven systems (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions).
  • Own and evolve data integrations with AWS, Microsoft, and Google marketplaces, and publish change events that downstream systems consume.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features — from design through deployment and operation — on a team where your contributions are immediately visible in production, including customer APIs, CRM integrations, and notifications when data changes.
  • Collaborate daily with a product manager and other engineers to shape how marketplace billing and usage data is modeled, synced, and surfaced in the product.
  • Participate in code reviews to uphold code quality standards and share knowledge across a small engineering team.

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years of professional experience building full-stack web applications, with working knowledge of both frontend and backend layers.
  • Professional experience with React and TypeScript (or strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with demonstrated readiness to work in a TypeScript-only codebase).
  • Hands-on experience deploying applications on AWS, particularly with serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, or DynamoDB. Familiarity with event-driven patterns (EventBridge, SQS, Step Functions, or DynamoDB streams) is a plus.
  • Comfort working with external APIs and moving or transforming data between systems and keeping search indexes and CRM records in step.
  • Comfort working with AI coding tools. We use Cursor heavily.
  • A strong sense of ownership, because on a team this small you will hold significant responsibility for product areas and need to drive work forward with limited direction.
  • Intellectual curiosity that leads you to understand how your code fits into the broader system.

At AppDirect, we believe that innovation thrives in an environment that houses diversity of excellence, experience and thought. We respect each AppDirector as their own fingerprint; unique with no one alike. We foster an environment of inclusion without regard to race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity enabling AppDirectors to embrace their uniqueness to do their best work. As such, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and/or people with intersectional identities.

At AppDirect we take privacy very seriously. For more information about our use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice:

At AppDirect, AI tools may assist our recruitment team with administrative automations — always under human oversight. AI tools do not make hiring decisions or solely automated decisions about your candidacy – all decisions are made by our people. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your information may be processed in this way. You may request access or deletion at any time by contacting privacy@appdirect.com.

title: Tortilla Prep
description:
Como Tortilla Prep, desempeñas un papel clave en el buen funcionamiento de nuestra cocina, preparando y organizando los ingredientes para la cocción y el montaje de los platillos del menú.

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar ingredientes, incluyendo cortar verduras, marinar carnes y porcionar condimentos, siguiendo las recetas y los estándares de calidad.
  • Supervisar los niveles de ingredientes y comunicarte con el personal de cocina para asegurar suficiente stock para los próximos turnos. Asistir en la organización y rotación del inventario según sea necesario.
  • Mantener la limpieza y el buen funcionamiento del equipo de cocina (cuchillos, cortadoras, procesadores de alimentos), siguiendo los procedimientos de limpieza y mantenimiento.
  • Cumplir con los protocolos de seguridad alimentaria e higiene, incluyendo el almacenamiento, etiquetado y manejo adecuado de los ingredientes.
  • Colaborar con el equipo de cocina, incluyendo cocineros y taqueros, para coordinar la preparación y garantizar un flujo eficiente durante las horas de mayor actividad.
  • Apoyar el control de calidad inspeccionando los ingredientes para asegurar frescura y consistencia en las porciones y presentación.
  • Ayudar en otras tareas de cocina según sea necesario, incluyendo lavado de platos, limpieza y organización de las estaciones de trabajo.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia previa en preparación de alimentos, preferiblemente en un restaurante o establecimiento de comida rápida de ritmo acelerado.
  • Conocimientos básicos de seguridad e higiene alimentaria.
  • Capacidad para seguir recetas y porciones con precisión.
  • Gran atención al detalle y habilidades organizativas.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera eficiente bajo presión y mantener la compostura en periodos de alta demanda.
  • Capacidad física para levantar hasta 50 libras (≈23 kg).
  • Flexibilidad para trabajar noches, fines de semana y días festivos según sea necesario.
Salario por hora = $18 por hora + propinas

--

As a Tortilla Prep, you play a vital role in keeping our kitchen running smoothly by preparing and organizing ingredients for cooking and menu assembly.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare ingredients, including chopping vegetables, marinating meats, and portioning condiments, following recipes and quality standards.

  • Monitor ingredient levels and communicate with kitchen staff to ensure adequate stock for upcoming shifts. Assist with inventory organization and rotation as needed.

  • Maintain cleanliness and proper function of kitchen equipment (knives, slicers, food processors) and follow cleaning and maintenance procedures.

  • Follow food safety and sanitation protocols, including proper storage, labeling, and handling of ingredients.

  • Collaborate with kitchen team members, including cooks and taqueros, to coordinate preparation and ensure efficient workflow during peak hours.

  • Support quality control by inspecting ingredients for freshness and ensuring consistency in portion sizes and presentation.

  • Assist with general kitchen duties as needed, including dishwashing, cleaning, and workstation organization.

Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in a food preparation role, preferably in a fast-paced restaurant or fast-food environment.

  • Basic knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices.

  • Ability to follow recipes and portion sizes accurately.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure and maintain composure during busy periods.

  • Physical ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

$18/hr + tips

title: Salesperson
description:
Job Description

What is a Salesperson?

Entry level sales position capable of supporting the DIY business and achieve our sales and service objectives. The role has good knowledge of store systems, basic automotive system knowledge and basic part knowledge. The role has the basic ability to source from stores, hubs, pdq, and external suppliers. The role has in-depth knowledge of the store inventory and maintenance processes. Position can be part time or full time. Fleet safety certification preferred.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent selling experience for DIY customer visits and phone calls
  • Achieve personal sales goal and help store achieve its sales goals
  • Provide DIY services including battery installation, testing, wiper installs, etc.
  • Maintain store product and operational standards
  • Responsible for inventory processes including truck put away, shoot outs, cycle counts, Back stock, etc.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Store Cleanliness including floors, bathrooms, facing, dusting, parking lot
  • General stocking including truck stocking and back stock
  • Safely deliver parts to customers as needed

Success Factors

  • Basic driving and navigation ability
  • Ability to use delivery board system
  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Operating inventory systems and store equipment
  • Parts and automotive system knowledge skills
  • Operating POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Expert at testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY service

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a Salesperson

  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and management
  • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, parts catalogs, and procedure manuals
  • Use basic math accurately: add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed

Prior Experience that Sets a Salesperson up for Success

  • 2-3 years of successful sales experience in a diverse retail environment, providing superior customer experiences

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.


Compensation Range

The good faith estimate for this role is between 12.20 USD and 13.21 USD per hour for a new team member.

The rate offered depends on a number of factors, including geographic location, experience in retail, automotive knowledge, education, leadership roles, and other skillsets ideal for this position and shift differential (if applicable).

title: Project Manager IV for IS Budget
description:
A Project Manager leads projects through the full project life cycle, ensuring delivery within defined scope, schedule, and resource constraints. Collaborates with cross-functional teams, manages risks and progress, and ensures alignment with the University’s priorities and stakeholder expectations.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead monthly IS financial reporting, including budget-to-actual analysis, forecasting, trend reporting, and project financial status.
  • Analyze financial performance, identify variances and risks, and provide recommendations to IS leadership.
  • Develop and maintain operating, personnel, contract, and software expense forecasts.
  • Reconcile financial and project data across multiple systems and resolve discrepancies.
  • Manage the annual and multi-year IS budget planning process from preparation through final submission.
  • Create and improve budget models, planning tools, reports, procedures, and documentation.
  • Support IS Directors throughout budget planning by providing tools, guidance, analysis, and submission reviews.
  • Consolidate budget submissions and prepare executive summaries for IS leadership and Finance.
  • Produce financial reports highlighting spending trends, forecasts, risks, funding gaps, and cost drivers.
  • Maintain budget data in Anaplan and ensure alignment with supporting documentation.
  • Facilitate budget planning meetings, training sessions, and status updates.
  • Review requisitions and project requests for budget compliance, accuracy, and alignment with approved plans.
  • Automate reporting and data preparation processes using Excel, VBA, Microsoft 365, and related tools.
  • Provide ad hoc financial analysis, scenario modeling, and decision support for IS leadership.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Manager I – 0

Project Manager II – 0

Project Manager III – May supervise 0-5 people

Project Manager IV – May supervise 5+ people

Project Manager V – May supervise 7+ people

QUALIFICATIONS AND CREDENTIALS

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field required.
  • Experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, or related analytical functions.
  • Strong knowledge of financial systems, budget management, data reconciliation, reporting, and process improvement.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, complex formulas, data consolidation, and VBA macros.
  • Experience with Banner Finance, Anaplan, Argos, Tableau, Jaggaer, ServiceNow, or similar ERP systems preferred.
  • Experience developing financial analyses and executive-level reports for diverse audiences preferred.
  • 5-6 + years of project management or related professional experience is required.

ABILITIES AND COMPETENCIES ESSENTIAL TO THE FUNCTION OF THE JOB

Communication and Comprehension

  • Advanced financial and analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and consistent delivery of accurate work under deadlines.
  • Skilled in financial data reconciliation, issue resolution, and root-cause analysis.
  • Proficient in developing financial models, dashboards, reports, and automated solutions.

title: Learning Accessibility Consultant
description:
About The Team

Join a passionate and purpose-driven team dedicated to enhancing student wellbeing, inclusion and success. In Access, Wellbeing & Equity (AWE), you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference by supporting students to overcome barriers, thrive in their studies and reach their full potential.

Working in a collaborative and supportive environment, you'll contribute to initiatives that shape the student experience across the University while advancing wellbeing, accessibility and equity outcomes for our diverse community.

Your New Role!

As a Learning Accessibility Consultant, you'll play a key role in supporting students with disability and health conditions to succeed throughout their studies at Murdoch University.

Working collaboratively with students and staff, you'll champion inclusive teaching practices, support the integration of Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles, deliver training on accessible technologies and identify appropriate reasonable adjustments that remove barriers to learning.

This is an opportunity to combine strategic influence with meaningful student support, helping to create a positive and equitable student experience.

Based at our South Street campus, you'll have the option to work from our Mandurah office one day per week. While this is optional, occasional work at the Mandurah campus may be required during semester periods.

Please refer to the Position Description for further details.

What We Offer You!

This Continuous| Full Time (37.5 hours per week) attracts a remuneration of $101K – $133K (pro rata) plus 17% employer superannuation contributions.

You’ll join a dynamic and talented team where diversity and innovation thrive. Our Silver-tier status in the Australian Workplace Equality Index (AWEI), awarded in 2025, reflects our commitment to LGBTIQA+ inclusion, equity, and creating a safe, welcoming environment for all. We strive to be the university of choice for First Nations peoples, honouring Indigenous knowledge. Sustainability is central to our community and guided by clear, confident leadership, we are working toward an ambitious future with goals of net zero emissions and zero waste by 2030.

As well as the flexibility to maintain a work life balance, our staff enjoy a vibrant, natural campus with world-class facilities, along with a variety of benefits, including:

Operational Execution & Stakeholder Engagement

title: Scientist 3, Discovery Oncology
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Scientist to join our Research Oncology team at Genentech. As a Scientist in this role, you will be critical to delivering on our drug discovery pipeline. You will develop projects and design experiments that yield key mechanistic insights to advance novel therapeutic targets and enable new drug discovery approaches.

This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and utilize cutting-edge technologies to conduct highly impactful and creative research with the ultimate goal of improving patients’ lives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver on the pipeline: Design, execute and interpret hypothesis-driven experiments, generate highly reproducible data robust tools and assays to drive oncology drug discovery forward.

  • Drive scientific discovery: Engage in scientific discussion, stay up to date with the scientific literature in a fast-paced dynamic research environment. Propose new ideas or creative solutions and identify key experiments to yield key mechanistic insights required to pursue and validate therapeutic targets.

  • Collaborate across functions: Work productively with multidisciplinary teams across Genentech, including colleagues in Drug Discovery, Computational Sciences, Translational Medicine, Pathology to support the validation and development of novel therapeutics. Foster a collaborative culture by sharing expertise and learning from others.

  • Communicate findings: Present and discuss data at regular lab meetings, team meetings, department forums, and cross-functional meetings.

Who You Are

  • Ph.D. in the field of Molecular biology, Cancer Biology, or related fields. Candidates with an M.Sc. and at least 3 years of research experience will also be considered.

  • Possess deep technical expertise in mammalian cell culture (including handling complex or difficult-to-culture models) and advanced cell engineering (CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing, lentiviral/transposon delivery, and generation of inducible or reporter cell lines).

  • Demonstrate hands-on mastery in executing cellular pharmacology and mechanistic assays, such as dose-response viability measurements, pathway modulation assays, Western blotting, qRT-PCR, and protein interaction/pull-down assays.

  • Bring a proven track record of rigorous, impactful research evidenced by peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, or documented milestone contributions within an industry drug discovery setting.

  • Demonstrate high resilience, self-motivation, and scientific problem-solving capabilities to navigate technical hurdles, with exceptional collaboration skills in team-oriented settings.

Preferred experience

  • Strong background in cancer signaling pathways. Prior work in hormone-dependent cancers would be a plus.

  • Background in transcription factor and chromatin biology, with experience in designing and interpreting NGS experiments (e.g. ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, RNA-seq).

  • Hands-on proficiency with advanced cellular imaging modalities, including live-cell microscopy, high-content imaging, immunofluorescence (IF), or fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) in cell and tissue specimens.

Relocation benefits are available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $103,400 to $192,000. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

title: Controls Supervisor
description:
Founded over 35 years ago, First Quality is a family-owned company that has grown from a small business in McElhattan, Pennsylvania into a group of companies, employing over 5,000 team members, while maintaining our family values and entrepreneurial spirit. With corporate offices in New York and Pennsylvania and 8 manufacturing campuses across the U.S. and Canada, the companies within the First Quality group produce high-quality personal care and household products for large retailers and healthcare organizations. At First Quality, you’ll find a collaborative environment focused on continuous learning, professional development, and our mission to Make Things Better®.

We are seeking a Controls Supervisor for First Quality Tissue located in Lock Haven, PA.

Job Function:

This role oversees day-to-day instrumentation, PLC/SCADA/DCS/QCS/VFD work, and the reliability of automated systems that keep production running safely and efficiently. You will supervise technicians, prioritize work, enforce standards, and act as the technical lead for controls issues on the floor.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Supervise controls technicians, electricians, instrumentation staff, contractors (scheduling, training, performance, safety).
  • Schedule controls maintenance activities, ensuring compliance with weekly and outage schedules along with safety and governmental regulations.
  • Manage backlog and follow Work Follow Management processes through a CMMS
  • Own reliability of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, DCS, QCS, VFDs, sensors, and related networks.
  • Plan and execute preventive and predictive maintenance on control systems.
  • Lead troubleshooting of production downtime related to controls, instrumentation, and automation.
  • Review and approve control logic changes, interlocks, and safety-related modifications.
  • Coordinate with production, maintenance, engineering, and vendors on upgrades and projects.
  • Maintain documentation: drawings, I/O lists, programs, change logs, and spare-parts strategy.
  • Enforce lockout/tagout, electrical safety, and site procedures.
  • Support capital projects: scope, commissioning, punch lists, and handover to operations.
  • Track KPIs (uptime, mean time to repair, backlog, training compliance) and report to leadership.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis after unplanned events.

Experience/Education:

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in electrical, electronics, industrial automation, or related field; bachelor’s preferred. Equivalent experience accepted.
  • 5+ years in industrial controls / automation; 2+ years in a lead or supervisory role preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with CMMS (INFOR, MP3, SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major platform (Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider, Emerson, Honeywell, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of PLC programming, HMI/SCADA, industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, etc.), and instrumentation.
  • Knowledge of PLC Siemens PCS7 and Step 7, QCS – Honeywell Davinci, networking and fieldbus, and instrument calibrations is a plus.
  • Familiarity with NFPA 70E, OSHA electrical safety, and plant safety systems.
  • Ability to read P&IDs, electrical schematics, and loop diagrams.
  • Strong communication and people-leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in paper manufacturing.
  • Knowledge of VFDs, motion control, robotics, or building automation (if applicable).
  • Exposure to cybersecurity practices for OT networks.
  • Project management or commissioning experience.
  • Relevant certifications (ISA, NICET, manufacturer training, etc.).

What We Offer You

We believe that by continuously improving the quality of our benefits, we can help to raise the quality of life for our team members and their families. At First Quality you will receive:

  • Competitive base salary and bonus opportunities
  • Paid time off (three-week minimum)
  • Medical, dental and vision starting day one
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Child and family care assistance (dependent care FSA with employer match up to $2500)
  • Bundle of joy benefit (year's worth of free diapers to all team members with a new baby)
  • Tuition assistance
  • Wellness program with savings of up to $4,000 per year on insurance premiums
  • ...and more!

First Quality is committed to protecting information under the care of First Quality Enterprises commensurate with leading industry standards and applicable regulations. As such, First Quality provides at least annual training regarding data privacy and security to employees who, as a result of their role specifications, may come in to contact with sensitive data.

First Quality is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or protected Veteran status.

Role and Scope of Position:
This position has the responsibility for the development and implementation of plans and procedures for the testing and commissioning of highly complex transmission and distribution substation projects. This position works closely with System Test and Protection & Controls Engineering in the development of project test and commissioning plans with a focus on ensuring safety and eliminating issues and errors during the commission process. This position is responsible for commissioning of substation equipment as individual units (breakers, transformers, etc.) as well as overall project commission including controls, systems, relays, metering, etc.

This position also has shared responsibility for optimizing the cost and performance of the assets of the
transmission/distribution system. In addition, this position coordinates the evaluation of system failures, and
the appropriate resolutions, in order to provide support to operations on unplanned maintenance. This
position shares accountability with peers in the strategy, development, and design of the organization’s
Life Cycle Plan, a comprehensive long-term plan for the transmission/distribution system.

This position is responsible for supervising, assigning, prioritizing and directing the work performed by other engineers. This position may require on-call responsibilities.

Essential Functions:

  • Responsible for ensuring complex substation projects are tested and commissioned in accordance with industry and Eversource standards with a focus on safety and maintaining system reliability
  • Responsible for assisting in the development of standards and procedures for the test and commissioning of substation projects.
  • Collaborates with Engineers within Engineering to ensure consistency and teamwork.
  • Accountable for root-cause analysis, development and implementation of corrective actions relating to project commissioning.

description:

To be considered, please complete the assessment within the allotted time. If you don't receive it after applying, check your spam folder. Assessment results are valid for 6 months.

JOB SUMMARY

The Branch Vice President responsibilities are to coach, develop and lead all branch employees to obtain individual, branch and organizational growth goals while delivering unbelievable member service experiences and maintaining operational excellence. This key position is accountable to create, implement, and maintain branch strategies aligned with VyStar’s objectives in a fast-paced environment. They also develop and implement tactical plans and establish objectives for the branch which are documented in the annual business plan. The Branch Vice President must maintain a high level of participation within VyStar Leadership Team and promote, reinforce, and support decisions of the credit union and management. The leader must also establish strong member and partner relationships and engage in community volunteer and leadership opportunities. The overall results and success of the branch team are the direct responsibility of the Branch Vice President.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Ensure day-to-day branch operations, choreography, and implementation result in unbelievable service experiences for members and achieve or exceed organizational strategic goals and profitability requirements.

  • Train, encourage, enable, and coach employees to embrace VyStar’s Standards of Excellence, Behaviors of Excellence, Being Unbelievable, and the Great 8 Member Service Commitments to successfully establish, maintain, and grow strong member relationships.

  • Model all VyStar Excellence behaviors while performing job duties.

  • Develop staff for succession planning within the branch network and other lines of business.

  • Work closely with Human Resources and Training to ensure the recruiting and training curriculum are appropriate, timely, and a positive experience for VyStar employees.

  • Partner with internal departments that are dependent upon referrals for success.

  • Establish and validate performance objectives for the branches consistent with VyStar Excellence and branch scorecards.

  • Reinforce appropriate employee activities and behaviors to achieve personal, branch, and organizational objectives creating consistent expectations and course-correcting when necessary.

  • Support the ABM in providing ongoing coaching for direct reports including side-by-side evaluations, Member Assist Call assessments, monthly performance reviews, and career progression discussions.

  • Provide ongoing coaching for ABM including coach-the-coach evaluations, monthly performance reviews, and career progression discussions.

  • Conduct daily team huddles and weekly sales meetings which include training on products and services and skill practice to increase knowledge and comfort level with making recommendations to members.

  • Prepare or assist with the preparation and administering of performance appraisals for all levels of Branch Management and indirect reports.

  • Support and participate in all Credit Union initiatives and campaigns.

  • Analyze data to determine and implement staffing changes and modifications as needed.

  • Ensure compliance with regulations, policies, and procedures and perform audits.

  • Adhere to solid risk management guidelines in a highly regulated environment.

  • At applicable locations, collaborate with Branch Operations Analysts to ensure compliance.

  • Exhibit a high degree of integrity, trustworthiness, and professionalism at all times.

  • Work from home during branch closures, such as during disaster recovery events.

  • Actively lead by example through community service supporting the VyStar brand.

  • Create and maintain an inclusive and professional environment where all team members are respected, and diversity is valued.

  • As applicable, support a high school branch and Collegiate employees, including mentoring, training, and development of the student interns, and ensuring sound branch operations and compliance with rules and regulations.

  • Resolve member concerns independently and escalate more complex concerns as appropriate.

  • Provide counseling to members and employees on all financial matters and make appropriate recommendations.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance.

  • A congenial attitude, excellent written and verbal communication skills, problem solving skills and the ability to relate well with others are required.

  • Must possess strong teaching and mentoring skills and a commitment to quality service.

  • Must be able to work in a fast paced, changing environment and have a strong desire to assist members in meeting their financial needs.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Patient Conversions
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Role Summary:
The Senior Full Stack Developer designs and builds modern web and service-layer capabilities that support patient communication experiences at athenahealth. This role works from Austin, TX in a hybrid model and combines front-end and back-end engineering to deliver reliable, maintainable software across React, TypeScript, Java 21, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and HAPI FHIR. The position reports to the Senior Engineering Manager.

Team Summary:
Patient Conversations creates modern communication experiences that connect patients with their care teams through SMS, secure web chat, and voice channels. The team is building a strategic platform that supports real-world patient and practice workflows, including conversational support, escalation paths, and secure handoffs across channels. The SMS and secure web chat experiences are already in use, and voice is an important next step in the roadmap. This work spans product experiences, backend services, data handling, integrations, and operational reliability. You would join a small engineering team with a mix of front-end, back-end, and full-stack contributors, partnering closely with product, design, architecture, and quality engineering to deliver high-impact capabilities at scale.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain full stack features using React, TypeScript, Java 21, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, HAPI FHIR, Gradle, and athenahealth’s Forge design system.

  • Build user-facing experiences and service APIs that support patient communication workflows across SMS, secure web chat, and voice-enabled experiences.

  • Design and implement scalable backend services, event-driven workflows, and integrations that support reliable conversation handling and data exchange.

  • Collaborate with product, design, architecture, and quality engineering to translate requirements into well-structured technical solutions.

  • Write clean, testable, well-documented code and participate in code reviews, design reviews, and troubleshooting.

  • Improve application performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability across the full stack.

  • Support secure handling of healthcare data and apply sound engineering practices for privacy, access control, and compliance requirements.

  • Use AI tools and AI-assisted workflows to improve engineering productivity, evaluate outputs critically, and apply judgment when incorporating AI-generated suggestions into code, design, or troubleshooting.

  • Contribute to technical discussions and help identify practical implementation patterns for new product capabilities and platform enhancements.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Support production issue investigation and root-cause analysis when needed.

  • Participate in release planning, deployment readiness, and post-release validation.

  • Help refine engineering standards, coding conventions, and reusable patterns.

  • Contribute to documentation for technical design, APIs, and system behavior.

  • Assist with mentoring peers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

  • Participate in cross-functional discussions to help clarify requirements and implementation tradeoffs.

  • Support continuous improvement of engineering processes, tooling, and developer experience.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4 to 8 years of software development experience building production applications.

  • Experience developing modern front-end applications with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building production-grade backend services with Java and Spring Boot.

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.

description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Lead Embedded Software Engineer to join our Flight Management System (FMS) team. In this role, you will develop and verify safety-critical, real-time embedded software supporting both legacy and next-generation avionics programs. Your work will focus on low-level middleware and platform software, including input/output interfaces, diagnostics and maintenance functions, BootROM, dual-redundancy management, and cross-loading capabilities.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in DO-178 software development, hands-on proficiency in Ada and C, and familiarity with avionics communication and partitioning standards such as ARINC 429, ARINC 653, and MIL-STD-1553. This role requires a technically strong engineer who can work across the software lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, verification, and issue resolution.

The location for this position is Grand Rapids, MI on at least a hybrid basis (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday in office): An extensive corporate relocation package is also available for eligible candidates.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Architect, develop, and maintain real-time embedded software for avionics computer systems supporting Flight Management System applications.

  • Design and implement low-level middleware and platform functions, including:

    • digital and analog I/O interfaces

    • system diagnostics and maintenance

    • BootROM and startup software

    • dual-redundancy management

    • cross-load / data loading mechanisms

  • Read, analyze, develop, and maintain Ada and C software for safety-critical embedded systems.

  • Derive, review, and maintain software requirements, low-level design, and interface documentation in compliance with program and certification needs.

  • Support and perform software verification activities, including test development, debugging, integration, and issue resolution.

  • Collaborate with systems, hardware, integration, certification, and program teams to ensure technical execution and compliance objectives are met.

  • Communicate program status, technical risks, and mitigation plans clearly and proactively to engineering and program leadership.

  • Plan and execute assigned work to meet Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and compliance objectives.

  • Contribute to technical problem solving across multiple programs, including both new product development and legacy product sustainment.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

  • 6+ years of professional experience in embedded software development or avionics software design.

  • Strong experience developing software in Ada and/or C for real-time embedded systems.

  • Experience working in a DO-178 or similarly regulated software development environment.

  • Experience with the full embedded software lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, integration, verification, and debug.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

  • This position requires U.S. citizenship status.

  • The location for this position is Grand Rapids, MI on at least a hybrid basis (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday in office): An extensive corporate relocation package is also available for eligible candidates.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience with flight management systems, avionics computers, or other safety-critical aerospace platforms is preferred. Familiarity with avionics and industrial communication interfaces, including ARINC 429, ARINC 653, ARINC 664, ARINC 825, MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet, CAN, RS-232/422/485, and analog and discrete I/O, is also desired.

  • Experience developing software for diagnostics, maintenance functions, startup/boot software, or redundancy management.

  • Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems and drive them to closure.

  • Strong technical writing skills, including requirements, design documentation, and verification artifacts.

  • Experience in aerospace or another highly regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with hardware/software integration and debugging in embedded environments.

  • Prior experience leading technical efforts, coordinating work, or mentoring other engineers.

title: PSiX Program Aide
description:
Cornell Human Ecology explores the complexity of human life. We bring together a wide range of perspectives to understand the full context of the human experience and improve lives at every scale, from cells to society. Our research and academic programs focus on the interaction of humans with their biological, economic, social and physical environments. Using Cornell's far-reaching extension network and the college's translational research methods, we deliver our findings directly to communities and families, ensuring that our work reaches those who need it most.

Established in 2025, the Purpose Science and Innovation Exchange (PSiX), currently incubated in the Bronfenbrenner Center for Translational Research, is built on the simple yet powerful premise that the science of purpose can drive human flourishing. This effort is committed to rigorous and pioneering research and fostering an innovative ecosystem that accelerates the translation of purpose insights into real-world solutions. Our partnership with the Purpose Commons, and others is united in a common mission: dedication to transformative advancements in the science of purpose. By conducting rigorous research on purpose in life and accelerating its translation to individuals, organizations, and communities, we strive to catalyze an ecosystem that generates knowledge and empowers flourishing through purposeful living. PSiX aspires to be the preeminent global hub for purpose research and transformative discovery. PSiX advances the field of purpose science through research, translation, and community partnership. This role and related efforts are funded in part by a competitive grant from the Bezos Family Foundation.

What You Will Do

PSiX Program Aide will provide support the PSiX Director, Managing Director, and other team members, to broadly support PSiX operations, including helping keep the Translational Fellowship in Purpose Science running smoothly. This role works directly under the PSiX Director and Managing Director, handling the recurring administrative tasks in a strategic, proactive, and team-oriented approach.

While position responsibilities vary, every member of our community is expected to foster a culture of belonging and a healthy work environment by communicating across differences; being cooperative, collaborative, open, and welcoming; showing respect, compassion, and empathy; engaging and supporting others regardless of background or perspective; speaking up when others are being excluded or treated inappropriately; and supporting work/life integration of oneself and others.

This is a one-year, fixed-term, in-person position based in Ithaca, NY on Cornell University’s campus. Annual renewal is possible contingent on available funding, work, and successful performance.

No visa sponsorship or relocation assistance are provided for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in US without sponsorship. Employment will end upon the expiration of work authorization in the US. Continued employment in this position is subject to eligibility to work in accordance with US immigration laws.

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit the following materials online:

  • Resume/CV

  • Cover Letter – describing your relevant experience and how your qualifications align with the role.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate degree and up to 2 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination.

  • Some administrative, office, or program support experience is preferred.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable managing calendars, correspondence, and basic recordkeeping.

  • Proactive communicator who can work independently on recurring tasks.

  • Proficiency with standard office and scheduling software (e.g., MS Office/Google Workspace).

  • Interest in higher education, research administration, or purpose science is a plus.

  • Experience incorporating the perspectives of multiple communities.

  • Experience modeling values that support inclusion, belonging, and wellbeing.

  • Ability to cultivate and develop inclusive working relationships with students, faculty, staff, and community members.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

PSiX Operating Support (45%)

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Director, Managing Director, and others: scheduling, correspondence, meeting prep, and follow-up.

  • Assist with logistics for in-person convenings and virtual sessions (calendar invites, room/tech setup, materials distribution, RSVP tracking).

  • Support travel and procurement, and the processing of agreements, stipends, honoraria, and travel reimbursements, and help the Director track expenses against the budgets.

  • Assist with maintenance and updating websites and digital presences, as requested.

Support PSiX Faculty Fellows Program (50%)

  • Maintain fellowship records — applications, offer letters, acceptance paperwork, rosters, and cohort files.

  • Support processing of stipends, honoraria, and travel reimbursements, and help the Coordinator track expenses against the grant budget.

  • Keep the Coordinator's task list and fellowship calendar organized, and flag upcoming deadlines proactively.

  • Help administer fellow surveys and organize feedback for the Coordinator's review.

  • Schedule, support, and manage key virtual or in person meetings related to the Fellowship.

  • Support communications, promotions, and reporting related to the Fellowship, as requested.

  • Serve as a liaison between the fellowship and broader PSiX staff and partners, including the Purpose Commons—sharing relevant PSiX updates, deadlines, and priorities with the Coordinator, and helping route fellowship needs to the right PSiX contacts.


Other Position-Related Responsibilities (5%)

  • Participate in projects or other duties as assigned with occasional work responsibility falling above or below current classification.

  • Completion of any university required compliance trainings.

title: Solutions Architect - Claim US
description:
Job Type:

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

Position: Solution Architect – Claims Transformation, Hiscox USA
Reporting to: Head of Solution Architecture, US
Location: Atlanta/Boston


The Role:
The Solution Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and evolving end‑to‑end technology solutions that support the insurance value chain, including underwriting, policy administration, billing, claims, and distribution. This role partners closely with business leaders, product owners, engineering teams, and third‑party vendors to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

The Claim organization will be going through a technical transformation, and we are seeking candidates with deep technical expertise as well as strong insurance domain knowledge to architect these solutions.

The ideal candidate combines this technical expertise with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solution designs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Interact with a range of people, from highly technical software engineers to Senior Executive stakeholders. This means the ability to change their style/approach is essential. Identifying what a particular stakeholder needs to know or is concerned about is critical to ensuring that projects address the major stakeholder concerns on an on-going basis.

  • Take ownership of the overall architecture strategy/design for a complex program of work and communicate it to all members of a project team. Technical, architectural, functional and impact and risk elements of the design need to be conveyed to technical and non-technical members. Presenting options, risks, recommendations in a language and a way that shows understanding and technical leadership is essential.

  • Document and develop architectural artifacts include As-Is Architecture, Transformation Architecture and End-State or To-Be Architecture. Defend these solutions in front of a local and enterprise Architecture Review Board.

  • Work closely with technical and business teams to confirm architecture artifacts match current implementations as well as understand how changes affect current and future implementations.

  • Partner with corresponding team members ensure all of our downstream system integrations (such as Reporting, Document Production, Finance and others) are supported as the evolution of our core platform progresses.

  • Interact with business domain experts and therefore must be comfortable acquiring and using business domain language and knowledge to convey concepts and recommendations.

  • Engage with and assist technical teams in delivering the Solution. From understanding testing requirements to being involved with the development of solution using a variety of technologies such as Java (and/or Microsoft .NET) the Solution Architect is required to be able to engage and operate across a broad range of technologies including relational database systems (e.g. Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle), and integration platforms (e.g. webMethods and Apigee).

Person Specification


Requirements:
For those interested applicants, please send a resume which clearly tells the story and demonstrates evidence of the following:

  • 5+ years of experience in solution, systems, or enterprise architecture

  • 5+ years of experience in insurance technology environments – specifically current market leading Claims platforms

  • Strong knowledge of P&C or Commercial insurance operations (policy lifecycle, claims, billing)

  • Experience with Core Insurance Platforms

  • Clearly stated demonstrable practical experience and understanding of best practice architecture principles

  • Strong communication, storytelling and presentation skills; Ability to engage, influence and motivate stakeholders at all levels

  • Experienced in an Agile software development environment

  • Strong software engineering or lead developer experience – the ability to take that experience up a level to the Solution Architecture space

  • Track record of managing the architecture of multiple change projects/programs in a complex environment

  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills

  • Highly results/outcomes driven, with the energy and determination to succeed in a very fast paced environment where the pace and quality of response is critical to success

  • Be a go-to resource for other solution architects and technical architects that are looking for assistance with solving complex architecture issues

  • Review other architects solutions and ensure those solutions align with program goals

  • Motivated self-starter who can work autonomously and add value in a team

  • Excellent interpersonal, organization and time management skills

  • Must be cooperative, flexible and able to work well with others

Hiscox Values:

At Hiscox our spirit is in Challenging Convention and everything we do is guided by our Values.

  • Courage: Dare to take a risk

  • Ownership: Passionate, commercial and accountable

  • Integrity: Do the right thing, however hard

  • Connected: Together, build something better

  • Human: Clear, fair and inclusive

What Hiscox USA Offers:

  • Competitive salary and bonus (based on personal & company performance)

  • 401(k) with competitive company matching

  • Comprehensive health insurance, vision, dental and FSA plans (medical, limited purpose, and dependent care)

  • Company paid group term life, short- term disability and long-term disability coverage

  • 24 Paid time off days, 2 Hiscox Days, 10 paid holidays, and ability to purchase 5 PTO days

  • Paid parental leave

title: Principal Research Operations, Participant Strategy
description:
Job Description:

Principal Research Operations, Participant Strategy

The Role

Are you passionate about shaping the future of UX research participant engagement? Do you believe the next generation of research will combine the strengths of human participants with advances in AI, agents, and synthetic users? Join our UX Research Operations team and help define how participant recruitment evolves in a rapidly changing technology landscape.

In this Principal-level individual contributor role, you will lead the strategy and execution of participant recruitment across both B2C and B2B research. You will serve as a subject matter expert on participant sourcing, panel management, and recruiting best practices while also helping establish our organization's approach to AI-enabled research methodologies.

Working closely with researchers, product teams, legal and compliance partners, and external vendors, you will develop scalable participant strategies, build and optimize research panels, and evaluate emerging capabilities such as AI agents and synthetic users. You will help determine when human participants are essential, when synthetic participants can accelerate learning, and how to responsibly integrate both into a modern research ecosystem.

This is a highly strategic role for someone who combines deep recruiting expertise with hands-on experience leveraging AI to solve complex operational and research challenges.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

You are a participant recruitment and panel management expert with a decade or more of experience building scalable recruiting capabilities; and a practitioner of emerging AI methodologies who has personally built agents, experimented with synthetic users, and can help determine how research organizations should evolve in an AI-driven future, especially in a highly regulated industry.

You are a strategic thinker who thrives in ambiguity, influences through expertise rather than authority, and enjoys helping organizations prepare for the future.

Preferred Experience and Skills Include:

  • 8-10 plus years of experience in participant recruitment, research operations, UX research, market research, or a related field
  • Deep expertise recruiting both B2C and B2B participants, including enterprise decision-makers and specialized audiences
  • Experience building, managing, and scaling participant panels, research communities, or participant databases
  • Proven success developing recruiting strategies that support qualitative and quantitative research at scale
  • Experience managing recruiting vendors, participant providers, and sourcing partnerships
  • Hands-on experience building, configuring, or deploying AI agents to automate workflows or improve operational efficiency
  • Experience creating, evaluating, or utilizing synthetic users, synthetic personas, or AI-generated participant models
  • Strong understanding of the opportunities and limitations of synthetic research methodologies
  • Experience developing frameworks for determining when human participants, synthetic participants, or hybrid approaches are most appropriate
  • Familiarity with research and recruiting platforms such as User Interviews, UserTesting, dscout, Respondent, Qualtrics, and similar tools
  • Strong communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working in highly regulated industries preferred

Note: Fidelity is not providing immigration sponsorship for this position.

The Team

We are a UX Research Operations team dedicated to enabling world-class research in a highly regulated industry. Our mission is to empower researchers with the participants, tools, processes, and support needed to generate meaningful insights and informed product decisions.

As AI continues to transform the research landscape, we are investing in the future of participant strategy. This role will help define how traditional participant recruitment, panel management, AI agents, and synthetic users work together to support high-quality research. You will partner closely with UX Research, Product, Technology, Legal, and Compliance teams to build innovative, responsible, and scalable approaches to participant engagement.

At Fidelity, we value curiosity, innovation, experimentation, and user-centered thinking. We are committed to exploring emerging technologies while maintaining the rigor, trust, and quality that underpin exceptional research.

title: Global Distribution Validation & Cold Chain Specialist
description:
Combine cold chain and validation expertise with digital innovation to strengthen global vaccine distribution

Do you have experience validating pharmaceutical transport solutions and ensuring GDP compliance? Can you turn temperature excursions and distribution challenges into lasting improvements? And are you interested in how data and digital tools can strengthen cold chain performance?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Global Distribution Validation & Cold Chain Specialist who combines strong technical and compliance expertise with a data-driven mindset. Your work will help ensure our vaccines are transported under the right conditions, while improving how we monitor performance, manage risks and make decisions.

The position can be based in Denmark or Switzerland, and travel is expected as part of the role.

Your role

You will develop, qualify and improve global transport and cold chain distribution solutions, ensuring compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP). As a subject matter expert, you will provide practical guidance on cold chain requirements, lead validation activities and support the resolution of distribution-related quality issues.

Working closely with Quality, Supply Chain, Digital, IT and external logistics partners, you will combine operational knowledge with data insights to strengthen distribution reliability. You will also contribute to new product introductions and new distribution lanes, ensuring that transport requirements, risks and qualification needs are addressed before implementation.

What you will do

Ensure transport validation and cold chain compliance

  • Develop, evaluate, optimize and implement global transport and cold chain distribution solutions that meet GDP requirements.
  • Plan and execute transport validation and qualification activities, including protocols, performance qualifications (PQs), reports, periodic reviews and risk assessments.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in cold chain distribution and support audits, inspections and assessments.
  • Support the qualification and ongoing assessment of logistics suppliers and transport solutions in collaboration with Quality and relevant stakeholders.
  • Contribute to new product introductions, new distribution lanes and other cross-functional initiatives by defining and addressing distribution and qualification requirements.

Own quality issues and drive improvements

  • Manage and assess temperature excursions in collaboration with Quality, using relevant stability data when required to support impact assessments.
  • Own deviations, change controls and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) related to distribution and cold chain activities.
  • Investigate root causes, coordinate actions across stakeholders and follow through on implementation and effectiveness.
  • Translate recurring issues and operational insights into improvements that strengthen cold chain performance and compliance.

Strengthen monitoring, analytics and digital capabilities

  • Drive the assessment and implementation of global systems for cold chain monitoring and data management.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs and analytics frameworks covering transport performance, temperature excursions and supplier performance.
  • Analyze data to identify trends and emerging risks and prepare actionable insights for management reviews and governance meetings.
  • Collaborate with Digital, IT, Quality and Supply Chain to implement and improve digital platforms, automate reporting and strengthen data quality.
  • Evaluate and support the implementation of AI-enabled solutions, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, digital simulation and connected monitoring technologies where they can improve distribution performance.
  • Support data governance, data integrity and validation requirements for GxP-relevant digital systems, including applicable AI-driven solutions.

What you bring

You bring a strong foundation in pharmaceutical cold chain distribution and validation, combined with the ability to use data and technology to improve how we work.

We are looking for someone with:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics or related discipline.
  • At least five years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical distribution, validation, cold chain management or a related regulated environment.
  • Strong knowledge of GMP/GDP guidelines and their practical application to transport and cold chain activities.
  • Hands-on experience with transport validation and qualification, including protocols, PQs, risk assessments and periodic reviews.
  • Experience assessing temperature excursions and managing deviations, change controls and CAPAs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical findings and data into practical actions.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar analytics tools, and familiarity with AI, predictive analytics or digital transformation initiatives.

Experience with logistics supplier qualification and distribution support for new product introductions is valuable. Knowledge of computerized systems, data integrity principles and validation of GxP-relevant digital solutions is an advantage.

How you work

You take ownership and follow issues through from investigation to resolution. You work systematically with documentation and risk assessments, while understanding the operational realities of global distribution.

You communicate technical and compliance requirements clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues and external partners. You are curious about new technologies and can assess how they can support reliable, compliant distribution in practice.

Why join Bavarian Nordic?

You will have the opportunity to influence how vaccines are transported globally, combining hands-on validation and quality responsibilities with the development of stronger monitoring and digital capabilities.

Your expertise will help prevent temperature-related risks, resolve distribution challenges and support new products and transport routes. At the same time, you will help shape how we use data to anticipate issues and continuously improve performance.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

Apply by clicking the ‘APPLY’ button. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your CV.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

For us, it is all about improving and saving lives

Improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do at Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of life-saving vaccines, and the largest pure-play vaccine company in the world.

Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

title: Senior Manufacturing and Industrial Base SME
description:
Position Title: Senior Manufacturing and Industrial Base SME

Clearance required: Top Secret clearance required

***THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON CONTRACT AWARD***

Who is ACT1 Federal? ACT1 Federal LLC is a 100% employee-owned company. We’ve served the Department of War (DoW) for nearly thirty years. Our core missions include weapon systems engineering, logistics, space domain expertise, global defense and security, business and financial management for security assistance and major defense articles, as well as military training and arctic security. Join us!

Description: ACT1 Federal is seeking an experienced Senior Manufacturing and Industrial Base SME to provide senior manufacturing, capacity, facility, tooling, workforce, quality, and industrial-base expertise to validate constraints and design executable interventions.

Responsibilities:

Manufacturing and Production Assessment:

  • Assess manufacturing processes, production flow, capacity, throughput, cycle time, work in process, yield, quality, equipment utilization, test capability, and schedule performance for assigned programs.
  • Identify and validate constraints involving material, labor, tooling, equipment, facilities, engineering, quality, test, planning, and lower-tier suppliers.
  • Evaluate current and planned production rates, surge potential, capacity-expansion proposals, recovery schedules, and readiness to meet Navy demand.
  • Apply manufacturing and operational judgment to distinguish symptoms from root causes and determine which constraints have the greatest effect on weapon-system deliveries.

Industrial Base and Supplier Analysis:

  • Analyze prime contractor and supplier capabilities, critical dependencies, sole-source exposure, long-lead materials, obsolescence, workforce limitations, and other sources of industrial fragility.
  • Assess how infrastructure, capital equipment, technology, qualification requirements, market conditions, demand stability, and supplier economics affect production performance.
  • Support supplier and production-site engagements, data reviews, interviews, and working sessions with program offices, industry, DCMA, and other authorized stakeholders.
  • Evaluate industry assertions, supplier recovery plans, investment requests, alternate-source strategies, and manufacturing-improvement proposals against available evidence.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, supplier development, workforce action, technology adoption, alternate sourcing, infrastructure modernization, or targeted investment.

Advisory and Implementation Support:

  • Serve as a senior manufacturing and industrial-base advisor to the BOND team for assigned PAE and weapon-system priorities.
  • Integrate manufacturing findings with supplier, schedule, cost, investment, engineering, acquisition, and program data to develop executable recommendations.
  • Develop recovery actions, implementation roadmaps, owners, milestones, performance measures, risk indicators, and escalation criteria.
  • Prepare and present executive briefings, industrial assessments, alternatives analyses, issue papers, site-visit findings, and decision memoranda to PAEs and senior DASN DIB leaders.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, operations management, supply chain, business, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years’ experience in defense manufacturing, production operations, industrial-base analysis, supplier management, engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing manufacturing capability, capacity, production flow, quality, schedule, and root causes of performance shortfalls.
  • Experience evaluating prime contractor or supplier operations and developing practical recovery, capacity, investment, or process-improvement recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing measures such as capacity, throughput, cycle time, work in process, yield, utilization, downtime, quality, and delivery performance.
  • Experience leading cross-functional analysis and communicating technical and operational findings to senior Government and industry leaders.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance required.
