title: Patient Education Consultant
description:
At Tactile Medical, we specialize in developing at-home therapy devices to treat lymphedema, chronic venous insufficiency and respiratory illnesses.

The Patient Education Consultant is responsible for conducting demonstrations and trainings with current and potential Tactile Medical patients on our products in their assigned area. This position will build strong rapport with the patient through introduction to our product, discussion of financial options and closing the sale to delivering the patient’s training and ensuring the patient is able to use their product as prescribed. Demonstrations are completed in-person with patients at a pre-determined location while trainings may be delivered in-person or via telehealth. Both patient facing interactions require documentation standards which vary based on the patient’s insurance as well as Tactile Medical’s requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Educate the patient and/or caregiver in all aspects of device use, including donning and doffing of garments, use of controller, following prescribed protocol and initiating a therapy session
  • Contact patients within service levels expectations to schedule and complete trainings and demonstrations
  • Responsible for direct sales to patients which includes providing a clear and thorough explanation of the patient’s financial responsibility for the product, insurance coverage and finalizing the sale
  • Provide clear verbal instruction while conducting the demonstration or training with patients and caregivers; modifying the interaction to their specific situation to ensure the training/demonstration approach meets the patient’s individual needs (utilize adaptive technique when needed)
  • Manage and respond appropriately to any patient feedback or objection, both positive and negative, regarding the product, their financial responsibility and required paperwork
  • Ensure appropriate preparation for all trainings and demonstrations including finalizing and confirming appointment details with the patient, ensuring that you have all equipment, supplies, documentation, and accessories necessary to effectively complete the training or demonstration
  • Review, complete and submit required paperwork with patient and answer questions
  • Work collaboratively with territory partners to facilitate completing of orders, which may include but not limited to collection of a signature on a prescription or other documents required for insurance requirements
  • Identify, escalate, and communicate problems, questions, or additional patient support needs to appropriate department for follow up
  • Effectively use translation tools for patients where English is not their first language
  • Meet or exceed established performance expectations
  • Maintain compliance with all appropriate regulatory requirements including HIPAA
  • Travel up to 80% within assigned territory
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of experience in a patient facing, education/training and/or highly advanced customer service role

Preferred:

  • Health related certification
  • Medical device or healthcare industry experience

Knowledge & Skills

  • Ability to lift 20 pounds on a regular basis
  • Ability to work remotely and travel to patients in a home, clinic or virtual environment
  • Able to provide clear written and verbal communication to patients, caregivers, field staff and internal teams
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills including the ability to empathize with patients and caregivers
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills in healthcare related situations
  • High degree of confidence and professionalism interacting with people of diverse cultures, ages, and abilities
  • Excellent organization and time management skills - proactive and efficient in scheduling and managing multiple appointments
  • Able to apply new information received via online learning modules, virtual or in-person interactions to enhance the patient experience
  • Skilled in teaching others
  • Ability to stay focused and organized to complete assigned tasks
  • Technology savvy to efficiently complete paperwork, update records and communicate progress
  • Ability to be self-directed and work independently to overachieve results

Our total compensation package includes medical, dental and vision benefits, retirement benefits, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off, parental leave, family medical leave, volunteer time off and additional leave programs, life insurance, disability coverage, and other life and work wellness benefits and discounts. description:

Make a difference every day with an organization dedicated to doing good and caring for others.
Compass Connections believes every child deserves to have a place where they feel safe and loved. Our organization offers emergency shelter and group home placement for children while we work to reunite them with family.
We know the sooner family reunification is accomplished, the sooner children can safely integrate into the community and thrive.
We are now hiring compassionate and dependable individuals to join our team at our facility in San Antonio, Texas.

ALL Benefits available on the first day of employment.

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, vision insurance

  • Retirement plan options

  • Additional employer sponsored benefits available

Ask your recruiter for a complete overview of the benefits available to you.

Language Requirement: Fluency in English and Spanish is required.

Work Schedule: Monday thru Friday 8am - 5pm; Travel is required for this role

Academic Requirement: Required – Doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in psychology, social work, counseling, marriage, and family therapy, or in other relevant behavioral science field in which clinical training and experience is a program requirement OR a master’s degree in a behavioral science field and five (5) years of full-time direct service delivery experience

Certifications: Current clinical license and LPC-S or licensure eligible, First aid, CPR, Emergency behavior intervention

Work Experience: Required – Three (3) years of supervisory experience or five (5) years in a related area with specific experience in working with community-based, residential, inpatient, or school based clinical treatment programs, in addition to the above. Experience developing and implementing trainings, applying recommendations from governing entities, and conducting training of clinical staff. A proven track record in working successfully with diverse populations

Critical Action Items & Measurable Deliverables:
1. Ensure all community relationships supporting partnerships are viable.
2. Provide oversight of data, evaluative tools, and survey information as necessary for the division.
3. Implementation and management of clinical and mental health service initiatives.
4. Ensure relevant program training remains updated according to local, state, and federal policy.
5. Ensure compliance dashboard reflects program critical action items.
6. Participate in scheduled meetings, in-service training and team decisions.
7. Work evenings, weekends and holidays as needed or requested by position supervisor.
8. Maintain Compass Connections professional and ethical standards of conduct outlined in Compass Connections employee handbook including demonstrating respect for agency staff, children, and community members and complying with required dress code at all times.
9. Meet all federal and state regulatory guidelines and standards that are applicable to this position.
10. Enhancement of supportive services for UAC with significant mental health issues, focused on the evaluation the efficacy of psychotropic medications.
11. Creation of additional tools necessary to identify and serve vulnerable populations.
12. Possess excellent interpersonal skills as well as organizational and planning skills.
13. Maintain confidentiality in all areas of child and program operations.
14. Maintain Compass Connections professional and ethical standards of conduct outlined in Compass Connections employee handbook including demonstrating respect for agency staff, children, and community members and complying with required dress code at all times.
15. All other duties as assigned.

Other Responsibilities:
1. Be available to travel with minimum notice for any period of time that the assignment warrants.
2. Be available for on call.
3. Ability to respond to common inquiries from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the professional community.
4. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.
5. Ability to communicate on an effective level with both clients and staff from a variety of disciplines.
6. Serve as a liaison between Compass Connections headquarters and programs as well as State and Federal partners as it relates to clinical and mental health services.
7. Ensure training is available to staff according to need.
8. Work irregular days/hours, including nights, holidays and weekends, depending on needs.
9. Communicate effectively in writing and verbally in English and Spanish.

Requirements:
1. Pass a pre-employment drug screen and random drug screens throughout employment.
2. Provide proof of work eligibility status upon request.
3. Pass a pre-employment and biennial criminal background checks.
4. Possess a valid driver’s license and have an excellent driving record.
5. Demonstrate the ability to:
a. Respond sensitively and competently to the service population’s cultural and socio-economic characteristics.
b. Work collaboratively with other staff members, service providers and professionals.
c. Provide crisis intervention according to training provided by Compass Connections when needed to maintain a safe environment.
d. Work in a fast-paced environment and maintain emotional control and professional composure at all times.
e. Maintain computer literacy required to meet the responsibilities of the position.
f. Work effectively and without intensive supervision both independently and as a member of a multidisciplinary team.
6. Demonstrate a working knowledge of all Compass Connections policies and procedures.
7. Must be licensed to practice mental health treatment and assessment (LCSW, LPC, LMFT, Licensed Psychologist).
8. Must possess clinical and mental health assessment and treatment skills with diverse populations of children/adolescents.
9. Must possess the ability to train staff in therapeutic processes, prepare reports and recommendations for clinical and mental health administrative use, and have the ability to work with youth in community-based programs, residential, day treatment or institutional settings.

title: Principal AI Solution Developer
description:
Donaldson is committed to solving the world’s most complex filtration challenges. Together, we make cool things. As an established technology and innovation leader, we are continuously evolving to meet the filtration needs of our changing world. Join a culture of collaboration and innovation that matters and a chance to learn, effect change, and make meaningful contributions at work and in communities. ​

Position Summary

The Principal AI Solutions Engineer is the most senior engineering role in Donaldson's AI Center of Excellence, a focused central team with enterprise-wide reach and a short path from idea to production. Reporting to the Director of Artificial Intelligence, you will build AI solutions and integrations into systems and processes across Donaldson's global manufacturing footprint, take them from prototype to production, and define the engineering standards every AI solution is built to. Qualified candidates must be able to work a hybrid schedule at our Bloomington, MN office.

Role Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical authority in the AI Center of Excellence for how AI solutions are designed and built, evaluating new models, frameworks, and tools and setting the direction the enterprise builds to.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and AI leads embedded across functions to identify high-value opportunities, redesigning existing processes with AI as a foundational element rather than a bolt-on.
  • Rapidly build and demonstrate working prototypes using large language models, agentic frameworks, and generative AI tools to validate ideas before full investment.
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI solutions from prototype through production, ensuring scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
  • Design and implement agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, tool-calling integrations, and context engineering strategies.
  • Define the reference architecture and engineering standards that both centrally built and business-built AI solutions are held to, covering prompt engineering, evaluation, monitoring, cost controls, and responsible AI guardrails.
  • Take on problems where the constraint is process and data maturity rather than model access, spanning supplier and customer communications, master data quality, and operational planning across a global manufacturing network.
  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data systems, APIs, and platforms such as cloud data services, collaboration platforms, and ERP and CRM systems to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Multiply impact through a federated delivery model, coaching business and IT teams who build their own AI solutions so their work meets enterprise standards for governance, security, and quality.
  • Mentor and upskill a central team of AI developers and program managers, along with colleagues across the business, fostering an AI-ready culture and working with IT, data, security, and compliance teams to meet enterprise standards.

Travel: Up to 10%

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience OR a high school diploma and 10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years building and deploying AI/ML or applied AI solutions in production environments.
  • Professional experience developing in Python with modern AI and agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent.
  • Professional experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, including multi-agent architectures and tool-calling integrations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building knowledge assistants or retrieval-augmented generation systems over enterprise documents and data, including evaluating and improving retrieval quality.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Foundry for AI solution delivery, and with Snowflake Cortex AI for applying models to governed enterprise data, along with MLOps and AI observability practices and model evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 and Power Platform AI capabilities, such as Copilot Studio and Power Automate, including governed environments that allow business teams to build and scale their own agents.
  • Experience integrating AI with enterprise manufacturing and supply chain systems, such as Oracle ERP, CRM platforms, and master data management tools.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with experience leading process redesign workshops with business teams and translating the outcomes into AI solution requirements.
  • Knowledge of responsible AI principles, prompt injection risks, data privacy, and large language model security practices in a governed enterprise environment.

Annual Salary Range: $111,840-$139,800. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to applicable work experience, training, education, performance.

This position is eligible for annual incentive plan based on performance and company growth.

title: Histology Supervisor (69676)
location: United Digestive Pathology Services - Alpharetta, GA 30022
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY OF DUTIES: The histology supervisor is a working histotechnician overseeing staffing, laboratory technical operations, workflow, quality assurance, and quality control programs.
REPORTS TO: Director, Pathology Services
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Duties may include but are not limited to:
  • Overall Lab Operations/Staff Supervision
  • Directs day-to-day lab operations including staffing, resources, access, throughput, reporting, and operational issues
  • Ensures lab is appropriately staffed during operational hours; manages staff overtime to lab needs
  • Ensures lab structure addresses changes in technology, operational processes, and lab needs
  • Supervises day-to-day laboratory workflow, quality control, and quality assurance programs; coaches and directs team members on quality and technical concerns; oversees team task assignment(s) to achieve daily case sign-out goals.
  • Directly supervises and evaluates full-time and PRN Histotechnicians and Grossing Technicians.
  • Performs all steps necessary relative to hiring, evaluating, coaching, promoting, disciplining & discharging employees by following established HR policies
  • Leads or participates in daily themed huddles focused on lab operations, efficiency, motivation, and highlighting metrics
  • Leads monthly 1-on-1s with each Histotechnician and Grossing Technician
  • Conducts/participates in regular staff meetings to keep staff informed of company policies and procedures.
  • Applies histotechnician skills and experience to daily work, functioning as a working floor-Manager and contributing to the overall productivity and quality of the lab.
  • Interact with physicians, patients, staff, visitors, and all customers via telephone conversations and in-person pleasantly and helpfully.
  • Abides by and promotes HIPAA compliance; maintains strictest confidentiality with regards to patient information.
  • Follows all CLIA Patient Safety Goals.
  • Quality Assurance/Quality Control
  • Performs daily check-ins with pathologists to discuss lab quality, workflow, and productivity
  • Researches and addresses concerns raised by internal physician partners; communicates resolution back to initiating provider and safeguards against future occurrence through process improvement and training
  • Facilitates positive working relationship between providers, lab leadership and team
  • Demonstrates timely response and effective communication in resolving issues and concerns
  • In collaboration with the Medical Director and Lab Leadership Team, develops and executes a comprehensive QA/QC Program
  • Provides leadership to staff to ensure quality patient care by utilizing the performance improvement model to correct quality issues
  • Implements and ensures Standard Work performed across all functional areas of the lab
  • Ensures each team member is assessed and provided feedback and training (as appropriate) through Quality Review process; maintains a master log of quality review scores for lab
  • Maintains established department policies, procedures, and objectives, including the areas of quality assurance, safety, environmental and infection control; leads annual review and approval process for policies and procedures
  • Ensures appropriate incident reporting for quality control concerns; works collaboratively with all relevant parties to resolve incidents and maintain appropriate documentation
  • Ensures adherence to quality assurance procedures such as quality control testing, instrument function checks, periodic maintenance; maintains appropriate records for these procedures
  • Ensures compliance standards are met as described by appropriate accrediting bodies such that accreditation is maintained without gaps
  • Manages CLIA and state inspections and ensures lab readiness for these
  • Develops and maintains appropriate protocols for equipment and staining to ensure high quality case materials for diagnostic purposes.
  • Provides leadership and oversight when developing new staining protocols, optimizing and validating new tests, and ensures appropriate controls handling.
  • Develops and revises policy and procedure manuals and maintenance logs to ensure compliance and accreditation readiness; reviews and signs off annually.
  • Designs and maintains Quality Review procedure for all staff. Works in collaboration with other leadership team members to assess staff quality through this review process.
  • Conducts regular quality review feedback sessions with pathologists to ensure high-quality case materials; resolves quality concerns expediently.
  • Oversees, tracks, and maintains staff quality metrics and ensures all staff members achieve appropriate quality thresholds.
  • Maintains established department policies, procedures, and objectives, including the areas of quality assurance, safety, environmental and infection control.
  • Leads safety training of all laboratory personnel, including maintaining appropriate documentation and protocols in conjunction with the office of quality and compliance.
  • Coordinates and participates, as needed, in proficiency testing.
  • Maintain and make minor adjustments and repairs to laboratory equipment such as microtomes, embedding machines, tissue processors, and slide and block printers.
  • Workflow & Operational Effectiveness
  • Provides leadership to staff to ensure laboratory operations and workflows are optimized and effective; manages and assigns workload/task responsibilities.
  • Oversees, tracks, and maintains staff productivity metrics and ensures appropriate production levels across all staff members.
  • Reviews workflow regularly to ensure the laboratory is actively engaged in continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate and/or facilitate continuous improvement activities for lab staff and leadership team.
  • Provides education, training, and support to team members focused on increased visibility of workflow process and procedures between laboratory workstations.
  • Performs all other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as directed.

REQUIRED EDUCATION, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:
High School diploma or GED; American Society of Clinical Pathologists registered histologic technician HT (ASCP) or histotechnologist HTL (ASCP), 5 years of experience as a histology technician, and 2-3 years of team or project management/oversight required. Demonstrated technical acumen required. Experience with quality control and assurance programs, regulatory and accreditation bodies preferred.
ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Histology Supervisor must have:
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, coach staff, and anticipate and address organizational needs, preferably across multiple shifts in a high-volume environment
  • Knowledge of biology, chemistry, histology, immunohistochemistry, immunology, mathematics, and basic computer use
  • Excellent organizational skills to cope with an extremely busy work schedule associated with wide variety of techniques which must be handled accurately and expeditiously
  • Independence in dealing with specimens and their proper handling
  • Ability to stay calm while working quickly and with a high degree of accuracy to meet the demands of the daily workload
  • Ability to sit for long periods, near vision for reading pathology diagnosis and reports
  • Ability to independently identify potential problems and troubleshoot problems as necessary
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to interact effectively with co-workers and department staff
  • Ability to work under general supervision
PHYSICAL/MENTAL/ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS
Requires sitting and standing associated with a normal laboratory environment. Ability to work 2nd and 3rd shift hours required.
DRUG FREE WORKPLACE
United Digestive is a drug free workplace. All offers of employment are contingent upon passing a pre-employment drug screening.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
United Digestive is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, color or national origin in its employment practices.

title: Osastonylilääkäri, Tyks akuuttipsykiatrian avohoito, Turku
description:
Haemme osastonylilääkäriäVARHA, Tykssairaalapalveluihin, psykiatrian tulosryhmän aikuispsykiatrian palveluihin, akuuttipsykiatrianvastuualueelle. Virkaan voidaan liittää akuuttipsykiatrian avohoidon vastuualuejohtajan tehtävä.Työskentelypaikka on vuonna 2024 avatussa KompassisairaalassaTurussa. Virka täytetään1.1.2027alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtäväsi

Osastonylilääkärinä toimit Tykspsykiatrian tulosryhmässä aikuisten akuuttipsykiatrian, neuromodulaation ja vanhuspsykiatrianpalveluissa.Vastuualueen erikoislääkärit edustavat akuuttipsykiatrian, yleissairaalapsykiatrian, vanhuspsykiatrian, neuromodulaatiohoitojen ja unilääketieteen erityisosaamista. Vastuualueella on yhteensä n. 112 työntekijää, ja oyl on suora lähiesihenkilö enintään 30 työntekijälle.

Osastonylilääkärinä suunnittelet päivystystoimintaa ja vastuualueen toimintaan sopivaa valmiutta yhdessä yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Päivittäistä yhteistyötä vastuualueelta tehdään akuutin HY7:n päivystyspalveluiden kanssa sekä yleissairaalapsykiatrialta ja vanhuspsykiatrialta somatiikan osastoille. Mielialahäiriöiden hoidon palvelut Tykspsykiatriallamuodostavat laajemman kokonaisuuden, johon pohjoismaiden suurin neuromodulaatioyksikkö kuuluu.

Osastonylilääkärinätoimit myös yhteistyössä palvelualuejohtajan, palvelualueylihoitajan ja vastuualueen osastonhoitajien kanssa ja osana psykiatrian tulosryhmän, palvelualueen ja vastuualueen johtamisrakenteita.

Akuuttipsykiatrian vastuualuejohtaja osallistuu palvelualueen sisällä mielialahäiriöiden hoitokokonaisuuden kustannustehokkuuden ja laadun parantamiseen. Perustason mielenterveyspalveluiden ja sosiaalihuollon kanssa tehdään aktiivista yhteistyötä mielenterveys- ja päihdepalveluiden sekä perhepalveluiden yhteensovittamiseksi.

Vastuualuejohtaja varmistaa vastuualueen tuotantosuunnitelman ja budjetintasapainontoteutumisen, koordinoi tilojen, henkilöstön ja muiden resurssien käytön tarkoituksenmukaisuutta,työhyvinvoinnin ja kustannustehokkuuden huomioiden. Hänkoordinoi oman vastuualueen muistutuksiin ja valituksiin vastaamista säädetyssä aikataulussaja huolehtii ja raportoi palvelualuejohtajalle vastuualueen palveluiden laadusta ja omavalvontaan liittyvistä asioista,sekä varmistaanäihin liittyväntietopohjankertymistä.Vastuualuejohtaja arvioi, seuraa ja kehittää vastuualueella hoidettavien potilaiden palvelupolkujen sujuvuuttaja potilaslähtöisyyttämuiden palveluntuottajien kanssa.

Varsinais-Suomen asukkaiden käytössä olevanVarha-sovelluksendigipoluttukevatosaltaan hoidon jatkumoa ja potilaan osallisuutta hoidossa.Uusi tietojärjestelmä ja tekoälyn soveltaminen yhdessä ajanvarausjärjestelmän kanssa tulevat tehostamaan toimintaa ja tuomaan lisää aikaa suoraan potilastyöhön, mutta edellyttävät hyvääyhteistyötä työntekijöiden kanssa muutoksen onnistumiseksi.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Toimimme uusissa, vuosi sitten käyttöön otetuissa tiloissa, ja loputkin toiminnot keskitetään pääosin samalle kampukselle vuonna 2029. Tämän mukana psykiatrian tilaratkaisut ja toimintamallit ovat uudistuneet.

Meillä pääset osaksi osaavaa yliopistosairaalan moniammatillista tiimiä, joka keskittyy psykiatriseen erityisosaamiseen ja psykiatristen hoitomenetelmien kehittämiseen. Osittainen etätyö on mahdollista(1pv viikossa).

Tarjoamme myös korkeatasoisen tutkimus- ja innovaatioympäristön ja mahdollisuuden omaan tutkimustyöhön. Tuemme osaamisen kehittämistä ja kiinnitämme huomiota työhyvinvointiin.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Työn menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää laajaakliinistäpsykiatrista osaamista,vahvaa päivystyskokemusta, näyttöäverkostokeskeisestä työskentelystäja johtamisestasekä erinomaisia yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työ edellyttää myös joustavuutta, muutosvalmiutta ja kehittämismyönteisyyttä. Tieteellinen työ, päihdelääketieteen pätevyys ja vahva kaksikielisyys katsotaan eduksi virkaan valittaessa.

Viran kelpoisuusvaatimuksen on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetussa laissa säädetty laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä ja erikoislääkärin pätevyys virkaan soveltuvalla erikoisalalla ja kokemusta erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä edellyttävistä tehtävistä sekä soveltuva johtamiskoulutus tai kokemusta hallinnollisista tehtävistä.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taito ja tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen ruotsin kielen taito. Koordinoimme Suomessa ruotsinkielisiäpsykiatrianpalveluitajayta-alue on vahvasti kaksikielinen, joten ruotsi on osittain myös työkieli.

Noudatamme maksimissaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme tulevaisuuden akuuttipsykiatriaa ja vaikuttamaan alueemme mielenterveyspalveluiden kehittämiseen osana yliopistosairaalan asiantuntevaa johtotiimiä.

title: DB Benefits Administrator-2
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The DB Benefits Administrator is primarily responsible for calculating defined benefit pension benefits accurately in accordance with applicable plan provisions, plan specifications, and established procedures. The role also supports the broader administration of defined benefit pension plans by maintaining participant and pension data, supporting pension payment and payroll administration, processing participant requests, and researching and responding to pension calculation-related questions received from the call center.

What You Will Do

  • Calculate defined benefit pension benefits accurately in accordance with applicable plan provisions, plan specifications, and established procedures.
  • Research and provide accurate responses to pension calculation-related questions received from the call center.
  • Review plan provisions and participant information required to complete benefit calculations.
  • Review, organize, and maintain plan and participant documentation to support efficient information retrieval.
  • Process and maintain participant records, payroll information, pension data, data queries, and plan-related documentation.
  • Perform data-processing activities related to defined benefit plan administration.
  • Use benefits administration applications to process participant requests within established service-level standards.
  • Support pension payment and payroll administration activities.
  • Coordinate fulfillment of participant letters and supporting documentation.
  • Collaborate with defined benefit associates on day-to-day pension administration activities.
  • Accurately record billable time to support correct client billing.
  • Deliver accurate and timely service to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes.
  • Follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Support special projects and additional defined benefit administration activities as assigned.
  • Pursue continued professional education, including taking and passing applicable professional examinations.
  • Call center responsibility does not include direct interaction with participants. Administrator only responds to internal call-center representatives, “provide guidance to call-center associates
  • Retirement (Early, Normal, Late, RMD), Death) QDRO & Disability.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
  • 1–2 years of work experience in defined benefit/pension calculations
  • Strong numerical, analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to calculation and data accuracy.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret plan provisions and apply plan specifications accurately.
  • Ability to use Microsoft Office or related software.
  • Effective planning, prioritization, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive client and participant information.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Previous experience with defined benefit plan or pension administration.
  • Experience calculating defined benefit pension benefits in accordance with plan provisions.
  • Experience researching and resolving pension calculation questions or discrepancies.
  • Experience supporting participant records, pension payroll, benefit calculations, or pension payments.
  • Relevant certification in U.S. employee benefits.
  • Having any U.S. Defined benefits certificate or professional examinations would be preferred; however, this is not mandatory.

title: Commercial Parts Pro

title: Shift Brewer
description:

Location: Brooklyn Center, MN

Status: Non-exempt
Direct Reports: None
This position will be eligible for our complete benefit package (medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO, etc)

  • A BA or BS degree and or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Formal Brewing Education.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • None
WORKING CONDITIONS
  • This position operates around a rotating shift schedule that will require long hours and evening/weekend work. Participation at relevant brewery and other company events is assumed.

title: Subject Matter Expert (Independent Contractor) - Human Performance & Performance Analytics (Remote)
description:
NWHSU is seeking an experienced and visionary Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Human Performance, Sport Science, and Performance Data Analytics to collaborate in the development of an innovative graduate-level academic program: the Master of Health (MHS) Science in Human Performance.

The Master of Health Science in Human Performance prepares graduates to support performance, readiness, and recovery through interdisciplinary, evidence-informed approaches. The curriculum integrates sport science theory, needs analysis, assessment and monitoring, and performance data interpretation to prepare graduates for careers in sport, clinical, and applied human performance settings.

Position Information:

The SME will provide consultation and leadership in the design and development of the program in collaboration with the internal experts, faculty, instructional designers, and other internal/external stakeholders. They will be responsible for creating curriculum for the data analytics specialization in the MHS in Human Performance.

  • Build upon and refine current curriculum strategy, mapping, and degree framework
  • Identify, refine, and develop courses and content
  • Advise on industry trends, competencies, and workforce alignment
  • Support & advise Prior Learning Assessment (PLA) processes and mapping
  • Support & advise on certifications and credentialing pathways aligned with career outcomes
  • Recommend instructional materials, assessments, and delivery methodologies
  • Ensure academic rigor, industry relevance, and applied learning integration
  • Participate in scheduled planning meetings and curriculum reviews
  • Identify and connect additional SMEs or industry partners as needed
  • Support development of quality pathways, partnerships, and experiential opportunities

This is a non-benefits eligible, independent contractor agreement.

Requirements:

  • Advanced degree in Exercise Science, Human Performance, Sport Science, Kinesiology, Biomechanics, Data Analytics, Strength & Conditioning, Physical Therapy, Chiropractic, or related field
  • Experience working in collegiate athletics, professional sports, tactical performance, clinical performance, or applied sport science environments
  • Expertise in athlete monitoring systems, wearable technologies, performance testing, and/or performance analytics platforms
  • Competency and expert in data analytics, particularly in how it relates to human performance
  • Experience in higher education curriculum development, preferred
  • Strong understanding of current industry demands and emerging technologies
  • Ability to collaborate across interdisciplinary teams

Targeted Professional Backgrounds:

We welcome candidates with experience and degrees to support their expertise in areas such as:

  • Athletic Training
  • Applied Performance Specialist
  • Chripractic
  • Clinical Performance Specialist
  • Exercise Physiologist
  • Human Performance Director
  • Performance Data Analyst
  • Physical Therapy
  • Researcher or Faculty in Human Performance or Sport Science
  • Sport Science
  • Strength & Conditioning Coach

The ideal candidate brings both academic and industry experience and understands how to bridge science, technology, and real-world application into a rigorous and market-relevant graduate curriculum rooted in human performance data analytics.

Compensation: $4,500 per class

NWHSU Overview:

Founded in 1941, NWHSU is a progressive institution educating the next generation of health care professionals. While the institution's history is rooted in the chiropractic profession, NWHSU now focuses more broadly on integrative care, health, and wellness. In addition to our Doctor of Chiropractic, we offer a Doctor of Acupuncture with a specialization in Chinese Herbal Medicine, Masters' offerings in Acupuncture, Chinese Medicine, Functional and Integrative Nutrition, and Integrative Care, and undergraduate offerings in massage therapy, health sciences, and allied health professions - medical laboratory science, medical laboratory technology, radiation therapy, and radiologic technology. We are a mission- and vision-driven university and intend to be a leader in creating integrative care solutions.

How to Apply:

Complete our online application and attach your CV/resume, and a brief summary of your experience in human performance and performance analytics.

If you have any questions submitting your materials, please contact talent@nwhealth.edu.

Overview:

The incumbent in this position will perform research on transient multiphase flow and heat transfer with applications in (i) geothermal engineering (construction and/or extraction thermal-hydraulics) and (ii) carbon management, including CO2 transport, injection, and well control. The position will also conduct CO2 atmospheric dispersion modeling for safety and risk-related studies and will develop and apply computational tools - including physics-based and data-informed digital twin models - for multi-energy applications. The position will also support PHMSA-related research on shrouding effects on pressurized liquefied natural gas (LNG) releases and pipeline leak detection using aerial distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS). Responsibilities include developing and validating models and simulation workflows, writing technical reports and peer-reviewed publications, presenting results, and supporting experimental facility development under faculty supervision.

title: Educational Consultant- Per Diem (Math & Literacy, K-8 Generalist) - New York State
description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

*This is not a remote role.

*This is a heavy-travel role with local and national coverage. We're looking for a candidate who is willing to drive within the state and lives near a major airport — Buffalo, Syracuse, Rochester, Albany, or Long Island.

Educational Consultant – Per Diem - New York State

Are you a retired educator or educator transitioning out of the classroom? This is an excellent opportunity to join a mission-driven company focused on creating equitable classrooms for students, and still be part of a school community! Curriculum Associates is seeking a temporary, part-time Professional Learning Educational Consultant with a background in teaching, coaching teachers, delivering professional development and support, analyzing data, and working with school leaders. Working closely with the Manager of Professional Learning, sales team, and other Curriculum Associates professionals, the Educational Consultant will be responsible for facilitating high-quality professional development, training, support, data analysis, and communicating consultatively with schoolteachers and leaders.

Benefits: Company-provided laptop. Ability to keep all travel points for flights and hotels booked for work-related travel. Mileage reimbursement may be available for applicable travel.

Hours: Per Diem consultants are scheduled on an as-needed basis, paid hourly. Schedule is highly dependent on customer demand – professional development is usually scheduled with partners during normal school hours. Our peak times of the year include August through October and then again January and February, although we deliver professional development throughout the school year.

Given the as-needed and heavily seasonal nature of this role, we do not recommend that you maintain a full-time role that operates during school hours, simultaneous with the Per Diem Educational Consultant role at Curriculum Associates.

We provide compensation for PD delivery, internal training, travel time, and travel expenses.

Location: This position is based on NY state, with candidates based near major regional airports preferred: including Buffalo (BUF), Syracuse (SYR), Albany (ALB) and the Long Island/NYC metro area (ISP/JFK/LGA). Travel outside these zones will be required to support statewide and national Professional Learning demand.

Travel: Travel up to 80% is required and considered an essential function of the job for all educator-facing positions. Travel includes overnight stays at hotels and transportation via car, plane, and/or public transportation.

Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, ranging from $30/hour-$65/hour, depending on the type of work you will be assigned to complete (e.g. “at-home” work versus “away from home” work, such as working directly with educators). Ability to keep all travel points for flights and hotels booked for work-related travel. Mileage reimbursement may be available for applicable travel. Company-provided laptop.

Start Date: ASAP

The impact you'll have:

  • Become an expert on the company’s online diagnostic and instruction program and Common Core product, focusing on grades K–8
  • Serve teachers in the classroom by coordinating on-site product training and professional development courses for teachers and school administrators. Adjust professional development workshops within specified parameters to fit the needs of the participants
  • Help to ensure equity in the classroom by delivering professional development courses to teachers, coaches, and leaders on how to effectively implement Ready and i-Ready to impact classroom learning
  • Meet teachers where they are and provide tailored on-site support to teachers, coaches, and leaders. This may range from providing lesson planning and pacing support, to helping educators analyze data and apply it to instruction, to working with leaders to identify evidence of implementation successes and challenges
  • Engage in internal cycle of professional improvement and development (including being observed, receiving feedback, and being coached)
  • Track and submit detailed training notes, as well as complete all assignments in a timely manner
  • Present a professional image at all times to customers and prospects

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 2+ years of experience in teaching, coaching teachers, and providing professional development. To best serve our educators and students, we would love to see experience teaching at the secondary (6–12) level
  • Strong working knowledge of the Common Core State Standards, Grades K–8 (or comparable state standards), including both the content standards and the practice standards
  • Fluency with using digital tools including online assessments, and a high level of comfort discussing and applying data with teachers and leaders
  • Understand principles of adult learning and how to apply them to professional development to ensure participants meet learning objectives
  • Excellent facilitation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Exceptional time management skills: ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize appropriately. Proven organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Excellent computer and internet skills including knowledge of Office programs (Outlook, Word, PPT, etc.); knowledge of online meeting programs (e.g. Zoom/WebEx) a plus
  • Ability to work independently and as part of an educational cohort
  • Bilingual Preferred

title: Application Security Engineer, Information Security
description:
Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.

Section 1: Position Summary

Reporting to the BISO, the Application Security Engineer is responsible for the application security program. This position requires a passion for data protection, possesses a combination of either application development and/or security experience, strong communication and organizational skills, collaborative abilities, self-motivation, innovation, efficiency and attention to detail. This position will perform a variety of application security responsibilities across Ascensus and be the primary resource for our application security program. This role serves as a trusted application security advisor to Ascensus scrum teams to drive best practices for application security, to help ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of our web and application program interfaces (API). The Application Security Engineer is deeply involved with our application scrum teams and is instrumental in helping define the strategy to meet the information security organizations high level goals, while still being embedded within the scrum team processes and serve as a subject matter expert in secure development practices. This is a critical role at Ascensus requiring strategic thinking, taking initiative, and proactive interaction at many levels. This role will receive strong support of the Head of Technology and the Information Security Leadership, to effectively execute on defined organizational goals and strategic plans.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
  • Our I-Client service philosophy and our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always® should be visible in your actions on a day to day basis showing your support of our organization
  • In conjunction with security and development leadership develops a comprehensive, agile, and innovative DevSecOps approach that supports all phases of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), identifies and effectively manage risk.
  • Provide security consultation to scrum teams, application owners, and technology teams on relevant security controls and secure SDLC process
  • Participate in sprint planning meetings and various decision-making sessions to ensure that security requirements and considerations are built into the development practices
  • Conduct application security analysis, including architecture review, analysis of data flows, penetration testing support, and threat modeling
  • Build and monitor compliance with application security policies, coding standards, and security controls in support of mitigating threats
  • Responsible for the deployment and integration of services to support SAST, DAST and SCA functions. Assist development teams in performance of static and dynamic testing, triage findings and provide remediation guidance where necessary
  • Assist with other tasks and projects as assigned

Supervision

  • N/A

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

Secure Software Development

  • A minimum of 7 years’ experience in Secure Software Development and/or DevSecOps (preferred)
  • Ability to define software security and privacy requirements
  • Solid understanding of threat modeling, risk, and mitigation from internal and external threats
  • Experience with development of system security architecture diagrams and security architecture specification per security architecture standards
  • Experience performing software security design reviews
  • Experience running security testing tools into a CI/CD pipeline including tools such as Static and Dynamic Application Security
  • Testing (SAST/DAST) and Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
  • Experience with application testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Fiddler, Zap, Wireshark, Metasploit)
  • Experience with configuration WAF, API Gateway, API Security Tools
  • Solid understanding of the most common application and API security risks (OWASP Top 10, SANS/CWE Top 25)
  • Solid understanding of application, database and network vulnerability testing principles
  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft Security Development Lifecycle (SDL), OWASP Software Assurance Maturity Model (SAMM), or Building Security in Maturity Model (BSIMM)
  • Experience with assessing secure adoption of third-party components such as open source or commercial software
  • .NET/Java Experience a plus

Information Security

  • Understanding of information security frameworks such as ISO27001, NIST, CSA and operating in a environment regulated against FFIEC, SEC and/or HIPAA requirements
  • Solid understanding f authentication and authorization systems
  • Solid understanding of cryptographic standards(e.g., encryption, hashing, key management, digital signatures, etc.)
  • Ability to provide vulnerability remediation guidance and mentoring to product development software engineers
  • Ability to translate security risks to business impact
  • Experience running or managing vulnerability assessments using automated tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, etc) as well as managing penetration testing engagements.
  • Understanding of privacy regulations as it relates to the handling and protection of information.
  • Experience with fraud detection and analysis as it relates to custom developed applications

DevSecOps

  • Experience integrating automated testing tools into a CI/CD pipeline
  • Experience in implementing Cloud security controls following owing Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) or Cloud Service Provider (CSP) best practices (Azure, AWS, etc.)
  • Experience implementing and supporting security automation tools (e.g., K8 and CSP platform configuration, hardening, and monitoring).

title: Assistant Director of Operations
description:
The Opportunity

The College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (CALS) Office of Pre-Award Services (OPAS) seeks an experienced and collaborative Assistant Director to lead a team of pre-award professionals and oversee the delivery of high-quality research administration services. This position provides leadership from proposal development through submission, serves as a Grants and Contracts Officer (GCO), and works closely with faculty, staff, college leadership, and the Office of Sponsored Programs (OSP) to support the successful pursuit of external research funding.

The Assistant Director supervises and manages grant coordinator staff, oversees workflow and proposal coverage, and ensures the effective and timely delivery of pre-award support services with a strong emphasis on customer service. The position partners with the OPAS Director and CALS leadership to translate strategic priorities into effective team practices, policies, procedures, and operational efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and supervise the OPAS grant coordinator team, including managing workflow, triaging proposal coverage, onboarding and training staff, and supporting professional development.

  • Oversee pre-award operations and services, identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies, and customer service in partnership with the OPAS Director and CALS leadership.

  • Serve as a Grants and Contracts Officer (GCO) for assigned CALS departments, providing guidance to faculty, staff, and students throughout proposal development and submission.

  • Review and approve proposals and budgets for compliance with university, federal, state, and sponsor-specific requirements, exercising signature authority for designated sponsors.

  • Collaborate across CALS and OSP with faculty, administrative managers, the Grant Proposal Team, and research administration colleagues to ensure timely, accurate, and effective proposal submissions.

  • Serve as an alternate CALS GCO, providing backup coverage and ensuring continuity of pre-award services as needed.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week) Contract College position based in Ithaca, NY. This position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement, with either a 2:3 or 3:2 campus-to-home schedule. The 3:2 arrangement is available for employees who prefer an individual workspace on campus. The hybrid work arrangement will be mutually agreed upon and is subject to change at any time. Work hours are 8:00am-4:30pm Monday through Friday, with flexibility to work up to 5pm as needed to meet deadlines. Final salary will be commensurate with experience.

About the CALS Office of Pre-Award Services

The CALS Office of Pre-Award Services (OPAS) assists in the execution of over 1,300 proposals and applications annually which reflect the superior quality and robust competitiveness of Cornell University research. OPAS’ mission is to:

Provide pre-award support to principal investigators and supported departments and colleges during the proposal development process from concept to submission. Build proposal budgets in a format which communicates the costs associated with a project in a clear and uncomplicated manner which address the considerations of post-award accounting practices and policies. Understand and communicate sponsor, university, college, and department procedures and policies. Work closely with colleagues at the Cornell Office of Pre-Award Services through the pre-award process; as stewards of initial and revised pre-award budgets, documentation, and correspondence. Promote proposal award success within CALS and supported departments and colleges.

What We Need

We are seeking a team member with prior supervisory experience, signature and transaction authority, and familiarity with sponsored research. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who works independently, demonstrates sound judgment, and can effectively manage responsibilities with minimal oversight. Additionally, you will have:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree with 3 – 5 years of progressively responsible experience with sponsored research administration, including research proposals and budget preparation, proposal submission systems or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience effectively supervising, managing, and leading staff and fostering a spirit of collegiality and teamwork.

  • Excellent computer skills, exceptional customer service skills, strong oral and written communication skills as well as organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience handling confidential materials and sensitive information with the utmost tact and discretion. Establishing appropriate individual priorities and demonstrating initiative and self-direction to follow through on all areas of responsibility and functioning as part of the team are required.

  • Demonstrated a positive and professional attitude with a commitment to continuous growth and learning.

  • The ability to function effectively under pressure, demonstrating sound judgment while ensuring critical deadlines are met, and adherence to university policies and procedures are upheld.

  • Experience working in an environment where change in process/procedures is common. Position requires meeting critical deadlines which will occasionally necessitate evening and weekend work.

  • Completed Cornell University Supervisory Development Training within one year of hire into the position. Recommendations: Turning Point and Harold Craft.

  • Compliance with all Cornell University and job-related training requirements.

If you possess these experiences and skills this may be the role for you! There are a few other qualifications we would view as incredibly helpful in this role, to include:

  • Three years of progressively complex experience in central administrative offices at department, college or university level.

  • Must have experience with research proposal and budget preparation, proposal submission systems, i.e. Fastlane, Grants.gov, Commons.

  • Familiarity with scientific and legal terms is preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively lead a team.

A cover letter and resume are required for consideration for this position.

Rewards and Benefits

  • This position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement. Employees typically perform this role
    remotely 3 days per week and on-campus 2 days per week or remotely 2 days per week and on-campus 3 days per week. The university reserves the right to modify, suspend, revoke or terminate the hybrid work arrangement at any time.

  • This position is based in Ithaca, New York. Employees who work remotely may receive
    multiple W-2 Forms depending on their work location. The New York Convenience of employer guidelines require New York State individual tax reporting and withholding for this position. Additional individual state income tax filings may also be required if working temporarily outside of New York State.

  • Cornell receives national recognition as an award-winning workplace for our health, wellbeing, sustainability, and diversity initiatives.

  • Our benefits programs include comprehensive health care options, generous retirement contributions, access to wellness programs, and employee discounts with local and national retail brands. We invite you to follow this link to get more information about our benefits: Understand Your Benefits | Working at Cornell.

  • Our leave provisions include health and personal leave, three weeks of vacation and 13 holidays: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, and an end of the year winter break from December 25-January 1. To offer greater flexibility for observing faiths and traditions we also offer two additional floating holidays. Learn more about our generous leave provisions: Holiday and Accrued Time Off | Working at Cornell

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
Role Overview

QuEra is standing up a new AI Engineering team to help every group in the company put AI to work. We are hiring senior founding engineers to set its bar. In this role, you will turn the highest-value ideas from our company-wide AI workshop into real, deployable tools, and build LLM- and agent-powered software that makes our slow, expensive, and expertise-gated steps faster, cheaper, and more accessible — from machine build and bringup to everyday engineering.

This senior, high-autonomy role is designed specifically for someone at the top of their craft. You will own projects end to end, set the technical patterns the team builds on, and raise the bar for how AI software is built across QuEra. You bring deep, modern AI application-engineering expertise that complements our in-house physics, controls, and hardware strength — and you help us build that talent quickly. A background in quantum computing is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and ship internal AI tools and features end to end — from a rough idea to a deployed and maintained product.
  • Set the technical direction and reusable patterns the AI Engineering team builds on and raise the engineering bar across the company by example.
  • Design and deploy LLM and agentic systems — retrieval, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation — with sensible guardrails and humans in charge where it matters.
  • Partner with engineering, hardware, operations, and other teams to turn their ideas into working tools they can own.
  • Create shared components, templates, and infrastructure that let other teams build faster.
  • Right-size models and optimize for cost, latency, and reliability; instrument usage and quality.
  • Mentor teammates and help grow the group’s talent fast; model strong engineering practice — clear specs, real documentation, tests, and honest estimates.
  • Drive work to completion independently — and, when needed, make the call to stop the work early and cleanly.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep software-engineering expertise and a strong track record of shipping and operating production software at scale (primarily Python), with excellent testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation habits.
  • Substantial hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications: prompt and agent design, tool/function calling and MCP-based integrations, retrieval-augmented generation, and rigorous evaluation.
  • Proven work with agentic systems and agentic coding workflows — designing or integrating agents that take actions against real systems safely.
  • Architectural judgment: able to design systems others build on, and deliver end to end across backend services, APIs, light front-end, and deployment.
  • High autonomy and ownership — thrives in ambiguity and reliably carries a project from idea to production with little oversight.
  • A demonstrated record of impact you can point to. Publications and notable open-source or research contributions count, but we weigh shipped software and fast, real-world delivery over research output.
  • A force multiplier for those around you: clear communicator, natural mentor, and able to translate a non-expert’s need into a working tool.

Preferred Qualifications

  • LLMOps / MLOps: model serving, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency optimization (right-sizing models).
  • Data and ML engineering: pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases; fine-tuning or adapting models.
  • Deep-learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and experience building or adapting generative models such as diffusion or image generation — useful if the team takes on more model-building work over time.
  • Front-end / UX for internal tools (e.g., React / TypeScript).
  • Experience with modern coding agents and the broader agent-tooling ecosystem.
  • Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD tooling.
  • Exposure to scientific, hardware, lab-automation, or other complex operational environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • You ship useful tools into production quickly, and teams actually adopt them.
  • The components you build get reused by others, rather than becoming one-offs.
  • Your work is well-documented, tested, and dependable.
  • You operate independently and reliably move projects to done — or to a clean stop.

The approximate base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $210,000.

We consistently monitor external market data and update base salary ranges accordingly. We determine base compensation decisions on several factors, including as geographic placement, role-specific knowledge, skills, and/or experience. In addition to our base salary offerings, we also provide equity grants for all new hires.

QuEra is committed to cultivating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We highly value diversity in our current and future employees and do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Precision Medicine Executive - Mid Atlantic
description:
Who We Are:

Cogent Biosciences is a publicly traded biotechnology company focused on developing novel precision therapies to treat a broad range of patients with unmet medical needs. Cogent’s lead program, bezuclastinib, is designed to selectively and potently inhibit exon 17 mutations found within the KIT receptor tyrosine kinase, including KIT D816V. KIT D816V is responsible for driving a rare and serious condition called Systemic Mastocytosis, and exon 17 mutations are also found in patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST), a type of cancer with strong dependence on oncogenic KIT signaling. Bezuclastinib has exhibited promising initial data across all three trials: APEX in AdvSM, SUMMIT in NonAdvSM and PEAK in GIST, including an encouraging safety profile across 600+ patients in single agent and combination dosing.

The Role:

The Precision Medicine Executive (PME) will serve as a critical member of the Customer Engagement Team and will have an exciting opportunity within Cogent’s Precision Medicine organization as we prepare for our first product launch. The Precision Medicine Executive (PME) is charged with embedding Cogent within some of the most influential healthcare systems across the United States. The Cogent PME role is best described as a hybrid Regional Diagnostic Expert and Thought Leader Liaison (TLL). Cogent PMEs are responsible for regional diagnostic expertise/ initiatives and KOL management.

The Precision Medicine Executive must possess a high level of clinical and customer knowledge. They must have experience with both field and headquarters protocols/procedures. Additionally, they should have experience engaging healthcare professionals to build educational platforms that inform the execution of current and future brand/disease-state strategies.

The PMEs will work closely with national and regional Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to ensure Cogent’s cross-functional commercial strategy is understood and resourced appropriately. In addition to Customer Engagement and Commercial Learning & Development personnel, the PME will work in close collaboration with field and home office-based stakeholders in Marketing, Commercial Operations & Analytics, Market Access & Trade, Medical Science/Affairs, and Legal & Compliance, among others.

Behaviors that are critical for success in this role are collaboration, communication, planning, relationship building, and the ability to execute tactical initiatives and provide timely feedback. PMEs will report to the ED, National Precision Medicine Executives.

Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with multiple Cogent stakeholders inside and outside the commercial organization to ensure strategic alignment and execution of key strategies/tactics to advance overall business objectives.
  • Partner with external HCP stakeholders at key healthcare systems/Labs across the US to ensure seamless access/availability to Cogent treatments post-FDA approval.
  • Identify, profile, cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with KOLs.
  • Plan and execute KOL engagements and executive encounters at local, regional, and national conferences; POAs; field visits, and other venues in a compliant manner.
  • Identify and prioritize novel programming, venues, etc. where Cogent should invest to advance overall business objectives.
  • Develop and foster an environment where the overall patient, caregiver, and HCP customer experience are prioritized.
  • Become embedded in target healthcare systems by differentiating themselves from competitors through delivering consistent value.
  • Adapt quickly to needs/adjustments necessitated by launch preparations and contribute to supporting both corporate and field-based colleagues in navigating a dynamic and evolving market to achieve and exceed expected results in a complex specialty environment.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to execute / pull-through business plans and serve as a critical member of the Customer Engagement team.
  • Develop and maintain all account/contact details within CRM.
  • Ensure budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
  • Incorporate all appropriate regulatory and legal compliance into daily activities and business practices.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS or healthcare equivalent degree required.
  • Minimum 8+ years of previous pharmaceutical, biotech, and/or medical experience with a strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical marketplace and deep understanding of industry and broader trends in the healthcare landscape.
  • Minimum of 5+ years combined experience in specialty and/or rare disease (Hematology/Oncology preferred)
  • Proven ability to access and influence C/D-Suite level customers.
  • Collaborative and organizationally savvy team player with a history of success in a matrixed setting.
  • Strong negotiation, partnering, and influencing skills; demonstrated ability to effectively manage business relationships with external strategic partners.
  • Prior experience working in large accounts and/or hospitals required. Expert at navigating complexities and removing barriers to advance corporate objectives in service of patients, caregivers, and HCPs.
  • Successful product launch experience required.
  • Prior pharma/biotech start-up experience preferred.
  • Prior Diagnostic/Precision medicine experience preferred.
  • Technologically savvy and committed to leveraging data and advanced analytics daily to drive business results.
  • Ability to travel on a frequent overnight basis, with occasional weekend travel, depending on business needs.

Salary Range:

$245,000 to $285,000 USD

Target Bonus: 20%
Exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, and location.
Our Locations

Waltham, MA: Our headquarters is located in the Greater Boston life sciences community, with an open, collaborative office environment designed to support teamwork and connection. Employees benefit from convenient on-site amenities, including free on-site parking and gym facilities in the building.

Boulder, CO: Our Boulder location is home to Cogent’s discovery research organization and a key scientific hub with strong leadership based on site. Situated in the greater Denver-Boulder biopharmaceutical corridor, this office plays a central role in advancing our discovery efforts and pipeline.

Our Offer To You

At Cogent Biosciences, we offer a competitive salary, bonus, and ongoing stock awards, alongside a benefits package that sets us apart. We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family, and help reduce out-of-pocket costs by funding up to 75% of in-network deductibles. Our benefits also include a 401(k) match with immediate vesting, generous paid time off, 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, paid family and medical leave for all employees regardless of location, and company-paid short-term disability coverage for up to 20 weeks. Additional perks like wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and inclusive family-forming support help you thrive at work and beyond.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our goal is to have a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, age, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or disability, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Reporting Actuary
description:
Are you looking for a role where actuarial reporting goes beyond delivering numbers?

If you enjoy understanding the story behind actuarial results, challenging assumptions, improving processes and influencing decision-making, this role will give you the opportunity to work at the heart of NN Spain’s reporting and financial performance framework.
You will play a key role in the evolution of our IFRS 17 and Solvency II reporting landscape, helping ensure that actuarial information is robust, transparent and meaningful for Finance, Risk, auditors and senior management. At the same time, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to automation initiatives, enhance reporting processes and strengthen actuarial capabilities across the business.

What this role offers

High visibility and business impact Your analyses and reporting will support key business decisions, helping stakeholders understand financial performance, risks and future opportunities.
Exposure to IFRS 17 and Solvency II You'll work across two of the most relevant actuarial frameworks in the industry, developing expertise that is highly valued across the market.
Continuous improvement and innovation You'll have the opportunity to streamline processes, reduce manual activities and leverage automation tools to increase efficiency and control.
International environment You will collaborate with different functions across Finance, Risk, Actuarial and the wider NN Group, expanding both your technical and business perspective.
Flexible and people-focused culture Remote working, flexible hours, learning opportunities and a strong wellbeing culture allow you to grow professionally while maintaining balance in your personal life.

Questions candidates often ask

"Do I need experience in both IFRS 17 and Solvency II?"
Not necessarily. IFRS 17 is currently a strategic priority for the team and experience in this area is highly valued. However, strong Solvency II experience combined with reporting, valuation and analytical expertise can also be a great fit.
"Is this role focused only on reporting?"
No. Beyond reporting, you will contribute to process improvements, automation initiatives, model governance, audits, forecasting activities and business decision support.
"Will I have opportunities to influence change?"
Absolutely. We are looking for someone who enjoys challenging the status quo, improving processes and helping the team evolve its reporting capabilities.

What will help you succeed in this role

  • A degree in Actuarial Science or a related quantitative discipline, providing the technical foundations needed to understand complex actuarial and financial concepts.
  • At least 4 years of experience in actuarial reporting, valuation, financial reporting or risk reporting within the insurance industry, allowing you to navigate reporting cycles confidently and contribute from day one.
  • Experience with IFRS 17 reporting, including areas such as BEL, Risk Adjustment, CSM, Analysis of Movements, experience variances and operating result analysis. This will help you quickly add value in one of the team's key strategic priorities.
  • Knowledge of Solvency II reporting, including Technical Provisions, Own Funds, OCG, SCR or ORSA, which will strengthen your ability to operate across regulatory and financial frameworks.
  • Experience with R3S, Prophet or similar actuarial modelling platforms, helping you analyze, validate and interpret actuarial outputs effectively.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling you to investigate movements, identify drivers and communicate conclusions clearly.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken, since you will regularly interact with international stakeholders across NN Group.
  • Knowledge of VBA, SQL, Python, R, Power BI or automation tools is highly valued, as we are committed to increasing efficiency and simplifying reporting processes.
  • Curiosity and a mindset of continuous improvement, helping you identify opportunities to improve controls, reduce complexity and enhance reporting quality.

Your mission

Your mission will be to ensure the delivery of accurate, transparent and well-controlled actuarial reporting across IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks, while continuously improving processes, strengthening governance and supporting informed business decisions that contribute to NN Spain’s financial performance and strategic objectives.

What will you do?

  • Perform IFRS 17 and Solvency II reporting activities, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of actuarial results.
  • Analyze and explain movements in liabilities, technical provisions and operating results, translating complex actuarial outputs into meaningful business insights.
  • Review assumptions, methodologies, models, controls and data quality to ensure robust and reliable reporting.
  • Support audits, business planning, forecasting, model validation and governance activities, contributing actuarial expertise across the organisation.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives, reducing manual processes and enhancing operational efficiency.

Ready to help shape the future of actuarial reporting?

If you're looking for a role where technical excellence, business impact and continuous improvement come together, this is an opportunity to join a team that is actively shaping the future of actuarial reporting at NN Spain. We would love to learn more about you.

If you think that your profile can fit with us and you like who we are, do not hesitate to sign in to our offers. We are waiting for you!

We are proud to be an inclusive organization and we offer equal opportunities, regardless of race, cultural background, gender, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, marital status, and sexual orientation. One of our core values is taking care of our employees so they can give their best within a respectful environment.
