title: Regional IT Business Partner - Europe
description:
We’re looking for motivated, engaged people to help make everyone’s journeys better.

The Regional IT Business Partner supports and executes gategroup’s IT business strategy within the assigned region. Acting as the primary link between business functions and IT, the role ensures that IT services and solutions effectively meet business needs and align with global standards.

The position partners with business leaders and key stakeholders to identify opportunities, define and prioritize initiatives, and guide the local investment and planning process. Through strong collaboration and strategic alignment, the role enables the business to achieve its objectives and drive value through the effective use of technology.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

IT Strategy and Roadmap Deployment
Implement agreed IT roadmaps and oversee the rollout of regional and local IT solutions. Ensure successful deployment of technology initiatives across business units and customer interfaces, aligned with global IT standards and strategic objectives.

Demand and Portfolio Management
Support business leaders in developing IT demands and roadmaps that can be assessed, costed, prioritized, and scheduled for delivery. Facilitate the intake, approval, and governance process for new initiatives, ensuring alignment with regional and corporate priorities.

Financial and Budget Planning
Collaborate with regional and country management to develop and manage IT budgets. Ensure that investment requests and business cases are well-structured, justified, and aligned with strategic and financial goals.

Business Analysis and Solution Development
Analyze business requirements and recommend technology solutions that meet operational and strategic needs. Partner with architecture, design, and operations teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with company standards.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management
Act as the key liaison between IT and business functions across all domains. Coordinate with third-party vendors and IT partners to ensure service quality, contract adherence, and value delivery.

Governance and Service Alignment
Ensure that business expectations are aligned with IT service levels and that agreed SLAs are achievable within available budgets. Negotiate service levels with the respective IT functions and teams, balancing cost and business value.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting
Monitor, report, and communicate IT service performance and project progress to business stakeholders. Provide transparent updates on issues, risks, and corrective actions in a timely manner.

Change and Escalation Management
Serve as an escalation point for IT-related issues, ensuring effective problem resolution and stakeholder communication during critical incidents. Support change management by helping the business adapt to evolving IT processes and solutions.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation
Identify opportunities to leverage technology for process improvement and operational excellence. Promote innovation and ensure lessons learned are embedded in future initiatives.

Qualification Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree or MBA with a focus on Technology Management or Business Strategy is an advantage.
  • Certifications such as ITIL, PMP/Prince2 are desirable.

Work Experience

  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience in IT business relationship management, project management, or business analysis, preferably in a regional or multinational environment.
  • Proven ability to align IT initiatives with business priorities and deliver measurable value.
  • Experience in IT demand management, budgeting, and investment planning.
  • Strong background in IT service delivery, governance, and stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated experience working in matrix organizations and coordinating across global and regional teams.

Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of IT governance, service management (ITIL), and project management methodologies.
  • Knowledge of business process analysis, portfolio management, and strategic planning.
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems (e.g., ERP), data analytics tools, and integration technologies.
  • Ability to evaluate and develop business cases and ROI analyses for IT investments.
  • Experience using ITSM and project tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, MS Project).
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and presentation skills.

Language Skills

  • Fluent in English and German (written and verbal); additional languages are an advantage

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Understands business goals and aligns IT initiatives accordingly.
  • Collaboration: Builds strong partnerships with stakeholders across functions and regions.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of deliverables and ensures timely, high-quality outcomes.
  • Communication: Clearly conveys complex ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Analytical Thinking: Identifies trends, evaluates data, and provides actionable insights.
  • Influence and Negotiation: Balances business needs, budgets, and technical feasibility.
  • Adaptability: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Customer Focus: Prioritizes business needs and ensures IT services add value.

If you want to be part of a team that helps make travel and culinary memories, join us!

title: Senior Director, GMP Quality
description:
The Role:

The Senior Director, GMP Quality will build/support and maintain fit-for-purpose quality systems, provide independent quality oversight of contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs), contract testing laboratories, and other strategic partners, and ensure the company’s products and processes meet applicable regulatory, GxP, and company requirements.

This is a hands-on individual contributor leadership role that will partner closely with Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, Supply Chain, external vendors, and internal company stakeholders to support programs from development through commercialization. This role will report to the Vice President, Head of Quality.

Here's how you will contribute:

  • Establish and maintain a scalable, risk-based GxP Quality framework covering analytical testing, manufacturing, technology transfer, validation, product lifecycle management, and regulatory commitments.
  • Provide independent, phase-appropriate Quality oversight of CMC and analytical strategies, including control strategies, CQAs, CPPs, specifications, method development and validation, comparability, stability, reference standards, and lifecycle management.
  • Serve as an enterprise Quality leader and strategic advisor to Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, executive leadership, and cross-functional teams on product quality, supply continuity, regulatory readiness, and business objectives.
  • Build a culture of quality, accountability, scientific rigor, collaboration, and proactive risk management across Generate and its external partners.
  • Lead Generate’s CMC Quality relationships with CDMOs, contract testing laboratories, and other technical partners, including qualification, quality agreements, governance, performance management, audits, and issue escalation.
  • Provide Quality oversight of outsourced development, manufacturing, testing, packaging, and storage activities, ensuring compliant and timely execution of clinical supply, GMP release, stability, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Provide Quality leadership across technology transfer, scale-up, process characterization, manufacturing changes, comparability, continued process verification, and other product and process lifecycle activities.
  • Review and approve key GMP and regulatory documentation, and provide quality leadership for manufacturing campaigns, batch review and release, deviations, investigations, OOS/OOT results, CAPAs, change controls, product disposition, and other significant quality events.
  • Drive product quality risk management, audit and inspection readiness, data integrity, computerized systems compliance, and alignment with global regulatory expectations, cGMP requirements, quality agreements, and Generate standards.
  • Support global regulatory submissions and health authority interactions by developing and reviewing CMC/QC Quality content, assessing data and control strategies, and supporting responses to regulatory questions.
  • Establish and monitor Quality performance indicators, identify evolving regulations and industry pr

Leadership Qualities:

  • Brings deep GMP, GLP, manufacturing, and regulatory expertise with sound judgment, business partnership, and strong people leadership.
  • Sets a clear Quality vision while remaining engaged in critical operational issues and making timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Identifies and prioritizes compliance and product risks, maintaining Quality’s objectivity and challenging decisions when patient safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance may be compromised.
  • Provides practical, timely, and science-based guidance that enables development progress while protecting product quality, participant safety, data reliability, and regulatory integrity.
  • Builds trust and alignment across Technical Operations, Preclinical, Regulatory, Clinical, Supply Chain, and internal and external partners through credibility, listening, diplomacy, and consistency.
  • Creates a culture in which Quality is owned across the organization, while maintaining strong oversight of documentation, data integrity, systems, and remediation commitments.
  • Develops fit-for-purpose Quality systems that support growth without unnecessary complexity, using metrics, lessons learned, and root-cause thinking to strengthen processes and prevent recurrence.
  • Provides day-to-day leadership to Quality contractors and other team members; may assume broader people-management responsibilities as the organization grows

The Ideal Candidate will have:

  • Bachelors degree in a relevant scientific discipline and 15+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience
  • Extensive GxP quality leadership experience supporting biologics development, including GMP and GLP operations.
  • Strong understanding of quality systems, including deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, OOS/OOT management, data integrity, and inspection readiness.
  • Experience providing quality oversight across preclinical, CMC, clinical manufacturing, quality control, supply chain, and product lifecycle activities.
  • Strong knowledge of biologic products regulations, process validation, method validation, stability, comparability, specifications, and control strategies.
  • Proven ability to establish phase-appropriate Quality strategies and scalable systems for early- and late-stage development programs.
  • Significant quality oversight experience working with CDMOs, CROs, contract testing laboratories, suppliers, and other external partners.
  • Experience leading audits, quality agreements, partner performance management, investigations, remediation, and risk mitigation.
  • Demonstrated success supporting regulatory submissions, health authority interactions, inspections, and responses to regulatory findings.
  • Experience partnering with Technical Operations, Preclinical, Regulatory, Clinical, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Proven ability to build, mentor, develop and lead high performing Quality Teams
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to explain complex scientific, regulatory, and quality matters to executive leadership and external stakeholders.
  • A strategic, proactive, and hands-on leader who anticipates risk, makes sound decisions, and holds teams and partners accountable.
  • Commitment to patient safety, product quality, data integrity, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

  • Involvement in pre-approval inspections, regulatory inspections, and commercialization readiness for biologics.
  • Exposure to highly outsourced or virtual biotechnology operating model.
  • Involved in implementing new quality technologies, electronic systems, automation, or data-driven quality tools
  • Global experience with health authorities, suppliers, and development or manufacturing partners.
  • Strategic Quality and GMP leadership for combination drug product development

About Generate Biomedicines

We are a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein-based medicines.

Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. By unifying computational design and clinical development within a single operating model, we translate this approach into clinical-stage programs and are leading a shift from traditional drug discovery toward systematic drug generation.

At Generate:Biomedicines, we collaborate across disciplines in new ways to invent and innovate. We bring diverse perspectives to a shared goal of delivering better medicines to patients in need, faster, guided by our values and leadership behaviors.

Generate:Biomedicines is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Generate:Biomedicines or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Company’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Generate:Biomedicines and the Company will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Compensation: The base salary range provided reflects our current estimate of what we anticipate paying for this position. Your actual base salary will be based on several factors, including job-related skills, experience, internal equity, relevant education or training, and market dynamics. In addition, you will be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and a competitive benefits package.

$210,000—$290,000 USD

title: Casual Art Technician
description:

Christie’s, the world’s largest Art Business, is an incredibly exciting & enriching place to start or continue your career. Whether you work within one of our Specialist Art Departments, or in one of our more Operational teams, we are all working together with one common goal in mind: to continue the success of this 250 year old company, steeped in history, bringing fresh ideas whilst not forgetting our shared values; Integrity, Excellence, Innovation, Responsibility & Relationships. The Casual Art Technician provides hands-on art handling and operational support within Christie’s King Street galleries, collection areas, and warehouse spaces. title: Steris Sterilizer Specialist

This is a highly technical position that will perform scheduled maintenance, repairs, inspections, and calibrations across a variety of medical sterilizer devices to ensure mechanical and electrical safety and functionality. This is a field service position primarily serving various customer hospitals in a geographical area. Steris experience and platform certifications are required.

  • Repairs can include the following: steam sterilizers, steam generators, cart washers, cart decontamination systems and ultrasonic cleaning systems
  • Achieve KPI targets while maintaining departmental standards and goals

  • Follow safety procedures related to bloodborne pathogens, hazardous materials, and device safety per OSHA and facility policy
  • Adhere to ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 13485 QMS policies, procedures, and documentation standards
Customer Support
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with clinical and facility staff
  • Communicate equipment status and service timelines clearly to customers and supervisors
  • Demonstrate a customer-first approach by actively listening to feedback and prioritizing service requests
Asset Tracking
  • Support inventory control by performing audits and verifying the status of assigned and incoming equipment
  • Recommend updates to inventory records and performance assurance schedule
Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with clinical biomedical equipment (specifically sterilization devices) in a hospital or clinical setting
  • Technical degree or equivalent preferred
  • Proficient with electromechanical and computerized biomedical devices
  • Basic knowledge of sterilization plumbing,
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable interpreting error codes and using diagnostic software
  • Clear and professional verbal and written communication

  • Accountability – takes ownership of assigned work and follows items through to completion

  • Integrity – Can admit mistakes, is direct and truthful
  • Customer Service – demonstrates a “customer-first” mentality, focused on meeting the needs of customers and captures feedback to make improvements
  • Priority Setting – Prioritizes assigned schedules and workload

Safety Requirements:
  • Maintain a safe working environment for self and others if they come in contact within the biomed area in accordance with the facility’s policies
  • Must follow OSHA guidelines in regard to blood borne pathogens, airborne pathogens, radiation, sharp instruments and/or tools, hazardous liquids, and operating devices
  • Ontime completion of safety and training assignments
  • Must have sensory ability to distinguish hot & cold ranges of temperature, surfaces, fine motor skills, manual dexterity, and detect/distinguish colors
  • Must be able be able to carry or lift up to 50 pounds routinely
Travel Requirements:
Field service position – meaning that candidate will be required to travel between Memorial Hermann facilities in the greater Houston, TX area. title: AI software solution Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact As an AI Software Solutions Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of Intel products by researching, developing, and optimizing AI solutions for diverse applications. In this role, you'll collaborate with engineering teams and customers to deliver cutting-edge AI software while enhancing model performance through deep expertise in AI frameworks, algorithms, and hardware. Your work will contribute to shaping innovative AI solutions that leverage the full potential of Intel technology in real-world scenarios. you will design, implement, and optimize end-to-end AI software stacks, model pipelines, and runtime accelerators on Intel's next-generation client and edge platforms (AI PCs, Core/Xeon CPUs, integrated/discrete GPUs, and NPUs). Building upon your advanced academic foundation (Master's degree) and hands-on internship experience, you will take direct technical ownership of software components, drive AI performance optimizations, and work directly with senior architects and cross-functional teams to bring cutting-edge AI capabilities from research prototypes into production-grade software. Business group The AI Software Solutions Engineer position is part of Intel Corporation's team focused on advanced client AI technologies. This group works to deliver optimized AI solutions by partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders. The team's mission is to enable impactful AI applications, advance technical innovation, and support Intel's broader goals in high-performance computing and artificial intelligence domains. Join a collaborative environment where your contributions will help shape the future of AI-powered solutions. Key Responsibilities - Research and prototype AI solutions, leveraging Intel products to optimize performance and drive customer adoption. - Develop AI software, including open-source libraries, models, and tools, tailored to diverse applications. - Optimize AI model performance using deep expertise in frameworks, algorithms, and hardware. - Implement adjustments to AI models, parameters, code, and quantization to enhance functionality and performance. - Collaborate with AI algorithm and framework engineers to optimize end-to-end AI solutions for Intel hardware. - Serve as a trusted technical advisor, enabling customers and partners to maximize the value of Intel AI products. - Partner with product development teams to accelerate application pre-enablement and optimize future Intel hardware and software products. - Deliver differentiated benchmark collateral and identify key workloads to inform product requirements and drive innovation

Qualifications:

description:

Who is ACT1 Federal? ACT1 Federal LLC is a 100% employee-owned company. We’ve served the Department of War (DoW) for nearly thirty years. Our core missions include weapon systems engineering, logistics, space domain expertise, global defense and security, business and financial management for security assistance and major defense articles, as well as military training and arctic security. Join us!

Description: ACT1 Federal is seeking an experienced Supply Chain and Supplier Management Lead to provide multi-tier supplier mapping, risk segmentation, supplier-capacity analysis, and Government-authorized recovery planning.

Responsibilities:

Supply Chain Analysis and Risk Visibility:

  • Map prime contractor and critical lower-tier supplier networks for assigned weapon and weapon-system portfolios, including sources, locations, dependencies, and points of failure.
  • Identify sole-source and single-point dependencies, long-lead materials, obsolescence, fragile subtiers, qualification barriers, foreign dependencies, and other threats to production continuity.
  • Collect and validate supplier data on demand, capacity, backlog, lead time, on-time delivery, quality, yield, workforce, tooling, material, and financial or operational stress.
  • Establish supplier-risk baselines, heat maps, watch lists, leading indicators, and escalation criteria that distinguish verified constraints from unsupported assertions.

Supplier Performance and Recovery:

  • Assess supplier capability, capacity, production readiness, quality performance, delivery reliability, management controls, and ability to meet current and forecast demand.
  • Lead structured engagements, site visits, data reviews, and working sessions with program offices, prime contractors, suppliers, DCMA, and other authorized stakeholders.
  • Evaluate supplier recovery plans, capacity-expansion proposals, capital requests, schedules, assumptions, dependencies, and measurable production outcomes.
  • Develop and recommend corrective actions addressing material, labor, equipment, tooling, test, quality, facilities, engineering, planning, and lower-tier constraints.
  • Monitor milestones and results; identify emerging variance and recommend escalation, alternate sourcing, supplier development, investment, or other intervention when warranted.

Decision Support:

  • Serve as the senior supply-chain and supplier-management advisor to the BOND team for assigned PAE and weapon-system priorities.
  • Integrate supplier findings with production, schedule, cost, investment, engineering, and program data to determine mission and delivery effects.
  • Coordinate actions across DASN DIB, PAEs, program offices, systems commands, contracting, engineering, logistics, financial management, and industry stakeholders.
  • Prepare executive briefings, supplier assessments, alternatives analyses, issue papers, action plans, and decision memoranda with clear owners, milestones, risks, and recommendations.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in supply chain management, business, engineering, operations management, logistics, acquisition, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years’ experience in supply-chain management, supplier management, manufacturing, production, acquisition, logistics, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating supplier capability, capacity, delivery, quality, risk, and recovery actions within complex manufacturing or defense supply chains.
  • Experience working with prime contractors and lower-tier suppliers to identify root causes, validate constraints, and develop executable corrective actions.
  • Knowledge of production and supplier measures such as capacity, throughput, cycle time, lead time, yield, backlog, on-time delivery, quality, and schedule performance.
  • Experience preparing executive assessments and recommendations and leading cross-functional engagements with Government and industry stakeholders.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance required.

Benefits:

  • ACT1 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Company Paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Company Paid Short-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Long-Term Disability

  • Voluntary Accidental Injury/Critical Illness/Hospital Care
  • Voluntary Pet Insurance, Legal Resources, and Identity Protection

  • If this position is listed as onsite, you’ll work with colleagues and clients in person, as needed for the specific role.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform - Libson
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is opening an engineering hub in Lisbon, our first dedicated one outside of our San Francisco HQ. And we’re building it from the ground up. As a member of our founding team, you’ll help set the direction for teams across Core Technology, advancing work that keeps Discord reliable for millions of people around the world, helps our engineers move faster, and protects our platform at scale. You’ll also help shape the culture of the hub so it feels unmistakably Discord while developing a distinctly Lisbon identity of its own.

We're looking for someone who gets excited about building data infrastructure at massive scale and cares deeply about the gaming communities we serve. Someone with passion for building lovable products for Discord users and Discord engineers. We're building the next generation Data Platform that powers decisions for one of the most vibrant platforms in the world.

If you're the kind of Staff Engineer who sees ambiguity as an invitation — who builds systems that make whole teams faster, shapes technical strategy across the org, and wants your decisions to directly impact millions of gamers worldwide — we want to talk to you.

To learn more about Discord's Data Platform, read our engineering blog, including how we built our modern data stack leveraging open-source tools!

  • Own the technical direction of major Data Platform initiatives like governance and compliance, scaling, or stream processing, from problem to production system and post-launch health
  • Be a force multiplier: build reusable primitives, unblock teammates, and raise the quality bar across the team
  • Stay a top code contributor. You write real production code while helping others reach the same bar
  • Partner with XFN stakeholders to translate business problems into clear technical strategy
  • Champion debate, decide, and commit and 80/20 thinking to drive robust technical solutions supporting multiple teams

What You Should Have

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of driving large, ambiguous technical initiatives end-to-end
  • Expertise in distributed systems and data infrastructure at scale. You've anticipated hard problems before they became incidents
  • Demonstrated ability to multiply a team's impact through architectural thought leadership, design reviews, reusable abstractions, and well-timed mentorship
  • Strong technical judgment: when to go fast vs. slow, when to build vs. integrate, and how to bring stakeholders along
  • Cross-functional influence: you've driven alignment across engineering, product, and business without relying on authority

Bonus Points

  • Passion for Discord and gaming
  • Experience with data governance, privacy compliance, real-time analytics infrastructure, or cost optimization in large-scale data environments

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Lisbon Area and attend the office 3-4 days a week.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer, Release Engineering
location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Marlborough, Massachusetts, United States
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer – Release Engineering

Location: Boston/Marlborough, MA — Hybrid, 3 days per week

Role Overview

Nasuni is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer – Release Engineering to help design, scale, and improve the systems that move software from development through testing and release.

You will be a senior technical contributor within DevOps / Release Engineering, with ownership of complex CI/CD pipelines, build and test infrastructure, build tooling and scripts, release automation, and engineering workflows used across multiple teams. Your work will directly influence software delivery speed, reliability, developer productivity, and release quality.

This role is suited to an engineer who has gone beyond maintaining pipelines and can independently diagnose systemic problems, design scalable solutions, establish reusable patterns, and lead technical initiatives across Engineering and QA.

It is not primarily a release-coordination or operations-support position. Success requires hands-on engineering depth and the ability to improve the underlying systems themselves.

Level & Scope

You will independently own technically complex release-engineering problems from design through implementation and operational improvement. You will make technical decisions within the release-engineering domain, lead medium-to-large initiatives involving multiple engineering teams, mentor other engineers, and influence CI/CD standards and technical practices.

The role remains highly hands-on, balancing implementation with system design, technical leadership, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and own scalable CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks supporting multiple engineering teams.
  • Engineer distributed build and test infrastructure using Jenkins and modern CI/CD patterns.
  • Act as a build engineer as well as a release engineer: understand, modify, and improve product build scripts and tooling, and partner with development teams to remove build bottlenecks and improve repeatability.
  • Own and optimize build environments and agent templates, using Packer together with Terraform and Ansible to define, provision, and maintain consistent build infrastructure.
  • Improve artifact and package-management workflows, including RPM lifecycle management, repository organization, traceability, and promotion models in Artifactory.
  • Improve pipeline performance, reliability, test parallelization, failure recovery, and developer experience.
  • Build reusable automation and infrastructure patterns that incorporate security, scalability, observability, and operational resilience.
  • Define CI/CD requirements for complex product changes and identify release, dependency, and infrastructure risks early.
  • Design and evolve branching, versioning, and release workflows across multiple repositories.
  • Develop automated validation for patch, release, and code-freeze workflows, including GitHub Actions where appropriate to verify branch state, policy compliance, and release readiness.
  • Integrate automated quality gates and partner with Engineering and QA to improve test reliability and release readiness.
  • Troubleshoot complex pipeline and distributed infrastructure failures and implement durable corrective actions.
  • Strengthen monitoring, alerting, and operational visibility across build and release infrastructure.
  • Lead cross-functional technical initiatives and drive alignment on architecture and implementation decisions.
  • Mentor engineers in CI/CD, automation, infrastructure, and release-engineering practices.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools where appropriate for tasks such as log analysis, code generation, troubleshooting, test creation, or workflow automation, while validating outputs for correctness, security, and production readiness.
  • Evaluate opportunities to create repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering productivity without reducing technical ownership or quality.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Strong professional experience in DevOps, release engineering, CI/CD, build infrastructure, or infrastructure automation.
  • Advanced hands-on Jenkins pipeline development and distributed CI/CD experience.
  • Hands-on build engineering experience, including the ability to read, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize build scripts and build tooling rather than only operate CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong automation or scripting ability using Python and/or Groovy.
  • Strong Linux, networking, and infrastructure fundamentals.
  • Hands-on Docker and Kubernetes experience.
  • Experience designing reliable build/test infrastructure supporting multiple engineers or teams.
  • Experience with branching models, release workflows, source control, and versioning.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex distributed-system or pipeline failures.
  • Strong communication and technical decision-making skills.

Preferred

  • AWS, Azure, or GCP infrastructure and CI/CD experience.
  • Packer, Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or comparable infrastructure-as-code and image/template automation tools.
  • Experience with Artifactory and package-management workflows, particularly RPM repositories, artifact promotion, retention, and release traceability.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions for automated branch validation, pull-request/release checks, or release-readiness controls.
  • Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or comparable observability platforms.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-team technical initiatives.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools with defined validation practices.

Ideal

  • Experience with storage, distributed systems, file services, or infrastructure software.
  • Experience creating reusable CI/CD frameworks adopted across multiple teams.
  • Experience modernizing or optimizing large build systems, build scripts, dependency management, or packaging workflows across multiple repositories.
  • Demonstrated improvements to build speed, reliability, release quality, or engineering productivity.

Experience Guidelines

Candidates will typically bring 5–8+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial hands-on experience with CI/CD or release engineering. Depth of ownership and system complexity matter more than a specific year count.

About Nasuni

The Nasuni File Data Platform delivers operational excellence by consolidating NAS and backup, eliminating data silos, and making management easy and flexible without changes to apps or workflows. title: Biometrics (Fingerprint) Technician - On Call
description:
This is an opportunity to work with the United States Citizenship & Immigration Services (USCIS) in meeting the mission of administering the nation’s lawful immigration system.

Compensation: $18.30 (SCA position)

*This is an hourly, overtime-eligible position that falls under the Service Contract Act (SCA). In accordance with the Health and Welfare provisions of the SCA, and in addition to your base hourly rate, you may be eligible to receive an additional health and welfare payment for each hour you work to ensure compliance with the minimums set forth by the act. The amount you are entitled to receive will vary depending upon the fringe benefits you select now and in the future.

Benefits: On call employees are eligible for retirement savings plan (401k) and the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Job Description:

As a Biometric Technician (BT), you will be responsible for supporting the mission of a government program located in Casper, WY. This position works as a part of a dynamic team of professionals assisting the United States Citizenship and Immigration (USCIS) Application Support Center (ASC) operations. Amentum provides all required job training for qualified candidates.

On Call (causal) employees are expected to be available during our operational hours for substitute coverage as needed at the site. This location is only operational a select few days per month. This is not a regular Full Time or regular Part Time position; it is a Casual On-Call position. All efforts are made to notify On-Call personnel in advance of the site on call needs, however, occasionally employees are notified the night before or day of. Interested candidates must meet this availability. In this position, hours are not guaranteed, and employees are on a “as needed” basis so a steady income stream cannot be guaranteed. The On-Call position is a perfect fit for candidates with flexibility, seeking supplemental income and for those who still want to be active in a work environment without a committed schedule.

Primary Responsibilities are:

  • Complete biometrics registration for applicants seeking legal immigration to the United States.

  • Ensure all who enter the ASC are approved applicants and visitors while providing both interior and exterior crowd control and assisting the staff in enforcing the rules and policies of the ASCs.

  • Provide front-line customer service as representatives of Amentum and on behalf of the United States Government.

Highlights of Responsibilities:

It is expected that providing applicants with the highest level of customer service is primary in all responsibilities. This position must be able to work with the public, display a cheerful and inviting demeanor, smile, manage the applicants with sensitivity, courtesy and ensure the applicant is treated with respect as a customer of the USCIS ASC. Further, personnel must safeguard all areas where Personal Identifiable Information (PII) is vulnerable such as applicant’s paperwork and identifications, electronic biometric data and reports.

  • Perform quality biometrics processing to include capturing electronic fingerprints, photographs, and signatures within established program-wide processing times.

  • Screen applicants entering the facility to ensure they have a valid appointment notice and identification allowing their entry into the ASC.

  • Utilize crowd control barriers (stanchions or rails) to ensure a safe and organized entry into the facility.

  • Visually inspect applicants and their belongings prior to allowing entry into the facility. During national pandemics or other health crisis, applicants may be asked questions about their status of illness and may be declined entry to the ASC per customer requirements.

  • Conducting periodic facility checks (both interior and exterior) reporting any concerns to the Site Supervisor to manage.

  • Assist the Site Supervisor and/or government Immigration Service Officer in calling local law enforcement or first responders when necessary.

  • Manage and complete with accuracy administrative paperwork such as tracking processing time for applicants, reconciliation paperwork of biometrics captured, assisting in maintaining a visitor control log for non-applicants entering the facility, signing off on facility checks and other administrative duties as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location.

  • A High School Diploma or equivalent.

  • Must be able to speak and write in English.

  • Ability to stand upright on one’s feet for scheduled shift duration, excluding meals and breaks.

  • Ability to hold and grasp applicant’s hands to obtain quality fingerprints.

  • Ability to work in a high paced environment with the public.

  • Ability to type and use basic computer skills.

  • Successful completion of the biometrics training and become certified within sixty days.

Desired Skills:

  • Ability to speak a foreign language.

​

*H&W monies are used to pay for the employer costs of benefits. Any remaining monies after all applicable deductions will be cashed out on a 1 pay period lag*

$18.30

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.

  • Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

  • Educational reimbursement

  • Parental leave

title: Koulunkäynninohjaaja, TOI-opetus (sijaisuus)
description:
Kerttulan koulun muodostavat Kerttulan pääkoulu ja TOI-opetuksen yksikkö Veitikanraitilla. Molemmat yksiköt sijaitsevat Raision keskustan läheisyydessä erinomaisten ulkoilu- ja liikuntamahdollisuuksien ympäröiminä. Koulussa on noin 260 oppilasta. Kerttula tarjoaa kaikille alueen oppilaille sopivaa opetusta ja tarvittavia tukitoimia oppimisen tueksi.

Haemme Kerttulan koulun erityisopetustiimiin määräaikaista koulunkäynninohjaajaa toiminta-alueittaisen opetuksen / vammais- ja autismiopetuksen luokkiin sijaisuuteen ajalle 21.9.-9.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan, joustavasti aloittaen.

Eduksi katsotaan:
- erilaisten kommunikaatiomenetelmien osaaminen
- kokemus vammais- ja autismioppilaiden kanssa työskentelystä

Työntekijältä vaaditaan:
- aktiivisuutta ja osallistuvuutta
- itseohjautuvuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta
- tiimityö- ja työelämätaitoja
- joustavuutta ja sopeutumiskykyä

Työhön kuuluu myös hoidollista työtä.

Viikkotyöaika on 38,25h/vko (koulun tunnit + ap/ip-kerho).
Palkkaus 2482,02€.

Sinua odottaa innostunut, motivoitunut ja tiivis työyhteisö, jossa arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä. Tuemme työssä kehittymistä kouluttautumismahdollisuuksilla ja huolehdimme työhyvinvoinnistasi mm. erilaisilla liikunta- ja kulttuurieduilla. Pääset maksutta Raision uintikeskus Ulpukkaan ja kuntosalille. Lisäksi saat käyttöösi ePassi-edun ja aktiivisen virkistystoimikunnan tarjoamat harrastusmahdollisuudet.

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: koulunkäynninohjaaja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja tai muu soveltuva ammatillinen perustutkinto / tehtävään soveltuva tutkinto. Alkuperäiset tutkintotodistukset ja työtodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

Toimita hakemuksesi sähköisesti Kuntarekry.fi -rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta viimeistään maanantaina 2.10.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä.

Huom! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan hakijan löydyttyä; toimi siis ripeästi!


Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan kuukauden (30 pv.) kuluessa tehtävän vastaanottamisesta sekä rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002) ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista. title: Impact Specialist, Curriculum and Instruction (Literacy) - West Coast Region
description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Impact Specialist, Curriculum & Instruction (Literacy) - West Coast Region


The Impact Specialist, Curriculum & Instruction is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) who will advance core footprint alongside field teams through opportunity advisement and sales presentations that drive success in core adoptions, as they strengthen key literacy core implementations including pilots and efficacy work. ISPs will collaborate with a range of external and internal stakeholders to lead efforts that achieve our company goals in the core literacy market.

The impact you'll have:

Grow Core Adoption Impact

  • Develop and maintain gold-standard product knowledge and presentation skills to effectively support core adoption and revenue growth

  • In collaboration with National Directors and internal product teams, develop and deliver awareness experiences that build curiosity and excitement among educators for our core literacy offerings

  • Develop the ability to clearly communicate the features, advantages, and benefits of core offerings in sales settings

  • Engage with national and regional leadership to understand upcoming state adoptions and open-territory opportunities for expanding our core footprint

  • Develop a deep understanding of emerging research, trends, and legislation that impact curriculum and instruction

Strengthen Key Implementations

  • Work closely with regional field teams to monitor and protect the health of core implementations

  • Assist and advise field teams in responding to implementation challenges that arise, including challenges related to instructional models and program coherence

  • Seek implementation health status with SME counterparts in literacy and mathematics for existing core adoptions

Commit to Continued Professional Learning

  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional learning in the ever-evolving field of core curriculum by staying informed about emerging trends, research, and best practices in education

Proactively Provide Feedback and Updates

  • Ensure transparent and effective communication by disseminating clear, concise, and timely updates to stakeholders, fostering a shared understanding of project status and milestones

  • Maintain and leverage data to report on the health of key core implementations

Who We’re Looking For:

  • Strong understanding of how high-quality curriculum is implemented across languages while supporting both content learning and language development

  • Knowledge of best practices and trends in your subject area (ELA/Literacy)

  • Ability to build credibility with teachers, coaches, principals, and district leaders

  • Ability to thrive in collaborative environments while demonstrating a high degree of self-directed initiative

  • Ability to manage projects through change, including building trust with stakeholders, listening deeply, learning from others’ input and experience, and driving toward best outcomes with respect, compassion, and humility

  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to balance short-term tasks with long-term projects and initiatives

  • Embody and model the CA culture tenets in all internal and external activities

Required Education and Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in education with a focus on curriculum and instruction

  • Demonstrated experience working in ELA and Literacy, preferably through classroom teaching, instructional leadership, school leadership, or district-level leadership

  • Demonstrated effectiveness working cross-functionally, building relationships with remote teams, and working with a broad range of stakeholders

  • Bachelor’s degree in education or a related field; advanced degree preferred

Travel: 60%-70%; primarily multi-state travel within the assigned West Coast region, including overnight travel.

Location: This position is based in the West Coast region and will be supporting customers throughout this area. Candidates must currently live in or be willing to relocate to the West Coast region. Additionally, a valid driver's license is required for this role.

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $69,250-$118,250.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.

Application deadline: October 9, 2026. This is subject to close earlier if there is a high volume of applicants or a qualified hire is made.

title: Ground Ramp Agent
description:
Job Description:

Job Description:

Do you enjoy working outdoors in a fast-paced, safety-obsessed aviation environment?

As a Ramp Agent, you will be essential in ensuring that flights run on time by providing efficient ground support services.

Alliance Ground International (AGI) is one of the largest independently owned ground handling companies providing services to 100+ airlines in 61 airports across the U.S. and Canada. We are the home to over 12,000 team members supporting over 1.5B Kilos and over 400K departures. Our Ground division has a strong reputation in aviation ground services. We are committed to providing the highest quality service and continuing our outstanding safety track record. As we continue to grow, we only look for the best in the industry.

Job responsibilities:

  • Guide inbound/outbound airplanes to and from the gate.

  • Transport, lift, load/unload, sort and transfer passenger baggage, cargo, and mail material in and out of aircraft bins, belt loader, or baggage carts in a safe manner.

  • Safeguards customer baggage, air cargo, airmail from weather, loss, theft, damage and/or destruction.

  • Clean aircraft passenger cabins between flights and stock aircraft with needed supplies.

  • Operate heavy equipment such as pushback equipment and maintain visual contact with Wing Walkers to ensure the equipment is free of any danger.

  • Operate and/or drive motorized equipment, such as belt loaders, air start units, lift trucks, push back tugs, bag cart, lavatory cart, and deicers; or manually push and pull push carts and containers. Operate equipment to move luggage and cargo, tow planes between gates, and refill water tanks and lavatories.

  • Receive and record customer baggage, air freight, mail, and company materials as required.

  • Pick up, deliver, and transport cargo and baggage to and from aircraft, which could include wheelchairs, strollers, live animals, and other vital property of passengers, and prepare records in connection with these responsibilities.

  • Complete paperwork and forms connected with work assignments pertaining to procedures and enter data into company's information system as required.

  • Follow company procedures and protocols to ensure we are always operating in a safe and responsible manner.

  • Complete all training when required by company, airport governing authority, or customer when required.

  • Be on time, be prepared, and be safe. Be willing to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Safety, Security and Compliance:

All AGI Team members have a responsibility and duty while at work to:

  • Take reasonable care for the health, wellbeing, safety, and security of themselves and of others who may be affected by their actions or omissions while at work.

  • Cooperate with their manager / supervisor to allow them to perform or comply with any legal requirements imposed on the company.

  • Not intentionally or recklessly interfere with or misuse anything provided by the company in the interests of health, wellbeing, safety, security or welfare reasons.

  • Inform their manager / supervisor of any work situation, equipment, or activity that represents a serious or immediate danger to health, wellbeing, safety, and security.

  • Report any hazards, near misses, incidents, accidents, or dangerous occurrences to their manager / supervisor, who will then follow the procedures contained in company and carrier Safety and Security procedures.

  • Carry out work in accordance with information and training provided and any specific health, wellbeing, safety, and security rules or procedures.

  • Fully understand AGI Health & Safety and Security policies.

  • Attend training courses as may be required by AGI.

Physical Requirements:

  • This job requires physical stamina and strength – Ramp Agents must be able to lift / carry / push / pull and move items 70 pounds (32 kg) or more on a regular basis and repetitively lift items weighing 40 to 50 pounds on raised surfaces.

  • Must be able to carry heavy items up and down narrow jetway stairs.

  • Must be able to walk, climb, bend, kneel, crawl, and stoop on a frequent basis and for extended periods.

  • Must be able to work in cramped or high places.

  • Must be able to be alerted to moving vehicles or aircraft and use radio equipment to communicate with crew and airport authorities.

  • Must be able to work outside in all types of weather, around jet and machinery noises.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Good Communication Skills – Ramp Agents must be able to communicate information and instructions verbally and/or via radio equipment effectively in a professional manner with the flight crew, gate agents, and other ground crew to coordinate the movement and handling of planes, equipment, baggage, and cargo.

  • Basic math skills: Ramp agents may be required to calculate weight and balance calculations for planes.

  • Computer skills: Ramp agents may be required to use computer systems to track cargo and baggage.

  • Problem-solving skills: Ramp agents may be called upon to troubleshoot issues during loading and unloading.

  • Time management skills: Ramp agents must be able to manage their time effectively to complete tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.


Qualifications:

  • Be at least 18 years of age and possess a high school diploma, GED, or work experience equivalent.

  • Possess a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

  • If work location is in the United States, must have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986. If work location is in Canada, must have authorization to work in Canada as defined by the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (IRPA) of 2001.

  • Must complete ramp and SIDA training to obtain airport authority identification security.

  • If required by customer or role access, be able to secure a Customs Seal through the respective governing agency.

  • Preferred Qualifications - One+ year of relevant experience.

AGI offers a comprehensive benefit package for all employees, including paid vacation and medical / dental / vision for full-time qualified employees as well as medical coverage for part time employees. AGI also provides free uniforms and free on-the-job training to all employees. Additional benefits include company-matched 401(k) program, company-paid employee assistance program, voluntary life insurance, and travel discounts on car rentals, hotels, and cruises to name a few.

The successful AGI team member brings their “A” game every day with energy and enthusiasm, respect for their team, and the highest regard for safety!

Alliance Ground International is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. AGI is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or veteran status.

title: Instructor, Other Programs (4790)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, The Instructor (youth programs) creates positive, nurturing relationships with children while building cooperative relationships with parents/caregivers, staff, and partners. Promotes and supports the potential of all youth in programs/classes and facilitates peer-to-peer connections as part of the overall program experience. Provides direction to support children in the classroom, and teaches curriculum that is focused on mastering specific skills. Provides a quality experience to children and parents that focuses on building achievement and belonging in youth and relationships among youth and within families.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Nurtures children through purposeful programming dedicated to building achievement and belonging in youth and relationships among youth and within families.
  • Maintains close visual supervision of a group of assigned children, following ratios based on specific program/class.
  • No child is left unsupervised or staff alone with a child at any time while attending program/class.
  • Help children manage behavior using a positive approach, including proactive strategies, redirection and using constructive discipline with natural and logical consequences.
  • Actively supports the YMCA is committed to inclusion and compliance with the American with Disabilities Act (ADA) where appropriate.
  • Planning and implementing classes based on a specific topic and skill mastery, culminating in an exposition/showcase at the end of the session.
  • Adheres to program standards including safety and cleanliness standards, maintains site and equipment, and maintains required program records in accordance YMCA expectations.
  • Cultivates positive relationships and maintains effective communication with parents. Engages parents as volunteers and connects them to the YMCA.
  • Attends and participates in family events, program activities, staff meetings and trainings.
  • Follows YMCA policies and procedures, including those related to medical and disciplinary situations, child abuse prevention and emergencies. Follows reporting procedures and proactively responds to situations to ensure a safe environment for all involved
  • Understands and complies with current federal, state, local regulations, and YMCA policies and procedures at all time
  • Maintains positive relationship with parents, other YMCA team members and community partners. Models relationship-building skills (including Listen First) in all interactions.
  • Attend meetings and trainings, as needed.
  • Uphold YMCA policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting and risk management.
  • Demonstrate the Six Pillars of Character (Trustworthiness, Citizenship, Respect, Responsibility, Caring, Fairness) as well as the YMCA Core Values of caring, respect, honesty and responsibility in all dealings with members, guests, volunteers and fellow staff.
  • Demonstrate competencies in and willingness to develop in the Cause Driven Leadership areas of mission advancement, collaboration, operational effectiveness and personal growth.
  • All other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

YMCA LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES
The Y’s Leadership Competency Model is comprised of 14 Leadership Competencies (leadership knowledge, skills, and behaviors required for success in the Y), organized by the four disciplines of Cause-Driven Leadership:

  • Advancing Our Mission & Cause: Provide visionary leadership to the organization and to ensure that all resources are mobilized to adapt to new challenges and needs in the community
    • Competencies Include: Change Leadership, Engaging Community, Philanthropy, & Volunteerism
  • Building Relationships: Connect people to the Y’s cause by developing inclusive relationships, partnerships and collaborations so that Ys can co-create solutions to pressing social needs
    • Competencies Include: Collaboration, Communication & Influence, & Inclusion
  • Leading Operations: ensure relevance, effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization so that we can continue to fulfill our promise to the community
    • Competencies Include: Critical Thinking & Decision Making, Fiscal Management, Functional Expertise, Innovation, & Program/Project Management
  • Developing & Inspiring Others: support the holistic development of self and others so that everyone can embrace the Y’s cause, sustain the Y’s culture, and inspire others to take individual and collective action to further our impact
    • Competencies Include: Emotional Maturity & Developing Self & Others

While all competencies are significant, the following are critical to success in this position:

  • Engaging Community
  • Inclusion
  • Functional Expertise
  • Developing Self & Others

title: Principal Engineer, Cloud
description:
8901 - Corp Office West Crk - 12800 Tuckahoe Creek Parkway, Richmond, Virginia, 23238

CarMax, the way your career should be!

Position Overview

As a Principal Engineer, Cloud, you will play a pivotal role in shaping CarMax’s next-generation cloud infrastructure. This is your opportunity to join an innovative team that is redefining the automotive retail experience through cutting-edge technology. You’ll lead efforts to design, build, and evolve scalable cloud platforms, ensuring reliability, security, and resilience for our customer-facing applications. By leveraging your expertise in cloud engineering and automation, you’ll help CarMax deliver a seamless, best-in-class experience that empowers customers to buy the vehicles they want—on their terms.

Why CarMax?

At CarMax, we are the nation’s largest retailer of used cars with stores from coast to coast, and we are still growing. We’re rethinking the way people buy cars – and it’s our associates that help us do just that. We believe work should feel meaningful and rewarding, with opportunities to make an impact every day. This is where innovation meets passion – be inspired and supported to take us to the future.

Team Overview

You’ll collaborate with engineers, architects, and technology leaders to define patterns and best practices for deploying cloud infrastructure. Acting as a technical mentor and trusted advisor, you will influence strategic decisions and guide teams in building secure, scalable, and automated solutions that support CarMax’s customer-first mission.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement self-service capabilities and automation tools to accelerate delivery and improve operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in design, product management, and architecture to transform innovative ideas into practical solutions.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and agile practices.

  • Consult with internal stakeholders to evolve cloud platforms and optimize performance using modern engineering principles.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends, applying best practices to enhance reliability, scalability, and security across cloud environments.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience with 7+ years in technology roles.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience building cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud considered).

  • 3+ years of scripting or coding experience in languages such as Python, PowerShell, or similar.

  • Expertise in cloud networking, storage, virtualization, and access control, including hybrid environments.

  • Proven ability to design and deploy resilient cloud architectures and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps or TeamCity.

  • Strong leadership skills with experience mentoring teams and driving cross-functional initiatives.

  • Passion for automation and eliminating manual processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

Work Location and Arrangement:

West Creek: This role will be based out of the CarMax Home Office at West Creek (Richmond, VA) and associates will work onsite 4 days per week

OR

Plano: This role will be based out of the CarMax Dallas Tech Hub (Plano, TX) and associates will work onsite 2 days per week

Work Authorization: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Sponsorship will not be considered for this specific role.

About CarMax

At CarMax, we revolutionized the used car buying experience over 30 years ago by introducing transparency and integrity into the process. Our commitment to customer experience, innovation, and community has made us the nation’s largest used car retailer. With over 250 store locations and over 30,000 associates, we are proud to have been recognized as one of the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® and are committed to helping our communities thrive.

As an associate, you are part of an innovative movement to empower the modern customer and drive progress. Your work fuels change—sparking ideas, overcoming challenges, and shaping what’s next. Join us in creating a better future– for our company, our customers, and the communities we call home.

CarMax is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual salary for this position is:

$136,200.00 - $204,300.00

May be eligible for bonus and equity.

Benefits:

Except as otherwise required by state law, CarMax Associates are entitled to the following paid sick, vacation, and holiday time.

Associates that are considered full-time hourly or commission/incentive eligible:

  • To earn up to 48 hours of sick time per year accrued on a per pay period basis and between 80 hours and 200 hours per year of vacation time after a 90 day waiting period depending on years of continuous service with the Company.
  • For 8 hours of pay for each of a total of 6 paid scheduled holidays per year plus 1 floating holiday. If such an Associate does work on a scheduled holiday due to business need, they are eligible for Holiday Premium Pay.

Associates considered full-time salaried are entitled to paid time away with no specified limit as needed for sick, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, holidays, floating holiday, etc. subject to manager approval.

For more details about benefits, please visit our CarMax Benefits website.

Upon an applicant's request, CarMax will consider reasonable accommodation to complete the CarMax Job Application.

title: Senior Managing Consultant – Management of Contaminated Sites
description:
Senior Managing Consultant – Management of Contaminated Sites

About EDGE

Edge Engineering and Science, LLC (EDGE) is an employee-focused environmental consulting firm providing technical, regulatory, and strategic services to clients across a range of industries. We help clients understand and cost-effectively manage past and on-going environmental liabilities.

We are looking for an experienced Management of Contaminated Sites practitioner to join our Cincinnati office and help enhance this service line and complement our presence in the Midwest.

This is an opportunity for a proven seller-doer—someone who enjoys both developing client relationships and leading the technical execution of projects. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of environmental consulting experience, a strong understanding of contaminated site investigation and remediation practices, and a demonstrated ability to generate new business and expand existing client relationships.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Managing Consultant – Management of Contaminated Sites, you will play a key role in building EDGE's contaminated sites practice in the Midwest and serving as a trusted advisor to clients.

You will have the autonomy and responsibility to:

  • Develop and maintain relationships with industrial, commercial, and institutional clients.
  • Identify opportunities to help clients address environmental liabilities and regulatory requirements.
  • Generate new business through existing relationships, networking, proposal development, and direct business development.
  • Lead and manage contaminated site investigation, remediation, and environmental liability projects.
  • Serve as a senior technical and strategic advisor to clients.
  • Develop scopes of work, budgets, and proposals and negotiate project terms.
  • Manage project teams, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, and client expectations.
  • Mentor and develop less-experienced professionals.
  • Collaborate with EDGE's other technical and service-line leaders to identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Help shape and grow EDGE's contaminated sites capabilities and market presence in the Midwest.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will have:

  • 10+ years of environmental consulting experience, preferably with significant experience in contaminated site management.
  • Demonstrated experience with site investigation, remediation, environmental due diligence, corrective action, or related environmental liability management.
  • A strong understanding of federal and state environmental regulations applicable to contaminated sites.
  • A demonstrated track record of business development and client relationship management.
  • Experience developing proposals, scopes, budgets, and client presentations.
  • Strong project management and financial management skills.
  • The ability to communicate complex environmental issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary project teams.
  • A practical, business-oriented approach to solving client problems.
  • A strong professional network and established relationships within the environmental consulting or industrial marketplace are highly desirable.
  • Professional licensure or certification (PE, PG, CHMM, etc.) is a plus.

The EDGE Seller-Doer

This role is not intended to be purely a project-management, technical or marketing position.

We're looking for someone who has a combination of these skills and wants to build on our past success.

If you have built a book of business, managed significant client relationships, or have a strong network of clients and referral sources, we want to talk with you.

Why EDGE?

At EDGE, experienced professionals have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact without getting lost in layers of corporate bureaucracy. We value initiative, technical excellence, client service, and entrepreneurial thinking.

This position offers the opportunity to:

  • Help build a growing regional practice.
  • Work directly with senior leadership and major clients.
  • Have meaningful influence over the direction of the business.
  • Develop and mentor a team.
  • Pursue the types of clients and projects where you can create the greatest value.
  • Participate in the growth of EDGE's broader environmental consulting platform.

Compensation & Benefits

EDGE offers a competitive compensation and benefits package commensurate with experience, including opportunities for performance-based compensation tied to individual and company success.

Interested?

If you are an experienced contaminated sites professional who is ready to combine technical leadership, client service, and business development in a growing environmental consulting firm, we would like to hear from you.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Resident Account Specialist
description:

title: AutoTEM technician
description:

Your day-to-day tasks will involve preparing ultra-thin specimens and conducting TEM (Transmission Electron Microscopy) analysis to support process/product development, qualification, and failure analysis. This position is critical to ensuring high-quality materials characterization and supporting Intel's engineering innovation through precise and reliable data. Business Group The Intel Foundry team is responsible for delivering cutting-edge manufacturing solutions that enable Intel's broader goals of advancing semiconductor technology. This group focuses on empowering process and product development through innovative sample preparation, imaging, and analysis techniques, enabling Intel to maintain its leadership in technology development.
