Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Why Syneos Health

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Uses SAS or other software to develop custom programming code to generate summary tables, data listings, graphs and derived datasets as specified in the statistical analysis plan and programming specifications.
  • Works to ensure that outputs meet quality standards and project requirements. Performs validation programming and works with other Programmers, Biostatisticians, and other project team members to resolve discrepancies or any findings. Keeps project team members informed of programming progress and issues requiring their attention. Follow applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, testing, and verification/quality control documents and programs ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects at a time, sets goals based on priorities from management, and adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload. Develops specifications for datasets and outputs of any complexity according to statistical and sponsor requirements. Anticipates and addresses potential programming issues, reflects forethought, establishes the basis for efficient programming and accurately defines all variables to be accepted by peer review and sponsor/requestor with little rework.
  • Prepares in advance for internal meetings, contributes ideas, and demonstrates respect for opinions of others.

Follows action items through to completion, and maintains order and focus of meetings, working toward consensus. Displays willingness to work with others and assist with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business. Negotiates and establishes accurate time estimates for completion of study programming activities with internal team members and statistical programming management, and completes project programming activities within timeframe allotted.
  • Acts as the lead statistical programmer. Directs the programming activities of other programming personnel and monitors progress on programming deliverables. Reviews project documentation such as Statistical Analysis Plan, mock shells, programming specifications, annotated CRFs, and SAS database design. Provides feedback to the appropriate project team members which reflects forethought and reduces inefficiencies in programming activities.
  • Participates in sponsor meetings, kickoff meetings, and bid defense meetings as statistical programming representative, as required by sponsor. Contributes to the mentoring of programming personnel through developing training courses, presenting training materials, reviewing work, and providing feedback or guiding new associates in process. Transfers deliverables. Performs other work-related duties as assigned.

  • Extensive programming experience in SAS or other required software, preferably in a clinical trial environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Head Corporate Security & Investigations (NN Group/CSI)
description:
The Head of Corporate Security & Investigations (“Head CSI”) is responsible for protecting the people, assets, information and reputation of NN Group globally. The role sets and drives the global Corporate Security & Investigations strategy and standards and advises the Management Board (“MB”) and other senior executives on current and emerging security and integrity risks, ensuring timely senior-level attention and action. The Head CSI acts as a trusted advisor to NN Group’s senior management and leads NN Group’s investigations capability, while ensuring an integrated approach to corporate personal and physical security and enhanced screening.


What you are going to do

As Head CSI, you will lead NN Group’s global investigations capability and provide strategic direction for corporate personal and physical security and integrity-sensitive screening. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, bringing the authority, presence and credibility required to influence decision-making and ensure that security and integrity considerations are understood and acted upon at all levels. You will lead complex and sensitive investigations, advise the Management Board and other senior executives, and help safeguard NN Group’s people, assets, information and reputation.


Key Responsibilities:


Investigations & Integrity:

  • Oversee the global investigations framework to ensure objective and timely assessments of irregularities
  • Ensure effective triage, review and follow-up of reports received through management or relevant reporting channels, including appropriate escalation to senior management or governance bodies where required
  • Identify trends and root causes from investigations to strengthen our control environment
  • Manage the integrity-sensitive screening framework for pre-employment and in-employment assessments

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive, risk-based security strategy across NN Group
  • Set and drive the global Corporate Security & Investigations strategy, ensuring a coherent approach to security, investigations, intelligence, resilience and integrity across NN Group
  • Establish global security and integrity standards, overseeing their governance and monitoring
  • Provide informed advice to the Management Board on emerging security and integrity risks

Security & Resilience:

  • Set and enforce global standards for physical security, executive protection, and travel security
  • Assess geopolitical and societal threats to enhance organisational resilience

Intelligence & Risk:

  • Build a corporate intelligence capability to proactively identify emerging threats
  • Translate geopolitical developments into actionable impact assessments for NN Group
  • Maintain robust relationships with authorities to enhance situational awareness

Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary representative of Corporate Security & Investigations to external partners and regulators
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, HR, and other functions for a unified approach to risk management
  • Cultivate an international network within security and investigations communities for benchmarking and cooperation


What we offer you
NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves.


We offer you:

  • Salary between € 9.700 and € 12.934 (40 hours a week) depending on your knowledge and experience
  • 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary
  • 27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and three Diversity Days
  • A modern pension administered by BeFrank
  • Plenty of training and learning opportunities
  • Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use
  • A company car is provided in accordance with our lease policy

Who you are
You are a seasoned professional with a strong background in corporate security and investigations, equipped with the expertise to navigate complex stakeholder environments. Your extensive experience and educational foundation enable you to approach security challenges with authority, independence, and sound judgment. You thrive in high-pressure situations and possess the leadership qualities necessary to advise senior management effectively.


Education:

  • At least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in Criminology, Law, Public Administration, Business Administration, Security Studies, or a related field
  • Additional training in security, investigations, risk management, or leadership is advantageous

Experience:

  • A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in corporate security, intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, or a comparable environment, ideally within an international or highly regulated organisation
  • Proven track record in a senior international leadership role within a complex stakeholder environment
  • Demonstrable experience in leading or overseeing crisis management, high-impact incidents, and sensitive investigations
  • Experience in advising management boards, executive committees, and supervisory bodies on security, integrity, investigations, and risk-related matters
  • Fluent in both Dutch and English, with strong spoken and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to operate with authority, independence, and sound judgment in sensitive and high-pressure situations

Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Corporate Security Governance
  • Proficient in Internal (Corporate) Investigations
  • Knowledgeable in Crisis Management and Business Continuity
  • Familiar with Insider Risk Management and Executive Protection
  • Expertise in Threat Intelligence and Compliance and Integrity


Who you will work with
You will lead a small team of experienced professionals, supporting their development and helping them achieve their full potential. As a trusted advisor, you will work closely with NN Group’s senior management and Board members, providing clear, risk-based and strategic advice to support informed decision-making. You will build strong relationships across the organisation and collaborate with a broad range of stakeholders to drive alignment, influence outcomes and contribute to the successful delivery of NN Group’s strategic objectives.


Any questions?
Any questions about the process can be directed to Michèle Borsjé, via michele.borsje@nn-group.com.

title: Mid-Level System Test Engineer IRES - SSFB
description:
Position Title: Mid-Level System Test Engineer

Location: Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado Springs, CO

Relocation Assistance: None available at this time

Remote/Telework: NO - Not available for this position

Clearance Type: DoW Secret

Shift: Day shift

Travel Required: Up to 10% of the time

Description of Duties:

Join our Space Systems Test & Integration team supporting the Missile Defense Space Enterprise Architecture (MDSEA) on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract. As a Mid-Level System Test Engineer, you will provide technical guidance for verification, validation, integration, and mission readiness activities across complex satellite ground system environments.

This position requires hands-on experience with space-ground enterprise systems, mission system integration, IT infrastructure, test automation, and DevSecOps-aligned development pipelines. You will guide multidisciplinary engineering teams, support DT/OT test events, and ensure mission-critical systems meet stringent operational requirements.

Who We’re Looking For

A mission-focused test engineer with strong technical experience in system-level testing with satellite ground systems, and the ability to coordinate across multiple vendors, engineering teams, and government stakeholders in secure DoD environments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute system level test strategies, plans, procedures, and verification artifacts.
  • Provide technical guidance that will be used by MDSEA System Engineers to ensure test standardization and performance targets are met
  • Coordinate test activities across multiple vendors, engineering teams, Agile groups, and government stakeholders.
  • Manage the Integrated Master Test Schedule (IMTS) for DT/OT events, integration milestones, and readiness reviews.
  • Conduct functional, integration, regression, performance, cybersecurity, and end to end mission system testing.
  • Validate software builds, configuration changes, and modifications to enterprise satellite ground system components.
  • Test IT infrastructure which includes servers, networks, storage systems, virtualized environments, and mission critical enterprise services.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for seamless integration into a modern DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline to increase test coverage and efficiency.
  • Apply familiarity with DevSecOps/DevOps pipelines to support Infrastructure as Code through automated builds, deployments, and integration workflows.
  • Identify, document, and track system anomalies, lead defect triage and root cause analyses for complex system issues, and coordinate resolution across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Produce test reports, readiness assessments, risk summaries, and technical briefings for leadership and government stakeholders.
  • Support strict configuration management, cybersecurity compliance, and test documentation quality.
  • Provide technical test leadership during integration events, readiness reviews, operational demonstrations, and certification milestones

Resumes, in month and year format, must be submitted with application in order to be considered for the position. The selected candidate may be assigned as an employee for one of our teammate companies.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must have 6, or more, years of general (full-time) work experience
    • May be reduced with completion of advanced education
  • Must have 3, or more, years of directly related experience in complex enterprise IT system testing and integration, underpinned by a solid foundation in systems engineering principles.
  • Must have experience with enterprise IT infrastructure (servers, networks, storage, virtualization, system services).
  • Must have a demonstrated high proficiency in authoring comprehensive test plans and test cases, and leading the execution of complex test campaigns.
  • Must have experience designing or executing test automation solutions.
  • Must have experience coordinating across multiple vendors, engineering teams, Agile environments, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of requirements analysis, verification methodologies, and the Systems Engineering V model.
  • Must have experience decomposing complex systems into testable components.
  • Must be familiar with Agile practices and secure development workflows.
  • Must have an active DoW Secret Security Clearance

Desired Requirements:

  • Have experience with space mission systems or enterprise satellite ground architectures.
  • Have 1, or more, relevant DoW 8570 IAT Level II certifications such as Security+
  • Be able to operate independently within classified DoD environments.
  • Be able to obtain a Top Secret/SCI clearance
  • Be familiar with DevSecOps/DevOps pipelines, CI/CD workflows, automated software deployments, and secure, air-gapped environments.
  • Have a Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related technical field

This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days. If a candidate has not been selected at that time, it will continue to be posted until a suitable candidate is selected or the position is closed.

title: Senior Data Product Manager, Analytical Data Products
description:
Why Genentech

​​​​​​​We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society.

Who We Are

Our Data, Digital,and Analytics (DDA) team is dedicated to solving complex healthcare challenges and improving patient outcomes. Data, Digital and Analytics empowers business partners across Commercial, Medical, and Government Affairs (CMG) to make impactful decisions by leveraging data, analytics, business products, and AI/ML to enable fast, targeted actions in rapidly evolving business contexts.

Data, Digital and Analytics fosters a unified understanding of customers, actions, and outcomes by integrating analytics and insights seamlessly into CMG’s evolving digital, data, and automation platforms, creating scalable solutions and eliminating silos.

In Data, Digital and Analytics, you will work as a trusted, objective advisor and expert, recommending critical decisions and actions to be taken with credibility and a focus on driving measurable impact. You will be part of a thriving culture built on collaboration and innovation.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Data Product Manager, Analytical Data Products, you will drive the development, execution, and optimization of strategic data products across the organization. Reporting directly to the Director for Analytical Data Products, you will operate as a fully autonomous product leader—defining the product vision, leading cross-functional execution, and ensuring alignment with enterprise-wide objectives. You will elevate our data capabilities by championing advanced frameworks, mentoring agile squads, and delivering scalable, high-impact data solutions that drive measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Develop and communicate a clear, value-driven product vision that aligns with Genentech’s broader organizational objectives. Partner with leadership to define comprehensive data product roadmaps, including features, timelines, and cross-product dependencies.

  • Product Lifecycle Leadership: Lead end-to-end execution from strategy through implementation for a complex portfolio of Analytical Data Products. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog to ensure it efficiently addresses both single and multi-business enterprise use cases.

  • Agile Collaboration, Evangelism & Adoption: Champion the product operating model. Actively engage with business leaders and technical end-users (e.g., Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineers) to evangelize the product vision, drive user adoption, foster trust, and lead operational improvements within cross-functional data squads.

  • Stakeholder & Demand Management: Act as the primary strategic liaison between business stakeholders and the data product technology team. Align stakeholders across multiple organizational levels, manage complex demand requests, and negotiate prioritization.

  • Data Quality & Standards Frameworks: Establish and maintain a comprehensive enterprise data quality framework. Define key metrics, identify root-cause issues, and partner with data stewards and engineers to ensure visibility into data integrity and performance.

  • Architectural Guidance: Guide cross-functional teams in adhering to modern data architecture principles, including data mesh, data fabric, Semantic Layer concepts, and FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data standards to ensure maximum scalability, including leading build-vs.-buy evaluations for data tooling.

  • Performance & Value Optimization: Monitor system health, adoption rates, and product usage data in collaboration with Business and IT partners. Drive product innovation through structured experimentation and data-driven decision-making to continuously maximize ROI.

  • Compliance & Governance: Oversee compliance with overarching data governance policies and regulatory standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR). Partner effectively with Legal, Compliance, and Privacy teams to ensure full adherence and mitigate risk.

Who You Are

  • You possess a Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Operations, Marketing, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • You have 5+ years of combined experience in product management, data management, AI, software development, or equivalent experience, with a proven track record of driving strategic and tactical execution.

  • You demonstrate strong technical fluency with big data technologies, relational and non-relational databases, SQL, and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) to effectively inform product and architectural decisions.

  • You possess strong working knowledge of Semantic Layer concepts, data lifecycle management, enterprise data governance frameworks, and FAIR data principles.

  • You are proficient in modern data observability, data quality, governance, and lineage tools (e.g., Informatica Data Quality, Collibra, Monte Carlo).

  • You have exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to evangelize product vision, navigate ambiguous corporate environments, and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

  • You have proven experience collaborating with Legal, Compliance, and Privacy teams to ensure adherence to governance and regulatory standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA or related graduate-level qualification.

  • Professional experience driving digital product operations within life sciences, or other complex, data-rich environments (e.g., technology, finance, CPG, or management consulting).

  • Relevant certifications or advanced training in agile product management, modern cloud data architecture, or enterprise data governance.

  • Experience with customer data strategy, enterprise omnichannel/digital marketing solutions, or complex CRM systems.

  • Experience leading enterprise data or systems projects to establish best practices, leveraging advanced knowledge of workflow tools and automation systems.

Location

  • This role is based in South San Francisco and offers a hybrid schedule, working 3 days per week on campus

  • No relocation benefits are available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $140,300 - $260,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented and resourceful People and Culture Coordinator to join our PnC Services team. This is a hands-on role with a strong focus on HR administration, employee records, HRIS data, documentation and service delivery. The successful candidate will enjoy working with processes, keeping information accurate and complete, and following tasks through to completion.

You will support a broad range of People and Culture activities, including employment documentation, HRIS updates and reporting, onboarding and offboarding, employee inquiries, compliance administration and process improvements. This role is well suited to someone with approximately two years of experience in a similar coordinator, HR administrator or HR generalist role who is comfortable managing recurring administrative work while responding to changing priorities.

If you’re looking for a fast-paced, challenging and fun People & Culture opportunity, this position is for you!

How Will I Make an Impact?

HR systems and services

  • Prepare and process employee documentation, including promotions, transfers, manager changes and other employment updates.
  • Process resignations and employee changes in the HRIS, ensuring records are complete and accurate.
  • Maintain employee records and complete ongoing and ad hoc HRIS data audits.
  • Generate standard HR reports and support employee data requests.
  • Monitor and support workflows and approvals for employee-initiated HRIS changes.
  • Prepare employment verification letters and other routine employee documentation.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding activities for independent contractors.
  • Own the monthly D2L anniversary report and related notifications.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by updating checklists, documenting processes and identifying practical ways to improve how work gets done.
  • Other duties as required.

Employee support and experience

  • Respond to employee inquiries through the PnC Service Desk, PnC News Slack channel and shared email inboxes in a timely, professional and helpful manner.
  • Support the administration and maintenance of PnC requests, workflows and automations in Jira.
  • Coordinate employee recognition activities, including the employee recognition bricks program.
  • Maintain the PnC Spark site, including PnC FAQs and quarterly Spark badge administration.
  • Manage the internal PnC birthday calendar, reminders and notifications.
  • Support emergency weather and contact-page notifications to PnC Business Partners, as needed.

Onboarding and offboarding

  • Support biweekly new-hire orientation sessions.
  • Support new hires through the I-9 verification process and monitor completion of onboarding requirements.
  • Conduct and analyze exit interviews, identify trends and escalate themes or concerns appropriately.

What you’ll bring to the role?

  • A strong interest in and genuine comfort with detailed, recurring administrative work.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • A proactive, resourceful approach; you take ownership, look for answers and move work forward independently.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when working with employee data, records and documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and service-oriented approach.
  • The ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in improving processes and creating practical solutions.
  • The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team.
  • Experience working with an HRIS (Dayforce preferred), employee information system, case-management platform or similar database.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic experience with qualitative and quantitative reporting.
  • Acumen with Artificial Intelligence Tools
  • Knowledge of general HR practices, employee records administration and the handling of confidential information.
  • Knowledge of employment legislation and human rights principles

Suggested Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, Office Administration or a related field.
  • Approximately two years of experience in an HR coordinator, HR administrator, HR generalist or similar role.

D2L operates in a hybrid work environment, with expectation of at least 3 days per week from D2L's HQ in Kitchener, Ontario for this role

This position is to fill an existing vacancy

The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more.

Base Salary Range
$45,000—$60,000 CAD

Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop!

Why we're awesome:

At D2L, we are dedicated to providing you with the tools to do the best work of your life. While some of our perks and benefits may vary depending on location or employment type, we are proud to provide employees with the following through #LifeAtD2L:

  • Impactful work transforming the way the world learns
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Learning and Growth opportunities
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $4,000 CAD for continuing education through our SkillsWave Program
  • 2 Paid Days off for SkillsWave-related activities like exams or final assignments
  • Employee wellbeing (Access to mental health services, EFAP program, financial planning and more)
  • Retirement planning
  • 2 Paid Volunteer Days
  • Competitive Benefits Package
  • Home Internet Reimbursements
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Employee Recognition
  • Social Events
  • Dog Friendly Offices Spaces at our HQ in Kitchener, Winnipeg, Vancouver and Melbourne offices.

title: Product Manager, Data Authorization
description:
The Geospatial Enterprise Open Data Store (GEODS) contract provides integration, design, development, and sustainment for data services in support of the Federal Government.

The Product Manager is responsible for overseeing the development of products from development to operational deployment, guiding Scrum Masters and developers through the requirements process and contributing to a robust, organized Backlog and streamlined Roadmap for the GEODS program.

Work Schedule:

Day shift, Monday through Friday.

Essential Responsibilities:

As a GEODS Product Manager, you will serve as a bridge between the government and one or more Scrum teams, advancing the vision and execution of the GEODS program by completing the following tasks:

  • Backlog Management
    • Prioritize work for one or more Scrum teams, maintaining the team Backlog in Jira and adding to it as feedback is received
    • Assist one or more Scrum teams in developing user stories and acceptance criteria that are clearly understood by developers
    • Review and accept completed work, ensuring it meets defined acceptance criteria
    • Ensure team is always working on highest value approved priorities while avoiding scope creep
  • Requirements Development
    • Work closely with government to bring new efforts through the requirements process
    • Assist the Chief Architect and Chief Engineer in Roadmap development, defining vision for future years of the program
  • Project Management and Execution
    • Oversee projects to ensure successful completion and adherence to timelines
    • Monitor project progress and identify potential issues alongside team Scrum Master
    • Provide contract and government leadership visibility into team progress and impediments, to include reporting (CDRLs, KPIs, etc.)

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:

Office environment, light physical demands, must have ability to attend to mental tasks for the duration of the workday.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Ability to clearly communicate, verbally and in writing, complex technical challenges and obstacles in a clear and direct manner
  • Previous experience supervising a team of developers and engineers in delivering new and updated software interfaces
  • Previous experience serving as a Product Owner or Product Manager
  • Experience utilizing SAFe or similar Agile methodologies
  • Grasp of authentication concepts, including but not limited to OAuth, ABAC and Zero Trust
  • Understanding of common imagery data types, including but not limited to raster, vector, etc.

Security Clearance Required: Active TS/SCI w/ Poly

Minimum Education: Master’s degree with 8 years’ experience, bachelor’s degree with 12 years’ experience, associate's degree with 20 years’ experience, or a minimum of 25 years’ experience, in relevant field

Minimum Years of Experience: Master’s degree with 8 years’ experience, bachelor’s degree with 12 years’ experience, associate's degree with 20 years’ experience, or a minimum of 25 years’ experience, in relevant field

description:
Pest Control Technician – Career Opportunity
Braman Termite & Pest Elimination

This might be the career you didn’t know was an option.
If you’re looking for something stable, hands-on, and long-term — this is an opportunity to learn a trade and build a career.
At Braman, we train you from the ground up and provide the tools to grow into a licensed professional.
About the Position: Braman Termite & Pest Elimination is seeking qualified Pest Control Technicians to join our growing team. Here at Braman we are committed to properly training and keeping our technicians up to date on the latest advancements in the industry. We are looking for ambitious individuals ready to begin a fascinating career path filled with opportunities for growth and advancement.   • 401K retirement plan- With company match!

Braman is a fourth-generation, family-owned company with over 135 years of history. We’ve grown from a small local business into a trusted industry leader—but what’s stayed the same is how we operate.

title: Intern, Taxation
company: Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd.
description:
Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group is looking for a motivated and curious Taxation Intern to join our team for a four-month co-op term from January to April 2027.

This isn't a co-op where you'll spend four months doing the same task. You'll work alongside experienced tax and finance professionals and gain hands-on exposure to a variety of businesses and investment sectors, including Infrastructure, Real Estate, Private Equity and our internal corporate operations. If you're interested in accounting and tax but still figuring out where you want your career to take you, this role offers an opportunity to explore different areas of tax while building practical skills that will carry forward into your career and CPA journey.

At CC&L Financial Group, you'll have the opportunity to see how tax supports a diverse financial organization and gain exposure to businesses and transactions you may not encounter in the classroom. You'll work with a team that values accuracy, collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development. By the end of your term, our goal is for you to leave with stronger technical skills, greater confidence working with financial and tax information, and a much better understanding of what a career in tax can look like.

As part of the Tax team, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Gain hands-on tax experience across partnerships, trusts and corporations.
  • Develop your technical skills by applying accounting and tax concepts to real-world transactions and financial statements.
  • Build your Excel skills by creating, improving and maintaining tax calculations, provisions and working papers.
  • Learn how a corporate tax function operates and how tax interacts with accounting, investments and other areas of the business.
  • Contribute to meaningful work with real deadlines and deliverables rather than hypothetical assignments.
  • Work directly with experienced professionals and learn how they approach complex tax and business issues.
  • Develop experience that can provide a strong foundation for a future career in tax, accounting, finance or investments.

What You Will Do

No two weeks will look exactly the same. Depending on our filing cycle and current projects, you'll assist the team with responsibilities such as:

  • Preparing and assisting with partnership, trust and corporate income tax returns.
  • Performing financial statement and account reconciliations to support tax filings and calculations.
  • Assisting with the quarterly tax provision for the parent company.
  • Supporting tax payment calculations and tracking balances for affiliated companies.
  • Helping the team manage and meet various tax filing and payment deadlines.
  • Supporting tax audits and inquiries from Canadian and other tax authorities.
  • Researching and helping respond to tax-related questions from teams across CC&L Financial Group.
  • Creating, developing and improving Excel-based tax calculations, provision models and working papers.
  • Identifying opportunities to make our existing tax processes more efficient and effective.
  • Helping develop clear tax summaries, templates and materials for senior management and other decision-makers.

What You Bring

This opportunity is designed for students who are eager to learn and interested in developing a career in accounting, tax or finance.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Are currently in the third or fourth year of an undergraduate program, or an MBA program, with a focus on Accounting, Taxation, Finance or a related field.
  • Have an interest in pursuing your CPA designation.
  • Have a strong understanding of fundamental accounting concepts and are interested in applying them in a practical environment.
  • Have some knowledge of Canadian taxation or tax preparation through coursework or previous work experience.
  • Are comfortable working in Microsoft Excel and interested in continually improving and automating working papers.
  • Enjoy working with numbers and analyzing financial information.
  • Have strong attention to detail and take pride in producing high-quality work.
  • Can manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Are comfortable asking questions and communicating with different people across an organization.
  • Are curious, proactive and willing to learn.
  • Experience with Taxprep or other tax preparation software is an asset but not required. We're looking for someone with the right foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn.

To apply for this position please submit your resume, cover letter and transcript.

The salary range for this position is $50,000-$55,000.The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

title: Project Controls Specialist
description:
What You'll Be Doing

Job Scope: The Project Controls Specialist is generally responsible for planning and scheduling heavy industrial engineering projects, monitoring project costs and/or estimating projects. Work will be performed under close supervision in our Angleton office.

Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

title: Senior Risk Management Consultant - Professions
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Risk Control

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

We're looking for an enthusiastic and commercially minded Senior Risk Management Consultant to join our Professions team in London, working across a portfolio that spans solicitors, accountants, surveyors and engineers. In this interesting and varied role, you'll analyse claims data to identify trends and recurring errors, advise clients on how to manage and mitigate their exposures, and work closely with underwriters to provide insight on risk and regulatory issues.

You'll be a confident communicator who thrives in front of an audience — whether that's presenting to insured firms on how to reduce their risk, organising and hosting client risk seminars, or engaging with professional bodies and third-party organisations. If you're passionate about helping professional services firms understand and manage their risks more effectively, and come from a legal, underwriting, claims or risk management background we’d love to hear from you.

Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion.

What Will You Do?

  • Supports and develops the Travelers value added risk management proposition across the Professions portfolio.
  • Advises customers on risk management issues, by responding to requests for information and advice.
  • Coordinates visit requests from underwriters and proactively contacts in conjunction with fellow risk managers direct insureds (and non-direct cases via their broker) paying more than £10,000 premium to ensure they have been made aware of our risk management offering.
  • Visits customers- firms, either at their request or at the request of the underwriters, and prepares a report dealing with current risk exposure, claims history (if appropriate) and ways in which they could reduce risk. This includes advising the underwriters as to the perception of future risk that the firm may present.
  • Researches and prepares written materials, including Gazette columns, items for the solicitor's bulletin, and any other articles that may be requested, either in house or for external publications.
  • Researches, prepares and presents seminars, in-house to customers at their request, or for external bodies such as local Law Societies, or other organisations (e.g. CLT) as requested.
  • Researches, develops and prepares relevant materials (such as the Risk Management factsheets, best practice guides).
  • Assists the underwriters as requested with advice on legal or professional practice issues.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • University degree and/or Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) Certification.
  • Working knowledge of insurance/underwriting.
  • Working knowledge of organizational and regulatory rules, policies and procedures and effectively employs that knowledge in day to day work activities.
  • Intermediate Relationship Management: Seeks out, builds, fosters and maintains productive relationships or alliances to meet goals and achieve objectives.
  • Basic Business Perspective: Uses knowledge of internal and external factors that impact the Lloyd's Market to make decisions.
  • Intermediate Analytical Thinking/Financial Acumen: Identifies current or future problems or opportunities, analyzes, synthesizes and compares information to understand issues, identifies cause/effect relationships, and explores alternatives to support sound decision making.
  • Intermediate Product/Technical: Demonstrates technical proficiency and application of knowledge commensurate to his/her experience.
  • Makes sound risk recommendations that are in the Company's best interests.
  • Intermediate Regulatory and Compliance: Understands, adheres to, applies and enforces Corporate policies, procedures and standards, and complies with Travelers' regulatory obligations.

What is a Must Have?

  • General knowledge of risk management process.

What Is in It for You?

  • Private Medical Insurance: On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.
  • Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution.
  • Holiday Entitlement: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.
  • Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.


If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.


Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

title: Women's Health NP/PA - West Hollywood, CA - Onsite
location: Los Angeles, California, United States; West Hollywood, California, United States
description:
About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people rather than as separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, and wellness across in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes and creating a better experience for patients and providers.

About the Role

We are hiring a Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant with strong gynecology and women’s health experience to join our West Hollywood clinic.

Our greatest current need is for a provider who can independently evaluate and manage a broad range of gynecologic, reproductive health, and sexual health concerns. This is not a general primary care-focused opening.

Because Tia treats women as whole people, you will also address related preventive, behavioral health, and common outpatient needs within scope, while coordinating with Tia’s broader clinical team when additional care is needed.

Why Tia

  • Protected time for documentation, care coordination, and team collaboration
  • AI-supported documentation designed to reduce charting burden
  • Beautiful, thoughtfully designed clinics
  • Quarterly bonus and equity
  • The opportunity to help shape a new model for women’s healthcare
  • A multidisciplinary model supporting coordinated in-person and virtual care

What You’ll Do

  • Provide preventive and problem-based gynecology care through both in-person and virtual visits
  • Provide annual exams, contraception counseling, STI care, cervical cancer screening follow-up, pregnancy confirmation, and pregnancy-options counseling
  • Evaluate and manage concerns including PCOS, fibroids, endometriosis, abnormal bleeding, pelvic pain, fertility, menopause and perimenopause, sexual wellness, and vaginal, vulvar, urinary, or genital symptoms
  • Perform physical examinations, specimen collection, testing, and procedures during in-person care within your training, licensure, credentialing, and Tia’s clinical scope
  • Determine when concerns can be managed virtually and when patients require an in-person examination, testing, imaging, specialty referral, procedural care, or a higher level of care
  • Address related primary care, preventive, and behavioral health concerns within scope
  • Review results, develop care plans, communicate next steps, and coordinate follow-up
  • Collaborate with physicians, APPs, nurses, mental health clinicians, operations, and clinical leadership
  • Use technology, data, and clinical protocols to support high-quality, evidence-based care

What You’ll Bring

Requirements

  • Active California NP or PA license
  • Current national board certification, such as ANCC, AANP, NCC, or NCCPA
  • Active DEA registration, or ability to obtain before starting
  • 2+ years of independent outpatient clinical experience
  • Significant experience independently managing gynecologic, reproductive health, and sexual health concerns
  • Strong judgment regarding which concerns can be safely managed virtually and which require in-person evaluation
  • Strong clinical judgment and patient communication skills
  • Commitment to inclusive, culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and patient-centered care
  • Comfort working within a collaborative, technology-enabled care model

We are especially interested in candidates with:

  • Core experience in gynecology, women’s health, reproductive health, fertility, or sexual health
  • Broad experience across both gynecology and primary care, with substantial gynecology-focused responsibility

Preferred Qualifications

  • Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner certification or another women’s health-focused background
  • Experience managing menopause, contraception, abnormal bleeding, PCOS, endometriosis, fibroids, fertility, pelvic pain, or sexual health concerns
  • Experience performing gynecology procedures within APP scope
  • Prior telehealth experience
  • Experience in an integrated or multidisciplinary care setting

Training and Development

Candidates must join with a strong existing foundation in outpatient gynecology and women’s health.

Additional training may be provided in areas such as virtual care pathways, menopause care, sexual wellness, weight management, medical dermatology, procedural scope, and Tia’s clinical workflows and technology.

Work Location and Schedule

This is an in person role based in our West Hollywood clinic.

Compensation and Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, role level, scheduled hours, business needs, and market conditions.

The expected base salary range for a full-time schedule is $140,000 to $170,000, depending on level and experience.

You are also eligible for:

  • Quarterly performance bonus with a 10% target
  • Equity grants
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k
  • Malpractice coverage
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays
  • CME stipend and licensing reimbursement
  • Access to clinical tools and ongoing training resources

#LI-AF1

About Tia

Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our “Whole Woman, Whole Life” model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in-person care and a national virtual platform.

We are a Series D, venture-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women.

About Tia’s Culture

Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women.

This position may require attendance at company and team off-sites.

Scam Notice

Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact peopleservices@asktia.com.

Equal Opportunity

Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high-quality work, and making waves in women’s healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

Description of Duties:

The Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) Specialist supports the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract.

As a key member of our Reliability Team on the Integrated Research and Development for Enterprise Solutions (IRES) contract, the Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) Specialist supports critical Missile Defense Agency (MDA) facility infrastructure. In this role, you will perform advanced condition monitoring and predictive diagnostics on building mechanical and electrical systems to prevent unplanned downtime and ensure mission readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct machinery health inspections utilizing predictive maintenance (PdM) tools (Thermography, Ultrasound, and Vibration Analysis, etc.).
  • Act as the primary specialist responsible for precision equipment lubrication, utilizing ultrasound-assisted greasing techniques to prevent bearing failure and optimize equipment lifespan.
  • Use the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to log, track, and document predictive work orders.
  • Partner closely with Reliability Engineers to optimize and scale the Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) program.
  • Interpret complex diagnostic data to identify early-stage equipment degradation and recommend corrective actions.
  • Assist in developing, refining, and executing predictive & preventive maintenance procedures.
  • Perform hands-on troubleshooting and minor corrective actions on faulted equipment identified during diagnostic runs.
  • Demonstrates a high degree of autonomy, with the proven ability to proactively identify facility needs, initiate tasks, and drive maintenance activities to completion without direct supervision or daily instruction.

The successful candidate will:

  • Have strong technical writing capability for drafting diagnostic and inspection findings reports.

Resumes, in month and year format, must be submitted with application in order to be considered for the position. The selected candidate may be assigned as an employee for one of our teammate companies.

Basic Requirements:

  • Must have 2, or more, years of dedicated industrial maintenance and/or CBM experience.
  • Must have hands-on experience navigating a modern CMMS (e.g., IBM Maximo, SAP, or similar).
  • Must hold TWO of the following certifications at start date:
    • Thermography Level 1+
    • Airborne/Structure-borne Ultrasound Level 1+
    • Machinery Vibration Analyst Level 1+ (ISO Category I or higher)
  • Must have the physical capability to climb ladders, navigate industrial spaces, and lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Must have, or obtain, an active DoW Secret Security Clearance

Desired Requirements:

  • Be a Certified Maintenance and Reliability Technician (CMRT) or Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional (CMRP) credentials.
  • Have advanced proficiency with IBM Maximo.
  • Have experience operating within secure DoD environments or supporting MDA mission infrastructure.

title: Senior Solutions Architect I, Pre-Sales - US Government Defense & Intelligence
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Pre-Sales Sr. Solutions Architect, you'll design complex solutions to demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services to help organizations within the United States Defense and Intelligence community overcome their earth data challenges. You'll collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development, to act as the voice of the customer and enhance Planet's industry offerings.

The ideal candidate enjoys helping customers get the most out of their work. This role will appeal to candidates who don't mind frequent travel and are comfortable working in the defense and intelligence sector.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Washington D.C. office located in Arlington, VA 3 days per week. This role requires travel up to 25%.

Impact You'll Own:

  • Architect and deliver solution demonstrations and presentations and highlighting technical capabilities and value of Planet’s offerings and our ability to fulfill customer’s business needs.
  • Build relationships with customers’ technical and management staff as a trusted advisor to their business.
  • Act as a senior technical advisor to the customer to recommend a solutions architecture that fits their business challenges.
  • Craft the technical response to tenders, RFI’s/RFP’s, and unsolicited proposals with respect to Planet’s products and solutions.
  • Partner with your sales team colleagues to architect and drive the technical strategy across customer and prospect account plans, shaping how accounts are engaged and won.
  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to act as the voice of the customer, assist with RFP and RFI preparation and submissions.
  • Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.
  • Represent the needs of Planet's Defense and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback.
  • Present to key executive Government stakeholders within the US Federal Government.
  • Act as a mentor to team members and lead training to drive their development.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in supporting the US Defense and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25%.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience working with GIS and Remote Sensing users within the Defense industry.
  • Experience in IMINT, ISR, and related fields.
  • Experience with QGIS, SocetGXP, ArcGIS, GDAL, Python, other common geospatial software packages and programming languages, and emerging technologies such as AI/ML.
  • Experience designing and presenting complex systems and solutions that bridge the gap between business problems and technology to meet organizational goals, budget, and scalability needs.
  • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive working style.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
  • Ability to process imagery, manipulate geospatial data, interact with APIs, and build data pipelines.
  • Ability to lead technical customer engagements.
  • Ability to run workshops or training sessions with users.
  • Obtaining and maintaining eligibility for a US Government TS/SCI security clearance is required.

We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. title: Commercial Lines Producer
description:
General Responsibilities:

Develop sales marketing plans and place eligible commercial lines accounts per carrier guidelines. Perform annual review and risk exposure analysis of renewal policies for proper coverage, incorporating information obtained from client. Assist clients with claim inquiries and provide important first steps when they report claim initially. Discuss and review exposures with new clients by performing a needs analysis. Inspect premises when applicable to determine eligibility and any deficiencies that might impair the ability to properly place insurance coverage for the client. Document new business discussions with client and make certain file is complete. Maintain client files and ensure proper documentation of any coverage discussions and proposed policy changes. Maintain control of renewal expiration lists, binders, and any aged receivables in accordance with agency guidelines. Respond to client inquiries, incoming e-mail, mail, and company requests on a timely basis. Participate in courses for insurance/sales skills. Maintain current knowledge of underwriting requirements of carriers and establish a relationship with carrier underwriters. Keep current with industry trends by reading appropriate journals and company bulletins. Incidental personal lines sales are permitted. Other tasks as assigned. Participate in any special projects at management’s request.

Essential Duties:

Provide new business sales to continue to add and develop new clients to the agency. In addition, provide assistance to the Agency commercial lines clients to ensure they maintain confidence in the Agency and demonstrate it is operating for their benefit.

1.) Greet and serve customers in a timely, friendly, and courteous manner.

2.) Develop marketing strategies and goals.

3.) Answer phone or electronic correspondence from clients to respond on a timely basis.

4.) Develop client relationship by reviewing their insurance program, making recommendations and obtaining various options at their request.

5.) Take claim reports from clients and proceed with reporting to the insurance carrier. Provide basic guidance to the client as to the next steps in the claim process. In event of a major or severe claim, notify management of the loss.

6.) Document client conversations on the agency management system with details of the specifics as to the nature of the conversation and resolution.

7.) Attach appropriate documentation to the client’s electronic file.

8.) Cross sell other lines of products or refer the client to the personal lines producer to discuss additional needs if applicable.

9.) Provide proper directions to the personal lines account manager with regard to endorsements and obtain the appropriate signatures as needed.

10.) Review renewal expiration list for potential remarketing of accounts and account rounding opportunities.

11.) Perform rewrites of in-force policies when applicable.

12.) Review policy endorsements for accuracy once received from the insurance carrier.

13.) Compare issued policies to requested coverage for the application.

14.) Respond to underwriting inquiries on new and renewal accounts.

title: IT Security Engineer
description:
Corporate

At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives.

We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.

Due to the on‑site requirements of this position, applicants are expected to reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the designated work location (Chelmsford, MA). This role does not offer relocation.

About the Role

We are looking for a Vulnerability Management & Security Engineer to help strengthen our enterprise cybersecurity program. In this role, you will operate and improve vulnerability management capabilities, analyze security risk, coordinate remediation with technical teams, and help reduce exposure across a complex global technology environment.

This is a hands-on technical role with strong cross-functional visibility. You will work closely with Infrastructure, End User Services, Cloud Operations, application teams, and Security Operations to identify, prioritize, communicate, and validate remediation of vulnerabilities that matter most to the business.

What You'll Do

  • Operate, administer, and continuously improve enterprise vulnerability management platforms, including Tenable and related technologies.
  • Define and maintain vulnerability scanning strategies across servers, workstations, network devices, cloud resources, web applications, and externally exposed assets.
  • Analyze vulnerability findings and prioritize remediation using exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, business impact, and risk context.
  • Partner with technical teams to drive remediation of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities through verified closure.
  • Improve scan coverage, authenticated assessment rates, asset visibility, vulnerability discovery accuracy, and reporting quality.
  • Develop dashboards, metrics, and reports that show vulnerability aging, SLA performance, asset coverage, exposure trends, remediation progress, and risk reduction.
  • Support exception reviews, compensating-control analysis, escalation activities, and evidence collection for audit-ready vulnerability management practices.
  • Contribute to broader cybersecurity engineering initiatives, including endpoint security, identity security, cloud security, Zero Trust, security hardening, threat hunting, and exposure reduction.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of cybersecurity, infrastructure, or security engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or supporting enterprise vulnerability management programs.
  • Hands-on experience with Tenable or equivalent vulnerability assessment platforms.
  • Experience supporting vulnerability remediation across large, decentralized, or complex technology environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of vulnerability scoring, risk-based prioritization, CVSS, CIS Benchmarks, NIST guidance, and industry vulnerability management practices.
  • Ability to translate technical security findings into clear remediation guidance and practical business risk context.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cybersecurity certification such as CISSP, GIAC, CySA+, Security+, CVA, or similar.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with vulnerability management platforms, security operations technologies, IT service management or CMDB platforms, cloud security technologies, scripting, APIs, or Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Experience developing dashboards, operational metrics, executive-ready reporting, or audit evidence for cybersecurity programs.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

  • Improve vulnerability scan coverage and reliability across key enterprise asset populations.
  • Strengthen risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking for critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.
  • Deliver clear reporting that helps technical teams and leadership understand exposure, aging, remediation progress, and risk reduction.
  • Build strong working relationships with Security, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, End User Services, application teams, and other remediation partners.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive vulnerability management workflows and improve operational efficiency.

Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients' lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. title: QC Inspector - Receiving
description:
About us

Silent-Aire, a division of Johnson Controls, is a global leader in owner equipment manufacturing (OEM) dedicated to providing custom solutions for data center customers. Our product line includes large-scale equipment such as air handling units and modular data centers. We pride ourselves on innovation, quality, and delivering tailored solutions to meet our clients' unique needs.

Overview

The Receiving Inspector is responsible for ensuring all incoming materials, components, and equipment meet defined quality standards and specifications before release to production. This role plays a critical part in maintaining product integrity, supplier quality, and overall manufacturing excellence.

Roles & Responsibilities

Incoming Inspection and Verification

  • Perform inspections of incoming materials, components, and assemblies against engineering drawings, specifications, and purchase requirements.
  • Verify dimensional, visual, and functional compliance using appropriate inspection tools.
  • Review certificates of conformance (CoCs), material test reports (MTRs), and Supplier documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify nonconforming materials and initiate containment actions.

Quality Control & Documentation

  • Accurately record inspection results in quality systems (ERP/MES or inspection databases).
  • Completed inspection reports and maintain traceability of materials and components.
  • Support maintenance of incoming inspection procedures, checklists, and work instructions.

Nonconformance Management

  • Raise and process Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) for rejected materials.
  • Evaluate disposition (use-as-is, rework, reject) in collaboration with Quality Engineering.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams on corrective actions.

Supplier Quality Support

  • Provide feedback to Supplier Quality and Procurement on supplier performance.
  • Assist in supplier evaluation, audits, and development initiatives as needed.
  • Monitor recuring defects and identify trends in supplier quality issues.

Measurement & Equipment Handling

  • Uses and maintain precision measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, height gauges, bore gauges, and CMM (if applicable).
  • Ensure inspection tools are calibrated and in proper working condition.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Purchasing, Warehouse, Engineering, and Production teams.
  • Support material disposition decisions to minimize production delays while ensuring compliance.
  • Perform all duties in accordance with Silent‑Aire Limited Partnership safety program standards and the Alberta Occupational Health and Safety Act, Regulations, and Code.
  • Support and participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to safe‑work practices.
  • Performs all duties in accordance with Silent-Aire Limited Partnership safety program standards and Alberta Occupational Health and Safety Act, Regulations, and Code.
  • Other duties may be assigned as deemed necessary.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Technical diploma, certification, or equivalent experience in Quality, Manufacturing, or a related field.
  • 2 to 5 years of quality control or receiving inspection experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings; knowledge of GD&T and quality standards (ISO 9001, AS9100, API, or similar) preferred.
  • Proficient in inspection methods, measurement tools, and ERP/QMS systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to work independently, make sound quality decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrates accountability, integrity, a quality-focused mindset, and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable in a manufacturing and warehouse environment.

• Document control systems proficiency; Microsoft Office.

  • Understanding of inspection workflows (assembly/electrical/welding) to validate completeness.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships.
  • Works effectively on individual tasks, maintaining productivity and accountability with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to prioritize tasks, resolve issues, and consistently meet deadlines.

Working Conditions

  • Manufacturing/commercial/industrial environment with PPE.
  • Potential exposure to energized systems under controlled procedures.
  • Must have the ability to stand for extended periods throughout each shift.
  • Overtime may be available occasionally with work volume.

Contacts

  • Quality team, Electrical Leads, Production Supervisors, Engineering.
