title: Principal DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, Denver, Boston, Remote

Who Are We?

About Airlock Digital:

Airlock Digital is a global leader in application control and allowlisting. We seek to empower every organization to run only what they trust and operate free from malware and ransomware.

With rapid growth across Australia, North America, and EMEA. We are committed to our core values, respect, determination, and integrity. We support a diverse and expanding global customer base. At Airlock, we pride ourselves on being a team of humble, collaborative, and driven professionals who support one another and share a passion for cybersecurity.

What We are Looking For:

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to improve the systems Airlock Digital uses to build, test, secure, and release its customer-hosted and multi-tenant SaaS products. You will work across engineering to design reliable delivery workflows, apply and improve team standards, and help product teams ship dependable software with less manual effort.

Our delivery environment spans cloud services, customer-hosted products, native endpoint software, Linux packages, containers, and signed installers. You will build and support the systems that test, secure, promote, and release them, working with engineering, product, QA, security, and support.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the reliability and continual improvement of the CI/CD and release systems you maintain for cloud services and native software across Windows, macOS, and Linux. Design and implement reusable workflows with product teams, using delivery measures and engineering judgment to identify risks, remove bottlenecks, and improve release confidence.
  • Implement and maintain pull request and branch policies, including permissions, merge checks, approvals, and security controls. Work with product teams to build dependable gates for unit, integration, end-to-end, packaging, upgrade, and platform-compatibility tests.
  • Improve deployment observability, alerting, and release readiness. Partner with engineering teams to investigate build, deployment, and release failures, and use incident findings to improve release safety and recovery.
  • Implement and improve software supply-chain controls with engineering and security teams, including automated security checks, artifact integrity, and auditable release promotion. Protect CI credentials and signing material through least-privilege access and managed secret stores.
  • Modernize existing build and release workflows while preserving supported operating systems, architectures, installation paths, and upgrade behavior.
  • Troubleshoot complex delivery failures, review automation changes, and mentor engineers in reliable build and release practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering or DevOps experience, including ownership of complex production build, test, deployment, and release systems, contributions to technical design and standards, and support for other engineers.
  • Strong experience building and operating CI/CD systems. This should include Git pull request controls, branch policies, change-management integration, and quality gates for several types of automated testing.
  • Experience writing, testing, and maintaining automation code in a programming or scripting language, with attention to readability, error handling, and code review.
  • Production experience delivering cloud services, including secrets management, environment promotion and rollback, observability, alerting, and incident response.
  • Working knowledge of software supply-chain security, with hands-on experience in areas such as vulnerability management, artifact integrity, signing credentials, provenance, or auditable release controls.
  • Experience automating builds, packaging, signing, or releases on at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux, with the ability to learn and troubleshoot delivery workflows across additional platforms.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience with application control, endpoint security, or another security-critical product where release integrity and auditability matter.
  • Experience delivering and operating production services on Azure.
  • Experience building self-service developer tooling used by multiple product teams.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required; equivalent practical experience is welcomed.

What We Offer:

We don’t think money is everything, but we know it is an important part of your decision to apply for a role. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include responsibilities of the job, education, location, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal equity, alignment with market data, or applicable laws.

At Airlock Digital we offer a wide range of benefits to our eligible team members. Our benefit programs vary by location and can include Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 401K Plan with 4% Company Match – Life and Disability Programs – Paid Parental Leave - Paid time off and Paid Holidays – Volunteer and Birthday Time off – Home Office Allowance

Our Commitment:

We believe in supporting our team members both personally and professionally. Named one of the USA’s Greatest Places to Work in 2024 and 2025, we value flexibility, trust, and a work environment that empowers our team to do their best work.

We will be assessing applications as they come in, so we encourage you to send your resume through to us as soon as possible. All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official BambooHR document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience. No contact from recruitment agencies, thank you

Job Summary

The Healthcare Economics (HCE) team's primary function is to provide various clinical and financial analyses to management to support the business decision process. The healthcare data analyst will be responsible for compiling, verifying, and analyzing data for trend and other analyses related to clinical, provider, and senior management requirements. Analyze data in order to uncover underlying utilization patterns and identify clinical and medical delivery drivers of trends. Examples of data analyses include, but are not limited to: identifying and tracking members for disease and case management, incentive and rewards programs, monitoring and evaluation of performance-based contracting, analysis of demographic mix, benefit changes, fee schedule updates, medical trends and marketing evaluation of expansion opportunities.
  • Analyze data for quality improvement studies and analysis (quantitative and qualitative) including trending, statistical analysis, and complex drill down of data to evaluate root causes.
  • Maintain and automate reports to support productivity and return on investment programs.
  • Verify and analyze report data and prepare documentation of processes needed for development and improvement of applications. Help implement improved applications and processes, where appropriate.

Reporting to the Vice President of Vendor and Strategic Transformation Management, the Reporting Analyst - AVP will support the Chief Corporate Services Office by developing, maintaining, and advancing procurement reporting across Third-Party Risk Management, Strategic Sourcing, Contracts, Accounts Payable, and Corporate Workspace Solutions.

title: Module Development Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Join Intel - and build a better tomorrow. Intel is in the midst of an exciting transformation, with a vision to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth. Join us and help us create the next generation of technologies that will shape the future for decades to come.

Engineers within Intel's Logic Technology Development (LTD) organization are chartered with continuing to meet the challenge of Moore's Law in the 21st century. We innovate leading edge fabrication processes and continue to overcome seemingly impossible barriers as tolerances and specifications for building best-in-class computing devices become increasingly rigorous.

The role of a Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Process Development Engineer in LTD encompasses developing and sustaining planarization techniques for a variety of materials and architectures, enabling rapid miniaturization in the semiconductor industry and the mass production of integrated circuits. CMP techniques leverage physics, chemistry, materials science and surface science concepts, and exist at the intersection of these disciplines. As a result, our team has a diverse set of scientific backgrounds that relies on strong collaboration and shared learning.

The role’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Drives technology development and enablement for both high volume manufacturing and future technology, provides process integration and equipment solutions, and performs feasibility studies to meet desired device specifications

  • Leads design and development of technically sophisticated manufacturing processes and/or repair reverse engineering including material selection, parameter optimization, equipment metrology, and system design to enable new product designs and functional requirements

  • Performs pathfinding activities in support of process and hardware development enabling manufacturing of innovative device architectures and develops roadmaps for technologies enabling future roadmap

  • Recommends and implements modifications for operating equipment to improve production efficiency, manufacturing techniques, and optimizing production output for existing products

  • Partners with key equipment and materials suppliers to develop and implement enabling elements of the technology

  • Performs process technology feasibility studies through theoretical simulations and/or practical engineering methods

  • Remains updated on relevant industrial process and material manufacturing technical trends and develops view of inherent future Intel process technology needs to push industry forward by partnering with vendor ecosystem to build cost sensitive roadmap

Qualifications:

You must possess the minimum qualifications below to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Computer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science, or a Semiconductor-related STEM (Science Technology Engineering Math) field of study (with a focus on hands-on experimental research).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Statistics Coursework, Statistical Process Control (SPC) or Design of Experiments (DOE) principles, and engineering analysis tools

  • Experimental lab work

  • Semiconductor and transistor device physics

  • Advanced transistor device structures and architectures including fabrication (e.g., lithography, etch, film deposition, cleans, chemical-mechanical planarization, etc.) with in-depth knowledge of semiconductor device physics and process integration

  • Data analysis skills with demonstrated ability to construct clear data-based problem statements

  • Semiconductor processing fundamentals (lithography, wet etch, dry etch, chemical and or mechanical polishing, etc.)

  • Design of experiments

  • Materials and physical device characterization (SEM, TEM, etc.) and fundamentals of semiconductor device testing

  • Statistical, data analysis (MATLAB, Excel, JMP, etc.)

description:
Eversource will not offer immigration-related sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B, O-1, J-1, TN, E-3, etc.). Applicants requiring visa sponsorship to start employment with Eversource will not be considered.


This is a Hooksett Troubleshooter Day shift. Hours are 06:00 AM - 6:00 PM on a rotating 3-2-2-3 shift.

THIS IS A FULLY QUALIFIED POSITION

Starting Rate of Pay: $60.78 per hour

Position Description: Dayshift Troubleshooter

Troubleshooters generally work as a single man crew. Individuals will work on energized and de-energized lines and equipment, at all voltage levels, utilizing approved work methods, equipment, and tools in accordance with current training levels. Responsibilities include identifying and isolating faulty primary and secondary equipment; operating switching devices on overhead and URD systems. work with Field Electricians on overhead and underground systems; clearing faulty and unsafe conditions including maintaining, restoring electrical service; connecting, disconnecting, and operating portable transformers, generators, and temporary primary jumpers to restore service under emergency or urgent conditions. working with the Substation group to connect mobile substations; replacing failed transformers with the assistance of another qualified person; replacing damaged or faulty services during the initial response or as a follow up corrective maintenance after a temporary repair has been made; repairing and re-energizing primary; performing street light installation and repair; installing and removing protective covers; performing overhead and underground inspections and patrols and performing additional security, perimeter and emergency inspections of substations as necessary; making current and voltage measurements as required; directing the work of other Lineworkers assigned or necessary to assist with emergency conditions; applying standards, operating procedures, services requirements, and safe operating practices relating to the work without reference to notes on work of a recurring nature; operating and adjusting overhead and pad-mounted controlled equipment inspections as required.

Position Requirements:

Familiarity with line crew work gained through a total of at least four years’ line related experience and obtaining a Lineworker I classification or the equivalent is required. Individuals must have mechanical aptitude, a thorough knowledge of the electric transmission and distribution system, be analytical, alert, resourceful, and a work history that demonstrates safe work habits. The ability to climb is required. Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions, day or night. Ability to perform physically demanding work, including climbing, lifting, and working aloft in a bucket and in confined spaces. Must be able to respond to storm emergencies, extended shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays as required. Must obtain and maintain a New Hampshire High/Medium Voltage License. A Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL) Class B rating is required. You must also have the ability to obtain a CDL Class A rating with an "0" endorsement within six months of hire.

Education:

You must possess a high school diploma or equivalent (GED).

External candidates must successfully complete and pass a written and practical test before an offer is made for a Troubleshooter position.

This is a Day-Shift Troubleshooter position, rotational shift 6am – 6pm. This is a 3-2-2-3 rotation.

title: Home-Based Controller
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Number of Openings: 1

Hiring Priority: Active Hiring

We are looking for a Home-Based Controller to join our Client, a growing U.S.-based company. In this role, you will take ownership of the company's core accounting operations, including monthly close, financial reporting, revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliations, payroll coordination, and sales tax compliance.

You will work closely with the CEO, fractional CFO, and outside CPA to maintain accurate and reliable financial records and deliver clear monthly reporting. You will also develop product-line P&Ls and customer profitability reporting, strengthen accounting processes and controls, and create documentation and SOPs that establish sustainable institutional knowledge across the organization.

This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional who is detail-oriented, precision-minded, and highly accountable, with strong expertise in deferred revenue and management accounting. The successful candidate will be comfortable taking ownership of the books while collaborating with a fractional CFO who provides financial oversight, planning, and forecasting.

REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Financial Accounting & Reporting: Demonstrates strong knowledge of accounting principles, monthly close, journal entries, reconciliations, and preparation of accurate financial statements.

  • Revenue Recognition & Deferred Revenue: Applies strong technical knowledge of revenue recognition and deferred revenue, particularly across multiple subledger accounts and revenue channels.

  • Management Accounting & Financial Analysis: Develops actuals-based product-line P&Ls, customer profitability analyses, variance commentary, and driver-based reporting to support management decision-making.

  • Accounting Operations & Compliance: Effectively oversees AR, AP, payroll coordination, account reconciliations, sales tax requirements, and coordination with external accounting and tax professionals.

  • Process Improvement & Documentation: Builds standardized accounting processes, close checklists, journal entry logs, SOPs, and other documentation that improve consistency, accuracy, and institutional knowledge.

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail: Maintains clean, reliable books and demonstrates a high level of precision when reviewing financial transactions, reconciliations, and reports.

  • Ownership & Collaboration: Takes accountability for accounting deliverables while working effectively with the CEO, fractional CFO, outside CPA, and other stakeholders.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Own the monthly close process and prepare accurate financial statements and variance commentary for review by the CEO and fractional CFO.

  • Revenue Recognition & Deferred Revenue: Manage revenue recognition and deferred revenue across multiple subledger accounts, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and consistently.

  • Accounting Operations: Oversee accounts receivable, accounts payable, account reconciliations, payroll coordination, and other recurring accounting activities.

  • Sales Tax Compliance: Coordinate sales tax requirements and maintain accurate supporting records and documentation.

  • Management Reporting: Prepare actuals-based product-line P&Ls, customer profitability analyses, driver reporting, and other management accounting reports for key accounts.

  • Financial Metrics & Reporting Package: Partner with the CEO to identify and operationalize core business metrics and incorporate them into the monthly financial reporting package.

  • Tax Coordination: Work closely with the company's outside CPA to support tax compliance, documentation, and other accounting requirements.

  • Accounting Records & Controls: Maintain an organized chart of accounts, journal entry log, close checklist, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Process Documentation: Develop and maintain SOPs for recurring accounting processes to create consistent workflows and preserve institutional knowledge.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Build effective working relationships with the CEO, fractional CFO, outside CPA, and relevant internal stakeholders.

  • Perform tasks analogous to the preceding and other related duties as assigned.

FIRST 90 DAYS – WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Establish and consistently complete the monthly close within 10 business days.

  • Develop and implement a documented monthly close checklist, chart of accounts, and journal entry log.

  • Partner with the CEO to identify 5–7 core business metrics and incorporate them into the monthly reporting package.

  • Produce clean, accurate monthly financial statements that provide leadership with confidence in the company's financial information.

  • Establish effective working relationships and processes with the outside CPA and fractional CFO.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Financial Management, or a related field.

  • Professional Certification: CPA or international equivalent is preferred.

  • Experience: 7–10 years of progressive accounting experience is preferred; candidates with at least 5 years of exceptional experience managing deferred revenue at scale may also be considered.

  • Deferred Revenue Experience: Direct experience managing deferred revenue in a multi-channel business involving subscriptions, gift cards, platform credits, customer prepayments, or similar revenue models.

  • Management Accounting: Strong experience preparing actuals-based product-line P&Ls, customer profitability analyses, variance reporting, and business-driver reporting.

  • Financial Close & Reporting: Strong hands-on experience with month-end close, financial statements, journal entries, account reconciliations, and general ledger management.

  • Accounting Operations: Experience with AR, AP, payroll coordination, sales tax compliance, and coordination with external CPAs or accounting professionals.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO).

    • Familiarity with modern accounting and finance technology.

    • Advanced spreadsheet and financial reporting skills.

    • Strong understanding of revenue recognition and deferred revenue accounting.

    • Ability to develop and maintain accounting SOPs, close checklists, financial schedules, and supporting documentation.

  • Professional Attributes: Detail-oriented and precision-minded, with a strong sense of ownership and pride in maintaining clean and accurate books.

  • Collaboration: Comfortable working alongside a fractional CFO who reviews accounting work and owns forward-looking planning and forecasting.

  • Values Alignment: Motivated by a mission-driven business environment and aligned with B Corp values.

  • Career Orientation: Values stability, consistency, and developing deep mastery within the role.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Workdays: Monday through Friday (USA)

BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US

WHO WE ARE

DCX stands out as a leading BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) company that takes pride in assisting growth-focused small and medium-sized businesses across the United States to discover the perfect global talent to enhance their teams.

At DCX, our core beliefs center around fostering growth and making hiring easy. We are dedicated to helping business owners, executives, and industry leaders, primarily within the promotional products industry, in their search for superstar team members.

Télétravail — Ce poste est classé comme un poste en télétravail. Cela signifie que la personne retenue peut être basée n’importe où au Canada et ne devrait pas avoir à se présenter sur un site de travail de GM, sauf indication contraire de la part de son gestionnaire.

Description du poste :

En tant que développeur logiciel principal au sein de l’équipe SimCore, vous développerez et déploierez des solutions d’IA/ML appliquées qui soutiennent directement les flux de simulation, les outils internes et les cas d’utilisation d’ingénierie essentiels à la mission. Vous travaillerez sur l’ensemble du spectre de l’innovation, de l’exploration initiale et du prototypage rapide jusqu’à la mise en production de systèmes robustes et faciles à maintenir.

Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de simulation, de génération de scénarios, de données et d’ingénierie afin de cerner les occasions où l’IA peut créer de la valeur, puis vous livrerez des solutions répondant à des critères clairs de réussite pour les clients et l’entreprise.

Nous recherchons un développeur logiciel principal possédant une solide expérience en recherche appliquée. Les personnes candidates idéales ont une expérience pratique des modèles génératifs multimodaux de pointe et/ou des modèles de reconstruction 3D, et excellent dans la création de pipelines d’inférence robustes et performants. Ce poste n’est pas axé sur l’entraînement de modèles fondamentaux, mais plutôt sur leur réglage fin, leur adaptation, leur optimisation, leur évaluation et leur déploiement sous forme de systèmes de production.

Qualifications minimales

  • Maîtrise exigée, doctorat souhaité, en informatique, robotique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en ingénierie ML/IA appliquée, dont au moins 2 ans dans la mise en production de systèmes d’IA à grande échelle.
  • Création de modèles du monde VLM et ML à partir de ce modèle physique. D’un capteur à l’autre et du capteur à la 3D.
  • Connaissance approfondie d’au moins un pipeline moderne de vision par ordinateur multimodale ou 3D, par exemple NeRF, Gaussian Splatting, les modèles du monde ou la génération fondée sur la diffusion.
  • Solides compétences en programmation Python, ainsi qu’une expérience avec une bibliothèque moderne de ML/IA comme PyTorch, TensorFlow, les API d’OpenAI, HuggingFace, gsplat, etc.
  • Bonne compréhension des principes fondamentaux du ML, notamment le prétraitement des données, les pipelines d’entraînement, les métriques d’évaluation et l’optimisation des performances des modèles.
  • Capacité à passer aisément de l’exploration de recherche à l’ingénierie pratique.
  • Capacité démontrée à diriger des projets de bout en bout avec un minimum de supervision.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience démontrée dans le réglage fin et l’optimisation de modèles fondamentaux (LLM, VLM, modèles de diffusion, modèles neuronaux 3D).
  • Expérience de l’intégration de modèles dans des pipelines de simulation, des systèmes robotiques, des flux de cartographie ou des piles de perception pour véhicules autonomes.
  • Expérience en compréhension de scènes ou en géométrie computationnelle.
  • Formation en géométrie 3D, en infographie ou en modélisation de capteurs.
  • Maîtrise des systèmes de recherche vectorielle/RAG et des pipelines d’intégration.
  • Connaissance de GCP ou d’autres plateformes infonuagiques, de Kubernetes, de Docker et de l’observabilité en production.
  • Expérience antérieure dans le mentorat d’équipes, la définition d’architectures et la direction d’initiatives techniques s’étendant sur plusieurs trimestres.

Rémunération :
La fourchette salariale pour ce poste est de 131 000 $ à 180 500 $. Le salaire de base réel offert à la personne retenue dans cette fourchette variera en fonction de facteurs pertinents pour le poste.

title: Apartment Maintenance
description:
Facilities Technician
Location: Dundalk, MD
Silver Tree Residential, LLC is one of the fastest growing property management companies in the industry. We were formed in 2009 to operate a growing portfolio of multi-family and senior apartment communities. Our primary goal is to provide the best quality housing possible to our residents with safe, quiet, and amenity filled communities. Our exhaustive resident screening process is important to making each property successful, by aiming to improve the quality of our residents' living environment. The Facilities Technician is responsible for the prompt and efficient performance of all tasks assigned by the Community Director and/or Facilities Director and for continuous self-improvement of skills and expertise. title: Program Manager Strategic Initiatives
description:
Job Description:

The Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives & Performance is responsible for planning and delivering assigned initiatives while enabling transparent, fact-based performance management. Working under the direction of the Associate Director, the role turns strategic priorities into clear plans, coordinates cross-functional execution, and provides leaders with accurate insight into progress, risks, decisions, and value.


What are we looking for?

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Project Management, or related field.

  • 3 years experience in project management or business experience, PMO, program coordination.

  • Experience supporting complex, cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization.

  • Demonstrated experience developing project plans, governance materials, status reports, RAID logs, and executive presentations.

  • Experience with Microsoft Office tools, Ppt, Excel, Word, Power BI, Power Sheets, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP, Agile, Lean, Power BI or related certifications.

  • 5+ years' experience in project management, PMO business analytics, program coordination, or a related role.

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Project delivery: Define scope, outcomes, workplans, timelines, governance, and ways of working for assigned initiatives; coordinate execution from initiation through closure.

  • Governance and controls: Prepare agendas and materials, facilitate reviews, document decisions, maintain action logs, and ensure agreed actions are completed.

  • Risk and dependency management: Maintain RAID logs, identify critical-path impacts, coordinate mitigations, and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations.

  • Performance analytics and dashboarding: Actively build and maintain project and portfolio dashboards, executive scorecards, risk heat maps, and performance views.

  • Reporting and insight: Translate complex delivery and performance data into concise narratives, trends, implications, and management actions.

  • Data quality: Partner with data owners to define measures, validate inputs, resolve inconsistencies, and maintain confidence in reported information.

  • Process improvement: Standardize and automate recurring reporting, status collection, governance, and workflow activities.

  • Stakeholder partnership: Build effective relationships across a matrixed organization, clarify ownership, surface trade-offs, and promote timely decisions.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.

  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.

  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:

At Regions, the Credit Products Leveraged Finance Product Specialist is a client-facing role, that partners directly with coverage on the extension of credit products transactions to meet clients’ needs. This role serves as part of the first line of defense, with the coverage team, and identifies and mitigates risk in existing and proposed credit products transactions. The role works directly with teammates in Credit Products, Credit Risk, Client Coverage, Capital Markets, and other areas of the bank to lead the analysis of credit opportunities, underwriting of credit exposure and management of a portfolio of loans and other credit relationships while providing effective challenge to these various constituents. This role provides subject matter expertise and manages the overall delivery of credit products to assigned clients.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Works in support of coverage banker to develop a target set of companies within markets to enhance proper client selectivity
  • Adds value directly to client and coverage in articulating Regions’ underwriting methods, processes and risk appetite for specific credit products
  • Maintains market knowledge of loan pricing and structural trends to match client needs with Regions’ credit product solutions
  • Calls clients jointly with coverage bankers to understand clients’ needs and specific risks to client business
  • Works with coverage bankers to develop client strategy focusing on existing and potential credit exposure
  • Assists coverage bankers in optimizing relationships through cross sell activities of credit products
  • Leads the credit process on identified credit product opportunities (ultimately accountable for structuring, underwriting, closing and management of new and existing credit products for clients)
  • Serves as the primary contact with Credit Risk
  • Oversees ongoing monitoring of existing portfolios by being accountable for periodic assessments and other servicing requirements
  • Serves as a mentor/coach to team members, specifically Credit Products Associates assigned to managed clients

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

This position is incentive eligible.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Seven (7) years of underwriting and portfolio management experience
  • Experience in relationship management either as a coverage banker or as a client facing member of the relationship team
  • Legal document experience
  • Understanding of loan structuring needs, loan documentation requirements and market knowledge
  • Financial analysis experience

Required Certifications/Licensures

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to negotiate with both internal and external parties
  • Analytical and problem solving skills

title: Clinical Specialist, Joint Replacement - Stamford, CT
description:
Work Flexibility: Field-based

Clinical Specialist, Joint Replacement – Stamford, Connecticut

About the job

As a Clinical Specialist at Stryker, you will help improve orthopedic surgeries around the world and play a direct role in our mission of making healthcare better. In this role, you will build deep clinical and technical expertise across both robotic (Mako SmartRobotics™) and manual orthopedic procedures. You will support surgeons in the operating room by assisting with pre-operative planning, case preparation, system setup, and real-time procedural workflows to ensure safe, accurate, and efficient outcomes.

You will gain hands-on experience working with Mako technology—including CT-based planning, implant sizing, registration, and intra-operative support—while also developing strong competency in manual procedures, instrumentation, and OR protocols. Through shadowing experienced team members, supporting product demonstrations, and participating in labs and education programs, you will learn the systems, processes, and best practices that define world-class clinical support.

This role requires adaptability, steady composure, and strong problem-solving in a fast-paced surgical environment. Because patients’ needs don’t follow business hours, you will also participate in on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure uninterrupted support for urgent cases and time-sensitive customer needs.

What You Will Do

  • Gain competency in solo case coverage for manual and robotic procedures through hands-on training.
  • Assist surgeons with pre-operative CT-based planning, implant sizing, and positioning using advanced software.
  • Support full case preparation, including instrumentation checks, equipment setup, and OR readiness.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues confidently and efficiently in the operating room.
  • Learn and support workflow for daily account coordination, including inventory management and logistics.
  • Shadow experienced teammates to understand territory dynamics and surgeon preferences.
  • Participate in product demonstrations, cadaver labs, education programs, and customer training events.
  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with surgeons, OR staff, and cross-functional partners.
  • Manage administrative tasks related to accounts, system updates, and case documentation.
  • Collaborate with sales partners to ensure seamless execution and a unified customer experience.
  • Complete required trainings, competencies, and certifications.
  • Provide on-call coverage during evenings, weekends, and holidays.
What You Need
  • Minimum Required: Bachelor’s degree OR Associate degree with 4 years of professional and/or related experience OR High school diploma with 6 years of professional and/or related experience
Preferred:
  • 1 year of relevant work experience.
  • Previous clinical experience (nursing, physical therapy, surgical technology, athletic training, personal training, medical scribing, etc.).
  • Extracurricular involvement such as community service, leadership organizations, or athletic teams.
Additional Information
  • This position requires the handling of instruments that may have been contaminated by blood or bodily fluids. In compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations, Stryker will provide a safe working environment for all employees.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods.
  • Ability to manage stressful OR situations with professionalism and focus
  • Exerting up to 50 lbs of force occasionally and/or up to 20 lbs of force constantly to move objects.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English required.


Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. title: Part Time Dock 5 A.M. Start
description:
At Old Dominion, we don't just move freight—we help businesses keep their promises. As one of the nation's leading LTL carriers, we've earned our reputation by putting people first, delivering premium service, and staying true to the values that have guided us for more than 90 years. Our PROMISES values shape how we work, our family culture shapes how we treat one another, and our commitment to being the Best in the Game drives everything we do. If you're looking for more than just a job, you'll find a career built on trust, teamwork, and opportunity at OD.


We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented individual to join the OD Family as a Dockworker. This role is vital to ensuring the safe, efficient loading and unloading of freight, as well as supporting overall warehouse and material handling operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong work ethic, a commitment to safety, and team driven. As a critical part of our team, you will help uphold our promise of delivering customer freight accurately and on time, contributing to the success of our OD Family culture.

Job Summary

The dockworker must efficiently load and unload freight, ensuring that the correct items are placed on the right trucks. Safety is paramount, and Dock Workers use equipment like forklifts and manual techniques to handle materials. Proper securing of freight with airbags and cardboard, as well as using straps, is crucial to prevent damage during transport. The dock worker position directly impacts the reliability of deliveries to customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Load and unload freight on trailers using a motorized forklift, pallet jack or manually in compliance with state and federal DOT guidelines. Use various loading techniques, such as loading tight or cross loading.
  • Transport self and/or freight continuously throughout the service center on non-forgiving surfaces.
  • Utilize Dock Yard Management System to consistently monitor freight shipment locations throughout the service center.
  • Read and interpret shipping labels. Familiarity with, and in some cases ability to complete the various forms utilized in freight movement such as shipping orders, city stripping manifests, freight bills, overage/damage movement reports and exception forms.
  • Hand load, rewrap or stack freight as necessary.
  • Insure the quality loading of all trailers.
  • Secure freight inside trailers using appropriate tools and supplies (e.g. pallets, straps, rope).
  • Frequent contact with service center personnel; fast-pace and deadline oriented.
  • This is not an all-inclusive list of job responsibilities and duties. Employees are expected and must be able to perform all duties and tasks assigned.

Job Qualifications

Education:

  • High school degree or equivalent

Experience:

  • Must have working knowledge of safe and efficient lifting and transporting procedures.
  • Must have working knowledge of procedures surrounding all aspects of freight transportation.
  • Must have knowledge of different loading techniques such as loading tight and cross loading.
  • Familiarity with, and in some cases ability, to complete the various forms utilized in freight movement such as shipping orders, city stripping manifests, freight bills, overage/damage movement reports and exception forms.
  • Ability to utilize the dock yard management system permitting consistent monitoring of shipment locations as freight moves through the various terminals.
  • Must be available for work at all times in order to meet customer pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Must have the ability to properly operate hand held tablet when needed

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be able to read, write, and speak English.
  • (Standing) Must be able to remain standing for a up to 8 Hours/shift, 5-7 days per week on non-forgiving surfaces such as concrete, wood, metal that are sometimes wet and slippery.
  • (Sitting) Must be able to sit on a forklift up to 8 hours/shift 5 -7 days per week.
  • (Moving/walking) Must be able to walk up to 8 hours a day on non- forgiving surfaces such as concrete, wood and metal and sometimes on wet and slippery surfaces.
  • (Bending/Stooping/Kneeling) Must be able to perform frequent squatting to handle, position and secure freight.
  • (Climbing) Must be able to get onto and off of the forklift many times throughout the day, must be able to climb about and move about easily in small spaces to adjust freight.
  • (Moving Materials). Must be able to load and unload full trailers of freight weighing as much as 500 lbs., with or without a dolly or cart. This could involve for example moving 100lb containers to and from floor level to carts, stacks or platforms over 4 feet high, balancing 300 lb. drums on their rims and rolling them into positions, rolling and lifting tires, or stowing cartons or other merchandise overhead that weigh as much as 100 lbs. each.
  • (Pushing/Pulling) Must be able to perform frequent pulling and pushing of freight with or without the help of freight pulling equipment up to 100lbs. Must also be able to push and pull forklift blades, forklift gas tanks, deck bars, and other freight related items.
  • (Hearing/Speaking) Must be able to see parts in and on the forklift mechanical equipment for pre and post inspections. Must be able to hearing the horns of other forklifts and shouted instructions and warnings.
  • (Reaching) Must be able to frequently reach for freight at waist level and occasionally reach for freight above shoulder height or below waist level. Must be able to reach for forklift controls, pushing deck bars, and placing/strapping airbags/straps/cardboard. Must be able to reach while sweeping work areas clean of debris.
  • (Lifting) Must be able to frequently lift and handle objects weighing up to 100 lbs. of varying sizes or shapes, using OSHA guidelines and lifting techniques, distances of 1 foot but usually no less than 100 feet.
  • Must be able to use right, left or both hands to get in and out of forklift, wrapping and unwrapping shrink wrap, securing and unsecuring pallets, using pallet jack or hand truck, using the steering wheel, buttons on lift gates, etc.
  • Must be able to grip with right, left or both hands to use handles to get in and out of the forklift, holding tablet, using pallet jacks or hand trucks, controlling and pushing the buttons on the forklift, holding the steering wheel, securing straps, cardboard, airbags, etc.
  • Must be able to pinch fingers on the right, left or both hands to shrink wrap, secure and unsecure straps, utilize clip boards, utilize tablets, etc.
  • Must be able to use cognitive skills for:
    • paying attention to surroundings, including cross-dock traffic, forklift inspections, freight, gates, etc.
    • long-term and short-term memory for inspecting areas, breaking down pallets, carrying products, driving in cross-dock traffic and for safety
    • logic and reasoning in reading manifests, tablets, reading boxes and order numbers
    • Auditory and visual processing to inspect forklifts, driving, reading, listening for horns and/or other cross-dock traffic and speaking with other dock workers. Must be able to see and read bills of lading, tablets for yard management systems, and read printed materials. Must be able to see and scan areas of work for debris and defects.
  • (Other) Must be able to work a variety of times and shifts in order to meet customer pick up and delivery schedules.
  • Ability to work in extremely hot or cold climates, ability to work in an environment where noise and odors may be present.
  • Attendance is a requirement

Work Environment

The work environment described below represents those that an employee would encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions of the job.

While performing the duties of the job, the employees will be exposed to various work environments which may include working with or around others while loading and unloading, working in an enclosed vehicle while driving, loading and unloading in an enclosed trailer, exposure to all weather conditions, noise levels that vary from quiet to loud and with lighting conditions that could be extremely bright or low light.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

Working Days:

Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,

Working Shift:

Morning

Work days/shifts may change based on scheduling and business needs and are provided as guidelines at the time of posting.

title: Senior Analyst - ALM Model Development
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Position Summary

Global Atlantic's Bermuda team is seeking a technically strong senior analyst to play a key role in the development and enhancement of our proprietary ALM projection platform used for Bermuda EBS valuation, BSCR capital calculation, and Embedded Value reporting. The platform is in active expansion from its core valuation engine into end-to-end regulatory reporting, financial forecasting, and a broader suite of actuarial and investment analytics, including predictive modeling and AI-enabled capabilities. This role combines quantitative and financial modeling with hands-on Python and SQL development and applied AI/ML development, working directly on production ALM projection systems that run across multiple insurance entities and economic scenarios. The successful candidate will apply numerical computing, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modeling, and machine learning techniques to support the continued development of the platform. The position will partner closely with Investments, Risk, Corporate Actuarial, FP&A, and Technology teams to deliver high-quality projection capabilities, scalable analytical tools, strong governance, and meaningful analytical insights. This role will be based in our Hamilton, Bermuda office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support code development, enhancement and deployment of the ALM projection model used for quarterly Bermuda Economic Balance Sheet (EBS) valuation, BSCR capital calculation, and Embedded Value reporting
  • Develop EBS forecasting capabilities to support FP&A, Deal Team, and new business modeling
  • Develop and enhance numerical modeling capabilities for asset-liability analysis, forecasting, scenario analysis, and portfolio optimization, including efficient implementation of large-scale calculations
  • Design and maintain automated unit tests and CI/CD pipelines to validate precision and reproducibility of financial, actuarial, and asset projection outputs across model releases
  • Collaborate with Actuarial, Investment and Risk teams to ensure asset assumptions, financial assumptions, and ALM strategies are appropriately reflected in projections
  • Perform review and challenge of model results to ensure accuracy, reasonableness, and regulatory compliance
  • Develop and integrate predictive modeling, machine learning, and AI capabilities to support forecasting, model acceleration, scenario analysis, and broader actuarial and investment analytics within the ALM platform

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, mathematical finance, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative discipline
  • 2-6 years of experience in quantitative modeling, financial modeling, actuarial modeling, data science, or related analytical/model development roles is preferred
  • Strong Python programming skills required; experience with SQL and/or other programming languages is preferred. Candidates must be comfortable developing reusable, production-oriented analytical or modeling code rather than only performing ad-hoc analysis
  • Experience with numerical computing libraries such as NumPy and SciPy and data manipulation frameworks such as Polars, Pandas, or similar
  • Experience developing forecasting, simulation, optimization, scenario-analysis, financial, or actuarial projection models
  • Experience developing reusable analytical/modeling code and automated data or modeling workflows
  • Experience with numerical optimization, large-scale computation, or performance optimization is preferred
  • Experience with machine learning, predictive modeling, or AI application development, including integrating models into production analytical workflows, is preferred
  • Experience with cloud-based model development or deployment and modern AI/ML frameworks is a plus
  • Experience with actuarial valuation/projection platforms such as MG-ALFA, Prophet, or Moody's AXIS is a plus
  • Familiarity with insurance, investments, asset-liability management, Bermuda EBS, Solvency II, or U.S. Statutory valuation frameworks is a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex quantitative problems, learn new financial or actuarial concepts, and dive into technical details

The successful candidate will be a motivated, results-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment. We are seeking someone who:

  • Excels at collaboration and communication, building strong cross-functional relationships
  • Works well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Is persistent when developing a solution to a problem
  • Demonstrates the ability to collaborate effectively within a high-performing team while maintaining strong individual accountability and execution.
  • Takes ownership of their responsibilities

title: Global Knowledge Senior Data Analyst
location: Mexico, Nuevo León, San Pedro Garza Garcia
description:
Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst

Global Knowledge Base | Enterprise Customer Experience

The Role

The Global Knowledge Data Senior Analyst plays a critical role in transforming Clarios’ Global Knowledge Base (GKB) from a traditional content and data repository into a globally connected, AI-enabled, and insight-driven enterprise capability.

Working closely with the Global Knowledge Sr. Manager, this role prepares, structures, analyzes, and translates customer, product, market, operational, and knowledge data into actionable insights that improve customer experience, support regional growth, and enable new business opportunities.

The Senior Analyst serves as a key bridge between data and business stakeholders across Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams, helping turn complex information into scalable data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, and business recommendations.

What You’ll Do (Impact Areas)

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, validate, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, usability, and analytical readiness.
  • Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, root causes, and business opportunities.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insights, business implications, and clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop insight narratives and executive-ready summaries that support CX, commercial, product, and regional decision-making.

Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical summaries that provide visibility into knowledge utilization, customer behavior, market needs, and platform performance.
  • Track KPIs related to knowledge management, data products, adoption, data quality, and insight effectiveness.
  • Monitor performance and recommend opportunities to increase accuracy, relevance, usability, automation, and business impact.

Data Products & Value Creation

  • Proactively identify opportunities to transform data and insights into scalable business solutions.
  • Support the development of data products, decision-support tools, benchmarks, diagnostics, and insight solutions.
  • Partner with business, Product, CX, Commercial, and regional teams to assess customer value, business value, feasibility, scalability, and monetization potential.
  • Help convert knowledge and data assets into solutions that create measurable customer, commercial, and operational value.

Global Knowledge Base & Data Governance

  • Support the consolidation, maintenance, enrichment, and expansion of Global Knowledge Base data.
  • Help define and implement data standards, taxonomies, metadata structures, quality rules, and governance requirements.
  • Monitor data quality and recommend improvements to data collection, modeling, and analytical processes.
  • Strengthen consistency, accessibility, and usability of knowledge across regions and functions.

AI, Automation & Advanced Analytics

  • Support the application of AI, automation, semantic search, content intelligence, recommendation logic, and predictive analytics across the Global Knowledge ecosystem.
  • Assist with testing and validating AI-enabled knowledge solutions, analytical models, and automated insight capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve knowledge discovery, relevance, and customer decision support.
  • Partner with technology teams to continuously enhance the effectiveness of AI-enabled capabilities.

Business & Technology Partnership

  • Partner with IT/Digital and technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytical, data, reporting, and platform requirements.
  • Collaborate across CX, Commercial, Marketing, Product, and regional teams to understand business challenges and develop data-driven solutions.
  • Communicate insights, opportunities, risks, and recommendations in a clear and business-oriented manner.
  • Act as a translator between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on requirements and outcomes.

Testing, Implementation & Continuous Improvement

  • Support data publication, testing, validation, and business acceptance activities for data updates, dashboards, tools, and data products.
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production readiness activities for Global Knowledge solutions.
  • Monitor solution adoption, usability, performance, and data quality after implementation.
  • Recommend and support continuous improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, scalability, and business value.

What Success Looks Like

  • Global Knowledge data is accurate, structured, governed, and ready for analysis and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Business stakeholders receive clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making.
  • Dashboards and analytical solutions provide meaningful visibility into customer, product, market, and knowledge performance.
  • Data opportunities are successfully translated into scalable tools, products, and decision-support solutions.
  • AI-enabled capabilities improve knowledge discovery, relevance, usability, and productivity.
  • Data quality and governance continuously improve across the Global Knowledge ecosystem.
  • Strong partnerships are established between business and technology teams.
  • Knowledge and data solutions demonstrate measurable impact on customer experience, operational effectiveness, and business growth.

Core Competencies

  • Data analysis and analytical thinking.
  • Business intelligence and data visualization.
  • Data storytelling and executive communication.
  • Business requirements gathering and translation.
  • Problem-solving and root cause analysis.
  • Data quality and governance.
  • AI and digital technology awareness.
  • Customer-centric thinking.
  • Cross-functional collaboration.
  • Stakeholder management and influence.
  • Business and commercial acumen.
  • Continuous improvement mindset.
  • Project coordination and execution.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Digital Strategy, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business analysis, analytics, data management, digital platforms, or related functions.
  • Experience collecting, cleaning, structuring, analyzing, and interpreting data from multiple sources.
  • Experience translating business needs into technical, data, analytical, or reporting requirements.
  • Experience working with both technical and business stakeholders in cross-functional, matrixed environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects within a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more data and analytics technologies such as SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, MongoDB, Alteryx, KNIME, Hadoop/Hive, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or similar tools.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting data, analytics, Knowledge Management, Customer Experience, Business Intelligence, digital products, or related initiatives.
  • Experience identifying business opportunities through data and translating them into dashboards, tools, product concepts, or decision-support solutions.
  • Experience supporting small to medium-sized data projects from requirements gathering through implementation.
  • Experience within Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, or other customer-facing environments.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, semantic search, recommendation engines, content intelligence, automation, or predictive analytics.
  • Experience working with external technology partners, data providers, vendors, or analytics consultants.
  • Ability to develop compelling executive presentations, insight narratives, and business recommendations.
  • Interest or experience in data monetization, benchmarking solutions, diagnostics, customer decision tools, and scalable knowledge-based products.

Work Model & Travel

  • Work Model: Hybrid, aligned with business and team requirements.
  • Scope: Global, supporting stakeholders and regional teams across the organization.
  • Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required based on project and stakeholder needs.
  • Key Partnerships: Global Knowledge, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Product, IT/Digital, and regional teams.

Our Commitment to You

  • Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of a global, AI-enabled Knowledge Management capability.
  • Exposure to strategic initiatives across Customer Experience, AI, analytics, digital transformation, and data products.
  • Opportunities to develop expertise in emerging technologies, advanced analytics, and knowledge-driven business solutions.
  • Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders.
  • A culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and measurable business impact.
  • Opportunities for professional growth while helping turn enterprise data and knowledge into capabilities that improve customer experience and create long-term business value.

Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. With around 18,000 employees in over 100 countries, we bring deep expertise to our Aftermarket and OEM partners, and reliability, safety and comfort to everyday lives. description:

Job Description

About the role:

GM’s simulation team is looking for an experienced Staff Software Developer to be a key technical leader in our mission to deliver autonomous driving technologies safely. This is a high-impact role where your work directly enables the validation of our most complex AI-driven systems.


Responsibilities

  • Technical Vision: Contribute to the architectural roadmap for our Simulation Scenario Definition platform and/or its programmatic Python SDK.

  • Scalable Tooling: Lead the design and implementation of our next-generation graphical editing tools used by hundreds of engineers to precisely define complex traffic, environment, and sensor scenarios.

  • Performance & Infrastructure: Drive the evolution of our Python infrastructure, focusing on core algorithms for scenario serialization, validation, and integration with our large-scale cloud compute cluster.

  • Mentorship: Act as a hands-on mentor, setting the engineering excellence standard for API design, code quality, and testing practices across the team.

Requires Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development, with a significant portion focused on large-scale platforms, tooling, or SDK development.

  • Proven ability to lead technical projects from concept to production.

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python, including deep knowledge of best practices, performance optimization, and building robust APIs/SDKs for external consumers.

  • Solid foundation in 3D graphics, computational geometry, and/or real-time simulation concepts.

  • A track record of mentoring and coaching mid-level and senior engineers, raising the technical bar, and driving code quality standards within a team.

Desired Skills (Bonus Points)

  • Experience with C++ for performance-critical components or integration with simulation engines.

  • Direct experience developing or extending a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) or high-level scripting language.

  • Background in game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal) or other professional simulation software.

  • Experience in data visualization techniques for large, complex datasets.

  • Familiarity with the architecture of Autonomous Vehicle (AV) technology (e.g., perception, planning, controls) or other complex robotics/safety-critical systems.

The salary range for this role is $147,000 to $196,600. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Statut du poste vacant

Ce poste ne correspond pas à un poste vacant existant au sein de l’organisation et est ouvert aux nouvelles candidatures. (Nouvelle création de poste)

Divulgation relative à l’intelligence artificielle

Dans le cadre du processus de candidature, l’intelligence artificielle sera utilisée dans le processus d’embauche pour ce poste.

Télétravail — Ce poste est classé comme un poste à distance. La personne retenue peut être basée n’importe où au Canada et n’est pas tenue de se présenter sur un site de travail de GM, sauf indication contraire de la part de son gestionnaire.

À propos du poste

L’équipe de simulation de GM est à la recherche d’un ingénieur logiciel principal expérimenté qui jouera un rôle de leadership technique clé dans notre mission visant à développer de façon sécuritaire des technologies de conduite autonome. Il s’agit d’un poste à fort impact, dans lequel votre travail contribuera directement à la validation de nos systèmes complexes pilotés par l’intelligence artificielle.

Responsabilités

  • Vision technique : Contribuer à la feuille de route architecturale de notre plateforme de définition de scénarios de simulation et/ou de son SDK Python programmatique.

  • Outils évolutifs : Diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de nos outils graphiques d’édition de nouvelle génération, utilisés par des centaines d’ingénieurs pour définir avec précision des scénarios complexes liés à la circulation, à l’environnement et aux capteurs.

  • Performance et infrastructure : Faire évoluer notre infrastructure Python en mettant l’accent sur les algorithmes fondamentaux liés à la sérialisation et à la validation des scénarios, ainsi qu’à leur intégration avec notre cluster infonuagique de calcul à grande échelle.

  • Mentorat : Agir comme mentor pratique et établir la norme d’excellence en ingénierie pour la conception d’API, la qualité du code et les pratiques de test au sein de l’équipe.

Qualifications requises

  • Au moins 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, dont une part importante consacrée aux plateformes, aux outils ou au développement de SDK à grande échelle.

  • Capacité démontrée à diriger des projets techniques, de leur conception jusqu’à leur mise en production.

  • Maîtrise experte de Python, notamment une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques, de l’optimisation des performances et de la conception d’API/SDK robustes destinés à des utilisateurs externes.

  • Solide connaissance des graphismes 3D, de la géométrie computationnelle et/ou des concepts de simulation en temps réel.

Compétences souhaitées (atouts)

  • Expérience directe dans la conception ou l’amélioration d’un langage spécifique à un domaine (DSL) ou d’un langage de script de haut niveau.

  • Expérience des moteurs de jeu, comme Unity ou Unreal, ou d’autres logiciels professionnels de simulation.

  • Expérience des techniques de visualisation de données pour des ensembles de données volumineux et complexes.

  • Connaissance de l’architecture des technologies de conduite autonome, notamment la perception, la planification et le contrôle, ou d’autres systèmes complexes de robotique et systèmes critiques pour la sécurité.

title: Assistant Control Room Operator
description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

We are looking for an Assistant Control Room Operator (ACRO) to join our operations team. The ACRO is a critical member of the plant operating team and serves as the eyes, ears, and primary field connection for the Control Room Operator (CRO).

This role requires a high level of technical knowledge, mechanical ability, sound judgment, leadership, trust, and reliability. The ACRO works closely with the CRO and Shift Supervisor to monitor plant conditions, interact with equipment and employees in the field, respond to operational issues, and ensure the facility operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of plant systems and how those systems work together, the ability to identify and respond to abnormal conditions, and the willingness to take ownership and support the broader operations team.

What You’ll Do

  • Uphold all company safety, environmental, operating policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Meet and maintain the qualifications established by the Operations Qualification Standard (OQS), including all applicable lower-level requirements.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough working knowledge of plant systems, including what each system does, how it operates, and how systems interact with one another.
  • Serve as the primary field resource and communication link for the Control Room Operator.
  • Take accurate equipment readings and complete operating logs at required intervals, typically twice per shift.
  • Perform equipment pre-start and post-shutdown field walkdowns to verify equipment condition and identify potential issues.
  • Respond promptly and safely to plant limiting malfunctions, abnormal operating conditions, and equipment issues.
  • Perform assigned operating tasks and work as directed by the Shift Supervisor or Control Room Operator.
  • Conduct required weekly and monthly safety, environmental, and operational compliance checks.
  • Participate in team safety activities, drills, facility safety evolutions, and emergency response activities.
  • Provide assistance and coverage to other watch stations and operational areas as needed.
  • Support safe and efficient plant operations during normal operations, startups, shutdowns, outages, and other facility evolutions.
  • Communicate equipment conditions, operating concerns, and other relevant information clearly and accurately to the Control Room Operator and Shift Supervisor.
  • Maintain a high level of personal accountability, reliability, and professionalism while working independently in the field.
  • Assist with training and development of other employees and share operational knowledge with team members.
  • Complete required annual retraining and maintain all necessary qualifications.
  • Pursue continuous self-improvement and actively develop technical and operational knowledge.
  • Demonstrate a reasonable commitment to scheduled and unscheduled overtime, including call-ins, vacation coverage, and outage support.

What You’ll Bring

  • Successful completion of the applicable Operations Qualification Standard (OQS) and required lower-level qualifications.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to understand and troubleshoot industrial equipment and systems.
  • Ability to understand complex plant systems and recognize how individual systems affect overall plant operation.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately monitor and document equipment conditions.
  • Ability to recognize abnormal equipment conditions and respond appropriately and safely.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to effectively communicate information between the field and Control Room.
  • Demonstrated reliability, dependability, and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team while also working independently with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to set a positive example for others.
  • Willingness and ability to complete required training, qualifications, and annual retraining.
  • Ability to work a rotating shift schedule, including nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as required.
  • Commitment to maintaining a safe, compliant, and environmentally responsible workplace.

Why This Role Matters

The ACRO plays a critical role in maintaining safe, reliable, and efficient plant operations. By continuously monitoring field conditions, communicating directly with the Control Room, and taking action when equipment or operating conditions change, the ACRO helps ensure the CRO and Shift Supervisor have the information they need to make sound operating decisions.

This position requires someone the team can trust to recognize issues, communicate effectively, follow through, and do the right thing even when no one is watching.
