title: Onboarding & Credentialing Specialist (Philippines, Remote)
description:
Home Heart Florida · Remote, Philippines · Full-time · US Eastern hours

We are a pediatric home health company in Florida. Our nurses look after medically complex children in their own homes, often overnight, often for years. Hiring a nurse well and getting them working quickly is the difference between a family sleeping through the night and a family not sleeping at all.

The problem you are here to fix

Too many of the nurses who accept our offers never make it to their first shift. They sign, and then they fall into a gap. Paperwork sits unfinished. A certification quietly expires. A skills check-off never gets booked. Weeks pass, nobody chases, and by the time we notice, the nurse has taken a job somewhere else.

That gap is the job. From the moment a nurse is sent an offer to the moment they are cleared to start, you own them. Nobody else picks it up. Nobody else drops it.

What you will actually do

  • Chase signed offers. An offer that has been sitting unsigned for eleven days is your problem, and you will not let it sit for twelve.
  • Collect and verify credentials. Licences, CPR cards, TB tests, background checks, immunisations. You will know what is missing before anyone asks you.
  • Book the clinical skills check-off with the right nurse leader, and keep rebooking it until it happens.
  • Keep personnel files audit-ready. A regulator can walk in and ask for any file on any day. Yours are ready.
  • Check in at 30 and 90 days, because that is the window where good people quietly leave.

What this job is not

You will not assess anyone's clinical skill. A licensed nurse does that. You schedule it, shepherd it and record it. You are not expected to arrive knowing US home health, Medicaid or credentialing rules. We will teach you all of it.

Who does well here

This role needs two personalities that usually do not live in the same person.

The first is a chaser. Comfortable being the person who follows up for the fourth time, politely, without being asked, and without taking silence personally.

The second is a detective. The kind of person who notices that a date on page four contradicts a date on page one, and cares enough to find out which is right.

If you are only one of those two, this will be a frustrating job. If you are both, you will be unusually good at it.

What we care about in your background

We care far more about how organised you are than about which industry you came from. Strong candidates often come from HR, recruitment coordination, onboarding, staffing or healthcare back-office work. If you have recruited, onboarded or credentialed nurses or caregivers for a US employer, say so clearly, because that is the closest thing to this job that exists.

Required: excellent written English, a reliable internet connection, and the ability to work United States Eastern hours.

The details

  • Full-time, remote, based in the Philippines
  • United States Eastern time zone hours
  • $1,200 USD per month
  • Engaged as an independent contractor
  • Reports to our HR Director

To be straightforward with you, so nobody wastes their time: this is a flat monthly rate. We do not offer HMO, 13th-month pay or a referral bonus. What we do offer is direct work for the company itself rather than through an agency, a role nobody else at the company currently owns, and a manager who will teach you a US healthcare speciality you cannot learn anywhere else in this market.

How to apply

Read this part carefully. We use it to see who follows instructions, because the job is made of following instructions.

  1. Include the word COMPASS in your application.
  2. Attach your CV.
  3. In your cover letter, answer one question in no more than 200 words: you are responsible for 50 nurses who each owe you a different set of documents, with different deadlines. How would you track them, and how would you know on any given morning who to chase first?
  4. Tell us the hours you can reliably work in US Eastern time.

Applications that skip any of these four steps will not be reviewed.

title: Munitions Materiel Handling Equipment (MMHE) Technician
description:
Purpose and Scope:

Inspects, maintains, and services assigned Munitions Materiel Handling Equipment (MMHE). Uses ELMS and MC2 as part of routine duties in accordance with applicable technical standards. Depending on operational tempo may at times be required to participate as part of the work force conducting explosives operations. Operates Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System (TICMS) daily.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Understands and consistently observes applicable AFOSH and security standards during all maintenance operations in assigned site and TDY locations.
  • Ensures pre-task safety crew briefings are accomplished before the start of any operation.
  • Takes necessary control and timely response actions during emergency munitions events.
  • Safely operates diversified test, handling and towing equipment.
  • Understands and perform basic inventory standards to account for all resources.
  • Performs the assigned maintenance workload in accordance with established technical and QMS directives.
  • Maintains all assigned equipment to maximum, serviceable standards in accordance with USAF technical data, including corrosion control, to meet minimum critical levels at all times.
  • Repairs/fabricates MMHE containers in accordance with military specifications.
  • Uses required technical data and completes the documentation in accordance with T.O.00-5-2 and 00-20 Series.
  • Documents equipment records IAW T.O. 00-20-1; processes appropriate transactions in ELMS and/or Munitions Information System (MIS).
  • Prepare and configures MMHE for air, sea, and surface transportation.
  • Submits timely and accurate completion of all serviceability records.
  • Store tools, replacement bench and operational stock.
  • Inspects and performs minor maintenance on facilities and installed equipment.
  • Maintains shelf life items (lubricants, paint, etc.) to include availability of SDS for assets.
  • Ensures all GPMS MHE assets are fully serviceable in accordance with technical standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:

  • Must have intermediate knowledge of the USAF Supply and Tech Order systems (ETIMS) or US service equivalent.
  • Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum Power Point, Excel and Word programs.
  • Will be required to operate munitions material handling equipment.
  • Must possess a valid US driver’s license.
  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Preferred a minimum of four years of experience with Military Munitions.
  • Preferred a minimum of two years of combined experience with USAF MMHE.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a US Secret Security Clearance.
  • Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods.
  • Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed.
  • Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Must pass vision test to prove ability to visually identify color-coded indicators, markings, or controls required for safe job performance.

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:

  • Regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and talk or hear.
  • Frequently is required to walk; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and work in tiring and uncomfortable positions.
  • Occasionally exposed to cold, wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; outside weather conditions; extreme cold; and risk of electrical shock.

Service Contract Act (SCA) Compensation & Benefits:

This is an hourly, overtime-eligible position that falls under the Service Contract Act (SCA). In accordance with the Health and Welfare provisions of the SCA, and in addition to your base hourly rate, you may be eligible to receive an additional health and welfare payment for each hour you work to ensure compliance with the minimums set forth by the act. The amount you are entitled to receive will vary depending upon the fringe benefits you select now and in the future.

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:

title: Senior Project Manager - Data Centers
description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We’re one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead a large project or multiple project efforts, which may include subcontractors, high dollar value material content and multiple resources within the Mission Critical Industry. Your responsibilities will include the management and coordination of the design, procurement, implementation, and commissioning phases of projects, including the commercial, financial, and technical success of projects ranging from $50K to $3.0M+.

You will take a leadership role in developing project proposals and vetting project cost estimates. You will develop and communicate a clear understanding of the client’s project goals and maintain the company’s alignment to these goals, enabling your team to exceed client expectations and budgeted profitability.

As a Senior Project Manager, You Will:

  • Lead Proposal Development – Participate in proposal scope, schedule, and cost estimates, as well as Project Management methodology and project pricing and structure. Prepare for a successful handoff from Business Development.
  • Manage Client Communication – Ensure effective communication between the client, the project team, Business Development, and the management team at all phases of the project. Be effective at resolving scope, schedule and cost issues as they arise.
  • Project Schedule and Plan – Develop the project labor resource plan and procurement plan to meet the client’s schedule objective and project cash flow requirements.
  • Drive Scope – Maintain firm control of scope and compliance with specifications and contract requirements. Ensure that scope is well defined and communicated, and proactively obtain any required Change Orders, develop additional scope opportunities which may serve the client’s objective.
  • Maintain Cost – Develop and maintain project cost budgets and reports; manage estimated cost at completion, earned value, and contingency. Forecast monthly project costs avoiding cost overruns.
  • Lead the Project Team – Lead the project team in achieving the project tasks and milestones on schedule and under budget. Work closely with the Operations group to ensure that the right resources are assigned to the project at the optimal time. Communicate project progress to the team and to the client and be an effective advocate for the project team. Identify project risks in advance and mobilize the necessary resources to mitigate risks.
  • Present regular project activity and financial updates on projects to large audiences of customers and/or internal associates/management/Executives.
  • Become proficient in the extensive use of the E TECH GROUP PMO Methods, Tools and Process specific to project management standards.
  • Participate in the implementation of new project management tools that will be utilized across the enterprise.
  • Develop a strong level of understanding of E TECH GROUP’s Project Management Life (PMLC) Cycle Stages.
  • Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

You Have:

  • BS Engineering degree or equivalent education/experience background.
  • At least 3 years of dedicated project management experience or 5+ years in a project engineering environment.
  • Proficient in the utilization of project management principles, methods, and tools.
  • Ability to implement Project Management Institute (PMI) based standards into the E TECH GROUP culture, and serve as a mentor to other associates.
  • Proven project leadership on difficult projects, applications, solutions, and situations.
  • Proven performance in a stressful environment.
  • Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills.
  • The ability to utilize technology to lead geographically dispersed project teams.
  • Experience managing contracts and/or subcontractors.
  • Experienced in the use of project management software such as MS Project.
  • Familiarity with industrial controls projects.
  • Experience with project budget / fiscal accountability.
  • A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

You May Have:

  • Controls Engineering background.
  • Experience with true design projects (EOR).
  • PMP Certified preferred
  • Experience managing control system, HMI, plant data historian, and other industrial projects

Benefits & Perks:

  • 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
  • Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
  • Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

title: VP, Technology Product Management
description:
We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Vice President, Technology Product Management to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of a portfolio of pharmacy health technology products, including clinical decision platforms, data-driven solutions, and AI-enabled workflow tools. This leader will operate at the intersection of pharmacy, healthcare, technology, and innovation, translating clinical and market needs into differentiated, scalable products that drive measurable outcomes.

Reporting to executive leadership, this role is a key partner in shaping enterprise strategy, advancing AI capabilities, and driving platform transformation within regulated pharmacy healthcare environments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the pharmacy health technology portfolio.
  • Ensure alignment of product strategy with organizational, clinical, and commercial objectives.
  • Oversee the full product lifecycle, from discovery through delivery and optimization.
  • Drive differentiation through innovation, data, and AI-enabled capabilities.

2. Executive Leadership & Organizational Impact

  • Lead and develop senior product leaders, managers, and high-level professionals.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Segment GM and executive team, contributing to corporate strategy and planning.
  • Represent product strategy in executive reviews, board discussions, and investor forums.
  • Drive business-wide initiatives, including digital transformation, growth strategy, and M&A evaluation.

3. AI & Innovation Leadership

  • Develop and operationalize responsible AI strategies, including generative AI, NLP, intelligent search, and related technologies.
  • Identify high-impact opportunities where AI can improve clinical workflows, research productivity, and decision-making.
  • Ensure AI solutions are transparent, compliant, and clinically safe.

4. Platform Transformation & Product Delivery

  • Lead next-generation platform initiatives, ensuring scalability, reliability, and user-centered design.
  • Partner with engineering, data, and design teams to deliver high-quality product releases on time.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs, success metrics, and adoption benchmarks.

5. Customer & Market Leadership

  • Analyze market dynamics, customer needs, competitive developments, and regulatory shifts to guide product direction and maximize profitability.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of clinician, researcher, and healthcare workflows.
  • Lead voice-of-customer programs, advisory boards, and market research initiatives.
  • Conduct competitive analyses and market assessments to identify growth opportunities.
  • Serve as an external thought leader representing Wolters Kluwer at industry events and with strategic partners.

6. Commercial Enablement & Partnerships

  • Collaborate closely with product development, sales, content, technology, marketing, and partnerships teams to develop go-to-market strategies.
  • Translate product value into compelling commercial and customer narratives.
  • Evaluate and support strategic partnerships and M&A opportunities.

7. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all products meet applicable healthcare regulations, data privacy requirements, and clinical safety standards.
  • Partner with legal, compliance, and clinical SMEs to establish governance frameworks and mitigate risk.
  • Champion ethical, fair, and trustworthy AI and data practices.

8. Operational Excellence & Resource Management

  • Own product-level P&L performance, including revenue targets, product and content investments, pricing strategies, resource allocation, and cost management.
  • Lead large-scale budget planning, prioritization, and investment decisions.
  • Remove organizational barriers and drive cross-functional execution.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in a matrixed corporate product management environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare, Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in pharmacy, health technology, life sciences, or clinical research platforms.
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex, large-scale digital platforms or SaaS products.
  • Experience leading AI/ML-enabled products, including generative AI applications.
  • Strong executive presence with experience partnering with C-level stakeholders.
  • Track record of leading enterprise-wide, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep knowledge of modern product management practices, including Agile, Lean, Design Thinking, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience building and scaling high-performing product organizations.
  • Proven success translating pharmacy healthcare technology market needs into innovative product solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with M&A diligence and integration.
  • Experience delivering AI-enabled solutions within regulated environments.
  • Technical fluency or prior experience in technical product management.
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD) or relevant consulting experience.

Core Competencies & Skills

Strategic Leadership

  • Executive leadership and organizational influence.
  • Strategic initiative development and long-range planning.
  • Ability to align product strategy with enterprise objectives.

Product & Innovation Expertise

  • Product vision, roadmap development, and lifecycle management.
  • Innovation leadership focused on AI-enabled transformation.
  • Platform strategy and ecosystem development.

Business & Market Acumen

  • Market strategy, customer insight, and competitive positioning.
  • Commercial mindset with strong go-to-market partnership capabilities.

Analytical & Execution Excellence

  • KPI development and data-driven decision-making.
  • Ability to balance speed, quality, cost, and risk.
  • Strong problem-solving skills in complex, regulated environments.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to align stakeholders across product, engineering, clinical, and business functions.
  • High emotional intelligence and a passion for talent development.

Ethics & Governance

  • Commitment to responsible AI, data privacy, and clinical safety.
  • Strong judgment in navigating risk, compliance, and trust.

Success in This Role

  • Deliver market-leading pharmacy health technology products with measurable customer and business impact.
  • Successfully modernize platforms and integrate AI-driven capabilities.
  • Create strong alignment across executive leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Build and lead a high-performing product organization with clear accountability and results.

title: Senior Reliability Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Alphia is a leading manufacturer of pet food – extruded (dry kibble) and baked (treats). Alphia has 7 plants across the United States.

JOB PURPOSE:

The Senior Reliability Engineer ensures that systems, products, or equipment operate reliably over their expected lifespan by identifying potential failures, mitigating risks, and optimizing performance.

The Senior Reliability Engineer role is to identify and manage asset reliability risks. They track the production losses and abnormally high maintenance cost assets, then find ways to reduce those losses or high costs. Senior Reliability Engineer develops a plan to eliminate or reduce the losses through root cause analysis, obtains approval of the plan and facilitates the implementation.

Within the Alphia organization, this plays a critical role by applying maintenance & reliability principles to predict, prevent, and mitigate failures. They collaborate with maintenance, engineers, manufacturing teams, safety teams, and quality assurance to enhance system reliability. The responsibilities include conducting failure mode analysis, developing reliability models, and driving continuous improvement.

You should have a strong understanding of reliability engineering and statistical analysis, as well as a thorough knowledge of maintenance management and manufacturing processes. Success in this role requires strong technical capability in maintenance, and the ability to drive cross-functional improvements that enhance safety, quality, service, and total delivered cost.

This position is also responsible for developing and executing strategic and tactical Maintenance and Reliability plans across multiple manufacturing sites.

DESCRIPTION OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

Core Responsibilities

Reliability Engineers are responsible for maintaining and improving the reliability and performance of equipment, systems, and processes. Key duties include:

  • Designing and implementing reliability strategies to enhance system performance and longevity

  • Conducting Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to proactively identify potential failures

  • Perform reliability analyses such as FMEA (Failure Modes and Effects Analysis), RCM (Reliability-Centered Maintenance), and root cause analysis (RCA) to identify potential system failures and recommend corrective actions.

  • Know the process and help to conduct 5S projects as it pertains to Maintenance and MRO.

  • Developing preventive and predictive maintenance plans based on data analysis

  • Monitoring system performance and identifying reliability issues using statistical tools and reliability modeling

  • Evaluate equipment failure modes and utilize engineering experience and training to develop solutions for eliminating/mitigating potential failure

  • Monitor equipment performance and evaluate equipment history and failure trends to determine sources of poor component performance

  • Lead targeted initiatives to improve throughput, yield, labor utilization, and equipment reliability

  • Identify, evaluate, and introduce new processes/technologies, automation solutions, and equipment upgrades to enhance capability and efficiency

Leadership Skills

  • Coordinate internal stakeholders, contractors, and equipment suppliers to ensure alignment and accountability.

  • Providing technical guidance and training to team members and maintaining reliability metrics and reports

  • Ensure compliance with all safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards

  • Technical support for factory and corporate maintenance functions.

  • Development and review of technical and operational standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Technical Expertise

  • Provide support to maintenance, engineering, operations, safety, CI, and quality teams

  • Participate in problem solving and root cause analysis for production issues.

  • Collaborate with Finance to quantify savings, build business cases, validate financial impact, and ensure benefits are sustained in the P&L.

  • Partner with all manufacturing locations to develop Reliability Best Practices and to collaboratively work through common issues.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: (To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Chemical or Manufacturing Engineering

  • 5-7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, continuous improvement, or related roles within a manufacturing environment (CPG or food manufacturing a plus)

  • Knowledge of reliability engineering methodologies, such as RCM (Reliability-Centered Maintenance)

  • Strong knowledge of reliability metrics such as MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), MTTR (Mean Time to Repair), and availability.

  • Experienced in FMEA, RCM, fault tree analysis, and root cause analysis techniques.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and make data-driven decisions.

  • Experience extracting and structuring data from CMMS and MES/plant performance systems (e.g., Redzone, Ignition, data historians) and building analytical insights and reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Excel

  • Proficiency in reliability analysis tools/software and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel up to 40% to other Alphia plants or vendors within the US, with potential irregularity depending on specific projects or engineering activities.

  • Willingness to work off-shifts and weekends at times depending on specific projects

WORK ENVIRONMENT: (The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions).

  • The employee may be frequently exposed to allergens and/or airborne particles in the production area. Production employees are exposed to temperatures ranging from 50 to 115 degrees, depending on the season and workstation, and maybe working near moving mechanical parts. Occasional exposure to outdoor weather conditions may occur.

  • The noise level in the work environment may be loud while production equipment is running.

Personal Protection Equipment (including, but not limited to, boots, gloves, safety glasses, and/or face shields) is required during various processes in the production area. Ear plugs and bump caps are required at all times in the production area.

description:
As a Workload Orchestration Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be recognised internally as an expert in workload orchestration, owning and advancing our scheduler tech stack across our High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms. With the rapid expansion of our compute infrastructure, your broad expertise will drive the efficient scheduling, policy management, and resource optimization of our multi-node CPU and GPU environments.

In this role, you will use your expertise to bridge traditional scientific computing with modern AI paradigms, while acting as a coach and mentor to help colleagues develop technical expertise. You will solve unique, unprecedented scheduling and infrastructure challenges that directly impact Roche’s compute architecture, ensuring our researchers, data scientists, and engineers can execute compute workloads reliably, efficiently, and successfully.

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premises infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.

The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team acts as a center of excellence and delivery for High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping infrastructure consumers optimize for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI to achieve rapid time-to-value.

The Opportunity:

SLURM Architecture & Ecosystem Leadership

  • Serve as the internal expert on the SLURM Workload Manager, architecting, scaling, and maintaining SLURM across heterogeneous HPC (and AI environments) to ensure high availability and dynamic resource distribution.

  • Design and tune advanced SLURM configurations, including custom plugin integration, topology-aware scheduling, GRES/GPU management, dynamic priority trees, and complex QoS/fair-share policies.

  • Bridge HPC and cloud-native ecosystems by evaluating and implementing integrations between SLURM, Kubernetes, and orchestration platforms (e.g., SLURM Slinky or Run:ai) to streamline job submission workflows across architectures.

Hybrid Workload & Kubernetes Integration

  • Integrate containerization standards across SLURM (using Singularity/Apptainer) while maintaining operational familiarity with Kubernetes container orchestration to support hybrid AI/HPC workloads.

  • Solve unique, unprecedented multi-tenant bottlenecks, such as GPU allocation overhead, MPI/NCCL communication failures, and complex workload failures.

Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Governance

  • Lead large, global cross-functional initiatives across ACE, infrastructure, platform, scientific computing, and AI teams to establish workload orchestration standards, policies, and architectural patterns across Roche compute environments.

  • Act as a technical mentor and coach for junior and mid-level engineers, driving skill development and continuous learning across the chapter.

  • Partner with Observability Engineers to establish deep telemetry dashboards for SLURM job efficiency, queue wait times, and hardware utilization, utilizing configuration-as-code to deploy policies uniformly.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Broad Platform Expertise: Apply broad knowledge across HPC, AI infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, networking/interconnects, observability, automation, and capacity management to solve orchestration problems spanning multiple technology domains.

  • Coaching & Collaboration: Strong leadership presence with a dedication to mentoring colleagues, driving technical standards, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams.

  • Cross-Organizational Coordination: Collaborative team player with demonstrated ability to coordinate initiatives across diverse global business units, IT functions, and scientific research stakeholders.

title: Senior Delegated Authority Technician
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Working at Howden Re

At Howden Re, we’re on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do.

As a big global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one-size-fits-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace. Our team is empowered to drive progress, creating opportunities for career and personal development, unlocking new value for clients, fostering long-term partnerships, and using the collective power of Howden to change how the world sees risk and insurance.

When you join Howden Re, you become part of a vibrant and entrepreneurial workplace culture that prioritises collaboration, ownership, and shared success. Here, your contributions will directly impact our mission to be the global partner of choice in reinsurance and strategic advisory.

Be a part of Howden Re's exciting journey. Together, we are shaping the future of reinsurance.

The Role

A Senior Delegated Authority Technician is responsible for supporting all post-placement processing activities relating to Delegated Authority Placements. Ensuring the efficient, accurate and compliant handling of premium, claims and bordereau transactions.

The role will support both the onshore and offshore processing teams, driving operational excellence, service delivery, process standardisation and continuous improvement. Working closely with broking, technical, claims and finance teams, a senior Technician will ensure processing activities support the business's growth ambitions while maintaining appropriate controls and client service standards.

This role will play a key part in the ongoing transformation of Bowood & Programs Operations, helping to deliver improved servicing standards and supporting the development of our offshore and onshore operations.

What will you be doing?

  • Support all processing activities across Bowood & Programs.

  • Ensure the accurate and timely processing of premium, claims and bordereau transactions.

  • Drive high levels of service delivery to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Monitor workloads and allocate resources effectively to meet business demands.

  • Manage operational risks and escalation points relating to processing activities.

  • Support the development of the offshore processing resources.

  • Ensure effective workflow management between onshore and offshore team members.

  • Help monitor quality, productivity and service delivery across outsourced functions.

  • Support initiatives to standardise processing activities across the business.

  • Support the implementation of new systems and other strategic technology initiatives.

  • Develop strong relationships with brokers, technical teams, claims teams, finance and senior management.

  • Provide regular reporting and updates to senior leadership.

  • Support strategic business initiatives and operational projects.

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory, Lloyd's, carrier and internal governance requirements.

Who are we looking for?

Essential

  • Significant experience within delegated authority, binder, MGA or insurance operations.

  • Strong understanding of premium and claims bordereau processing.

  • Experience with offshore or outsourced operational services.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Desirable

  • London Market and Lloyd's experience.

  • Knowledge of OpenTWINS, GlobalXB, Brokasure or similar market systems.

  • Experience of workflow and automation technologies.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Product Manager III, Rapid API - Post-Booking

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B is the B2B arm of Expedia Group. We bring innovative technology and distribution solutions to partners across the world, powering travel partnerships at scale through access to one of the industry's most comprehensive travel supply sets.

Within this space, our Post-Booking Servicing team focuses on everything that happens after a traveler books: modifications, cancellations, refunds, relocations, and the tools and notifications that keep partners, travelers, and suppliers aligned when plans change. This role is centered on the lodging vertical, with a strong emphasis on API-driven servicing capabilities, partner self-serve tooling, and reducing the cost and friction of post-booking events.

The Role

As a Product Manager III on the Post-Booking Servicing team, you will own product strategy and execution for the capabilities that manage a booking's lifecycle after confirmation. You will work at the intersection of partner needs, operational realities, and technical delivery to build products that make cancellations, refunds, relocations, and disruption handling faster, more transparent, and less dependent on manual intervention.

This role is ideal for a product manager who is energized by operational complexity, has strong instincts for API product design, and can translate messy real-world servicing scenarios into clear, scalable product solutions.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and evolve the product roadmap for post-booking servicing capabilities, including modifications, cancellations, refunds, relocations, and disruption notifications, prioritizing based on partner impact, servicing cost, and technical feasibility

  • Partner closely with engineering teams across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and API design through launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization of servicing workflows

  • Develop a deep understanding of the financial, operational, and compliance rules that govern refunds, cancellations, and modifications, and translate them into clear product and API requirements

  • Define self-serve capabilities, including AI-assisted case triage and resolution suggestions, that let partners resolve servicing requests independently and reduce contact center volume

  • Design proactive and reactive notification capabilities (e.g., disruption alerts, availability changes, relocation triggers) that keep partners and travelers informed with minimal manual intervention

  • Collaborate with commercial, operations, servicing, and partner success teams to define clear escalation paths, ownership boundaries, and service-level expectations across partners

  • Define and track success metrics such as self-serve adoption, resolution time, contact center deflection, servicing cost per booking, and partner satisfaction

  • Identify opportunities to differentiate servicing for high-value traveler segments and strategic partners through tailored SLAs and enhanced capabilities

  • Communicate product vision, priorities, trade-offs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership

  • Contribute to broader servicing strategy by bringing insights from partner feedback, operational data, and industry trends in post-booking experience

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in B2B, platform, marketplace, or travel technology products

  • Strong experience with API or platform products, including a solid understanding of RESTful APIs, integration workflows, and developer experience

  • Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, create roadmaps, write clear requirements, and deliver iteratively with engineering teams

  • Experience working in operationally complex domains where financial, compliance, or policy rules directly shape product requirements

  • Strong analytical skills, including experience using data and product metrics to inform prioritization and measure outcomes

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across technical, commercial, and operational teams

Preferred

  • Experience in the travel industry, particularly in servicing, customer care, or partner-facing product roles

  • Familiarity with modern API patterns and integration models

  • Experience with AI-enabled product capabilities or intelligent automation to reduce manual servicing effort

  • Experience participating in partner engagements such as roadmap discussions, business reviews, or escalation reviews

title: Software Architect - Enterprise AI
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Architect, Enterprise AI (L6)

About the job

This position is needed to define and drive the vision, software architecture, and establish the AI/ML platforms across all of our business functions internally at Twilio.

Our charter and remit has expanded to cover all of the business teams companywide, including Marketing, Sales, Customer Support & Global Operations, along with our corporate functions, including HR/People, Finance, Legal, Security & Privacy. This role requires a deep understanding of AI/ML platforms, full-stack software architecture, a strategic system design mindset, and the ability to drive innovation and efficiency across the organization.

The AI/ML Software Architect position will serve as a key technical leader in our Enterprise AI Engineering group, and s/he will provide architectural guidance globally, across our U.S., Canada, Colombia, and India teams. You will be responsible for shaping our long-term technical vision, establishing architectural standards and guardrails, and establishing our best practices for the modern AI-Assisted SDLC practice. You will drive cross-organizational initiatives, solve complex and ambiguous technical challenges, and partner with other Cross-BU Software Architects to elevate the technical standard for Twilio company-wide.

You will be responsible for guiding technical blueprints, mentoring developers, and partnering with program managers, designers, full stack developers, and AI/ML engineers to set our team up for long-term success. The ideal candidate should have experience across the software lifecycle from architecture, design, development, deployment and maintenance of modern, cloud applications. This is an opportunity to be an integral leader of a fast-growing engineering team, and shape the future of how Twilio works

This leadership role requires a range of technical expertise in full-stack software architecture, LLM and Agentic Applications, and ability to drive effective stakeholder collaboration and present work with executive leadership. To succeed in this role, you will have a strong sense of ownership for our engineering products, and possess a deep technical background to develop constant growth and innovation. This is an opportunity to be the key leader of a fast-growing team, and shape the future of how Twilio works for internal Twilions and customers alike.

Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:
  • Establish and model a high-performance culture of our Software Engineering team.
  • Grow and mentor senior technical leaders, building a durable culture of engineering excellence.
  • Lead architecture for the Enterprise AI engineering platform and products, ensuring consistency and quality through cross-product reviews and shared standards.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and executive partners to shape where we're headed.
  • Own the most complex engineering problems at enterprise scale.
  • Present to executive leadership on our AI Engineering plans and deliverables.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work across different verticals (Support, Sales, Marketing, Operations, etc.) to ideate, develop, and implement new AI/ML solutions that drive business growth.
  • Cultivate a team of builders and owners that collaborate, grow and continuously improve together.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 15+ years of experience designing and scaling distributed systems and platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical vision and strategy at an enterprise or company-wide level.
  • Expertise in system design, reliability, scalability, security, and cost optimization for large-scale architectures.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and resolving highly complex, ambiguous technical problems.
  • Proven record of mentoring senior engineering talent and elevating organizational standards.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, influence, and leadership skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • $234,880 - $293,600 CAD
  • Target Bonus Percentage 20%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. title: Product Analyst, Digital Channels
description:
Job Description:

The Role

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Digital Channels teams create digital experiences that help customers confidently manage their financial lives. We work at the intersection of product, technology, and design to solve meaningful customer and business problems at scale.

As a Product Analyst, you help product teams turn ambiguity into clarity. You bring product knowledge, data-driven thinking, and execution discipline to help teams make better decisions and deliver high-quality digital experiences.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring evidence into decisions by using data, customer feedback, and operational insight to inform product and delivery conversations.

  • Frame problems as testable hypotheses, helping teams validate ideas before committing to build.

  • Define what success looks like, measure results after launch, and distinguish between what shipped and what was solved.

  • Translate product intent and customer/business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

  • Know how our systems and business work — rules, dependencies, workflows, and customer impacts.

  • Enable speed in a regulated business by engaging Legal, Risk, and Compliance early so integrity is built into solutions from the start.

  • Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, testing, business acceptance, release readiness, and implementation.

  • Use AI tools to shorten the path from question to decision, accelerating analysis and improving the quality of what the team knows.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree with 5 plus years of business analysis or related experience, or Master's degree with 3 plus years; financial services or regulated-industry experience preferred.

  • Experience supporting digital products or capabilities through the full lifecycle, from discovery through launch and measurement.

  • Strong business analysis fundamentals, including process modeling, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Data fluency, with hands-on experience using Excel, BI tools, or other methods to generate insights.

  • Systems thinking, with the ability to connect platforms, business rules, dependencies, and customer impacts.

  • Ability to form a clear point of view from evidence and refine it as new information emerges.

  • Strong communication and influence skills, translating complexity into action across teams.

  • Sound judgment to match the depth of analysis to the decision at hand.

  • Ownership mindset, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools — and a point of view on where they help, where they fall short, and how to verify what they produce.

The strongest candidates build trusted relationships across product, technology, design, and stakeholders — and use that trust to move work forward through ambiguity, incomplete information, and competing priorities. They are curious about why customers behave the way they do, disciplined in testing assumptions, and focused on helping teams understand the actual impact their solutions deliver.

The Team

Digital Channels teams improve the digital experiences customers use every day to manage their financial lives. We work across products, platforms, and customer journeys to create experiences that are simple, reliable, and valuable. This role is aligned to our Core Experiences group, which supports critical Account Opening and Money Movement capabilities across the digital experience.

As a member of our community, you'll join a group of product-minded analysts who bring together customer understanding, data, domain knowledge, and delivery discipline. You'll receive coaching and development support while helping shape the future of Fidelity's digital products and experiences.

title: Concierge Security Engineer 3
description:
Concierge Security Engineer 3

Global Job Code: SSCOP3

Job Level: P3

Position Overview and Objective

The Concierge Security Engineer 3 owns the technical relationship with their assigned customers and leverages their skills and expertise to create, maintain an outstanding partnership with customers around the provision of security services and drive customer security outcomes as wells as risk reduction activities. Beyond the technical relationship, the Concierge Security Engineer 3 quarterbacks the overall customer experience—coordinating across service lines (cSOC, GTS2, AWIR, and Aurora) and owning the outcome. The Concierge Security Engineer 3 may perform the duties of the team captain to coordinate the day-to-day work of the Concierge Security Team.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Build and maintain a trusted relationship with assigned customers. Lead discussions on security strategy, governance, and industry best practices.

Independently prepare, deliver and carry out post work for consultancy session.

Support Concierge Security Engineers 2 in advanced tasks. Ensure the technical correctness of analysis and presentations prepared by team members before customer delivery.

If the Concierge Security Engineer 3 is acting as the team captain:

  • Be the first owner of all sensitive customer issues
  • Organize the day-to-day work which includes assigning tasks and balancing workload for team members
  • Coach and mentor new or junior team members in Arctic Wolf and Industry Best Practices
  • Be the point of contact for managers to identify areas of improvement and other topics
  • Be able to effectively communicate complex issues with a customer’s C-Suite level executive team

Interact on behalf of AWN with customers as a technical representative and provider of security services. Create and deliver enhanced reports for the customer. Analyze security events utilizing all relevant customer data, including but not limited to network, endpoint, and log sources expediently. Leverage education and training to identify correlations in client environments to determine if behavior is expected. Analyze and interpret complex security findings, incidents, vulnerabilities, and trends to provide actionable guidance to customers. Consult with customers on risk reduction strategies and coordinate with internal subject matter experts to address complex security concerns. Prepare and document security governance, standard operating procedures, and protocols; translate technical findings into meaningful business outcomes, enable customers to understand risk exposure and prioritize remediation efforts, and present tailored recommendations independently or with your team.

Assess customer environments and provide recommendations regarding security configuration, controls, and operational improvements. Also, present the tailored outcomes to the customer independently or with your team.

Determine the need for escalation and proactively communicate and coordinate with customers and stakeholders (both internal and external to AWN). Provide sufficient context in escalations (summary, impact, urgency, and customer sentiment) so downstream teams can act without re-interviewing the customer. Coordinate with internal experts and service teams to resolve complex issues. Own or drive escalations and ensure appropriate follow-through.

Educate and train staff on information system security best practices. Educate or consult customers on security capabilities, processes, and recommendations, and advocate for customers internally while helping align services to customer objectives.

Be on camera for all meetings (internal, vendor, and customer) to ensure effective communication and engagement. Maintain professional appearance and environment during video interactions.

AI Workflow Design & Optimization: Design, implement, and maintain standardized AI workflows and prompt libraries that streamline Concierge operations.

Cross-Team AI Feedback Loops: Act as the Concierge subject matter expert (SME) partnering with Product, R&D, and SOC/Detections teams to test, benchmark, and refine internal AI models, agents, and automated playbooks.

Mentorship & AI Upskilling: Coach and mentor CSE2 engineers on best practices for AI adoption, prompt formulation, and critical analysis of model outputs.

Adversarial AI & AI Threat Landscape Awareness: Monitor and advise on emerging threats involving generative AI, prompt injection, and adversarial attacks targeting customer environments or security tooling.

Key Skills

Networking: Strong understanding of common business network requirements and knowledge of some common equipment brands. Ability to perform simple network troubleshooting. Ability to scope requirements for AWN services based on client's network.

Cloud: Ability to enable IaaS-specific security controls. Ability to troubleshoot simple cloud-based service configurations for logging purposes. Familiarity with regional privacy laws.

Software as a Service: Knowledge of vulnerability management including tools and processes used to create an effective vulnerability management program.

Strong knowledge of vulnerability management including tools and processes used to create an effective vulnerability management program. Strong understanding of the concepts of Business Continuity Planning. Strong understanding of Disaster Recovery Planning and Incident Response concepts.

Authentication & Access Control: Strong understanding of Active Directory policies and events. High-level understanding of the features of Group Policy and working with INF security templates.

Endpoint: Understanding of how to harden a system using best practices and frameworks like the CIS benchmarks. Understanding of common tools used to conduct OS Based attacks. Ability to audit and make policy recommendations for common EPP/EDR solutions. Ability to read and effectively use Windows event logs, especially those originating from Sysmon, to conduct investigations and make security recommendations. Knowledge of common Windows services and protocols and how they should be properly secured.

Perimeter: Intermediate understanding of firewall concepts. Some intermediate troubleshooting skills. Familiarity with hardening common services. Be able to speak to specific advantages between IDS & IPS and when and where you might use one over the other. Familiarity with typical VPN scenarios. Knowledge of GEO filtering and potential impacts.

Communication: Hold technical conversations effectively in English, plus any additional languages required for the location, in both written and verbal contexts. Strong customer de-escalation and conflict resolution skills. Ability to break down client requests into actionable, trackable tasks.

Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking to resolve issues and overcome challenges with some assistance as required.

Customer Focus: Brings together aspects of a trend or policy into a clear picture for internal and customers to understand. Looks for ways to add value beyond customers' immediate requests and acts on them. Anticipates customers' upcoming needs and concerns. Explores and addresses long-term customer needs. Demonstrates a strong commitment to customer success by providing responsive, transparent, and proactive support—keeping customers informed throughout service delivery, responding within established SLOs, and following through on commitments. Prioritizes customers' concerns and addresses them quickly and with the customer's best interest in mind.

Key Competencies

Strategic Ownership: Owns the end-to-end customer outcome and quarterbacks the experience across service lines (cSOC, GTO, AWIR, and Aurora), coordinating internal teams and driving issues to resolution.

Analytical Thinking: Analyzes and interprets complex security events, incidents, vulnerabilities, and trends across network, endpoint, cloud, and log data to deliver sound, actionable guidance without supervision.

Independent Judgment: Manages assigned customers and consultancy sessions independently on any topic, exercising confident judgment on complex, cross-domain matters and recognizing when to engage other experts.

Communication and Influence: Explains complex technical issues clearly to both technical teams and C-suite executive audiences, and builds credible, trusted relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

Leadership and Mentorship: Coaches and mentors Concierge Security Engineers 2 and junior team members, ensures the technical correctness of their work, and—when acting as team captain—coordinates the team's day-to-day workload.

Collaboration: Partners with internal subject matter experts and service teams to resolve complex, cross-functional issues while keeping the customer experience coordinated rather than fragmented.

Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Stays current with evolving security threats, tools, and best practices and applies new knowledge to customer environments.

Minimum Qualifications

5 years relevant experience

Relevant IT or security education could include university degree, college diploma, or industry certifications

Technical competencies are generally at the intermediate level, as the engineer has to manage customers independently. May have technical competency of special interest at the advanced level.

Preferred Qualifications

7 or more years of experience in a security operations, MDR/SOC, or managed security services (MSSP) environment.

Advanced industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCED, CISSP, or equivalent.

Deep hands-on experience with EPP/EDR platforms, SIEM or log-analysis tooling, and cloud (IaaS/SaaS) security.

Demonstrated experience presenting security findings and recommendations to both technical teams and C-suite/executive stakeholders.

Working knowledge of common security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001).

Experience mentoring junior engineers or acting as a team lead.

Proficiency in an additional language beyond English, aligned to regional customer coverage.

Environment and Physical Demands

Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed in sitting or standing positions in an office environment.

Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity.

If located near a company office, an in-office presence is required, and the role often requires the mobility to physically navigate the space.

In the event of business travel, mobility sufficient to utilize public and private transport and navigate to essential locations.

May include moving or lifting of 25 pounds or less (e.g., office chair, reams of paper).

Requires frequent participation in video-based meetings using standard conferencing tools. Must have the ability to remain on camera for extended periods and maintain a professional setting suitable for video communication.

Travel Requirements

Typically 10% or less of business travel

Exemption Status to be reviewed by Legal

Exempt

Security Requirements

Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of AWN business information.

Each successful candidate will be required to pass a criminal background check and an employment verification as a condition of employment.

The base salary range for this job family is 7,719,000 to 18,426,000 JPY annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Solutions Architect - Traded Systems
description:
Job Type:

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

Position: Solution Architect – Traded Systems, Hiscox USA
Reporting to: Head of Solution Architecture, US
Location: Atlanta/Boston


The Role:
The Solution Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and evolving end‑to‑end technology solutions that support the insurance value chain, including underwriting, policy administration, billing, claims, and distribution. This role partners closely with business leaders, product owners, engineering teams, and third‑party vendors to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

Hiscox is transforming the applications that support our Traded/Broker business which today includes multiple platforms and technologies. This is a great opportunity to drive change that will have meaningful business benefits.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong insurance domain knowledge and the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solution designs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Interact with a range of people, from highly technical software engineers to Senior Executive stakeholders. This means the ability to change their style/approach is essential. Identifying what a particular stakeholder needs to know or is concerned about is critical to ensuring that projects address the major stakeholder concerns on an on-going basis.

  • Take ownership of the overall architecture strategy/design for a complex program of work and communicate it to all members of a project team. Technical, architectural, functional and impact and risk elements of the design need to be conveyed to technical and non-technical members. Presenting options, risks, recommendations in a language and a way that shows understanding and technical leadership is essential.

  • Document and develop architectural artifacts include As-Is Architecture, Transformation Architecture and End-State or To-Be Architecture. Defend these solutions in front of a local and enterprise Architecture Review Board.

  • Work closely with technical and business teams to confirm architecture artifacts match current implementations as well as understand how changes affect current and future implementations.

  • Partner with corresponding team members ensure all of our downstream system integrations (such as Reporting, Document Production, Finance and others) are supported as the evolution of our core platform progresses.

  • Interact with business domain experts and therefore must be comfortable acquiring and using business domain language and knowledge to convey concepts and recommendations.

  • Engage with and assist technical teams in delivering the Solution. From understanding testing requirements to being involved with the development of solution using a variety of technologies such as Java (and/or Microsoft .NET) the Solution Architect is required to be able to engage and operate across a broad range of technologies including relational database systems (e.g. Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle), and integration platforms (e.g. webMethods and Apigee).

Person Specification


Requirements:
For those interested applicants, please send a resume which clearly tells the story and demonstrates evidence of the following:

  • 5+ years of experience in solution, systems, or enterprise architecture

  • 5+ years of experience in insurance technology environments

  • Strong knowledge of P&C or Commercial insurance operations (policy lifecycle, claims, billing)

  • Experience with Core Insurance Platforms

  • Clearly stated demonstrable practical experience and understanding of best practice architecture principles

  • Strong communication, storytelling and presentation skills; Ability to engage, influence and motivate stakeholders at all levels

  • Experienced in an Agile software development environment

  • Strong software engineering or lead developer experience – the ability to take that experience up a level to the Solution Architecture space

  • Track record of managing the architecture of multiple change projects/programs in a complex environment

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Highly results/outcomes driven, with the energy and determination to succeed in a very fast paced environment where the pace and quality of response is critical to success

  • Be a go-to resource for other solution architects and technical architects that are looking for assistance with solving complex architecture issues

  • Review other architects solutions and ensure those solutions align with program goals

  • Motivated self-starter who can work autonomously and add value in a team

  • Excellent interpersonal, organization and time management skills

  • Must be cooperative, flexible and able to work well with others

Hiscox Values:

At Hiscox our spirit is in Challenging Convention and everything we do is guided by our Values.

  • Courage: Dare to take a risk

  • Ownership: Passionate, commercial and accountable

  • Integrity: Do the right thing, however hard

  • Connected: Together, build something better

  • Human: Clear, fair and inclusive

What Hiscox USA Offers:

  • Competitive salary and bonus (based on personal & company performance)

  • 401(k) with competitive company matching

  • Comprehensive health insurance, vision, dental and FSA plans (medical, limited purpose, and dependent care)

  • Company paid group term life, short- term disability and long-term disability coverage

  • 24 Paid time off days, 2 Hiscox Days, 10 paid holidays, and ability to purchase 5 PTO days

  • Paid parental leave

  • 4 week paid sabbatical after every 5 years of service

  • Financial Adoption Assistance and Medical Travel Reimbursement Programs

  • Annual reimbursement up to $600 for health club membership or fees associated with any fitness program

  • Company paid subscription to Headspace to support employees’ mental health and wellbeing

  • Recipient of 2024 Cigna’s Well-Being Award for having a best-in-class health and wellness program

  • Dynamic, creative and values-driven culture

  • Modern and open office spaces, complimentary drinks

**Please note that this position is hybrid and requires two (2) days in our office weekly**

Salary Range: $110-$150k

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment

About Hiscox USA:

Hiscox USA underwrites small- to mid-market commercial risks through brokers, other insurers and distribution partners and directly to businesses. In 2026, gross written premiums for the segment will represent over $1bn. Circa 50% of the portfolio comprises small commercial business sold either online or through intermediaries, and the remaining 50% represents traditionally traded business intermediated through broking partners including Professions, Crisis Management and Specialist lines such as Media & Entertainment. Hiscox USA has built the digital business since 2010 through ongoing investment in the brand, technology and operational capabilities. The business has pursued an omni-channel approach since inception, and so are less constrained by the channel conflict which affects some competitors. Customers have a choice of buying policies online end-to-end, by connecting with a Hiscox agent over the telephone, or alternatively through a third-party broker or insurance carrier partner. The business follows an ‘all roads lead to Hiscox’ philosophy, ensuring it is available to do business with target customers whichever way they choose.
