title: klantenadviseur KMO
description:
Liantis zoekt klantenadviseurs met een helikopterperspectief. Want bij jou draait het om meer dan die ene vraag alleen. Jij kent de klant door en door. Detecteert de noden. Met het hoofd niet in de lucht, maar met beide voeten tussen de klanten, collega’s en externe partners. Jouw expertise? Payroll. Dat maakt van jou het eerste aanspreekpunt voor loonbeheer en sociale wetgeving. Klaar voor vertrek?

Zo ziet jouw job eruit

“Elke dag is anders. Maar ik haal altijd voldoening uit de job”, vertelt Arzu, klantenadviseur payroll. Hoe zo’n dag eruitziet?

  • Of klanten je nu mailen of opbellen. Jij zit klaar om hun sociaal-juridische vragen in te lossen. Want jij bent de kenner en het aanspreekpunt voor loonbeheer en sociale wetgeving.

  • Door jou gebeuren de loonberekeningen op tijd en correct. Ook andere operationele taken – met externe partners samenwerken, rapporten opvragen, de het klantendossier updaten – vallen onder jouw betrouwbaar toezicht.

  • Met een tiental klantenbezoeken per jaar pols je proactief waar je kan ondersteunen. Zoekt de klant een hr-softwarepakket? Staat het preventie- en welzijnsbeleid op punt? De klant vertrouwt je, want je wijst de weg waar nodig.

Goed om weten: op je eerste werkdag heten we je warm welkom en ga je aan de slag met start@payroll. Ons opleidingstraject waarin je drie maanden begeleid wordt. Zo sta je meteen sterk in je schoenen, klaar om te groeien als klantenadviseur payroll.

Herken je jezelf hierin?

  • Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma op zak en reeds enkele jaren ervaring in payroll. Maar het allerbelangrijkst voor ons: je goesting om ervoor te gaan.

  • Sociaal zekerheidsrecht, arbeidsrecht en algemene sociale wetgeving? Dat is jouw winkel. Meer zelfs: je bijt je erin vast. En blijft zo altijd up-to-date.

  • Bij Liantis zit er een mens achter de cijfers en gegevens. En dat ben jij. Je geeft ze accuraat en punctueel in. Met alle zorg en oplettendheid.

  • Als klantenadviseur payroll ben je service- en mensgericht. Vlot in omgang en met een luisterend oor naar de klant, om hun noden te detecteren en op te lossen. Maar ook naar externe contacten zoals accountants, sectorfondsen, de RVA … En tot slot: je Liantis-collega's. Denk maar aan preventie en welzijn, sociaal verzekeringsfonds, risk solutions ...

  • Ben je stressbestendig? Mooi. Want klantendossiers zijn vaak complex. Hoe dan ook, samen met jouw collega’s helpen we bij Liantis klanten zo snel mogelijk verder.

  • Beheers je naast Nederlands ook vlot de Franse taal? Dan heb je enkele strepen voor!

Word je klantenadviseur payroll? Dan word je ambassadeur van Liantis. Je herkent jezelf in onze waarden: schouder aan schouder, handen uit de mouwen, echt en oprecht. En draagt ze mee uit.

Wat wij je te bieden hebben

Waarom je bij Liantis wilt werken? We zetten het op een rijtje.

  • Voor je comfort;

Je krijgt een aantrekkelijk loonpakket, dat je zelf deels samenstelt met ons flexibel verloningssysteem (extra vakantiedagen, een fietsleasing …). Naast je basisloon, krijg je ook maaltijd-, eco- en cadeaucheques. En als we de vooropgestelde doelstellingen bereiken, is ook de loonbonus een comfortabele extra. Maar de hoogste prioriteit: het welzijn van de medewerkers. Tijdens de job en erbuiten. Vandaar onze hospitalisatieverzekering en pensioenfonds.

  • Voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

Mensen zijn het kloppende hart van onze organisatie. Daarom zetten we bij Liantis sterk in op persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Zo krijg je de kans om je talenten te ontplooien, in een moderne en professionele werkomgeving in volle beweging. Met e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen. Resultaat? Een mooie loopbaan en voortdurende groei.

  • Voor je werk-privébalans.

Belonen is meer dan verlonen. We hechten waarde aan jouw werk-privébalans. Daarom werk je met een glijdend uurrooster van 38 uur per week. Telewerken? Tijdens je startersopleiding nog niet, maar daarna: zeker en vast. Ook mooi meegenomen: je krijgt 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.

Dit is Liantis

Bij Liantis zijn we meer dan een compagnon voor ondernemers en werkgevers; we zijn hun compagnon de route. Dit geldt niet alleen voor onze klanten, maar ook voor onze collega's. Onze compagnon cultuur staat voor samenwerken met een flexibele, mens- en klantgerichte mindset.

Wij geloven in het aanbieden van oplossingen die op het juiste moment inspelen op de behoeften van onze klanten. Daarbij zorgen we voor een werkomgeving waarin medewerkers zich gewaardeerd en ondersteund voelen, zodat iedereen bij Liantis zich met enthousiasme en trots kan inzetten. We organiseren onze oplossingen op een efficiënte en kwalitatieve wijze. Bij alles wat we doen draagt een persoonlijke en geïntegreerde dienstverlening bij aan onze collega's, klanten en partners. Kortom iedereen rondom ons.

Bij Liantis engageren we ons om een werkplek te bieden waar iedereen zich thuis voelt en waar jouw welzijn en professionele groei voorop staan. Ben je klaar om deel uit te maken van een team dat met trots compagnon is van meer dan 235.000 klanten? Solliciteer dan via bovenstaande knop! Heb je nog extra vragen na het lezen van deze vacature? Contacteer ons via joke.bulte@liantis.be of 0485 22 21 98.

Meer informatie over wie we zijn? Bezoek .

Ontdek de kansen, voel de sfeer: onze vacatures in beweging!

description:
Job Description:

Title: Sr Specialist Quality and Sensory

Location: Chicago, IL

Workstyle: Onsite

Mars Snacking does not sponsor visas for this role. This position is not eligible for relocation benefits

Accelerator, a global Division of Mars Snacking, is on the front line of unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands to fuel what’s next for Snacking. It’s home to both emerging and enduring brands, including KIND, TRÜ FRÜ, NATURE’S BAKERY, RXBAR, EGGO, POP-TARTS and RICE KRISPIE TREATS. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a start-up, our Division has the ambition to accelerate the future of snacking by delivering products consumers love today, discovering category-shaping innovations for tomorrow and developing entrepreneurial teams whose impact will last for generations.
We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!

The Sr. Specialist Quality and Sensory is responsible for the implementation, coordination, and continuous improvement of Mars Snacking quality and sensory programs to enable products consistently meet established quality, food safety, sensory, regulatory, and consumer expectations. This role serves as a key technical resource and liaison supporting the execution of quality standards across products, ingredients, suppliers, manufacturing sites, and commercialization activities and ensures that the products are safe for human consumption and meet customer, consumer and regulatory requirements to achieve business objectives. The Sr. Specialist Quality and Sensory provides technical leadership and collaboration to assure quality and sensory program requirements are effectively executed, measured, and sustained across the organization.to improve Q&FS Management System for the Mars Snacking Accelerator brands.


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Lead the implementation, coordination, and continuous improvement of company quality and sensory programs to support product excellence, consumer satisfaction, and business objectives.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute quality and sensory evaluation processes, methodologies, and standards to assess product and ingredient performance against established specifications.
  • Coordinate sensory testing activities, including descriptive analysis, discrimination testing, consumer evaluations, and product benchmarking to support product development, commercialization, and quality assurance initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain product and ingredient quality standards, specifications, scorecards, and monitoring systems to drive consistency across manufacturing locations and suppliers.
  • Monitor product quality performance metrics and sensory program effectiveness, communicating findings and recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Identify, recommend, and implement corrective and preventive actions to address quality and sensory risks and improve product consistency.
  • Support commercialization activities by providing quality and sensory guidance during product development, reformulation, line extensions, and process optimization initiatives.
  • Maintain documentation, records, and reporting systems related to quality and sensory assessments, investigations, and improvement projects.
  • Provide training, coaching, and technical support to cross-functional teams on quality standards, sensory methodologies, product evaluation techniques, and best practices.
  • Participate in internal audits, compliance assessments, and quality system reviews to ensure adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing product quality, ingredient performance, sensory excellence, operational efficiency, and consumer satisfaction.
  • Influence strategic quality and sensory initiatives by leveraging technical expertise, consumer insights, and data analytics to drive informed decision-making and business results.

What are we looking for?

  • BS degree in Chemistry, Food Science, Food Safety, Engineering or related technical field
  • 3 years of food manufacturing experience in a responsible position related to food safety or Quality and food safety management system and or a combination of education and 5+ years demonstrated success in relevant field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Chemistry, Food Science, Food Safety, Engineering or related technical field
  • 2 years of food plant experience in a responsible position related to food safety or Quality and food safety management system
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities in leading a team
  • Demonstrated leadership of robust internal audit program
  • Demonstrated success with Food safety risk, identification and management, HACCP and prerequisite controls
  • Proven application of quality tools, food science, and statistics
  • Demonstrated capability to manage multiple priorities
  • Proven leadership within a team and demonstrated ability to lead change
  • Exhibited understanding of GMP, GLP, food allergens, pest control, sanitation, and food safety regulations
  • Expert knowledge of Food Safety Standards, procedures and legislation
  • Ability to work effectively in cross functional teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Strong presentation Skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success with Food safety risk, identification and management, HACCP and prerequisite controls
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Product Engineering Formation Expert

Department: Americas Application Engineering

Primary Purpose:

This position is responsible for organizational technical expertise for Formation chemical conversion processes. This role will serve as the technical SME for the assigned chemical processes for the entire product life cycle, cradle to grave, including development, launch and production.

Primary Duties:

  • Consolidate formation program among plants for optimization practices.
  • Support technical knowledge for Materials/process/design physics & chemistry (lead-acid battery electrochemistry, synthesis & characterization of materials related to battery industry & in the interaction with lead alloys mechanics, and corrosion resistance).

  • Follow up & development of designs/formulations of lead-acid battery formation from prototype phase up to project launching and validation. Following PPAP automotive rules per customer, cost & time requirements. Harmonize existing designs of formation for the global Clarios organization, keeping an overview over Americas regions to enable supply safety combined with lowest cost.
  • Lead & support global test methods and specifications for analysis and valuation of Formation at lab & manufacturing levels within the organization or for external suppliers or customers according to the automotive industry.
  • Knowledge of patent applications and Patent claims.
  • Support failure analysis and optimization of product/process/ formation for customers & manufacturing plants using lab techniques, statistical tools (six sigma) and quality tools for problem solving (5s, KT, 8D, 5 whys, and others). Contribute to customer requirements clarification, support IAM, OEM engineering teams in customer discussions / meetings.
  • Support the entire life battery cycle on strategic projects for suppliers and customers project launching.
  • Interaction with external institutions and Clarios internal engineering academy for training purposes.
  • Support DFMEA review of assigned projects.
  • Manage and contribute for keeping the Design Guidelines updated.
  • Identify best practices, share, document and implement among regions.

Qualifications:

  • MSc Grad degree in chemistry / physics / Materials engineering
  • scientific maturity / technical expertise …
  • Engineering experience in lead acid battery for automotive industry in Materials, chemistry, R&D, lab testing, etc.
  • Fundamental understanding and experience of Processes / Materials / design Physics and Chemistry and lead alloy parts in the interaction with lead-acid battery electrochemistry. Understanding and experience of lead alloys for molded and hard formed lead parts.
  • Expertise on advanced Pb-acid battery material/chemistry/physicist for lead-acid battery materials & electrochemistry assessment.
  • Experience with statistical tools (DOEs, six sigma) and quality tools (5s, KT, 8D, etc.) for failure analysis and problem solving with suppliers and customers.
  • Experience with product launching according to automotive industry rules (PPAP, APQP, DVP&R, DV/PV builds, data analysis, problem solving, design review etc.).

Job Description:

Note: Fidelity is not providing immigration sponsorship for this position

The Fidelity Intern Program (FIDTERN Program)

Fidelity’s full-time, paid, 10-week FIDTERN Program offers students the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, real-world work and projects as valued members of a dedicated team.

Our program is designed to provide students with firsthand experience of what it’s like to work here full-time. We deliver a best-in-class program experience to ensure interns feel a sense of belonging and community, while receiving critical training and development to be a future Fidelity associate. Here’s the experience you can expect to have as a FIDTERN:

  • Professional & Financial Development Sessions: Join exclusive webinars designed to equip you with essential skills for both your career and personal growth! Learn directly from senior leaders, sharpen your professional communication, explore strategies for maintaining well-being in the workplace, and build financial confidence through expert-led financial literacy workshops.

  • Mentorship: Opt-in to our intern mentorship program and connect with experienced professionals who will support your growth and help you navigate your career journey.

  • Regional Events: Build connections with leaders and fellow interns through engaging onsite experiences and unwind with your peers at fun local outings (like go-karting, pickleball, or bowling).

The Role

Our Audit, Risk, and Compliance groups protect the interests of our customers, associates, and Fidelity's outstanding brand. Internship opportunities include roles such as Corporate Audit, IT Audit, Enterprise Risk, Technology Risk, Enterprise Compliance, Compliance Technology and Fidelity Global Security (FGS). This role is for candidates interested in playing a key role in protecting the firm, proactively identifying issues before they arrive at our doorstep, and being the ethical standard of the organization.

Audit is a great role for students who are problem solvers, possess intellectual curiosity, and enjoy analyzing information & complex data sets. As an Audit Intern, you will gain exposure by working directly on audit throughout planning, testing/data analysis, and documenting plus communicating findings to management.

Risk is a great role for students who want to focus on the regulatory and operational side of managing financial risk, flagging accounts with suspicious withdrawal/funds, and/or potentially investigate financial crimes.

Compliance is a great role for students interested in navigating and managing the regulatory landscape, diving into policies and procedures, risk assessment, and reporting. ​

Fidelity Global Security (FGS) is a great role for students who are interested in criminal justice/security and want to contribute to keeping our Fidelity associates safe in collaboration with our team of Fidelity security professionals.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

  • Analytical and critical thinking

  • Problem-solving skills

  • Ability to evaluate information, identify patterns, and draw logical conclusions

  • Strong presentation, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Attention to detail and ability to organize and manage multiple priorities.

  • Curiosity and a desire to understand how businesses operate and manage risk.

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

  • Current college student (undergraduate or graduate) who will return to coursework after their summer internship

  • Availability for entire 10-week program from June 7th, 2027 - August 13th, 2027

description:
Job Title: Retail Team Lead (RTL)

Department: Donated Goods Program(DGP)

Reports To: Store Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt



Mission Support:

Goodwill Houston (GWH) is leading change, connecting people, and improving the potential for the future of work. We educate, train, and hire individuals with barriers to employment to help them thrive. We connect people, families, and communities to improve lives and meet today's and tomorrow's workforce needs. Powered, in part, by donations and retail customers, we change lives through the power of work.

Position Summary:

Under the leadership of the Store Manager and District Director, the RTL will assist with the day-to-day operations and management of the store and donation area. To ensure efficient and cost-effective operation through world-class customer service, processing donated goods, quality control, and maintaining a productive workforce.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

· Assume management responsibilities in the absence of the Manager or Assistant Manager, including opening/closing and all day-to-day store operations.

· Manage and influence the team by communicating clear company goals daily, weekly, and monthly.

· Accurately and efficiently complete all sales transactions and maintain proper cash accountabilities at POS registers/safe.

· Supervise and assist with the training and development of Team Members.

· Ensure the proper handling and processing of incoming donation flow in and out of the store according to GWH policies and procedures.

· Help ensure the timeliness of proper apparel and hard goods rotation according to GWH policies and procedures.

· Accurately operate store systems and ensure financial and statistical counts are completed (donor counts, production standards, etc.).

· Performs other duties as assigned by Management.

Additional Responsibilities

· Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism in communication, attitude, and teamwork with customers and team members.

· Ability to multi-task, make quick decisions, adapt to change, and work in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

· Adheres to all GWH Policies & Procedures, Loss Prevention & Safety Regulations, and GWH Guiding Principles.

· Must be punctual and have dependable attendance, and maintain an appropriate appearance.

· Must safely conduct work; maintain good housekeeping standards, have all aisles and pathways to fire exits clear and free from clutter, and keep work areas neat and clean.

· Adheres to local, state, and federal laws and regulations.



Minimum Qualifications:

· High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

· One (1) to two (2) years of retail sales experience is preferred.

· Management/Supervisor with one (1) or more years of experience is preferred.

· Basic computer skills.

· Good time management and organizational skills.

· Ability to communicate and interact well with a variety of personality types.

· Ability to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business, including holiday, evening, overnight, and weekend shifts.

· Must have reliable transportation.



Key Performing Indicators (KPI):

1. Transaction Value (Assigned District vs. goal)

2. Donor Value (Assigned District vs. budget)

3. Donors Integrity and Growth (Assigned District vs. budget)

4. Budget Sales vs. Actual Sales (Assigned District vs. budget)

5. Payroll as a Percent of Revenue (Assigned District vs. goal)

6. Budgeted Profit vs. Actual Profit (Assigned District vs. goal)

7. Retention Rate (Measured by annual leadership retention vs. LY, 30-New Hire date vs. goal, and Annual Retention Rate vs. LY)

8. Customer Service (Feedback from team, secret shopper, and donor ratings for assigned district)

9. Change Roundup as a % of Transactions (>30% and higher than the previous year)

10. Active with Zero hours TMs vs Goal (Zero (0) – 28+ days) (Assigned District)

11. Administration - Performance management/Training (Assigned District at <5%)

12. Reporting-, Team Meeting Minutes, Safety, Over/Short (Assigned District)

13. Safety – 95% quarterly safety metric score

14. GWH LMS Training completion

The ability to continuously stand/walk for the duration of the shift, frequently push/pull, occasionally bend/stoop/crawl/kneel/reach above shoulders, and climb a ladder. Able to lift, up to, 40 lbs. (fixture parts, cartons of product).



An indoor work environment with exposure to outside temperatures. The noise level in the normal work environment is usually moderate.

description:
Total Number of Openings

1

Chevron is one of the world's leading energy companies, with approximately 60,000 employees working in countries around the world. Chevron explores, produces, and transports crude oil and natural gas; refines, markets and distributes fuels and other energy products; manufactures and sells petrochemical products; generates power; and develops future energy resources, organized in four main divisions: Upstream, Midstream, Downstream & Chemicals & New energies.

Upstream division is responsible for the exploration and production of oil and natural gas worldwide. Chevron has an exceptionally strong portfolio with key operations in the world's most important oil and gas regions.

As part of Global Business Support Center located in Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), Upstream Finance Department provides financial and accounting services to Chevron Global Upstream organization around the world, covering a wide range of activities.

Upstream International Tax & Royalties Team

Our team provides tax and royalties support to Chevron's international Upstream operations. We are responsible for indirect tax compliance, primarily for Argentina and Venezuela; as well as filing and review of Oil & Gas Royalties for Argentina Upstream operations. Additionally, we support international Exploration entities with direct tax processes, including tax accounting, deferred income tax and related compliance activities. The team also supports regulatory compliance, audits, controls, process improvement and digital transformation initiatives

The Senior Tax Analyst will serve as a key technical reference for Argentina Tax, providing oversight across tax compliance, Oil & Gas royalties, audits, internal controls and special projects. The role combines strong technical expertise with business partnership, sound judgment and the ability to drive improvements across processes and stakeholders.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to the following:

· Lead the preparation, review, filing and payment coordination of tax returns, tax informative regimes, and related reporting requirements.

· Oversee Argentina Oil & Gas royalties' calculations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

· Prepare, maintain, and control proper information to respond to requirements and/or audits from the national or provincial tax authorities, or other government entities.

· Interpret Argentina tax legislation, assess business impacts, and provide clear guidance to the Tax Team Lead, team members and business partners.

· Review SOX tax controls, tax account reconciliations, and close activities; identify risk areas and recommend corrective actions.

· Act as a technical reference for the team by supporting training, coaching, and knowledge transfer.

· Lead or support cross-functional projects and drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

· Operate with appropriate autonomy and professional judgment, escalating matters when management involvement is required.

Required Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree in accounting

· 10+ years of experience in tax compliance, tax accounting, and tax advisory roles.

· Experience preparing and reviewing Argentina tax returns and related compliance processes.

· Experience managing tax audits.

· Strong knowledge of Argentina tax legislation and compliance requirements.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

· Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability to assess complex situations and apply sound professional judgment.

· Experience mentoring, training, or supporting development of team members.

· Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

· Intermediate to advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications:

· Big Four experience.

· Experience in the Oil & Gas industry.

· Experience with deferred income tax, tax accounting, and international tax compliance processes.

· Experience participating in process transformation, digitalization, or automation initiatives.

Chevron participates in E-Verify in certain locations as required by law.

title: Senior Security Engineer, CPU and Platform Security Validation
description:
About SiFive

As the pioneers who introduced RISC-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC-V to the highest performance and most data-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC-V has no limits.

At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.

Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.

Are you ready?

To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.

Job Description:

The Role
We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to validate CPU, firmware, and operating-system security across pre-silicon emulation platforms and post-silicon hardware. You will work directly with security architects and designers in France and collaborate with CPU design, firmware, software, and system validation teams.

Responsibilities

  • Translate security architecture requirements into test plans, threat models, and coverage goals for system level validation purposes.

  • Develop tests for CPU security features such as SVUKTE, TRNG, CFI, privilege separation, isolation, and memory protection.

  • Validate Secure Boot, measured boot, TPMs, hardware Root of Trust, secure firmware update, key handling, and debug security.

  • Execute tests on emulation, FPGA, and virtual platforms, or reproduce and debug issues on real chips.

  • Localize failures across tests, firmware, operating systems, hardware, and architecture; drive issues to root cause.

  • Develop automated validation tools and regression suites using scripting languages.

  • Document evidence and communicate security risks, coverage, and debug results to global stakeholders.

Requirements
Must Have

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in CPU, SoC, firmware, platform security, or silicon validation.

  • Strong CPU security knowledge, including SVUKTE, TRNG, CFI, privilege, isolation, and hardware-assisted security.

  • Hands-on experience with Secure Boot, Root of Trust, TPMs, measured boot, secure firmware, or debug security.

  • Strong Linux security and kernel-hardening knowledge.

  • Experience developing security tests and debugging hardware/software failures.

  • Proficiency in Python and C/C++; ability to read low-level code or assembly.

  • Experience with pre-silicon emulation or FPGA platforms and post-silicon validation.

  • Strong English communication skills and experience working across international teams.

Nice to Have

  • RISC-V architecture and privilege-specification experience.

  • Experience with Ghostwriter attacks, threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, fuzzing, fault injection, or side-channel testing.

  • Experience with UEFI, Trusted Firmware-A, OpenSBI, U-Boot, or trusted execution environments.

Additional Information:

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

Taiwan

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

An exciting opportunity has become available in the Model Risk Office (MRO) within Lloyds Banking Group’s Risk division.

This is an excellent opportunity to accelerate your modelling expertise, by developing a comprehensive understanding of the model lifecycle, and building a strong network across the organisation.

  • Evaluate model build, calibration, operation, usage, reporting, governance, and overall fitness for purpose

  • A good understanding of modelling and validation principles including awareness regulatory requirements.

  • Ideally, knowledge of banking and risk management, and an interest in developing your expertise across treasury and risk models in a changing regulatory environment

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to provide clear, constructive challenge and influence a range of stakeholders

  • A proactive and ethical approach, demonstrating sound judgement, resilience in solving complex problems, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes with integrity.

This is a place for you:

title: Automation Lead
description:
Automation Lead

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for identifying, designing, and delivering automation solutions across finance to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve overall process efficiency. It supports a broad portfolio of initiatives spanning finance operations and reporting workflows, including workflow automation, RPA, data automation, and emerging AI tools. The role balances strategic responsibilities, such as defining the automation roadmap, standards, and pipeline, with hands-on execution, including solution delivery, release management, and driving adoption. It also promotes an “automation by design” approach, building scalable, reusable solutions with embedded controls and clear intake processes, while ensuring appropriate human oversight where needed.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Own the automation pipeline: Lead intake and feasibility assessments to build a prioritized backlog aligned with business value.

  • Design automation solutions: Translate business needs into scalable automation designs, partnering with IT or engineering for implementation when needed.

  • Set automation standards: Establish best practices for documentation, testing, monitoring, and exception handling.

  • Track value and performance: Define and monitor KPIs such as hours saved, cycle time reduction, and defect reduction.

  • Ensure controls and compliance: Embed strong controls into solutions to avoid audit or compliance risks.

  • Drive adoption and hypercare: Partner with business teams to ensure successful rollout, training, post-go-live stability monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work closely with Finance, IT, Controls, Data, and Governance teams to align priorities and delivery.

  • Lead through influence: Coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors, prioritizing high-impact opportunities and demonstrating measurable outcomes to leadership.

Who You Are:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience: 3–10 years in automation, process improvement, or finance transformation roles.

  • Proven experience delivering automation solutions into production with measurable business impact.

  • Strong skills in process mapping, diagnostics, and simplification, including assessment of control impacts before automation.

  • Experience working in matrixed environments alongside IT, compliance, and business stakeholders.

  • Solid understanding of the automation lifecycle (design, build, test, deploy, monitor) and ability to quantify benefits and prioritize opportunities.

  • Controls-aware mindset (audit trails, approvals, exception handling), strong communication skills to drive adoption, and ability to influence behavior change.

Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. Ocular Therapeutix has built a robust product pipeline of drug delivery solutions developed to reduce the complexity and burden of the current standard of care and position itself to become a leader in the ophthalmic space.

Position Summary:

As a Corporate Account Director, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless access and fostering growth for our company's products within designated corporate accounts. As an individual contributor at the director level, your primary focus will be developing and executing strategic account strategies while establishing and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders, including influential physicians and management at the C-suite level within the account's organization. Be cognizant of overall impact of decisions working closely with commercial operations to ensure financial accountability (i.e. GTN, potential ASP impact)

This includes implementing account strategies, leveraging available resources effectively, and partnering with sales and reimbursement in a compliant manner as needed.

Create forums to ensure proactive communication across internal functions.
  • Compensation: Compensation for this role is reflective of both the strategic and execution requirements and is a combination of MBO’s and overall account production

Qualifications:

  • 8-10+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, healthcare, market access, or strategic account management experience.

  • Experience managing large corporate accounts, IDNs, GPOs, health systems, ASC networks, or physician organizations.

description:

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About the position:

A Data Analyst is responsible for gathering, analyzing and problem solving as it relates to data, types of data, and relationships among data elements within a business system or IT system and with business domain expertise. A Senior Data Analyst provides expertise on how Business workflows map to data, and how data can be integrated to build reusable data products. A Senior Data Analyst will serve as a subject matter expert for delivery teams.
The Senior Data Analyst will play a key role in transforming complex data into actionable insights to support business decision-making processes. This role requires advanced knowledge of data analysis, visualization, and cloud data services, particularly within Microsoft Azure and the Power Platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and data scientists to develop meaningful reports and dashboards, leveraging tools such as Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau. A Senior Data Analyst will serve as a subject matter expert for delivery teams.

Key responsibilities:

• Data Analysis: Extract, analyze, and interpret complex datasets using Microsoft Azure Services to derive insights that drive strategic business decisions.
• Data Modeling: Develop and maintain data models using Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL Database to facilitate data analysis and reporting.
• Data Visualization: Create interactive dashboards and reports using tools like Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau to effectively communicate data insights to stakeholders.
• Azure Services: Leverage Azure Data Lake for efficient data storage and retrieval, ensuring data consistency and quality.
• Power Platform Integration: Utilize Microsoft Power Platform to automate processes, build data-driven workflows, and enhance the efficiency of data analysis tasks.
• Collaboration with Teams: Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and provide analytical support that meets their needs.
• Data Quality and Governance: Implement and maintain data quality checks and data governance practices to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
• Mentoring: Mentor junior data analysts and provide guidance on best practices for data analysis and visualization.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4-7 years of experience in data analysis, data visualization, or related fields.

  • Technical Skills:

  • Microsoft Azure Services: Advanced proficiency in Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, and Azure SQL Database.

  • Data Visualization Tools: Expertise in Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau for building insightful dashboards and reports.

  • SQL Skills: Strong skills in SQL for querying, transforming, and analyzing data.

  • Power Platform: Experience using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps, to create automated workflows and enhance data processes.

  • Data Modeling: Experience in creating and maintaining data models that facilitate analytics and reporting.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns and trends within large datasets.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data insights to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

  • Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team, collaborating with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.

  • Certifications: Microsoft certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate or Azure Data Scientist Associate are highly preferred.

  • Experience with Big Data Technologies: Exposure to big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, or Databricks.

  • Programming Skills: Knowledge of programming languages like Python or R for advanced data analysis.

  • Experience with Data Governance: Familiarity with data governance practices and data privacy regulations, ensuring compliance in data handling.Selection Criteria:

  • Technical Skills:

  • Microsoft Azure Proficiency:

  • Demonstrated expertise in working with Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, and Azure SQL Database to manage and analyze large datasets.

  • Ability to leverage Azure services for efficient data storage, processing, and analysis.

  • Data Visualization Expertise:

  • Strong experience in creating interactive and insightful dashboards using Power BI, Spotfire, and Tableau.

  • Ability to translate complex data insights into visually appealing and understandable formats for stakeholders.

  • Power Platform Integration:

  • Proficiency in using Power Platform tools, such as Power Automate and Power Apps, to build workflows that streamline data analysis and business processes.

title: Auto Physical Damage Claim Representative
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$55,200.00 - $91,100.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Claim Rep, Auto Damage, you will support our customers and third-party claimants through the claims process when they experience vehicle damage. In this role, you will serve as a trusted resource and will deliver exceptional customer service by providing clear explanations of policies and coverage options while investigating and evaluating claims to ensure accurate payments.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage auto physical damage claims from first notice of loss through resolution and settlement, handling low to moderate complexity cases, including total loss evaluations and vehicle repair oversight. Types of claims are typically multi-vehicle (2 or more cars) auto damage with unclear liability and no injuries.
  • Evaluate and analyze policy terms, conditions, and exclusions to determine coverage, liability, and damage; negotiate equitable settlements within your authority.
  • Coordinate and partner with appraisal team(s) and repair facilities to obtain necessary information and ensure thorough accurate damage assessments and timely claim resolution.
  • Leverage all internal and external resources to conduct thorough investigations to gather all relevant facts accurately document findings in the claim management system and maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Determine settlement amounts based upon appraisal estimate, negotiate and convey claim settlements within authority limits to insureds and claimants. As appropriate, write denial letters, Reservation of Rights and other necessary correspondence to insureds and claimants.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, and internal stakeholders.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers’ requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Two years of auto claim handling experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Proficient in claims management systems with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year auto claim handling experience or comparable claim experience, or successful completion of Travelers Auto Claim Representative training program.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

title: Staff Cloud and AI Solutions Architect
location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

Posting summary

Production Mapping is looking for a Staff Cloud and AI Solutions Engineer to build and scale future-ready mapping foundations that support the expansion of our mapping databases and the next generation of software-defined vehicle experiences.

This role will combine deep software and cloud engineering with data-platform architecture and practical AI enablement. You will design scalable foundations for mapping data, create reusable services and workflows, and help transform the team’s existing knowledge, tools, and engineering practices into secure, production-ready Agentic AI solutions. Your work will help mapping teams move faster, improve data quality and traceability, and use cloud-based intelligence in their day-to-day development and operations.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can work across data engineering, backend services, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows. Experience in automotive, mapping, ADAS, SDV, robotics, or other data-intensive domains is highly desirable.

The role

As a Staff Cloud and AI Solutions Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the solutions, services, and engineering patterns that make Production Mapping data more scalable, trusted, discoverable, and useful.

You will help define the architecture for a future-ready mapping database ecosystem, including data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, quality, lineage, governance, and delivery to downstream consumers. You will also identify practical opportunities to apply AI and agentic workflows to engineering work, using the knowledge base that already exists across documentation, code, metadata, operational data, and team practices.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad influence and hands-on delivery responsibility. You will set technical direction, build reference implementations, establish reusable standards, and partner with multiple teams to move solutions from concept to production. Success will come from creating durable capabilities that teams adopt—not from becoming the owner of every mapping system or every AI initiative.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve the target architecture for scalable mapping data foundations, including data models, storage patterns, ingestion and transformation pipelines, APIs, data access, metadata, lineage, quality controls, and governance.

  • Build, productionize, and scale reusable cloud-native solutions and services that support the growth, availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency of mapping databases.

  • Establish data contracts, validation frameworks, observability, and operational standards that make mapping data trustworthy and easier to consume across engineering teams.

  • Design and implement cloud-first solutions using infrastructure as code, automated deployment, containerized services, CI/CD, monitoring, and production-readiness practices.

  • Partner with map creation, map delivery, validation, simulation, embedded software, data science, and platform teams to understand their data needs and deliver integrated solutions.

  • Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI to everyday engineering workflows, including data discovery, technical search, map-data analysis, validation support, diagnostics, release readiness, incident triage, and engineering productivity.

  • Design and productionize knowledge-grounded Agentic AI solutions that can use approved documentation, code, metadata, telemetry, and operational knowledge to support multi-step engineering tasks.

  • Help define the architecture and operating model for smart agents, including retrieval, tool use, orchestration, access controls, evaluation, observability, human oversight, and safe deployment.

  • Create patterns that allow AI agents and data services to scale reliably in the cloud across environments and teams.

  • Build reference implementations and reusable frameworks so teams can adopt cloud, data, and AI solutions without repeatedly solving the same foundational problems or creating unnecessary central dependencies.

  • Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and focused technical workshops across teams; clarify ownership boundaries and resolve cross-team technical seams.

  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design feedback, code reviews, and examples of strong engineering practices.

  • Balance near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, solution simplification, security, reliability, and responsible use of AI.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

  • Demonstrated experience providing senior technical leadership across architecture, design, implementation, and production operations.

  • Strong experience with cloud-native and distributed systems, including scalable services, asynchronous or event-driven workflows, data-intensive applications, and reliability engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, containers or Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, cloud security, and production operations.

  • Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, Java, C++, or a comparable production language.

  • Experience designing data platforms, data services, or large-scale data pipelines, including data modeling, storage, transformation, APIs, data quality, and governance.

  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, or workflow automation to practical software engineering or business problems.

  • Understanding of Agentic AI or multi-step workflow patterns, including tool integration, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and access control.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying on formal organizational authority.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in automotive, software-defined vehicles, ADAS, autonomous driving, mapping, geospatial systems, robotics, simulation, or another safety- and scale-sensitive domain.

  • Experience building or expanding mapping databases, geospatial data platforms, map-production pipelines, map validation systems, or data-delivery services.

  • Experience with Azure, Databricks, Terraform, Kubernetes, Spark or PySpark, Kafka or other event-streaming technologies, and modern data-lake or lakehouse architectures.

  • Experience with vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs, metadata platforms, document intelligence, or knowledge-grounded AI applications.

  • Experience designing and operating internal developer platforms, engineering productivity tools, or self-service cloud capabilities.

  • Experience with model-training, simulation, offline analytics, digital-twin, or other high-volume data consumers.

  • Experience defining AI quality, security, privacy, governance, and responsible-use practices for internal engineering tools.

  • Experience scaling reusable engineering capabilities across multiple teams and managing tradeoffs among delivery speed, performance, reliability, and cost.

What will make you successful

  • You are a builder who can move between architecture, code, infrastructure, data, and operational outcomes.

  • You can distinguish a reusable engineering problem from a one-off team problem and focus effort where it creates the most leverage.

  • You are comfortable working with ambiguity and turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable products with measurable adoption.

  • You bring strong systems thinking: data quality, security, observability, reliability, cost, and user experience are considered together.

  • You communicate clearly, create alignment, and use influence rather than authority to drive adoption.

  • You value practical delivery and can simplify complex technical choices without losing the long-term architectural direction.

title: Journeyman Records Management Analyst
description:
Amentum is seeking a Records Management Analyst to support the Records Management Group (RMG) for a US government customer. This person will ensure the RMG follows the Federal Records Management Act and all related statutes, federal regulations, and customer and Intelligence Community (IC) policies and procedures. This includes but is not limited to requirements set forth in the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), United States Code (USC), and National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) mandates. The RMG helps train and assist the customer workforce to meet the requirements set forth by the CFR, USC, and NARA mandates.

Further responsibilities include the following:

  • Aid in the development of a Records Control Schedule (RCS), support offices who have created digital and paper records, guiding them on RM best practices throughout the record life cycle.
  • Implement customer RCSs to address records from creation to disposition for both paper and electronic records. Evaluate and institute customer RCSs and coordinate RCSs with NARA. Support the transition to a media-neutral, RCS approach that will incorporate current customer office and organizational structure.
  • Perform physical records archiving as directed by lead contractors and Government staff.
  • Draft or review, update, and deliver content for training on customer records management.
  • Deliver customer support and training on records management to customer personnel.
  • Consult and coordinate with Intelligence Community (IC) elements on the development and consistent implementation of IC records management policies and procedures, utilize proper handling of classified records and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) records, and support the Information Management Council (IMC) and other IC records management committees.
  • Advise government offices in their efforts to reorder and clean their Shared Drive and support the implementation of a customer electronic records management system (ERMS).
  • Develop and implement plans for customer essential records identification and protection.
  • Provide inputs to annual compliance reports as directed by the government staff.
  • Support records management system reviews and implementation.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph is required.

  • Required BA/BS with 3+ years of experience, OR no degree and 9 years of experience.
  • Experience supporting IC records management requirements to ensure compliance with federal statutes and organizational policies.
  • Experience implementing RCS, developing an office file plan (OFP), and aid in records disposition determination in conjunction with NARA guidance.
  • Possess organizational skills with experience developing and maintain SOPs for use within a customer organization.
  • Comfortable with written and spoken communication across all levels of government, including large groups and senior leadership personnel.

title: Software Engineer, Simulation Scalability - Sim RIM (Release and Incident Management) Focus
description:
Job Description

Vacancy Status:

No: This posting is not for an existing vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications. (New Head Count)

AI Disclosure:

As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

Remote/Hybrid: candidates can be considered anywhere in the country of work, but if someone is within 80 KM of a hub, they are required to be onsite 3 days a week.

About the Team

The Simulation Scalability team builds the core systems, frameworks, and workflows that ensure simulation runs reliably, efficiently, and at scale. We work across all simulation products and pipelines, addressing systemic issues, improving release quality, and strengthening the foundations that enable teams to iterate quickly and confidently.

Our work spans systems architecture, software engineering, release management, and quality strategy, with a mission to increase reliability, throughput, and operational excellence across the entire simulation ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Release Management & Quality Strategy

  • Lead improvements to the end‑to‑end simulation release process, ensuring it is predictable, well‑defined, and continuously improving.

  • Define and drive the simulation-wide quality and test strategy, including shift‑left testing, automated validation, and early‑signal integration.

  • Strengthen release readiness criteria, quality gates, and verification workflows across multiple simulation teams.

  • Partner with product teams to reduce regressions, shorten validation cycles, and ensure higher-confidence releases.

Scalability, Reliability & Stability

  • Improve the performance, stability, and reliability of simulation frameworks and core tooling used at scale.

  • Identify systemic bottlenecks in the simulation stack and deliver architectural improvements that increase throughput and reduce operational friction.

  • Enhance simulation exit codes, error attribution, and debugging workflows to improve diagnosability and reduce wasted compute.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish and enforce best practices for simulation incident management, improving resilience, recovery time, and overall operational readiness.

  • Improve signals, metrics, and monitoring patterns that help teams identify release-related issues earlier and more accurately.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with simulation feature teams, infrastructure groups, and platform stakeholders to align on scaling needs, test coverage gaps, and systemic quality improvements.

  • Work backward from organizational-level problems to design solutions that raise simulation quality and reliability across all workflows.

Who You Are

We’re looking for engineers with depth in at least one of the following areas, and interest in growing across the rest:

1. Release Engineering & Quality Strategy

  • Experience improving release workflows, verification processes, or quality gates.

  • Ability to spot gaps in test coverage, validation workflows, or release signals and drive systemic improvements.

2. Systems & Solutions Architecture

  • Ability to analyze complex simulation or compute workflows and design scalable, maintainable solutions.

  • Skilled at identifying recurring failure patterns and eliminating systemic causes.

3. Software Development

  • Strong coding fundamentals with experience building production-quality services, frameworks, or tools.

  • Background improving reliability, performance, or developer experience in distributed systems.

We welcome candidates who bring strong expertise in one area and are eager to expand into the others.

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in Python and/or C++

  • Experience with build and release management, including CI/CD

  • Strong software architecture skills, with experience building distributed systems

  • Experience supporting production systems and optimizing performance

  • Experience with release management systems and integration/regression testing

  • Strong hands-on coding and problem-solving abilities

  • Experience with incident management.

Compensation:
